title: Tax Intern
description:
DeLeon & Stang, CPAs & Advisors is a professional services firm focused on helping our clients succeed in every meaningful way—from navigating complex tax requirements to making smarter business decisions. For more than 40 years, we've built a culture centered on professional expertise, collaboration, flexibility, and providing our team with opportunities to learn and grow.
We're looking for motivated accounting students to join our Tax team for the 2027 tax season. This is a hands-on opportunity to gain real-world public accounting experience while working alongside experienced tax professionals and contributing as an integral member of our team.


What You'll Do
As a Tax Intern, you'll work under the guidance of our experienced tax professionals and gain exposure to a variety of tax and accounting engagements. Responsibilities may include:
• Assist with the preparation of individual and business tax returns
• Support tax, accounting, and other client projects as assigned
• Learn and utilize the Firm's tax and accounting software and processes
• Communicate with team members regarding assigned work and client matters
• Work within established deadlines and time budgets
• Maintain the confidentiality of Firm and client information
• Develop professional communication, organization, and time-management skills
• Participate as an active member of the Tax team throughout busy season
• Gain hands-on experience using AI-powered tools to support tax research, prepare workpapers, better understand tax law, and assist with client engagements.


What We're Looking For
• Current junior or senior pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Accounting; qualified sophomores with relevant accounting coursework may also be considered
• Completion of foundational accounting coursework, with an interest in applying classroom knowledge in a professional environment
• Interest in pursuing a career in public accounting
• Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn
• Professional, positive attitude and strong communication skills
• Ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines
• Availability to work a minimum of 30 hours per week, with flexibility to increase hours as needed during peak tax-season deadlines
• Ability to work in-office at our Frederick, MD or Leesburg, VA location
We will work with interns to establish a consistent schedule around their academic commitments while meeting the minimum weekly hour requirement.


Where Can an Internship at D&S Take You?
Our internship program is designed to give accounting students the opportunity to put what they've learned in the classroom into practice. You'll work alongside experienced tax professionals, contribute to real client engagements, and gain a better understanding of what a career in public accounting looks like.
We also view our internship program as an important part of building our future team. Top-performing interns who are nearing graduation may be considered for full-time Staff Accountant opportunities following graduation, while students continuing their degree may have opportunities to extend their internship or return for a future season.

title: Foreman
description:
Job Summary:

Since 2015, Integrated Scaffolding Concepts (ISC) has provided best-in-class service in the rental, lease, and purchase of commercial and industrial scaffolding. Serving customers across Virginia, Maryland, North Carolina, South Carolina, and Georgia, ISC is committed to delivering safe, efficient, and high-quality solutions through a professional and passionate team.

As we continue to grow, ISC is seeking an experienced Scaffold Foreman to lead and coordinate scaffold crews on commercial and industrial construction projects. This hands-on leadership role is responsible for overseeing the safe and efficient erection, modification, and dismantling of scaffolding systems while ensuring all company and jobsite safety requirements are followed. The ideal candidate will have strong scaffolding experience, proven leadership skills, and the ability to safely work at heights of 90 feet or higher.

Major Duties and Responsibilities:

The duties and responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and scope of work being performed by this position. This is not a complete listing and other duties will be assigned based on the positions role within the business unit.

  • Manages the day-to-day activities of a construction site, including supervising the crew and ensuring work is done according to the plans and specifications.
  • Ensure crew has adequate materials, manpower, and resources.
  • Responsible for ensuring safety requirements, occupational health and quality standards are followed during the cutting, installation, removal, and disposal of insulation.
  • Create and communicate schedules to crew members in a timely manner.
  • Ensures the job site work area is always kept in a clean, organized, and safe manner.
  • Record time and attendance accurately for crew; submit weekly timesheets by the Payroll deadline.
  • Conduct daily briefings with crew to review assigned tasks and priorities, communicate and assess progress towards meeting productivity goals, communicate timelines, troubleshoot issues, and assess resources and support needed.
  • Ensure operations adhere to defined budget and timelines.
  • Train new crew members in accordance with company policy.
  • Communicate and track change orders with the construction manager and project manager.
  • Assess the scope of the job, accurately complete a material take-off, and follow contract documents.
  • Maintains company equipment and company truck
  • Basic carpentry skills, able to lift 80-100 lbs
  • Willing to work weekends, off hour shifts, etc. when needed
  • Must be able to travel to the assigned jobsite, timeliness is a must
  • OSHA 10 training; OSHA 10/ 30+ / CPR/ First Aid
  • Transports and unloads scaffolding equipment at construction sites.
  • Assists with building scaffolding and securely attaching it to buildings or structures.
  • Helps to lay planks and other platforms for workers to stand/walk on.
  • Install fall protection equipment as needed.
  • Hoist and lower materials onto and off scaffolding.
  • Work with crane operators, as needed, to properly rig material onto platforms using equipment.
  • Inspect work daily and perform light maintenance.
  • Use power and hand tools as needed.
  • Breakdown scaffolding when project is complete.
  • Perform all work in accordance with safety requirements and plans/drawings.



Minimum Qualifications:

  • Valid driver’s license/ability to pass a DMV check
  • Authorized to work in the United States
  • Previous scaffolding experience
  • Ability to safely and correctly use and maintain tools and equipment.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and apply information from job orders, work orders, technical drawings, and other plans
  • Demonstrated ability to listen and follow instructions carefully, accurately, and safely
  • Basic math skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Ability to use and maintain tools and equipment safely and correctly
  • Demonstrated commitment to following safety rules



Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bilingual (English, Spanish)
  • Supervisory Experience
  • High school diploma or equivalent (GED or graduation from trade school)



Physical Requirements include but are not limited to the following:

  • Able to work in an outdoor construction work environment with potential exposure to dust, noise, waste, toxic and infectious materials and possible inclement weather conditions.
  • Able to walk, sit, stand, bend, kneel, crouch, crawl, stretch, squat and climb, often in restricted spaces and at great heights.
  • Ability to stand for extended periods of time.
  • Excellent hand-to-eye coordination.
  • Good dexterity and coordination
  • Able to wear required personal protective equipment.
  • Able to work safety with specialized construction equipment, tools, and materials.
  • Able to see, talk and hear in person and phone.
  • Able to lift & carry items up to approximately 100 lbs.
  • Able to understand and execute actions based on verbal and visual instructions.



Core Competencies:

  • Has strong technical knowledge of install process and products we use on what systems.
  • Strong communicator with our Foreman, Estimators, Project Managers, and Customers.
  • Sets project production goals for crew on each job.
  • Self-motivated and hard working. Leads by example.
  • Has the ability to find and secure labor to adequately staff projects.
  • Is an active participant in every project turnover meeting.
  • Has the ability to read contract drawings
  • Positively impacts their projects every day by driving safety, quality and production.
  • Follows up and follows through with Customers, Estimators, and Project Managers on deliverables.
  • Looks for opportunities to become more efficient on each job
  • Questions deviations from plans with customer and communicates to Project Managers and Estimators.
  • Has the ability to identify change orders.
  • Approves time daily.
  • Has a Positive “can do” attitude

Note: Offers will be made based on candidates' qualifications relevant to the position.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

ISC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Buyer
description:
Flō Networks is a leading provider of telecommunications services between the United States and Mexico. We provide connectivity and managed services to Fortune 1000 companies, telecommunications and cable companies through a fiber optic network that extends for 35,000 km between both countries.


We have an immediate need for a Buyer in Ciudad Juarez, Chihuahua, Mexico.


The Role:

The Buyer is responsible for procuring goods and services necessary for the operation and growth of the company. This role involves sourcing suppliers, negotiating contracts, managing purchase orders, and ensuring timely delivery of quality products and services while adhering to company policies and budgetary guidelines. This position requires strong negotiation skills, market knowledge, and the ability to build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers.


The Responsibilities:

  • Sourcing and Supplier Selection: Identify, evaluate, and select qualified suppliers based on price, quality, delivery, and reliability.
  • Negotiation and Contract Management: Negotiate contracts with suppliers to secure the best possible terms and conditions. Manage existing contracts and ensure compliance.
  • Purchase Order Processing: Create, manage and process purchase orders, track deliveries, and resolve any discrepancies.
  • Inventory Management: Monitor inventory levels and ensure that sufficient stock is available to meet operational needs while minimizing carrying costs.
  • Market Research and Analysis: Stay informed about market trends, pricing fluctuations, and new technologies in the telecommunications industry.
  • Cost Savings Initiatives: Identify opportunities to reduce costs through strategic sourcing, negotiation, and process improvements.
  • Supplier Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers to ensure reliable supply and favorable terms.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with other departments, such as engineering, operations, and finance, to understand their needs and ensure timely procurement of goods and services.
  • Compliance: Adhere to company policies and procedures, as well as relevant regulations and ethical standards.
  • Reporting and Documentation: Maintain accurate records of all purchasing activities and provide regular reports to management.


The Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field preferred. Relevant experience may be substituted for a degree.
  • Proven experience in purchasing or procurement, preferably in the telecommunications industry.
  • Strong negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Knowledge of procurement principles, practices, and procedures.
  • Familiarity with contract law and commercial terms.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Proficiency with ERP systems such as Netsuite, Oracle, SAP, etc.
  • Customer service oriented.
  • Negotiation skills with national and foreign suppliers
  • Knowledge of Incoterms, foreign trade and customs.
  • Fluent in both English and Spanish.


Privacy notice: Flō Networks does not use the personal information of job applicants for any purpose other than strictly the recruitment process.

title: Inclusive Education Practitioner
description:

We are currently looking for an Inclusive Education Practitioner to join our STEP IEI team on a full-time indefinite basis. This role offers an excellent opportunity to make a meaningful impact by supporting inclusive education initiatives and empowering individuals to reach their full potential.

Reporting to the Shop Supervisor, the 310T Truck & Coach Technician is responsible for diagnosing, repairing, inspecting, and maintaining heavy trucks, trailers, cranes, and other heavy equipment to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems on heavy trucks, trailers, cranes, and other heavy equipment.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment in accordance with company policies and health and safety regulations.
  • Collaborate effectively with team members while also working independently to meet operational and service deadlines.
  • Ensure all work is completed in compliance with applicable safety standards, legislation, and company procedures.


Qualifications

  • Valid Ontario 310T Truck & Coach Technician License (required).
  • Minimum two (2) years of experience repairing and maintaining heavy trucks and trailers.
  • Strong knowledge of diesel engines, air brake systems, electrical systems, hydraulics, and vehicle diagnostics.

  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
  • Ability to perform physically demanding work, including lifting heavy components and working in various environmental conditions.

Assets

Benefits & Perks

Job Description:

The Software Systems Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining embedded and systems software for both new and existing ASIC-based products. This role involves troubleshooting and debugging hardware and software issues, developing low-level system software components, and collaborating closely with hardware teams to ensure seamless integration and optimal system performance.

The position plays a key role in influencing hardware design decisions, driving innovation, and delivering high-quality software solutions for complex system architectures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead project teams and development partners responsible for software design, analysis, coding, testing, and system integration activities.
  • Manage and strengthen relationships with internal teams and outsourced development partners involved in software systems development.
  • Review and evaluate software designs and project deliverables to ensure compliance with engineering standards, development guidelines, and quality requirements.
  • Provide actionable feedback to improve product quality, reliability, and risk mitigation.
  • Serve as a technical expert and provide software systems leadership across cross-functional programs and engineering initiatives.
  • Drive the adoption and integration of new technologies, methodologies, and best practices within the software systems organization.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering technical growth and knowledge sharing.
  • Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools and practices to improve software development, debugging, testing, diagnostics, and automation while maintaining quality, security, and engineering standards.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline.
  • Typically 5 to 8 years of experience in software engineering, systems engineering, or embedded systems development.

Technical Knowledge and Skills

Software Development and Embedded Systems

  • Strong experience developing systems or embedded software using C and Rust; experience with Go is advantageous.
  • Experience designing, implementing, testing, and integrating software features for embedded or systems-level environments.
  • Strong understanding of software systems architecture, including:
    • Linux kernel drivers
    • Embedded systems

  • Experience integrating software across multiple hardware and platform environments.

Hardware and ASIC Development

  • Proven experience debugging hardware/software interaction issues.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret ASIC designs in detail.
  • Experience working with hardware emulation and simulation environments.

Testing and Quality Assurance

  • Experience defining software testing methodologies and executing comprehensive validation plans.
  • Proficiency with software debugging tools, testing frameworks, automation tools, and test scripting.
  • Ability to identify, diagnose, and resolve complex technical issues effectively.

AI-Assisted Engineering

  • Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools and practices to accelerate software development, debugging, testing, and technical problem-solving.
  • Strong engineering judgment to review, validate, and verify AI-generated outputs while ensuring compliance with quality, security, and technical standards.

Professional Competencies

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to develop innovative technical solutions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and the local language.
  • Ability to effectively present and communicate product architectures, design proposals, technical recommendations, and solution alternatives to engineering teams, stakeholders, and leadership.
  • Demonstrated leadership, collaboration, and mentoring capabilities within complex technical environments.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
Job Title: Systems Engineer

Reports to: Managed Services Operations, Manager

Department: Managed Services


Summary

The Systems Engineer is responsible for the professional and timely resolution of alerts generated from system-managed devices. The complexity of alerts will range from simple to complex based on the specific client environment. This can be from architecture, installation, support and documentation of client systems infrastructure networks; capability with the following technologies from Microsoft to include all facets of a Windows based network. The systems managed devices range from enterprise storage arrays to local area networking equipment as well as virtualized and physical servers. From time to time the Systems Engineer may be tasked to work on projects. These projects can range from simple infrastructure refresh, to Office 365 migrations, to complex infrastructure refresh.



Key Elements of the Role

The primary responsibility of the Systems Engineer is to resolve systems-generated alerts including but not limited to the monitoring of customer backup environments, VMware environments, patch management, and other projects. Additionally, the Systems Engineer will work as an escalation point of the help desk team and take regular calls as needed during high volume periods.

Additionally:

  • Ensure a high level of responsiveness, communication, professionalism, and technical knowledge. Continually striving to improve Helixstorm client experience, perception, and overall satisfaction.
  • Continuous development of both technical support and customer service skill set based on the direction of immediate supervisor.
  • Performing regular maintenance tasks on managed devices to include but not limited to; Firewalls, Switches, Routers, and Server (both physical and virtual) as directed by management.
  • Follow all in place change control procedures.
  • Manage and maintain customer backup environments by performing periodic reviews of the systems and trial restores as needed to validate the backup systems; this includes customer-owned backup systems as well as the Helixstorm Managed Backup and Disaster Recovery service.
  • General understanding of each managed service’s client computing environment as well as the ability to quickly troubleshoot issues as they present themselves.
  • Setup, configuration, and ongoing management of Helixstorm RMM tool(s) to include the deployment of toolset into customer environments during the onboarding process.
  • Identify and resolve the root cause of outages caused by failures of client devices; craft complete post-mortems of the events to be presented to customers as needed directed by management.
  • Coordinate with internal resources as well as third-party services providers to resolve issues as needed; leverage third-party providers to perform mundane work when appropriate.
  • Exercise sound judgment while solving technical issues presented by managed services clients. To include protection of Helixstorm client's employee data during the troubleshooting process.
  • Manage work and time as service tickets in ConnectWise system; prompt and accurate time entry in the systems to ensure accurate client billing as well as contract profitability.
  • Maintain system documentation as needed to support clients; continuously review documentation to ensure it is relevant to current client support requirements.
  • Additional duties and projects as requested by manager or supervisor.

Experience and Background Required


  • Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology/Computer Science or equivalent
  • Three to Five years of hands-on experience administering either a Microsoft and/or VMware computing environment with recent support of Microsoft Office365 and/or Azure deployments
  • Experience with any of the following technologies is a big plus; VMware, Enterprise Storage, Converged and
  • Hyper-converged infrastructure, Linux based networks, Networking, and Firewalls.
  • Current Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer and/or Equivalent Certifications
  • Excellent organizational skills; enthusiasm for multi-tasking, and a TEAM player
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills; both verbally and in writing.
  • The ability to demonstrate, active listening and customer care, within a fast-paced environment
  • Current experience working in the MSP industry not required but a plus
  • Ability to work weekends and/or off-hours as necessary to meet Company's needs.


Physical Demands:

The Systems Engineer is required to talk and hear. The employee is required to sit, stand, walk, reach with arms and hands, climb, balance, twist, lean, move from one location to another and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. Vision abilities required by this job include close and far vision. Ability to, operate a computer keyboard and lift equipment. Will have exposure to glare from a computer. Must be able to lift 25 lbs and travel via automobile up to 25%. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


*Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
The Opportunity

Typography is central to how ideas are communicated. If you're passionate about beautifully created design, have deep curiosity about what AI can do, and take personal responsibility for creating products that people love; then this may be the role for you. Adobe Fonts supports millions of creatives in choosing and using typefaces across fonts.adobe.com, Express, Photoshop, Illustrator, Acrobat, and more Creative Cloud platforms. Our Internal Services team provides the platform engineering and deployment backbone for all of these. We manage CI/CD, deployment approaches, the services and data layers our engineers depend on, our observability and security stance, and increasingly the agentic tools that transform how our entire organization delivers software.

We're seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to lead this exciting journey in our San Francisco location.

What you'll do

  • Own and evolve our deployment platform. Lead strategy for CI/CD, PR environments, and release safety across a mixed fleet that includes containerized services, serverless services, and static front ends.
  • Build the foundation for AI-accelerated development. Help build our agent factory and grow our internal agentic toolkit and skill library.
  • Ship inference applications at scale. Take greenfield services from spec to production and standardize our ML/inference footprint.
  • Modernize our services for the AI era. Identify where an existing service is held back by its current build and lead the fix.
  • Rethink our security posture for agentic threats. Lead how we secure autonomous agents and their tool use.
  • Expose Adobe Fonts to the agentic ecosystem. Extend our Model Context Protocol (MCP) surface and conversational, intent-based font discovery.
  • Work higher up the stack, too. Contribute directly to search, browse, discovery, and the customer-facing experiences our platform powers.
  • Hold ownership over what you deliver to production, encompassing on-call support, incident management, and the reliability of the services and pipelines that the entire organization depends upon.
  • Set technical direction and multiply the team. Write the development docs, run the technical reviews, and mentor engineers.

What we're looking for

Software engineering

  • Deep full-stack fundamentals and craft — build, testing, code quality, code review — plus system development and production maturity: latency, scale, reliability, observability, and on-call ownership.
  • Ships and owns services end to end, and reasons fluently across the whole stack: front end (JavaScript/TypeScript, React or Web Components), application services (Ruby/Rails, Python, Go, and comfort picking up others), and the SRE/config/hardware layer beneath (Terraform, Chef, Kubernetes/Helm, AWS).

Platform & deployment depth

  • Strong CI/CD ownership (Jenkins or equivalent), containerization and orchestration, infrastructure-as-code, and AWS (EC2/ASG, IAM, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFront). Experience making deployment fast, safe, and self-service — ephemeral/preview environments, progressive delivery, rollback strategy.
  • Solid grasp of the data and messaging layers behind real services, including relational, caching, search, and event-driven/pub-sub. You know how to run migrations and upgrades without downtime.

AI/agentic proficiency

  • Hands-on understanding of building AI-enabled systems: agent runtimes, tool calling, MCP, LLM/inference serving, and the infrastructure around them — evaluation, feedback loops, observability, and sandboxed execution.
  • A security outlook for this new surface — you think about how agentic systems fail and get abused, and proactively build guardrails accordingly.

Leadership & scope

  • Track record of delivering high-impact platform work used across multiple teams, leading complex cross-team technical efforts, and balancing near-term delivery with long-term maintainability, security, and operability.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Typically 12+ years of software engineering experience, with demonstrated senior-level impact.

Nice to have

  • Ruby on Rails at scale, and experience decomposing or modernizing a large monolith.
  • GPU/model-serving infrastructure and low-latency inference (e.g. SageMaker, Kubernetes GPU platforms); search-engine internals (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, vector/hybrid search).
  • Experience building developer platforms, internal tooling, or agent harnesses adopted by other teams.
  • Event-driven architectures and secrets-management platforms (Vault, CyberArk).
  • Front-end depth with modern component systems (Web Components/Lit, React/TypeScript, build systems).

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

title: Warehouse Supervisor Hal Far
description:
Warehouse Supervisor


Role purpose

The Warehouse Supervisor is responsible for overseeing daily warehouse operations, ensuring the efficient receipt, storage, and distribution of goods. This role involves managing staff, maintaining inventory accuracy, enforcing safety procedures, and optimizing workflows to support organizational goals. The Warehouse Supervisor serves as a key link between warehouse staff, management, and other departments to ensure smooth operations and timely order fulfilment.


The key duties and responsibilities of the role are as follows:

  • Supervise, train, and motivate warehouse staff to achieve productivity, accuracy, and safety goals.
  • Coordinate and monitor daily warehouse activities including receiving, storing, picking, packing, and shipping.
  • Ensure inventory accuracy through regular cycle counts, audits, and system updates.
  • Maintain compliance with company policies, safety standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Implement and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs) for warehouse efficiency.
  • Oversee equipment use, maintenance, and inspections (e.g., forklifts).
  • Prepare and analyse reports on warehouse performance, productivity, and inventory.
  • Collaborate with procurement, logistics, and customer service teams to resolve order or supply chain issues.
  • Identify areas for process improvement and implement solutions to optimize warehouse operations.
  • Schedule shifts, assign tasks, and manage labour to meet workload demands.


KPIs

  • On time clearing/processing of all demands for allocated area
  • Accuracy
  • Assertiveness with supervised staff


Core competencies, knowledge, and experience

  • 1+ years’ experience in similar role
  • MQF Level 2/3 - Must have a minimum of three ‘O’ Level passes in English and Maths, depending on their role OR MQF level certificate @ level 2.
  • Highly effective supervisory skills and techniques
  • Knowledge of warehouse software packages and MS Office proficiency
  • Ability to input, retrieve and analyse data
  • Hands-on commitment to getting the job done
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Proven ability to direct and coordinate operations
  • Strong organisational and time management skills

Job Description:
This job is responsible for working with Portfolio Manager(s) to establish and execute a risk based coverage plan for a specific portfolio or set of portfolios. Key responsibilities include leading examinations as an Examiner-in-Charge or Assistant Examiner-in-Charge, executing transaction reviews, secondary reviews of transactional testing completed by others, and issues management. Job expectations includes managing field work capacity for exams to ensure accurate and timely execution of Credit Review examinations including work product of new or less experienced team members.

Position Summary:

Credit Review provides an independent assessment of credit decisions and the effectiveness of credit processes across the bank’s credit platform, identifies existing and emerging risks, and reports its findings to various stakeholders, including executive management, the Board of Directors or committee thereof, external auditors and regulatory agencies.

The Portfolio Specialist works together with the Credit Review Portfolio Manager(s) to establish and execute a risk-based coverage plan for a specific portfolio(s) or set of portfolios for assessing the quality of credit decisioning and the effectiveness of credit processes and policies. Key responsibilities include executing transaction reviews, leading examinations as an Examiner-in-Charge (EIC) or Assistant Examiner-in-Charge (AEIC), secondary reviews of transaction testing completed by other examiners and issues management. Manages field work capacity for exams to ensure accurate and timely execution of Credit Review examinations. Coaches, mentors, and reviews the work product of new or junior team members. Establishes working relationships with relevant Risk and regulatory partners to facilitate ongoing dialogue of key issues and emerging risks. Additionally, assist the Portfolio Manager(s) in preparing quarterly Business Assessment Reports and Coverage Plans; maintains awareness of current economic trends and its impact on credit portfolios.

We are looking for a Portfolio Specialist to join our dynamic, high-energy Credit Review team supporting review of credit portfolios consisting of Counterparty Credit Risk exposure (e.g., Hedge Funds, Asset Managers, Central Counterparties etc.) and Structured Financing Transactions globally.

Responsibilities:

  • Participates in exam activities and/or periodically serves as an Examiner-in-Charge , Assistant Examiner-in-Charge or Examiner
  • Performs transactional testing of credit process execution for new and existing clients, providing direct and timely feedback on transactional reviews
  • Provides assistance on portfolio reporting as needed and engages in stakeholder discussions alongside the Portfolio Manager
  • Tracks and follows observations from exams and testing
  • Provides regulator updates on results, and responds to inquiries
  • Engages with Corporate Audit to ensure ongoing awareness of review activity, coordination, and ongoing risk assessment
  • Manages issues, including approval of issue severity ratings, action plans, ongoing issue status tracking, and oversight of issue validation

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 8 – 10 years of commercial credit experience (direct lending, underwriting, workout, credit review, risk management, and/or regulatory)
  • Solid understanding of counterparty credit risk concepts such as limits framework, exposure metrics, margin practices, risk sensitivities, stress testing, trading agreements (ISDA/CSA) etc.
  • Ability to support conclusions through fact-based analysis and ability to influence senior leaders
  • Excellent credit analysis, project management and leadership skill
  • Experience in risk management, lending and/or regulatory agencies
  • Strong organizational and communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Ability to manage multiple complex tasks while delivering high quality results
  • Data manipulation and analysis skills
  • Experience with leading without authority

Desired Qualifications:

title: Senior or Principal Scientist, Formulation and Process Development
description:
We are seeking a Senior or Principal Scientist, Formulation and Process Development, who will report to the Director, Pharmaceutical Development. You will focus on leading formulation and process development work supporting Celcuity’s drug product development and product lifecycle management. The Sr./Principal Scientist role will join a collaborative Pharmaceutical Development group focused on advancing Celcuity’s lead drug candidates. The Sr./Principal Scientist will lead formulation and process development projects for novel formulations targeted toward existing and new indications, as well as projects supporting Celcuity’s existing oncology drug product.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead projects to support development of novel and existing formulations, spanning the product lifecycle including pre-formulation, dosage form selection, formulation development, process development, and manufacturing scale-up.
  • Design, execute, and interpret formulation and process development experiments in an outsourced environment at contract laboratories and CDMOs.
  • Identify and vet new contract organizations to support formulation and process development.
  • Help define & execute the project plans for formulation lifecycle management.
  • Support writing technical sections for intellectual property and regulatory filings.
  • Develop and maintain an in-depth knowledge of formulation development trends, techniques, and technologies.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for formulation development within the Pharmaceutical Development group and the broader Celcuity team.
  • Summarize, document, and present information to subgroup, group, and cross-functional audiences.
  • Other duties as assigned.


Qualifications:

  • Ph.D/M.S./B.S. in Pharmaceutical Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biochemical Engineering, or related fields.
  • 7+ years of experience in pharmaceutical development (preferred 4+ years industry experience for Ph.D; 5+ years for M.S.; 7+ years for B.S.).
  • Demonstrated experience with formulation development and drug product development, preferably for small molecule drugs.
  • Deep understanding of formulation techniques & considerations for sterile, parenteral dosage forms. Knowledge of other dosage forms (e.g., for ophthalmic or oral) is beneficial.
  • Experience with drug device combination products for injectable drug products (e.g., prefilled syringes, autoinjectors) is preferred. Knowledge of other dosage form delivery techniques (e.g., for ophthalmic) is beneficial.
  • Technical expertise in formulation strategies and processes specifically tailored to poorly water-soluble APIs is preferred. Subject matter expertise in one or more of these areas is highly desirable:
    • Nano-milling and nanosuspension formulation.
    • Micro/nano-emulsions.
    • Salt formation and salt screening/selection.
    • Complexation and co-solvency using cyclodextrins or co-solvents.
    • Lyophilization
  • Experience with physicochemical characterization methods for drug substances and drug products.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with ability to influence and build credibility at all levels.
  • Strong interpersonal skills for interacting with colleagues across various levels and functions.
  • Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple processes and documentation requirements.
  • Strong technical and analytical skills with advanced knowledge in MS Office products.
  • Ability to work in a team or independently as required.
  • Outstanding organizational skills with the ability to prioritize.
  • Demonstrated independent and sound decision-making skills; ability to think critically and make decisions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Flexible and willing to learn; able to adapt to business and site needs in a dynamic environment.
  • Maintain a positive, approachable and professional attitude.


About Us:

Celcuity is a commercial biotechnology company pursuing development of targeted therapies for treatment of multiple solid tumor indications. The company's first FDA-approved product is REVTORPYK (gedatolisib), a potent, pan-PI3K and mTORC1/2 inhibitor that comprehensively blockades the PAM pathway. REVTORPYK is approved to treat adults with HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer that progressed on prior endocrine therapy in the metastatic setting.

The Phase 3 VIKTORIA-2 trial is evaluating gedatolisib in combination with palbociclib and either fulvestrant or letrozole for the first-line treatment of HR+/HER2- locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer. A Phase 1/2 clinical trial evaluating gedatolisib in combination with darolutamide in patients with metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer, is ongoing.


Celcuity is an Equal-Opportunity Employer.

Celcuity is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices, and we strive to provide employees with total compensation packages that are competitive. For this role, the anticipated base pay range is $150,000 - $175,000 DOE. The exact base pay offered for this role will depend on various factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s geography, qualifications, skills, and experience.

The successful candidate will be eligible for an annual performance incentive bonus and a new hire equity package. Celcuity also offers various benefits offerings, including, but not limited to, medical, dental, vision insurance, 401(k) match, PTO, and paid holidays.


Notice to Recruiters/Staffing Agencies

Recruiters and staffing agencies should not contact Celcuity through this page. All recruitment vendors (search firms, recruitment agencies, and staffing companies) are prohibited from contacting our hiring manager(s), executive team members, or employees directly.

We require that all recruiters and staffing agencies have a fully executed, formal written agreement on file. Celcuity’s receipt or acceptance of an unsolicited resume submitted by a vendor organization to this website or employee does not constitute an actual or implied contract between Celcuity and such organization and will be considered unsolicited. Celcuity will not be responsible for related fees.

title: Infrastructure Field Technician
description:
Infrastructure Field Technician

Wireless Installs & Tower Work | Entry Level | Overton, NV.

This is an on-site field position. Relocation costs are not covered.


InfoWest is an Internet service provider based in St. George, Utah, serving communities throughout southern and central Utah and Overton, Nevada, with reliable wireless and fiber-optic technology. We recently became a subsidiary of Boston Omaha Corporation (NYSE: BOC) and are growing quickly. As part of that growth, we're looking to add a field technician who can install wireless internet equipment for our customers and support our wireless network from the tower side.

Our objective is simple: to provide the ultimate internet experience, one customer at a time. We're looking for someone who wants to help close the digital divide in our community and give more households access to fast, reliable internet.

About the Role

This is an entry-level opportunity for someone interested in building a career as a wireless infrastructure technician. You'll split your time between customer sites, installing and configuring wireless equipment so people can get online, and our tower sites, where that equipment connects back to our network. You'll train alongside experienced technicians and foremen to learn both sides of the job. This position will also require in office work on multiple programs for billing and scheduling.

What You'll Do

Customer Installations

  • Install and configure wireless customer premise equipment (radios, routers, and related hardware) at homes and businesses.
  • Test signal strength and connection quality, and confirm service is working properly before completing each install.
  • Walk customers through their new equipment and service in clear, friendly terms.
  • Perform routine service calls and troubleshoot wireless connectivity issues.

Tower Work

  • Climb communication towers to install, mount, and align wireless radios and antennas, following all required safety procedures.
  • Perform routine tower maintenance and equipment upgrades.
  • Work safely around tower equipment such as bucket trucks, lifts, and rigging as needed.

Equipment and Vehicles

  • Install battery backups and grounding systems for equipment.
  • Prepare equipment for jobs and maintain company-issued tools, equipment, and vehicles.
  • Drive company vehicles between job sites.

Training and Safety

  • Attend training sessions and professional certification opportunities.
  • Attend safety meetings and training, and follow OSHA and all other applicable safety rules and company policies at all times.
  • Use all required safety equipment for the task at hand.
  • Work well both independently and as part of a team.

What You'll Need

  • Physical ability and willingness to climb towers while following all required safety procedures.
  • Comfortable working outside in all weather conditions, including high and low temperatures.
  • Good communication and customer service skills; comfortable explaining equipment and service to customers in plain language.
  • Basic AC/DC electrical skills; knowledge of low-voltage wiring is a plus.
  • Basic familiarity with personal computers, routers, and wireless networking concepts.
  • Willingness to take part in rotational on-call coverage.
  • Previous wireless, telecom install, or customer service experience is a plus, but not required.

Working Conditions and Schedule

  • A mix of outdoor fieldwork (customer sites and towers) and some indoor work, in varying weather conditions.
  • schedule to be determined. Will be a Monday - Friday schedule, times to be determined.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift up to 75 pounds.
  • Ability to lift and carry 50 pounds for extended periods.
  • Ability to climb and work from ladders, rooftops, and towers.
  • Ability to operate manual and mechanical equipment as needed.
  • Ability to work with or without direct supervision.

Education and Licensing

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record required. No CDL required.
  • Must pass a background check, MVR check, and drug screen.

Benefits (Full-Time)

  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Health insurance
  • Monthly bonus pool
  • Family-friendly, stable company culture
  • Paid time off

title: Driver / Transportation Specialist
description:
Position Summary

Compassion Behavioral Health is seeking an experienced, dependable, and highly flexible Driver / Transportation Specialist to join our dual diagnosis treatment program. This position is based out of our Fort Lauderdale facility and is responsible for providing safe, professional, and reliable transportation services for both newly admitting clients and current clients receiving treatment.

The Driver / Transportation Specialist will transport clients to and from our facilities, airports, medical appointments, recovery-related activities, and other approved destinations within a 200-mile radius. Because transportation needs frequently change based on admissions and client care requirements, the ideal candidate must be flexible with scheduling and willing to adjust working hours to meet operational demands.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provide safe and timely transportation for newly admitting clients and active clients of the program.
  • Transport clients between our Fort Lauderdale and South Hollywood facilities as needed.
  • Drive clients to and from airports, medical appointments, meetings, treatment-related activities, and other approved destinations.
  • Safely provide transportation to newly admitting clients within a 200-mile radius.
  • Maintain professional boundaries and interactions with clients at all times.
  • Conduct routine vehicle inspections and immediately report any maintenance or safety concerns.
  • Ensure vehicles remain clean, fueled, and ready for daily operations.
  • Maintain transportation logs and other required documentation.
  • Communicate effectively with Admissions, Operations, Clinical, and Leadership teams regarding transportation schedules and changes.
  • Adapt to changing schedules and respond appropriately to urgent or last-minute transportation requests.
  • Follow all company policies, HIPAA requirements, and transportation procedures.


Qualifications

title: Rakennuslogistiikkatyöntekijä, Kotka
description:
Haemme asiakasyritykseemme rakennuslogistiikkatyöntekijää Kotkaan!

Kohteeseen haemme reipasta logistiikka-alan osaajaa varastotöihin. Tehtävässä pääset myös ajamaan trukkia sekä kurottajaa joten koneajotaitoa vaaditaan. Toimit kahdessa toimipisteessä josta toinen on työmaa-alue, pisteet sijaitsevat n. 6km päässä toisistaan.

Työtehtävät:

• varastotyöt, kuorman purku ja lastaus
• koneajot trukilla sekä kurottajalla
• tuotteiden lajittelut (putket) sekä yleiset varastoon liittyvät tehtävät

Tarjoamme:

• kokoaikaisen työsuhteen, arvioitu kesto vuoden loppuun
• sopimuspalkan, huomioiden aikaisempi kokemus

Odotamme sinulta:

• aikaisempaa kokemusta varastotöistä ja logistiikasta. Rakennuslogistiikan tuntemus on eduksi
• koneajotaitoa (trukki ja kurottaja)
• hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta tarvittaessa
• tuli- ja työturvakorttia sekä suomen kielen taitoa

Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan pääsiäisen jälkeen. Palkkaus 14-15€/h ja määrittämisessä otetaan huomioon aikaisempi kokemus ja koulutuksesi. Tehtävässä noudatetaan teknologiateollisuuden työehtosopimusta. Töiden arvioitu kesto on aluksi 3-6kk riippuen työmaan tilanteesta.

Kolahtiko?

Kuulostaa hyvältä, mutta miksi hakisin töitä juuri Amikon kautta?

Amiko tarjoaa kaiken tasoisille ammattilaisille laajan valikoiman töitä. Olemme sinulle reilu, luotettava ja joustava työelämän kumppani. Amikolla on hyvä maine työmarkkinoilla. Pyrimme aina etsimään parhaat mahdolliset ratkaisut työllistymisesi tueksi. Amikolaisena saat:

• Vähintään TES:in mukaisen palkkauksen-palkkausjärjestelmämme on kannustava, joskus jopa suurempi kuin työllistyessä suoraan yrityksen palkkalistoille.

• Laajasti erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia- meillä on kattavat verkostot ja laaja työpaikkavalikoimaniin osa-aikaisia, kokopäiväisiä kuin sesonkitöitä monelta eri alalta. Kun sopiva työ löytyy, monille tarjoutuu myös mahdollisuus siirtyä vakituiseksi työntekijäksi asiakasyritykseen.

• Oman yhteyshenkilön ja yksilöllistä työnhakua – Amikolta saat henkilökohtaista palvelua ja oman tutun yhteyshenkilön, johon voit olla suoraan yhteydessä.

• Kattavat työterveyspalvelut, normaalin eläkekertymän ja sairausajan palkan sairauden sattuessa – Vaikka teetkin työsi asiakasyrityksessämme, olet amikolainen ja kannamme sinusta vastuun ja huolehdimme eduistasi.

• … vai kenties jotain ihan uutta urallesi? Autamme myös alanvaihdossa. Räätälöidyt uravalmennukset auttavat päivittämään osaamistasi ja löytämään uuden suunnan urallasi.

Voisiko tässä olla sinulle uusi työpaikka?

Toimimme asiakkaallemme rekrytointikumppanina, käsittelemme saapuvat työhakemukset sekä vastaamme ensimmäisen vaiheen haastatteluista. Jätäthän hakemuksesi pikimmiten tai soita Amikon Joona Rantanen p. 0503397633 ja nappaa itsellesi uusi huippuduuni!

Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivien henkilön löydyttyä.

Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse vastaanotettuja hakemuksia vaan jätäthän hakemuksen nettisivujemme kautta tietosuojasyistä.

The rating is determined by a proficiency test designed by the Official Languages and Bilingualism Institute.

title: Data/Integration Engineer
location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
description:
Position Summary
The Data/Integration Engineer designs and supports the data architecture connecting DOT financial, contracting, service-management, planning, and external-provider data required for the WCF solution. The engineer integrates and standardizes data from Delphi, PRISM, ServiceNow, Oracle EPM/IMPACT, spreadsheets, CSV files, and other Government-approved sources into a common analytical structure.

The position supports DOT's transition from Microsoft to Google through a modular, nonproprietary, and transition-ready architecture. The Data/Integration Engineer preserves the authoritative roles of existing systems of record while configuring approved interfaces, extracts, staging, validation, reconciliation, and reporting data flows within the environment authorized by OCDIO.

Key Responsibilities
- Design and maintain the common financial and operational data structure supporting the WCF solution.
- Integrate data from Delphi, PRISM, ServiceNow, Oracle EPM/IMPACT, and approved external sources.
- Develop documented source-to-target mappings, crosswalks, data dictionaries, and interface specifications.
- Profile incoming datasets to understand field definitions, formats, identifiers, units, quality, and reporting grain.
- Standardize external Government and commercial provider datasets into a consistent schema.
- Develop controlled intake processes for spreadsheets, CSV files, scheduled reports, database extracts, and other approved formats.
- Design validation rules for required fields, duplicates, invalid values, customer mappings, service mappings, and control totals.
- Reconcile processed datasets to provider control totals and applicable authoritative financial totals.
- Design and maintain exception-handling workflows for invalid, unmatched, incomplete, or changed-format records.
- Support structured staging, transformation, and processing of larger or more complex datasets.
- Develop and maintain metadata, lineage, schema-version, and source-system documentation.
- Support automated and scheduled data movement using DOT-approved technologies and interfaces.
- Work with OCDIO on interface configuration, identity and access, platform dependencies, security requirements, and migration activities.
- Support the Microsoft-to-Google transition by identifying platform dependencies and reconfiguring data interfaces and processing components as required.
- Support development of reporting datasets and analytical views for financial analysts, executives, and Operating Administration customers.
- Perform integration testing, data reconciliation, defect analysis, and UAT support.
- Prepare technical runbooks, interface documentation, data dictionaries, and knowledge-transfer materials.
- Provide Level 2 data and integration troubleshooting while coordinating privileged platform issues with OCDIO.


Role Outcome
Provides DOT with a governed, traceable data foundation that connects authoritative financial information with service consumption and external provider data without creating proprietary or platform-dependent integration.

Risk Coordinator (Safety, Claims & Contract Compliance)

Location: Brea, CA
Company: Nevell Group (NGi)
Department: Risk Management
Reports To: Risk Management/Legal Department Head
FLSA Status: Exempt


About the Role:

Nevell Group is seeking an organized, analytical, and experienced Risk Coordinator to support our Risk Management and Legal functions across workers’ compensation, claims administration, contract compliance, safety compliance, litigation support, and construction risk management.


This position will play a key role in overseeing workers’ compensation claims, coordinating claims administration across multiple lines of coverage, supporting contract review and compliance, tracking job rights documentation, assisting with litigation and legal matters, and monitoring contract-driven safety requirements.


The Risk Coordinator will work closely with the Risk Management/Legal Department Head, Director of Safety, Human Resources, Finance, Operations, Project Management, insurance carriers, third-party administrators, brokers, outside counsel, General Contractors, and project teams. The Director of Safety retains responsibility for the Safety Department and field safety personnel, while this role will support contract-driven safety requirements, documentation, and compliance tracking.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Risk Management & Legal Support:
    • Support the Risk Management/Legal Department Head with claims management, insurance matters, subpoenas, litigation support, and internal legal correspondence.
    • Coordinate contract review workflows for project agreements with General Contractors and second-tier subcontractors/vendors.
    • Gather scopes, exhibits, and supporting documentation; track revisions and ensure timely routing for review and execution.
    • Perform initial administrative reviews of contract terms and commercial exhibits, including risk and insurance requirements, schedules, scope references, and key obligations.
    • Identify and flag contract risks, deviations, and items requiring further review.
    • Draft and organize contract redlines and contract summaries for the Supervisor and project teams.
    • Maintain negotiation notes, correspondence, and executed agreement files.
    • Support master agreement administration, including maintaining templates, tracking renewal dates, and coordinating internal inputs.
    • Support job rights administration, including lien and stop payment documentation, preliminary notice tracking as applicable, deadline tracking, and file organization.
    • Assist Finance with accounts receivable risk tracking and collection support documentation.

For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.


Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).


RECENT RECOGNITION

  • Barron’s 100 Most Sustainable Companies
  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

The position involves front-end analysis, reviewing and consulting on as-is and to-be job responsibilities, developing methods for measuring on-the-job performance, designing work processes, and developing recommendations for workforce training. The position also supports the actual design and development of training by working alongside Instructional Designers to evaluate client needs and develop suitable solutions. The Field Operations Industry Expert serves as an advisor to both our clients and to Mosaic’s internal team members to provide expertise and industry domain knowledge in support of building solutions that result in positive impacts in workforce performance.


Roles and Responsibilities

  • Work with Mosaic project teams and client leadership to define/address personnel knowledge and skill gaps.
  • Leverage expertise and hands-on experience to develop task analysis, work procedures, safety standards, and other deliverables for Utility Field Operations activities.
  • Provide industry expertise for the creation of client future state business processes and derive the associated business outcomes.
  • Evaluate training materials and training effectiveness to ensure end-user needs are met, including the development and evaluation of training metrics used to track end-user performance.

title: Field Service Technician II – Solar
description:
WORK ARRANGEMENT: ON-SITE, FIELD-BASED. THIS IS NOT A REMOTE OR WORK-FROM-HOME JOB.



This role is performed in person, outdoors, on solar sites in and around Roseville, MN. You must already live within commuting distance of Roseville, or be prepared to relocate there at your own expense before your start date.

You may see this listed as "field-based." That means you drive from your home to job sites rather than reporting to an office each morning. It does not mean you can work from another city or state. Applications from candidates who are not located in — or actively relocating to — the Roseville area cannot be considered for this posting.



Territory: [30–90 minutes typical, rarely over 3 hours]. Overnight travel: [under 10%]. Schedule: [M–F, 7am–3pm or 8am–4pm]. On-call: [rotational Saturday 8am–12pm]. Overtime: [paid biweekly; 40–45 hours typical; 1.5x over 40].




SOLAR EXPERIENCE HELPS. IT IS NOT REQUIRED. STRONG ELECTRICAL AND DIAGNOSTIC SKILLS ARE.


Energy Support Services keeps solar and energy storage systems safe, reliable, and producing clean power. As a Field Service Technician II – Solar, you’ll work independently on advanced inspections, preventative maintenance, and system troubleshooting — operating safely in high-voltage environments without direct supervision, guiding junior technicians on site, and progressing along a defined pathway toward Technician III.


If you have two or more years of serious hands-on technical work in any industry and you’re the person people bring the problem nobody else could figure out, we want your application.


COMING FROM ANOTHER TRADE? THIS IS THE PART TO READ.


We hire experienced technicians out of other industries at this level regularly, and we build the solar knowledge on top. Here’s how your background translates:

  • Automotive, diesel, or heavy equipment — Root-cause diagnosis, circuit tracing, reading schematics, using a scan tool and DMM, working to torque spec, and writing up findings. You’ll trade flat-rate for a salary, and your tool box for ours.
  • HVAC/R, especially commercial or light-industrial — Control circuits, contactors, VFDs, three-phase power, service calls run solo, and preventative maintenance on a schedule. Very close cousin to this work.
  • Telecommunications, broadband, or utility line work — Working at height, terminations, test equipment, prints, and outdoor work in every kind of weather. Your safety habits are already right.
  • Industrial maintenance, wind, or power generation — Lockout/tagout discipline, medium-voltage awareness, PM programs, and CMMS documentation all carry directly across.
  • Military technical specialties — Power generation, electrical systems, avionics, and electronics maintenance transfer cleanly.


The tools you’ll learn (and their equivalents you may already know)


  • I/V curve tracer — measures the performance curve of a string of solar modules to find underperformance. Conceptually similar to putting a vehicle or motor on a load test.
  • Megohmmeter ("Megger") / insulation resistance tester — finds insulation breakdown and ground faults. If you’ve used one in industrial or motor work, it’s the same instrument.
  • Infrared thermography — thermal imaging to find hot spots in connections and modules. If you’ve used a thermal camera on bearings, panels, or refrigerant lines, you’re already there.
  • Drone-based aerial thermal inspection — we pay for your FAA Part 107 and teach you the flight work.


PAY

$75,000 – $95,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications.


WHAT WE OFFER



  • Tools and equipment: provided. Company truck, company fuel/credit card, and vehicle maintenance card. You will never spend your own money on tools here — no tool truck payment, no tool debt.
  • Bonus: Up to an 8% performance bonus, paid annually.
  • Apparel: Company-provided PPE and flame-resistant clothing kit (bibs, jackets, pants, shirts) at no cost to you.
  • Health: Medical, dental, and vision. We pay 80% of your health insurance premiums.
  • Retirement: 401(k) with up to a 7.5% company match.
  • Time off: PTO accrued each pay period — 120 hours/year (years 0–2), 160 hours (years 3–9), 200 hours (10+ years) — plus 11 paid holidays.
  • Family: 8 weeks of paid parental leave.
  • Insurance: Company-paid Life and AD&D insurance at 1x your annual salary.
  • Certifications — we pay, you keep them: OSHA 10/30, NFPA 70E/70B, FAA Part 107 (drone), and our internal O&M Tech course series. These certifications stay with you for the rest of your career.
  • Advancement: A published Field Tech Development Pathway with defined progression to Technician III. You move up on demonstrated capability, not on how long you’ve been here.
  • Education: Tuition reimbursement up to $10,000 per year for approved programs.


WHAT YOU'LL DO


Safety

  • Lead by example in promoting a safe working culture in the field.
  • Perform approved hazardous electrical energy control procedures and select the exact PPE required for each task.
  • Participate in and actively critique Pre-Job Briefs and Job Safety Analysis (JSA). Apply personal lockout/tagout as a worker, or serve as work leader once approved.

Inspections and preventative maintenance

  • Perform comprehensive electrical and mechanical inspections of solar energy systems.
  • Conduct advanced preventative maintenance including infrared thermography, insulation resistance testing, and I/V curve tracing — all of which we train you on.
  • Help build and implement preventative maintenance schedules for your assigned sites.

Troubleshooting

  • Independently diagnose and troubleshoot system and operational issues.
  • Operate and troubleshoot safely in 600VAC and 1500VDC environments without direct supervision. Note: 1500VDC is a higher DC voltage than most trades encounter — this is exactly why our safety training is extensive, paid, and mandatory before you work unsupervised.
  • Use specialized diagnostic tools and root-cause analysis to handle equipment repairs and replacements.

Documentation

  • Create and maintain detailed, accurate records of inspections, maintenance, and repairs with minimal oversight.
  • Prepare clear technical reports and actionable equipment recommendations for the Team Lead.

Knowledge sharing

  • Stay current on industry best practices, safety updates, and emerging technology.
  • Share your expertise and give supportive guidance to junior technicians on site.
  • Help improve the quality, clarity, and safety content of our training materials.
  • Support your teammates and take on other duties as assigned.


WHAT YOU NEED


Required

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • 2+ years of hands-on technical, electrical, or mechanical work in any industry — solar, electrical, automotive, diesel, HVAC/R, telecommunications, wind, power generation, industrial maintenance, utilities, or a military technical specialty.
  • Solid working understanding of electrical fundamentals — AC and DC theory, series and parallel circuits, grounding, and safe work practices around energized equipment.
  • Confident with a multimeter and able to read, interpret, and work from electrical schematics or engineering drawings.
  • Strong analytical, time management, and problem-solving skills, and a track record of working independently without someone checking on you.
  • Strong communication skills and the patience to bring a junior technician along.
  • Valid driver’s license and clean driving record.


Helpful, but we’ll train and certify you

  • Solar-specific or grid-tied PV system experience.
  • FAA Part 107 drone certification — we pay for it.
  • OSHA 30 and NFPA 70E — we pay for these as well.
  • Hands-on time with I/V curve tracers, megohmmeters, or insulation testers — or comparable diagnostic instruments from another trade.
  • Familiarity with Data Acquisition Systems (DAS) or SCADA — the monitoring systems that report site performance remotely.


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Drive a vehicle confidently and with a high degree of safety.
  • Stand for long periods and walk distances up to three miles per day.
  • Navigate ladders, stairs, scaffolding, and ramps while maintaining three points of contact.
  • Have visual acuity for depth perception, no field-of-vision issues, and the ability to distinguish between colors.
  • Work comfortably in a range of climate conditions, including extreme heat (above 100°F) or extreme cold (below 32°F), for periods of more than one hour.
  • Exert up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, up to 30 pounds frequently, and up to 10 pounds constantly to move objects.








Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time.




The expected annual compensation range for this position is $75,000 - $95,000, encompassing base pay and potential incentive target opportunity. This range is a good faith estimate based on the position's requirements. Specific compensation offered to the selected candidate may vary depending on factors such as relevant knowledge, skills, training, experience, and market conditions. Additionally, this position may qualify for a comprehensive benefits package, including Retirement Benefits, Medical, Dental & Vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Account, Life Insurance and Disability, Tuition Reimbursement, Voluntary Benefits, Paid Absences, and more.

At New Energy Equity, a proud subsidiary of ALLETE, we’re leading the charge in transforming the energy landscape with innovative solar solutions 🌞. As a top player in the renewable energy sector, we’ve successfully developed over 600MW of solar projects and closed more than $1.2 billion in clean energy investments 💼. Our projects deliver sustainable electricity to a wide range of clients, including commercial, industrial, municipal, and utility customers 🌍. But there’s more to us than just impressive numbers. We pride ourselves on a dynamic and engaging work environment where teamwork, continuous learning, and environmental stewardship are at the core of what we do 🌿. Salary: £33,000

Hours: 36 hours per week

Kisharon Langdon UK has an exciting opportunity for an experienced Maintenance Assistant to join their growing team in North West London.


Kisharon Langdon are a charity offering a wider breadth of services of enhanced quality, enabling us to better support people with a learning disability and autistic people and their families. From nursery and school to further education, through to employment opportunities and supported living, Kisharon Langdon will enable people with a learning disability and autistic people to thrive and realise their ambitions and aspirations.


Whilst we support the Jewish community, we celebrate and benefit from the diversity of the communities in which we are based and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.


The Role;

  • The Maintenance Assistant will be responsible for the front-line service to our members for facilities and property management in relation to the 50 properties within the supported living services in North West London and Hertfordshire.
  • The post holder will be responsible for Langdon College, Maccabi House and various other properties as required: with the expectation to carry out various maintenance duties to the remaining rented housing portfolio.
  • As part of the role, the post holder will need to be responsible for managing sub-contractors carrying out preventative maintenance work, and at times, work with them to achieve the outcomes required.


Key Responsibilities;


  • To ensure health & safety checks including fire alarm testing, legionella flushing, emergency light testing, and site safety/security checks are carried out regularly at Kisharon Langdon properties and offices, maintaining the safety and welfare of our members and staff,
  • To carry out a preventative, planned maintenance program and undertake routine inspections of the premises, fixtures, fittings, utility meters, and grounds,
  • To carry out repairs, maintenance, improvement works and inspections to ensure the general upkeep and maintenance of the premises, e.g. assemble furniture, fit curtain poles, general household repairs etc,
  • To act as a contact for Contractors attending properties, ensuring they are fully aware of the organisation’s attendance procedures, that they will follow full H&S procedures/risk assessments and permits to work are issued/reviewed where required.
  • To ensure keys, access cards and access codes/fobs are signed out and recovered according to procedures, to maintain security of buildings,
  • To ensure basic electrical safety procedures are adhered to and PAT testing is organised and carried out as required.


About You;


  • Understanding of basic maintenance strategies and buildings,
  • Be able to undertake basic plumbing, carpentry, minor electrical and painting/finishing trades,
  • A good all-round knowledge of the building maintenance industry,
  • Knowledge and understanding of current legal and legislative responsibilities related to Asbestos, Legionella, Fire Safety, Manual Handling, Working at Height, COSHH, Building Regulations etc,
  • Level 2 in Building Maintenance or Multi-trade Repair and Refurbishment Operations or similar.


What we offer;


  • 21 days paid holiday per holiday year which increases with length of service, in addition, you are entitled to bank and public holidays and major Jewish festivals. (Pro-rated for part time staff)
  • Company Pension scheme,
  • Occupational Sick Pay after a qualifying period, which increases with length of service,
  • Employee Assistance and Wellbeing Programme with free access to independent advice, support and counselling on a wide range of issues,
  • Development and career progression opportunities.


How to apply;


Please apply online today with your most current up to date CV and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant skills and experience in Maintenance and facilities management.


This post is subject to an Enhanced Disclosure Application to the Disclosure and Barring Service and all applicants will need to demonstrate the right to work in the UK. Please note at this time Kisharon Langdon cannot offer certificate of sponsorship support.
