title: Artistic Mentor
description:
ARTISTIC MENTOR DESCRIPTION

The Artistic Mentor (AM) is a vital teaching artist position that leads a small group of students aged 13- 19 years old in the delicate process of devising scenes based on their lived experience. The AM guides the group of teens through its emotional journey while simultaneously steering the storytelling and improvisations toward a well-structured coherent script and performance. The AM is a part-time hourly position which leads students once a week, mid-October to mid-April, with additional hours for tech week and the performance tour. Mentors must be available for orientation and training the weekend of October 4 and 5th.


Reports to: Director of Education


QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

  • Background in theatre education with a firm understanding of the fundamentals of devising, directing, playwriting, and dramaturgy.
  • Firm understanding of best practices in facilitating a brave and welcoming space for participants in order for them to successfully navigate the process of devising an original play based on their experiences.
  • Demonstrates best practices in terms of positive youth development, and trauma-informed leadership.
  • Must be an expert facilitator able to navigate challenging topics, including triggering disclosures from participants.
  • Ability to lead a team, working collaboratively and communicating regularly with all stake-holders.
  • Enthusiasm for youth development, devising process, and conflict resolution.
  • Experience and or training as a playwright or dramaturg
  • A desire to help facilitate the stories of young people

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Supervise a staff of two peer mentors
  • Collaborate with a playwright and the director of PMP
  • Record and transcribe monologues and scenes
  • Escalate and report participants’ issues that require a referral or outside support
  • Send weekly Reports to the Director of PMP identifying the group's emotional needs, creative strides, lesson plans, and possible material for the group’s play.
  • Attend monthly staff meetings, PMP School Tour, technical rehearsals, and public performances.
  • Lead the group through a devised theatre process based on the students’ personal experiences once a week as scheduled.
  • Facilitate issue-based discussions, making sure that each participant has an opportunity to participate at their comfort level
  • Collaborate with the program playwright and the participants to establish themes, links, and transitions and to strengthen the monologues, scenes, and dramatic structure of the entire script
  • Artistic mentors are mandated reporters who need to assess when and how to advocate for students at what level in consultation with the program director and clinical consultants.
  • Serves as a role model for students and staff: stays positive, listens, mediates conflict, and encourages healthy choices
  • Directs the final play
  • Ensures the overall vision of PMP
  • Absences are not permitted without prior approval from the Director of PMP
  • Reports attendance and or tardiness of peer mentors, playwrights and students

title: Singapore - Offshore Superintendent
description:
Who are Inchcape?

At Inchcape Shipping Services, our vision is to create a connected world where customers can trade successfully and make informed decisions in every port, everywhere. We achieve this by combining our worldwide infrastructure with local expertise, through our global network of more than 250 proprietary offices and a team of over 3,000 dedicated professionals. Our diverse customer base includes owners and charterers in the oil, cruise, container, and bulk commodity sectors, as well as naval, government, and intergovernmental organizations.

We have an ambitious growth model, and a career here is certainly going to be a rewarding one that will allow you to bring your skills

& experience. We embrace change and are open to new thinking and pushing for positive change in our industry.


Main Purpose of Job :

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Offshore Superintendent to take overall operational responsibility for the safe, efficient and timely execution of vessel and offshore project activities.

The Offshore Superintendent will act as the principal operational interface between the company, vessel Master and crew, Ship Management Company, appointed Port Agent, clients, offshore teams, contractors, vendors and relevant authorities.

The role covers integrated vessel operations, marine agency coordination, ship management coordination, port calls, mobilisation and demobilisation, offshore logistics, HSE compliance, documentation and project execution.

The appointed Port Agent will be responsible for statutory port-agency functions and formal clearance submissions. The Offshore Superintendent will maintain operational oversight and accountability to ensure all port, vessel, technical, logistical and project requirements are properly coordinated, followed up and completed within the required timeframe.

The successful candidate should be comfortable working in a dynamic offshore environment, managing multiple stakeholders and taking ownership of operational issues from planning through to completion.


Key Responsibilities

Overall Offshore & Vessel Operations

  • Take operational ownership for the safe, efficient and timely execution of vessel and offshore project activities.
  • Plan, coordinate and monitor vessel mobilisation, demobilisation, port calls and offshore operations.
  • Monitor vessel movements, operational schedules, cargo activities, crew changes and offshore logistics.
  • Coordinate with vessel Masters, offshore personnel, clients, Ship Management, Port Agents, contractors, vendors and marine service providers.
  • Monitor operational readiness and identify potential constraints that may affect safety, schedule, cost or project execution.
  • Take timely corrective action and escalate significant operational issues to management.
  • Ensure effective handover and continuity of information between vessel, shore-based teams and project stakeholders.
  1. Integrated Marine Agency & Ship Management Coordination
  • Act as the principal operational coordination point between the vessel, Port Agent, Ship Management Company, client and project team.
  • Integrate marine-agency and ship-management activities to ensure smooth vessel operations from arrival through departure.
  • Coordinate with the Ship Manager on vessel readiness, technical support, maintenance, repairs, spares, stores, statutory/class documentation and other shore-based requirements.
  • Coordinate with the Port Agent on port-call arrangements, clearance formalities, immigration, customs, pilotage, tug services, berth/anchorage and other port services.
  • Ensure the Port Agent and Ship Management team are aligned with vessel schedules, project requirements and operational priorities.
  • Monitor outstanding actions between the vessel, Port Agent and Ship Manager and ensure timely closure.
  • Coordinate service engineers, technicians, contractors and specialist support during port calls where required.
  • Support coordination of repairs and maintenance during port stays while minimising vessel downtime.
  • Monitor the availability and validity of vessel certificates, statutory documents, class requirements, insurance documents and other operational records in coordination with the Ship Manager.
  • Coordinate crew changes, crew travel, accommodation, medical requirements and related logistics with the Ship Manager and Port Agent, where applicable.
  • Coordinate bunkering, fresh water, provisions, stores, waste disposal, spare parts and other vessel services.
  • Monitor marine-agency and ship-management service performance and escalate unresolved issues.
  • Maintain an integrated vessel operational tracker covering port call, agency, technical, crew, logistics, HSE and project requirements.

Port Call & Port Agency Oversight

  • Manage the day-to-day operational interface with the appointed Port Agent.
  • Provide the Port Agent with vessel, project and operational requirements and ensure timely follow-up.
  • Monitor vessel ETA/ETD, berth or anchorage arrangements, pilotage, tug services and other port requirements.
  • Monitor the status of arrival and departure formalities and ensure outstanding requirements are identified and closed out.
  • Ensure the Port Agent progresses required port notifications, declarations, clearance documentation and regulatory submissions within the required timelines.
  • Coordinate with the Master and Port Agent to ensure vessel readiness for arrival, port activities and departure.
  • Review port-call documentation and maintain an appropriate operational record and audit trail.
  • Follow up on delays, discrepancies, documentation gaps or non-compliance that may affect vessel operations.
  • Review port-agency services, marine services and associated operational costs against project requirements.

Day-to-Day Vessel Port Call Management

Before Vessel Arrival

  • Review vessel ETA and port-call requirements.
  • Confirm vessel readiness with the Master and Ship Manager.
  • Confirm port arrangements and clearance requirements with the Port Agent.
  • Ensure required vessel, crew, cargo and project information is available to the relevant parties.
  • Identify technical, maintenance, repair, crew, stores and logistical requirements to be completed during the port call.
  • Coordinate service engineers, technicians, contractors, spares and other resources where required.
  • Establish a port-call action list with clear responsibilities and deadlines.
  • Identify potential operational constraints and delays before vessel arrival.

During Port Stay

  • Monitor vessel status and operational activities.
  • Coordinate with the Master, Port Agent, Ship Manager, client and project team.
  • Monitor cargo operations, crew changes, bunkering, stores, waste disposal, repairs, maintenance and other port services.
  • Coordinate technical attendance and shore-based support.
  • Monitor progress against the port-call schedule.
  • Resolve operational conflicts between project, vessel, agency and technical requirements.
  • Monitor port delays, operational restrictions, additional services and potential cost exposure.
  • Escalate matters that may affect safety, vessel readiness, schedule or project execution.

Before Departure

  • Confirm completion of planned port, technical, crew and project activities.
  • Confirm with the Ship Manager that outstanding technical or statutory matters have been appropriately addressed.
  • Obtain confirmation from the Port Agent that required departure formalities and port arrangements are completed.
  • Confirm vessel readiness with the Master.
  • Ensure pilotage, tug and other departure services are arranged.
  • Review outstanding actions and ensure proper handover before departure.
  • Record actual departure time, delays, deviations and significant operational events.



Offshore Logistics & Project Execution

  • Lead and coordinate offshore mobilisation and demobilisation activities.
  • Ensure personnel, cargo, equipment, materials and documentation are available as required.
  • Coordinate marine and offshore logistics in accordance with project schedules.
  • Coordinate procurement and marine/offshore service requirements.
  • Monitor vessel and project schedules and identify potential delays.
  • Develop practical recovery actions to minimise schedule impact.
  • Minimise vessel standby time, operational downtime and avoidable project costs.
  • Support project management in achieving operational, commercial and contractual objectives.
  • Ensure effective coordination between offshore operations and shore-based project support.
  1. HSE, Marine & Regulatory Compliance
  • Promote and maintain a strong HSE and marine safety culture across all operations.
  • Ensure activities are performed in accordance with company, client, marine and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure appropriate risk assessments, JSA/JHA, method statements, permits and operational controls are implemented where required.
  • Monitor compliance during vessel and offshore activities.
  • Intervene and escalate where unsafe or non-compliant activities are identified.
  • Support investigation and close-out of incidents, near misses and non-conformities.
  • Monitor corrective and preventive actions through to completion.
  • Maintain awareness of applicable marine, port and offshore regulatory requirements.
  1. Client & Stakeholder Management
  • Act as a key operational contact for clients and project stakeholders.
  • Maintain effective communication with vessel Masters, Ship Managers, Port Agents, offshore crews, vendors and contractors.
  • Provide timely operational updates, status reports, risk assessments and recommendations.
  • Coordinate multiple stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of vessel and offshore activities.
  • Build effective working relationships with clients, authorities, service providers and project partners.
  • Represent the company's operational interests professionally and effectively.
  1. Reporting, Documentation & Cost Control
  • Prepare and maintain daily vessel and offshore operational reports.
  • Maintain vessel movement, port-call, mobilisation and project trackers.
  • Monitor clearance and documentation status through the appointed Port Agent.
  • Maintain records of operational delays, incidents, deviations and corrective actions.
  • Review operational records supporting project billing and cost control.
  • Monitor port-agency and marine-service costs and highlight significant variances.
  • Maintain proper documentation for project, contractual, HSE, compliance and audit requirements.
  • Provide management with regular operational performance and exception reports.



Role Accountability & Authority

The Offshore Superintendent shall maintain end-to-end operational oversight of vessel and offshore activities while respecting the defined responsibilities and statutory authority of each party.

The Superintendent does not replace:

  • The Master's authority over navigation, vessel safety, crew and onboard command.
  • The Ship Management Company's responsibility for technical management, maintenance, statutory/class support and vessel technical readiness.
  • The Port Agent's responsibility for port-agency functions, statutory submissions, clearance processing and coordination of port formalities.

Instead, the Offshore Superintendent is accountable for ensuring that these functions are properly integrated, coordinated and followed through, and that any outstanding matters are addressed before they affect vessel safety, operational readiness, project schedule or commercial performance.

The Superintendent is expected to take ownership of operational issues, drive resolution, escalate appropriately and ensure that agreed actions are completed.

Key Interfaces

Offshore Superintendent
Overall operational coordination, integration and project accountability

Vessel Master
Navigation, vessel safety, crew and onboard command

Ship Management Company
Technical management, maintenance, statutory/class support, crew management and vessel technical readiness

Port Agent
Port agency, statutory submissions, port clearance, immigration/customs coordination and port services

Client / Project Team
Project requirements, schedule, contractual deliverables and offshore campaign objectives

Vendors / Contractors
Marine services, technical support, logistics, equipment and specialist services


Requirements

  • Diploma or Degree in Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, Offshore Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Maritime Studies, Marine Operations, Project Management or a related discipline.
  • Min 3 - 5 years of relevant experience in offshore, marine, vessel operations, shipyard, FPSO, oil & gas or energy projects preferred.
  • Candidates with strong vessel operations, marine agency or ship-management coordination experience are encouraged to apply.
  • Practical understanding of vessel operations, marine logistics, port calls and offshore mobilisation.
  • Experience coordinating with Port Agents, Vessel Masters, Ship Managers, clients, contractors and marine service providers.
  • Good understanding of vessel documentation, port-clearance processes and marine operational requirements.
  • Familiarity with HSE requirements, risk assessments and operational procedures.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
  • Familiarity with Optic or similar digital marine/offshore operational systems will be an advantage.
  • Strong organisational, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • Able to work independently and manage multiple operational priorities.
  • Able to work under pressure and respond effectively to changing vessel/project requirements.
  • Willingness to support operations outside normal working hours when required by vessel movements or offshore project activities.



Preferred Qualities

  • Strong operational ownership and accountability.
  • Positive, proactive and practical problem-solving mindset.
  • Strong teamwork and interpersonal skills.
  • Good commercial and cost awareness.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with senior management, clients, vessel crews and external stakeholders.
  • Passion for the marine, offshore and energy industry.
  • High level of integrity, reliability and professionalism.



What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on international offshore and marine projects.
  • Exposure to vessel operations, integrated marine agency, ship management and offshore logistics.
  • Experience across offshore oil & gas, FPSO / FLNG and energy-sector projects.
  • Dynamic and operationally focused working environment.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression within the marine and offshore industry

title: Reconstruction Scheduler
description:

Coordinate the Details. Support the Team. Help Customers Rebuild.


Arrow Service Team is North Dakota's leader in disaster restoration. Since 1979, we've helped homeowners and businesses recover from fire, water, storm, and other property damage. As a family-owned company, we're committed to quality workmanship, exceptional customer service, and investing in our employees.


We're looking for an organized, customer-focused Reconstruction Scheduler to join our team. This position plays an important role in keeping reconstruction projects moving by coordinating schedules, communicating with customers, managing job information, and supporting our Project Managers and field teams.


If you're someone who enjoys staying organized, communicating with people, solving scheduling challenges, and keeping multiple moving pieces on track, this could be a great fit. You'll often be one of the first people our customers speak with and will help guide them through the scheduling process during what can be a stressful and unexpected time.


What You'll Do

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for incoming customer calls and direct calls to the appropriate team or department.
  • Gather information and schedule appointments for fire losses, emergency board-ups, vehicle impacts, structural cleaning, contents services, and other specialty emergency projects.
  • Coordinate reconstruction schedules and schedule initial site visits for Project Managers.
  • Communicate directly with homeowners to confirm appointments, schedule changes, project timelines, delays, and next steps.
  • Perform daily follow-up calls and maintain clear communication with customers throughout the reconstruction process.
  • Create and maintain Arrow Service Team and Arrow Roofing Systems job files within the CRM (customer relationship management software).
  • Collect, document, and upload insurance information, photos, and other required job information.
  • Assign reconstruction, roofing, and contents projects based on team workload and experience.
  • Monitor online inquiries and form submissions, keeping the inbox organized and ensuring new opportunities receive timely attention.
  • Upload and distribute schedules and communicate scheduling information to team members as needed.
  • Coordinate hotel reservations and other scheduling-related logistics when needed.

title: WAF Security Specialist
description:
About Miggo

We're Miggo — a cybersecurity startup on a mission to stop app-layer breaches before they happen. Founded in 2023 and backed by top-tier cyber VCs, we're building the world's first Application Detection & Response (ADR) platform. Why? Because 80% of cyber attacks target the app layer, and current tools just don't cut it. Miggo brings visibility into how apps actually behave at runtime, spotting risky flows and shutting down threats in real time.

We're closing the patch gap: showing security teams what's reachable, what's exploitable, and what's being attacked right now — and delivering targeted mitigations when a patch isn't ready.

At Miggo, we live by four core values:

  • We make it customer-focused — user needs are our north star.
  • We make it happen — driven by execution and a can-do mindset.
  • We make it better — always pushing boundaries and learning fast.
  • We make it together — one team, thriving on collaboration and diverse perspectives.


About the Role

Miggo's WAF Copilot takes a freshly disclosed CVE and produces a validated, provider-specific WAF rule — researching the vulnerability, deriving the attack surface, composing the rule, then attacking its own output with an independent bypass judge and a false-positive prober before a human is offered a deploy.

As WAF Security Specialist you are the ground truth the Copilot is measured against — the person who can look at a generated rule and say this blocks the PoC but not the four obvious variants, this will trip on legitimate multipart uploads, this is 340 WCUs of nothing because the managed ruleset already catches it, this can't be anchored tightly enough to live in a global Web ACL.

You'll be shipping rules for real customers — and you'll do it through our AI harness, and help optimize it.

In practice that means driving the harness on live work: feeding it a vulnerability, judging what comes back, tightening the match, and validating it against real exploit traffic until it's something you'd put your name on.
Sometimes you'll write the expression yourself — the CVE with no public PoC, the emerging threat you have to reason out of a patch diff, the customer who needs coverage this afternoon. Most of the time you'll be applying expert judgment at every step of a generated rule's life, which is a different and harder skill than authoring from a blank page.

Because you'll be the harness's heaviest user, you'll also be the reason it gets better. You'll see exactly where it breaks down — the research step that missed the real sink, the composer that over-broadened, the judge that passed a rule it shouldn't have — and turn that into validations, analyses, and evals that go back into the agent. You'll work side by side with the Copilot & AI team so the agent stops making the mistake, instead of you catching it again next month. That feedback loop is the core of this role.

All of it rests on knowing where WAFs actually break: normalization and encoding evasion, parameter pollution, body-inspection size limits, oversize-content handling, rule precedence, and the gap between "the rule matched in staging" and "the rule holds against a motivated attacker." An AI can propose a rule. Knowing whether to trust it is the job.


What You'll Do

  • Create - Produce production WAF rules across providers for high-impact CVEs and customer findings — driving the Copilot harness on most of them, writing the expression yourself on the hard ones (no public PoC, exploitable path reasoned out of a patch diff, urgent customer coverage). Your rules ship, and they set the bar generated rules are measured against.
  • **Optimize -**Tighten generated rules for real production constraints: WCU and rule-capacity budgets, latency, provider expression limits, and the anchoring required for a rule that fires against all traffic behind a shared Web ACL — not just the vulnerable app.
  • Validate - Own the adversarial pass. Build exploit variants the PoC doesn't cover, hunt bypasses in our own rules, and run the false-positive side seriously — verifying against how the legitimate client actually behaves on the wire, not against an assumption.
  • Monitor - Watch deployed rules in production: false-positive signals, hit patterns, coverage drift as managed rulesets shift underneath us, and the log→block promotion decision. Retire what no longer earns its capacity.
  • Make it reproducible - Turn every finding into a regression test. Build and curate the golden CVE datasets and scoring rubrics that gate whether a new Copilot version ships.
  • Set the coverage line. Judge which CVEs are genuinely WAF-mitigatable and which aren't, and make the call on what enters and leaves our managed rulesets — with the reasoning written down.


What You'll Have

  • Deep, hands-on WAF expertise across multiple major providers — you've written, tuned, and operated real rules in production on several of: AWS WAFv2, Cloudflare, F5, Imperva, Akamai, Azure, GCP, Fortinet, ModSecurity/CRS. Not "managed a WAF vendor relationship" — written the rules.
  • You know the caveats cold. Body-inspection limits and oversize handling, text transformations and normalization order, encoding and unicode evasion, parameter pollution, chunked and multipart edge cases, rule precedence and evaluation order, WCU/capacity economics, and how each provider's expression language quietly differs from the others.
  • Strong security research background — application security, vulnerability research, or offensive security. You can read an advisory, build the PoC, derive the variants nobody published, and explain exactly which request component carries the exploit primitive.
  • A real feel for the false-positive tradeoff. You've had to defend a blocking decision to someone whose production traffic you broke, and you know why "block everything suspicious" is not a security posture.
  • Comfortable in code. Enough Python (or similar) to automate replay, build variant generators, and query exploit and traffic data yourself rather than waiting on someone.
  • Fast under pressure, systematic afterward. You can get a solid rule out the door when a customer needs one today — and your instinct once it ships is to build the check that catches the whole class, not just the instance you fixed.
  • Advantage: virtual patching / vulnerability-mitigation experience, or time on a WAF vendor's rules or research team.
  • Advantage: hands-on with LLMs and agentic tooling — you'll be shaping an AI system's output, and it helps to understand how it fails.


Why You'll Love This Role

You'll do the craft work you're actually good at — writing rules against hard vulnerabilities, under real time pressure, for customers who feel the difference. What's unusual is that here it compounds: every rule you write and every bypass you find makes an AI system permanently better at something an expert used to do by hand, across every customer and every future CVE. You get the individual save and the leverage over the whole fleet.

You'll have real authority over what we ship and what we refuse to ship, direct access to the engineers building the agent, and a rare seat at the point where security research and AI actually meet in production.

title: Laboratory Integration Engineer
description:
Laboratory Integration Engineer

Wilmington, NC
Full-Time | On-Site
Q-Clearance Required or Eligible



The Laboratory Integration Engineer will support the development and execution of experiments associated with GLE’s first-of-a-kind uranium enrichment technology development program.


The Laboratory Integration Engineer will operate, configure, calibrate, maintain, and troubleshoot laboratory analytical equipment and experimental systems, including residual gas analyzers (RGA), mass spectrometers, vacuum instrumentation, gas analyzers, spectroscopy equipment, data acquisition systems, and associated test hardware.


This position will work directly with scientists and engineers to develop experimental setups, execute testing, collect and organize data, troubleshoot unexpected results, and support interpretation of experimental results. The role requires a strong hands-on background and the ability to work effectively with analytical instrumentation, vacuum and gas systems, sensors, controls, and prototype laboratory equipment.


NOTE: This role is subject to the incumbent’s ability to hold and maintain an NRC Q-clearance and nuclear site access.


Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Operate analytical and laboratory equipment in accordance with established procedures, including RGA, mass spectrometry, gas analysis, spectroscopy, and vacuum instrumentation.
  • Set up, configure, calibrate, maintain, and troubleshoot laboratory instrumentation and supporting equipment.
  • Work collaboratively with scientists and engineers to develop and assemble experimental test setups.
  • Execute experiments and test procedures and document test conditions, observations, and results.
  • Collect, organize, and perform preliminary review of experimental data and assist scientists and engineers with interpretation of results.
  • Assemble and modify laboratory test apparatus, prototype equipment, and supporting hardware.
  • Configure and connect vacuum and gas-handling components, instrumentation, sensors, tubing, valves, and related hardware.
  • Perform vacuum system setup, leak checking, troubleshooting, and basic maintenance.
  • Install and configure sensors, instrumentation, data acquisition equipment, and basic control systems.
  • Troubleshoot unexpected equipment behavior and experimental results in collaboration with scientists and engineers.
  • Support commissioning and checkout of new laboratory equipment and experimental systems.
  • Maintain laboratory equipment, calibration records, test documentation, and experimental configurations.
  • Support development and improvement of laboratory procedures and equipment operating practices.
  • Maintain a safe, organized, and effective laboratory work environment.


Qualifications and Experience:

  • Associate degree in engineering technology, physical science, instrumentation, electronics, or a related technical field with relevant hands-on experience; or a bachelor’s degree in engineering, physics, chemistry, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience operating, assembling, maintaining, or troubleshooting laboratory or experimental equipment.
  • Experience working with instrumentation, sensors, data acquisition systems, or analytical equipment.
  • Ability to follow technical procedures and accurately document experimental activities and results.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting ability.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative laboratory environment with scientists, engineers, and technicians.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain required security clearance and nuclear site access.


Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience with residual gas analyzers, mass spectrometers, gas analyzers, spectroscopy equipment, or similar analytical instrumentation.
  • Experience with vacuum systems, pumps, valves, fittings, leak detection, and vacuum instrumentation.
  • Experience assembling or modifying experimental or prototype equipment.
  • Experience with gas-handling systems and associated instrumentation.
  • Experience configuring data acquisition systems, sensors, signal conditioning, or basic control systems.
  • Experience with laboratory equipment calibration and preventive maintenance.
  • Experience working in a research and development, first-of-a-kind equipment, nuclear, or highly regulated environment.
  • Experience supporting commissioning, test execution, and troubleshooting of prototype systems.

title: Internship in Investment/Strategy Research (Undergraduate & Master's)
description:

The Research Department at Dimensional is integral both in the successful day-to-day functioning of the firm and in developing Dimensional’s long-term strategy. The team also leads the development of the firm’s investment approach, the application of that approach through portfolio management and trading, and the implementation of technology solutions that make the investment process more efficient.

Our team is seeking students from top tier academic programs to intern in the summer of 2027. The Internship offers an opportunity to work on intellectually rigorous and stimulating challenges and provides real life experience into the different aspects of research at Dimensional. The Internship is open to students in finance, economics, mathematics, statistics, computer science, physics, engineering, and other related quantitative fields who expect to complete their degree in December 2027-June 2028.

This nine-week program will be fully in person and expose interns to the day-to-day activities of the Research group. Interns will gain an understanding of what it's like to be a Research Analyst at Dimensional, as they will be involved in projects that meet our firm’s current business needs. Depending on what team within Research you are assigned to, projects may include the following:

  • Perform analysis on portfolios and prospective strategies;

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.


Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies

  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

description:
The Immigrant Legal Resource Center is Hiring!

Project Manager- San Francisco, CA (Preferred); Central Valley of California or Southern California (Considered)


The Immigrant Legal Resource Center (ILRC) is seeking a full-time Project Manager in our San Francisco, CA headquarters. This is an exempt position that reports to a Directing Attorney. This is a bargaining unit position represented by the National Legal Services Workers (NOLSW), Local 2320. This is a term-limited position through December 31, 2028, with the potential for renewal based on funding.

The ILRC currently has a hybrid work model requiring two in-office days per week.

Who We Are:
The ILRC is a leading immigrant rights organization headquartered in San Francisco with staff in Washington, D.C., Texas, Southern California, the Central Valley of California, and Washington state. Since 1979, our mission has been to educate, support, and empower immigrants, community organizations, and legal practitioners to build a more just, inclusive, and democratic society. Our team is passionate, collaborative, and committed to equity and innovation in all we do. Additional information about our organizational values is available here.

The Opportunity:

The Project Manager’s primary goals are to ensure efficient and effective overall administration and management of a robust statewide program for which the ILRC serves as Program Administrator. The Project Manager will be responsible for coordination of regional partners, dissemination of information and resources, tracking and ensuring timely reporting and fiscal management, and maintaining effective communication systems. The specific duties of this position include, but are not limited to, the following:


Job Responsibilities:


Manage program administration

  • Serve as primary point of contact for partners’ program managers, grant managers, and funders of specific programs
  • Maintain current understanding of program goals and initiatives, focus areas, successes, and overall results to timely communicate to partners, funders, and other stakeholders effectively
  • Engage proactively with partners on an ongoing basis to ensure accountability and timely completion and reporting of grant deliverables and program goals
  • Monitor program progress on a regular basis and facilitate timely provision of necessary technical assistance to support partners in meeting their goals and fulfilling their reporting requirements
  • Ensure internal ILRC coordination of various program components and alignment with other relevant ILRC projects.
  • Participate in strategic planning discussions to ensure the program is responsive to community needs and leverages available resources and services.
  • Plan and facilitate virtual and in-person events such as program meetings with partners and large scale convenings
  • Participate in regular remote and in-person funder meetings
  • Document meetings, decisions, and processes and maintain program files, including partner FAQs
  • Engage ILRC programmatic staff to provide trainings or generate resources on identified topics and support tracking for program-specific technical assistance and training including webinars, trainings, written resources, and partner calls

Manage and administer subgranting

  • Execute and maintain partner subgranting documents from drafting through execution, including scope of work, budget, and reporting forms
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for communication between the ILRC, funders, and partner program managers and grant managers; triage and follow up on conversations as necessary
  • Work collaboratively with finance and administrative teams to execute timely subgrant agreements and ensure payments to partners on schedule and within budget
  • Maintain and update project directories and listservs
  • Collect, track, review, analyze, and approve partner invoices and expense reports
  • Facilitate and track subgrantee budget modifications
  • Maintain, meet, and track deadlines

Manage reporting

  • Train and onboard partners on reporting requirements including Salesforce-based reporting portal
  • Provide technical assistance on reporting issues including qualifying deliverables and reporting portal usage
  • Run and provide deliverables reports as requested
  • Communicate with partners about reporting requirements
  • Manage the collection and analysis of quantitative and qualitative data
  • Work collaboratively with internal IT team and data consultant to support the design and development of reporting portals, including technical troubleshooting and serving as main point of contact for developers
  • Aggregate data and draft and ensure timely submission of reporting to funders
  • Serve as liaison for communicating data and findings to funders and internal ILRC teams

Qualifications: We seek candidates who have outstanding interpersonal skills, organizational skills, data analysis skills, project management skills, high attention to detail, ability to collaborate effectively, and commitment to advancing the power of immigrant communities. To be most successful in this role, you must:

  • Preferably have previous experience working with or in government agencies;
  • Have program management experience, preferably related to grants compliance and administration;
  • Five to eight years of relevant experience;
  • Preferably have a bachelor’s degree;
  • Be passionate about immigrant rights;
  • Have advanced aptitude for complex data analysis and experience managing and analyzing large data sets;
  • Have advanced Excel skills including usage of and experience creating formulas, graphs and pivot tables as well as some knowledge of data visualization principles and tools;
  • Have a strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 products including Excel, SharePoint, Word and PowerPoint;
  • Have excellent oral and written communication skills, including strong facilitation skills and presentation skills, report writing skills, and the ability to communicate complex data, findings, and ideas clearly;
  • Experience designing and managing events and other opportunities that promote learning;
  • Experience working in databases; Salesforce experience in particular is a plus;
  • Experience managing large and complex projects. Holding a PM certification is a plus;
  • Have the ability to collaborate cross-departmentally; appreciate working as part of a team; be able to problem solve; and enjoy the initial building phase of a new project;
  • Keen attention to detail;
  • Recognizes ways that race and ethnicity, gender, and other identities intersect in the communities that we serve;
  • Growth mindset and commitment to gathering feedback to inform improvements;
  • Flexibility, adaptability, and the ability to prioritize and juggle multiple streams of work at once;
  • Be able to travel throughout the state of California at least once a month; and
  • Support the organization in other duties as assigned.

Compensation/Benefits:

Pay is commensurate with experience, with an expected range between $108,000 - $116,000 annually. The ILRC offers excellent benefits, medical/dental/vision insurance, EAP sessions, a flexible spending account for medical and dependent care, vacation, and sick leave. The ILRC also sponsors a retirement plan option upon fulfillment of eligibility. Additionally, we offer an annual professional development stipend of $2,500 and from 2025 – 2027, an annual wellness stipend of $2,500. ILRC also offers a sabbatical program: employees are eligible to apply for an 8-week sabbatical after five years of service and a 12-week sabbatical after ten years of service.


Applications:

The position will remain open until September 30, 2026. We will consider applications on an ongoing basis beginning immediately. To ensure consideration of your application, submit a cover letter explaining your qualifications for the position, your salary requirements, a current resume, writing sample, and the contact information for three professional references, one of which must be a supervisor.

The ILRC is an equal opportunity employer and does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion or religious beliefs, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender-identity, sexual orientation, disability age, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal laws. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and other similar state laws and local ordinances, ILRC will also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records.

title: Senior Analyst - Forecasting Oncology
description:
GCL : D1

Introduction to role:

Are you ready to turn patient flow insights into forecasts that shape Oncology strategy and impact patients’ lives across the US? Translate complex datasets into clear narratives that senior leaders trust to make significant choices!

Based in Manyata Tech Park, Bangalore, and working a 2 PM – 11 PM IST shift on a hybrid schedule, you will partner closely with the US Oncology Forecast Leader and cross-functional commercial teams to build robust revenue, volume, and patient forecasts for strategic brands. Your work will anchor brand planning, advise investment and access decisions, and bring clarity to risk and opportunity as therapies progress through the market.

From building patient-based and patient flow models to integrating S&OP and new product introductions, you will be the go-to authority for short- and mid-term forecasts that align assumptions across Marketing, Sales, Market Access and Pricing, Finance, and Sales Operations. You will help set expectations for performance, evolve forecasting capabilities, and equip leadership with the confidence to act fast.

Accountabilities:

  • Forecast Model Development: Build, validate, and maintain short-, mid-, and long-term product forecasts that synthesize data from multiple sources into a single, clear view of demand and revenue.
  • Patient Flow Forecasting: Develop and refine patient-based models that reflect real-world diagnosis and treatment pathways, treatment dynamics, and market access drivers.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Drive alignment on assumptions and scenarios with Marketing, Sales, Market Access and Pricing, Finance, and Sales Operations to ensure forecasts inform strategy and operational plans.
  • Scenario and Sensitivity Analysis: Apply industry-leading modeling approaches, conduct sensitivity analyses on key variables, and quantify risks and opportunities to support confident decision-making.
  • Leadership Communication: Present and defend methodologies, assumptions, and outputs to senior collaborators, clearly detailing confidence levels and model adaptability.
  • New Product Introduction: Develop short- and long-term launch forecasts that foster strategic and operational planning, ensuring readiness for multiple launch scenarios.
  • Performance Intelligence: Lead core business planning workstreams, including performance analytics, QBRs, sales bridges, and ad-hoc analyses supporting Finance and Commercial leadership.
  • S&OP Integration: Participate in monthly S&OP, submit volumes, and maintain weekly, monthly, and yearly models and conversions for ongoing demand planning.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify capability gaps, embed innovation in methods and tools, and champion process improvements that increase forecasting accuracy and speed.
  • Data Integration: Source and harmonize findings derived from market research, secondary data, claims, epidemiology, and syndicated datasets to improve model fidelity and objectivity.

Essential Skills/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in relevant field
  • 7-10 years of direct Pharmaceutical forecasting experience with an in-depth knowledge of forecasting techniques, models and approaches
  • In-depth understanding of Oncology and how patients move through their respective diagnosis and treatment pathways, including treatment dynamics
  • Experience integrating insights from market research and secondary data analysis into forecast assumptions
  • Experience applying various data sources and analytics involving standard data in the Pharmaceutical industry – e.g. IQVIA (MIDAS, DDD NPA, Monthly Xponent), claims data (Truven, Marketscan), epidemiological data, etc. For US forecasting, experience with TRx / NBRx / NRx data and methodologies
  • Strong analytical expertise; excellent Excel, financial modelling and forecasting skills
  • Ability to build positive relationships across a range of partner groups including Marketing, Analytics, Operations, and Technology
  • Validated experience in problem solving and continuous improvement
  • Strong written and verbal communication

Desirable Skills/Experience:

  • Advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred (e.g., PhD, MBA, Masters)
  • Knowledge and experience in sophisticated statistical forecast methodologies and applied AI / ML / automation
  • Experience working with Power Apps, specifically PowerBI
  • Validated understanding of US Market Access, Oncology landscape and gross-to-net etc.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we fuel bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and bold world.

Why AstraZeneca:

Here, ambitious problem solvers use data, build thinking, and digital innovation to power decisions that move therapies to patients faster. You w ill join a high-performing, collaborative community where unexpected teams come together to solve complex problems, take balanced risks, and turn ideas into impact. We blend ambition with support, valuing patience alongside drive, and give you real ownership to build forecasting capabilities that shape strategy across the enterprise—all while staying closely connected to the purpose that guides us: improving patients’ lives.

Call to Action:

If you are ready to lead Oncology forecasting that leaders rely on and patients benefit from, step forward and share your story today.

27-Aug-2026

10-Sept-2026

We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

title: Global Clinical Program Lead
description:
Typical Accountabilities
- Design or manage the implementation of the Physicians strategy within Clinical Development both regionally and globally.
- Use expertise and knowledge of global issues to develop strategic Physicians objectives for inclusion into AstraZeneca’s annual business objectives.
- Define strategies or leads AstraZeneca’s response to complex technical issues for specific medical aspects in relation to current projects, new projects and various plans.
- Provide expert advice in the area of specialism, influencing the development of statistics to the global business and Global Clinical Development.
- Closely follow medical developments within assigned areas and disseminates new information within Clinical Development and outside to transform trends and emerging data into new plans.
- Liaise with the internal and external medical community to follow developments within areas of expertise.
- Ensure an adequate number of qualified physicians is available for clinical testing to satisfy AstraZeneca’s objectives in the clinical testing area.
- Maintain a high degree of understanding and awareness on new and emerging medical development.
- Contribute to or manage the development of the senior management team in area of expertise.
- Mentor, develop, and manage performance of line management and project teams, to ensure alignment with organizational goals and fostering succession planning.
- Follow important developments and trends in scientific literature and develops contacts with opinion leaders.
- Lead regulatory communication and preparation of higher-level documents.

Essential qualifications

  • M.D., Ph.D., or equivalent medical or scientific qualification.

  • At least 5-8 years of relevant clinical development experience, including study design, protocol development, trial implementation, monitoring, data interpretation, and reporting.

  • Experience in clinical development and working within cross-functional teams.

  • Knowledge of biostatistics, global regulatory requirements, pharmacovigilance, GCP, and clinical trial safety.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, teamwork, and influencing skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

  • Strong presentation and stakeholder engagement capabilities.

  • Ability to work effectively across global teams and travel as required



Qualifications and Skills
Essential: Medical degree and experience as a physician or academic; Extensive experience in designing, monitoring and implementing clinical trials and interpreting trial results; Significant experience in advanced research and development; Therapeutic area expertise and commercial understanding; Thorough understanding of pharmaceutical safety, reporting and surveillance processes.
Desirable: Medical degree in scientific discipline; Extensive general medical knowledge.

Compensation and working environment.

The annual base salary range is $288,059 to $432,088 annually USD, depending on factors including location, skills, experience, and qualifications. The role may also be eligible for a short-term incentive bonus and equity-based long-term incentive program, subject to applicable terms.

AstraZeneca’s Gaithersburg site offers a collaborative and inclusive workplace, with amenities including gym access, networking events, lunch-and-learn sessions, and a sustainable office environment. Employees work from the office a minimum of three days per week, subject to role requirements and applicable arrangements.


Key Relationship to Reach Solutions
Internal: Senior Physician Team and Development function; Development leaders; Pharmacology; Pharmaceutical Development; Regulatory Department; Quality.
External: External service providers and regulatory bodies.

title: Operations Administrator
description:
Organization Information


Borealis Fuels & Logistics is an international company that distributes and sells propane (LPG) for domestic energy consumption. Borealis is one of North America's fastest-growing propane companies. Borealis’s customers are residential, commercial, and industrial consumers. Borealis works with domestic propane producers to deliver the most cost-effective and reliable solution available to its customers.


Borealis is looking to add a motivated leader to the team to maintain the quality of service offered to our customers. Borealis’ primary objective is to offer the best full-fuel service and customer experience. We utilize technology, share accurate information, and respond promptly. Borealis performs service work, delivers fuel to customers, and has a network of bulk transport vehicles moving fuel across Canada and the USA.


Job Description


Summary:


This position will be vital to the business's day-to-day and long-term goals. The ideal candidate will be highly motivated and able to work in a flexible environment. As Borealis is growing, successful applicants can grow with the company. The selected candidate will work with the corporate operations group and support Central British Columbia branch team members. Customer service is emphasized here as it is a key role for Borealis in our corporate and branch offices.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provide administrative support to the Operations team and local branch office (Safety, Compliance, ERP support, Projects)
  • Facilitate client requests and customer management within our ERP software.
  • Accounts receivable as directed
  • Assist staff in procurement through appropriate channels
  • Assist in the preparation of reports, presentations, and data analysis.
  • Maintain safety, inspections, maintenance and compliance records.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records, both physical and electronic.
  • Ensure compliance with record-keeping policies and procedures.
  • Facilitate communication within the organization and with external partners.
  • Manage correspondence, emails, and phone calls.
  • Assist in HR-related tasks such as onboarding, offboarding, and employee record maintenance.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational policies and procedures.
  • Maintain office organization and cleanliness.


Qualifications:

  • Working knowledge of the propane industry is preferred
  • Safety, compliance and logistics experience
  • Strong knowledge of computers and cloud ERP systems
  • Communication and coordination skills required
  • Strong administration experience
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills required
  • Friendly and outgoing


Education/Experience Requirement:

  • High school Degree
  • University or college degree in business administration preferred


Job Type:

Full-time work from our branch location in Quesnel or Williams Lake, B.C.

title: Fullstack Developer (f/m/x) - Remote Friendly
description:
Emporix is an AI-driven Autonomous Commerce Execution Platform that gives enterprises full control over how their commerce works. It orchestrates operations end-to-end—so companies can scale faster, respond smarter, and deliver better customer experiences.



We are looking for Fullstack Developers
to join our team in Poland. In this role, you will bridge the gap between robust backend microservices and sleek, high-performance user interfaces, while leveraging modern AI tools to accelerate development and build smarter features.



You can work from our modern office in Gliwice or remotely from anywhere in Poland, with a visit to the office at least once per month to meet the team.



What You’ll Be Doing



End-to-End Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain highly scalable features across the entire stack, from frontend web applications (React, TypeScript) to backend microservices (Java, Spring Boot/Micronaut).
  • Develop intuitive user interfaces and reusable frontend components that provide a consistent, responsive experience for our users.



API & Services Engineering

  • Build robust APIs and backend services that aggregate data from commerce and external systems, ensuring high performance, proper permissions, and security.
  • Integrate complex business workflows, translating product requirements into clear technical rules, validations, approvals, and exception handling.



UI/UX Craftsmanship

  • Partner closely with UX/UI designers to translate Figma specifications and design systems into modular, highly accessible, and maintainable component architectures.
  • Optimize client-side performance and deliver seamless end-to-end commerce workflows.



AI Integration & Innovation

  • Leverage AI engineering tools (like GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) to write cleaner code, generate tests, and accelerate your daily development workflows.
  • Collaborate with the team to brainstorm and implement AI-driven capabilities directly into our commerce platform.



Software Quality & Testing

  • Maintain high standards of software craftsmanship by writing clean, modular code adhering to modern engineering principles (SOLID, clean code).
  • Ensure strong test coverage across the stack, validating your code against business scenarios through functional, integration, and end-to-end testing.



Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product Managers, UX/UI designers, and fellow engineers to refine platform capabilities, define user journeys, and align on technical acceptance criteria.


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: You have 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Fullstack Developer building scalable, production-grade applications.
  • Education: You hold a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Frontend Stack: You have strong proficiency in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS, and modern web APIs.
  • Backend Stack: You are comfortable working in Java and are familiar with modern backend frameworks like Spring Boot or Micronaut.
  • Culture & Team Fit: You are a highly collaborative team player. You are proactive, hardworking, and believe that being a "nice person" is just as important as writing great code.
  • AI Savvy: You embrace the AI revolution in software engineering. You actively use AI coding assistants to improve your productivity and have a strong interest in integrating AI APIs into software products.
  • UX & Design Alignment: You have a strong eye for design, detail, and user experience, with practical experience building interfaces directly from Figma or design systems.
  • Communication: You communicate effectively in both Polish and English (minimum B2 level).


Why You’ll Love It Here

  • An Amazing Team & Culture (Our Best Asset!): We aim high and build rapidly, but we do it together. You will join an incredible, high-trust, and psychologically safe workplace where people truly care for one another. We collaborate closely, support each other unconditionally, and genuinely have fun doing what we do.
  • Hands-On Innovation: We value creative freedom. You’ll have the opportunity to choose the hardware and tooling that help you achieve the best results.
  • Autonomy and Innovation: Enjoy the freedom to explore new ideas, experiment with innovative technologies, and influence the technical direction of a rapidly growing company.
  • Flexible Work Setup: Enjoy a hybrid work model that promotes flexibility and personal well-being while encouraging collaboration and meaningful team connections. (Meet in our Gliwice office at least once a month.)
  • Impactful Contribution: Your work will directly contribute to the stability and evolution of a cutting-edge, AI-driven commerce platform used by global enterprises.


Come as you are: We are building an AI-driven future for commerce, and that requires a variety of perspectives. Emporix is an equal opportunity employer where your skills, proactive attitude, and ability to work well with others are what matter most. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Even if you don’t check every single box, but you are passionate about fullstack development and AI, we’d love to meet you.

title: Backend Developer
description:
Introduction


Currenxie is a financial technology company for borderless businesses. Founded in 2014, our Global Account platform offers businesses of all sizes a single finance app for global growth. Features include multi-currency digital wallets, on-demand virtual bank accounts, worldwide payments, currency exchange, and instant Visa cards. We value innovative technology, user experience, and service.


We are an ambitious and rapidly growing company led by an entrepreneurial and collaborative team. We offer our people an opportunity to be part of building a new financial services platform for a borderless world, and to learn and progress in a friendly, dynamic and multi-cultural environment.


Job Description


We are looking for a Backend Developer to join our agile dev team, and interested in building state-of-the-art, performant, scalable and maintainable backend services and APIs. You will be involved in working on multiple products with a modern tech stack, and on projects involving multiple team members in a dynamic environment.


We’d like that you aren’t afraid of voicing an opinion on how to do things better, in both our code base, and in our daily workflows and processes. You must be a driven team player that never compromises on quality. You are comfortable working in a dynamic, multinational environment where excellence is encouraged and rewarded.


Responsibilities

  • Develop secure backend services and APIs to support new features and further enhancements.
  • Understanding product requirements and translating them to robust technical solutions.
  • Contribute to overall solution architecture.
  • Work and collaborate with the rest of the engineering team, including frontend developers and product owners.
  • Maintain code and write automated tests to ensure the product is of the highest quality.
  • Keep improving our code base as we go along, and refactor things for the better.
  • Diagnose and fix bugs and performance issues.


Skills

  • 5+ years of Java experience, candidates with less working experience will be considered as Backend Developer
  • Experience building and maintaining APIs using Spring Boot, JPA, connecting to various SQL and NoSQL databases (ideally PostgreSQL and Redis).
  • Experience building server-side generated web applications using templating engines (such as Thymeleaf)
  • Ability to write well-documented, clean code.
  • Degree in computer science or similar technical discipline.
  • Hands-on experience in team programming projects, preferably using Git or other source control systems.
  • Excellent English communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving skills and able to pick up new technologies.


Bonus

  • Understanding of CI/CD for building and deploying applications to the cloud.
  • Experience with containerized applications.
  • Exposure to banking/card/e-wallet and general fintech products.
  • Experience with AWS (cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, container orchestration).
  • Familiarity with application security and DevSecOps.


Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.


Data collected will be treated in strict confidence and used for recruitment purpose only. Currenxie does not accept unsollicited resumes from search firm recruiters. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Currenxie.

title: Personal Banking Advisor -  Cape Coral
description:
General Information:

Primary Location: Cape Coral

Employee Status: Full Time

Workplace Type: Fully On-Site

Who we are:

At LMCU, you'll find more than just a job - discover a fulfilling career where your contributions truly matter. Join our talented team at Lake Michigan Credit Union and discover the difference an employer who puts people first can make in your career and life.

About this position:

LMCU is looking for a Personal Banking Advisor who will serve as a financial consultant and advocate for LMCU's members including both new and existing consumer and business clients. This role focuses on meeting members' financial needs by providing expert guidance, actively cross-selling LMCU products, and delivering exceptional service. Personal Banking Advisors are responsible for setting up new accounts, processing loans, and assisting with a variety of financial products while building long-term relationships with members to help all members achieve their dreams for a lifetime. The role requires strong consultative skills, a commitment to service excellence, and the ability to meet individual and branch goals. This role requires excellent attention to detail, superior verbal and written communication skills and the ability to provide solutions through exceptional critical thinking abilities.

What you’ll do:

Member Experience

  • Promote strong member interactions by establishing trust and rapport with members, ensuring a personalized and consultative approach to addressing their financial needs.
  • Educate and inform members on LMCU products and services that meet their financial goals, identifying opportunities to cross-sell relevant products, such as loans, credit cards, second mortgages, and other banking services.
  • Demonstrate critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify solutions that meet members' needs while mitigating risks to both LMCU and its members.
  • Build relationships with members, ensuring high-quality service that encourages member retention and satisfaction.
  • Resolve conflicts and de-escalate unfavorable situations, maintaining a high level of professionalism, empathy, and care in every interaction.
  • Self-manage prioritization and organization of tasks, ensuring timely follow-ups and ensuring accuracy in all dealings with members.
  • Ensure compliance with LMCU’s policies and regulatory requirements when processing financial transactions, managing sensitive member data, and maintaining security standards.

Product Promotion/Growth

  • Consult with both consumer and business members, demonstrating the ability to accurately process new consumer accounts, loans, credit cards, second mortgages, HSA or IRA accounts, and business account products.
  • Actively contribute to branch goals by meeting individual sales and customer service targets, promoting LMCU products that meet the financial needs of members.
  • Represent LMCU in the community by participating in sponsored events or on-site business employer group sessions, building brand awareness and promoting LMCU services.
  • Identify opportunities to refer members to other LMCU departments, such as Mortgage, Wealth, Premier, Insurance, Treasury, and Commercial services, to enhance member satisfaction and branch growth.

Leadership & Development

  • Mentor and coach peers recognizing opportunities to share best practices for referrals, product knowledge, and sales techniques.
  • Actively participate in LMCU projects, initiatives, and culture, promoting core values such as PRIDE, I AM LMCU, and upholding LMCU’s service standards.
  • Adapt to changing branch needs, maintaining composure and effectiveness in a dynamic work environment, and contributing to problem-solving when faced with new challenges.
  • Assist in various aspects of branch operations as needed, including processing transactions, handling vault responsibilities, and taking on supervisor duties during Saturday shifts or other peak times.

What you’ll bring:

  • Three years to five years of similar or related experience, including preparatory experience.
  • High school diploma or equivalent (required), with additional coursework or banking experience preferred.
  • Michigan Resident Producer Credit Insurance License required for all Michigan-based employees. External candidates without current licensure must successfully complete the licensing examination and provide proof of certification within 90 days of hire.
  • Ability to become registered through NMLS and achieve notary certification through the county.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively engage with members and provide personalized financial solutions.
  • In-depth knowledge of LMCU products and services, with the ability to process consumer and business accounts and loans accurately.
  • Proven ability to meet sales targets and contribute to branch goals in a results-driven environment.
  • Exceptional problem-solving and conflict resolution skills, with the ability to handle challenging situations calmly and professionally.
  • Adaptability and a flexible approach to meeting changing needs and demands in the branch.

What you’ll get:

  • All Employees: weekly pay and retirement savings options.
  • Full Time Employees: comprehensive health coverage including medical (with prescription), dental, vision, HSA match, paid parental leave, and tuition reimbursement.
  • To see a full list of our benefit offerings, check out this helpful guide!

Have additional questions about the role? Email the Talent Acquisition Team at: Careers@lmcu.org.

If you lack access to the internet or require an accommodation in the application process, please send your resume via mail to P.O. Box 2848, Grand Rapids, MI 49501-2848.

LMCU is an Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Metallityöntekijä Forssaan
description:
Haemme asiakasyritykseemme monitaitoista metallityöntekijää Forssaan määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Pidätkö tarkasta ja laadukkaasta työstä, jossa jokainen yksityiskohta tehdään huolella alusta loppuun?
Saatko motivaatiota siitä, että näet oman työsi jäljen konkreettisesti ja tiedät sen vaikuttavan lopputuloksen laatuun?
Oletko oma-aloitteinen, vastuullinen ja viihdyt työssä, jossa tekemisen tahti on ripeä ja yhteistyö on osa arkea?

Nyt on tarjolla huippupaikka – ja se voisi olla juuri sinulle!

Työtehtävät:
• Osallistut monipuolisesti tuotannon päivittäisiin työtehtäviin, moninaisten teräsrakenteiden valmistukseen.
• Käytät alan perustyökaluja ja -menetelmiä esimerkiksi kokoonpanossa, koneenkäytössä tai laadunvalvonnassa
• Huolehdit omalta osaltasi työn laadusta, siisteydestä ja turvallisuudesta työvuoron aikana

Tarjoamme:
• Pitkäaikaisen työn arvostetussa teollisuusalan asiakasyrityksessä
• Mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi kokeneiden ammattilaisten rinnalla
• Hyvän työilmapiirin ja osaavan tiimin tuen

Odotamme sinulta:
• Alan koulutusta tai aiempaa kokemusta teollisuustuotannon tehtävistä, (esim. levyseppä-hitsaaja)
• Motivoitunutta, oma-aloitteista ja huolellista asennetta työhön
• Hyviä tiimityöskentelytaitoja ja halua tehdä laadukasta jälkeä

Työ alkaa sopivan henkilön löydyttyä ja työllistyt aluksi Amikon kautta, mutta tavoitteena on siirtyä asiakkaan kirjoille vakituiseksi työntekijäksi. Palkkauksessa sovelletaan teknologia työehtosopimusta ja määrittämisessä otetaan huomioon aikaisempi kokemus ja koulutuksesi.

Kolahtiko?

Kuulostaa hyvältä, mutta miksi hakisin töitä juuri Amikon kautta?

Amiko tarjoaa kaiken tasoisille ammattilaisille laajan valikoiman töitä. Olemme sinulle reilu, luotettava ja joustava työelämän kumppani. Amikolla on hyvä maine työmarkkinoilla. Pyrimme aina etsimään parhaat mahdolliset ratkaisut työllistymisesi tueksi. Amikolaisena saat:

• Vähintään TES:in mukaisen palkkauksen-palkkausjärjestelmämme on kannustava, joskus jopa suurempi kuin työllistyessä suoraan yrityksen palkkalistoille.

• Laajasti erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia- meillä on kattavat verkostot ja laaja työpaikkavalikoimaniin osa-aikaisia, kokopäiväisiä kuin sesonkitöitä monelta eri alalta. Kun sopiva työ löytyy, monille tarjoutuu myös mahdollisuus siirtyä vakituiseksi työntekijäksi asiakasyritykseen.

• Oman yhteyshenkilön ja yksilöllistä työnhakua – Amikolta saat henkilökohtaista palvelua ja oman tutun yhteyshenkilön, johon voit olla suoraan yhteydessä.

• Kattavat työterveyspalvelut, normaalin eläkekertymän ja sairausajan palkan sairauden sattuessa – Vaikka teetkin työsi asiakasyrityksessämme, olet amikolainen ja kannamme sinusta vastuun ja huolehdimme eduistasi.

• … vai kenties jotain ihan uutta urallesi? Autamme myös alanvaihdossa. Räätälöidyt uravalmennukset auttavat päivittämään osaamistasi ja löytämään uuden suunnan urallasi.

Voisiko tässä olla sinulle uusi työpaikka?

Toimimme asiakkaallemme rekrytointikumppanina, käsittelemme saapuvat työhakemukset sekä vastaamme ensimmäisen vaiheen haastatteluista. Jätäthän hakemuksesi pikimmiten. Lisätietoja saat soittamalla Amikon Tarmo Laakso, 050 5532819 ja nappaa itsellesi uusi huippuduuni!

Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivien henkilön löydyttyä.

Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse vastaanotettuja hakemuksia vaan jätäthän hakemuksen nettisivujemme kautta tietosuojasyistä.

Please note that we do not process applications submitted by e-mail, so please submit your application via our website for privacy and data protection reasons.
