title: Systems Engineer (Forward Deployed)
description:
Systems Engineer (Forward Deployed)

About Anvil

Anvil is a trusted partner in the defence industry, delivering cutting-edge solutions that enhance military capabilities and operational effectiveness. We extend our expertise to public safety, law enforcement, and national security organizations, accelerating mission-critical decision-making through analytical tools, automations, and game-changing machine learning capabilities. ANVIL helps organizations discover, manage, enrich, fuse, and exploit the information available to them in support of Information Dominance and Decision Advantage.

Job Type: Full Time (Ottawa / Hybrid / up to 30% Travel)

Total Compensation: CAD $140,000 - $180,000 - Placement within range based on experience and qualifications

Vacancy Status: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Anvil. We are actively hiring for this role

The Role

We are seeking a versatile Systems Engineer to join our team, focused on delivering mission-critical software to our defence, public safety, and national security customers. You will install, configure, and deploy our software on secure, government-operated infrastructure, and design the integrations and data pipelines that connect our platform to the systems our customers depend on. This role owns both sides of the deployment lifecycle - the infrastructure it runs on and the data flowing through it.

Working closely with defence contractors, military personnel, and technical authorities, you will architect and deploy foundational infrastructure, implement secure containerized deployments, build integration pipelines, and stand up reliable production systems end to end. You will own the technical deployment process for our professional services team, from setting strategy through validating functionality, catching issues early, and keeping documentation current.

At Anvil, we are fundamentally in the relationship business. Technical excellence is table stakes. What sets our team apart is the ability to build trust with customers, communicate with clarity and confidence, and represent Anvil with professionalism in every interaction. Exceptional customer-facing communication skills are not a nice-to-have in this role; they are essential to your success and to ours.

This is a full-time position based in Ottawa with up to 30% travel (domestic and international). Candidates must either possess or be eligible to obtain a Government of Canada Top Secret security clearance.

Required Qualifications

Security Clearance

Eligible for Government of Canada Top Secret security clearance

Experience

  • Minimum of 4+ years of software deployment, infrastructure, or systems integration experience, preferably in defence or related industry
  • A minimum of 2+ years of experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift)
  • A minimum of 2+ years of experience with Linux server deployment and administration, or building integrations against external systems (REST APIs, message queues, streaming interfaces)
  • Demonstrated experience deploying, securing, or integrating production-level systems in government or enterprise environments
  • Demonstrated experience or strong aptitude for leading customer-facing technical discovery sessions, including requirements gathering, solution scoping, and value-driven conversations that build customer trust

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of Linux server deployment, networking, logging, and troubleshooting tools (e.g., ssh, tcpdump, iproute2)
  • Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift, and hypervisors (e.g., KVM, VMware ESXi)
  • Familiarity with pipelines that ingest data from diverse sources (flat files, databases, APIs, message queues, streams)
  • Working understanding of TLS, HTTP/2-3, and PKI as they relate to secure deployment and data exchange
  • Working knowledge of IAM standards and protocols (e.g., OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML)
  • Strong analytical mindset with exceptional attention to detail
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across development teams and customer stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills; able to manage multiple deployment and integration initiatives simultaneously
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure or data/interface issues and drive efficient resolution

Nice to Have…

  • Familiarity with software systems used by defence organizations such as SitaWare HQ, TAK, Esri AllSource, and others
  • Experience packaging, templating, and deploying applications with Helm charts for Kubernetes/OpenShift Proficiency in Python and web frameworks (e.g., Django, Flask)
  • Experience with message brokers and streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, Redpanda)
  • Experience with data and storage technologies such as SQL, Elasticsearch, and S3
  • Experience deploying and monitoring machine learning models in cloud-hosted and on-premise networks
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tooling for repeatable deployments
  • Proficiency in scripting for automation (e.g., Bash, Python) Prior experience working with or for defence, public safety, law enforcement, and national security organizations

What You’ll Do

Deployment & Integration Strategy and Planning

  • Partner with customers and internal teams to understand infrastructure and data requirements, and develop comprehensive deployment and integration strategies
  • Create and maintain detailed deployment plans, integration designs, and documentation to ensure successful implementations across all customer environments
  • Document deployment and integration approaches based on security assessments, data sensitivity, and regulatory requirements
  • Advise on and implement infrastructure strategies, containerization frameworks, and integration patterns across the entire platform

Software Deployment, Infrastructure, and Integration

  • Travel to customer and partner sites to participate in requirements gathering, software deployment, integration development, testing, and hands-on support Build and manage containerized applications using Docker, Docker Compose, and Kubernetes/OpenShift
  • Deploy, secure, and monitor Linux-based containerized applications, services, and machine learning models in both cloud-hosted and on-premise networks
  • Design, build, and test integrations with external systems, including pipelines for ingesting, transforming, and validating data
  • Develop custom connectors and adapters for diverse customer data sources
  • Streamline installation, configuration, and integration processes and documentation for repeatable deployments
  • Provide regular status updates on deployment and integration progress and system health metrics

Infrastructure, Data Quality, and Security

  • Ensure all deployments and integrations meet strict government security and operational standards Implement appropriate processes for data protection, validation, disaster recovery, and failover procedures
  • Diagnose and resolve technical infrastructure, data, or interface issues leveraging deep knowledge of Linux, networking, APIs, and security principles
  • Provide documentation and technical specifications to IT staff for planning and implementing infrastructure upgrades
  • Champion security and data quality standards and best practices across all deployment and integration environments

Customer Support and Communication

  • Work directly with stakeholders, including defence contractors and military personnel, to ensure solutions align with operational requirements
  • Participate actively in customer meetings, technical reviews, and deployment/integration planning sessions
  • Review and provide detailed feedback on infrastructure requirements, interface specifications, and security documents
  • Customize software deployments and integrations to meet unique customer operational needs
  • Communicate deployment and integration results and system metrics to stakeholders at all levels

Why Join Us?

Our Mission

This is more than just a job; you'll be part of a team of dedicated professionals who share a common goal: to increase the safety and security of western democracies through the effective use of data. Our workplace is not just a job, it's a community of like-minded people working together to make a positive impact on the world we live in.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salaries
  • Flexible health benefits package through Equitable
  • Industry-leading employer retirement contributions match


Work Environment

  • Hybrid (Ottawa market) work model combining remote flexibility with meaningful in-person collaboration *this role requires 30% Travel
  • Modern office in the historic Carriageway building in beautiful downtown Ottawa
  • Access to downtown amenities, transit, and Ottawa's vibrant cultural scene


What You'll Experience

  • Work alongside dedicated professionals who value excellence and collaboration
  • Contribute to projects with real-world security impact
  • Join a culture where your expertise and ideas matter


Application Process

To apply for this role, please submit your CV and cover letter. The application process will likely include:

  • A preliminary call with our HR team which will be a chance for you to find out more about Anvil and the role.
  • An initial interview to discuss your experience and suitability for the role.
  • A technical interview to assess your competencies.


Use of AI in Recruitment: Anvil does not use artificial intelligence to screen, assess, or select applicants for this position. All applications are reviewed by members of our recruitment team. However, we do use AI for scheduling, note taking and other administrative functions.
Anvil is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you require accommodation during the selection process, please let us know.

title: Inventory Supervisor
description:
POSITION SUMMARY: The Supervisor, Inventory at SriSai Biopharmaceutical Solutions, LLC (SBS) is responsible for the day-to-day supervision and coordination of inventory activities to ensure accurate receipt, storage, movement, staging, and documentation of materials and finished goods.

This position ensures that inventory operations are performed in accordance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), Good Documentation Practices (GDP), applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), safety requirements, and company policies.

The Supervisor provides daily direction to Inventory Associates, monitors workflow and priorities, supports inventory accuracy and reconciliation activities, and ensures proper material identification, segregation, labeling, and traceability. The position works closely with Inventory Management, Shipping & Receiving, Production, Quality Assurance, and other departments to support timely and compliant operations.

Principal Responsibilities and Tasks
The statements below reflect the general nature and scope of work assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the job. Management may assign additional duties and responsibilities as needed, in alignment with business needs and applicable laws.

Essential Functions:

Inventory Operations and Material Control

  • Supervise daily inventory activities including receiving, storage, material movement, staging, picking, replenishment, and issuance of materials.
  • Ensure inventory transactions are completed accurately and in a timely manner within the applicable ERP or Warehouse Management System (WMS).
  • Verify that materials are properly identified, labeled, stored, and segregated according to their status, including quarantine, released, rejected, or other designated classifications.
  • Monitor inventory levels and material availability to support production and operational requirements.
  • Coordinate material staging and kitting activities according to production schedules and departmental priorities.
  • Ensure appropriate handling, storage, and movement of temperature-sensitive or controlled materials when applicable.
  • Support cycle counts, physical inventories, and inventory reconciliation activities.
  • Investigate inventory discrepancies and escalate significant issues to Inventory Management.
  • Assist with documenting inventory adjustments and corrective actions in accordance with established procedures.

Leadership and Team Supervision

  • Provide daily work assignments, priorities, and operational direction to Inventory Associates.
  • Monitor employee performance, productivity, attendance, and adherence to departmental procedures.
  • Provide hands-on coaching and training related to inventory procedures, documentation requirements, material handling, safety, and applicable SOPs.
  • Ensure employees are trained and qualified before independently performing assigned inventory tasks.
  • Promote accountability, teamwork, professionalism, and adherence to SBS's RICE values.
  • Identify performance or training concerns and communicate them promptly to Inventory Management.
  • Support onboarding and training of new Inventory Associates.
  • Conduct routine team communication to ensure employees understand daily workload, priorities, operational changes, and compliance expectations.

Compliance and Documentation

  • Ensure inventory activities are performed in accordance with cGMP, GDP, SBS procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Review inventory documentation for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with Good Documentation Practices.
  • Ensure material movements are traceable and appropriately documented.
  • Maintain accurate inventory records and support documentation needed for audits, investigations, and inventory reconciliation.
  • Immediately report documentation errors, material discrepancies, damaged materials, labeling issues, or potential compliance concerns to management and Quality Assurance as appropriate.
  • Assist Quality Assurance and Inventory Management with internal and external audits, investigations, CAPAs, and material disposition activities.
  • Ensure employees follow established SOPs, work instructions, safety procedures, and applicable EHS requirements.

Workflow and Operational Coordination

  • Monitor daily workload and allocate personnel according to operational priorities.
  • Coordinate with Shipping & Receiving, Production, Quality Assurance, and other departments regarding material availability and movement.
  • Communicate inventory shortages, discrepancies, delays, or other operational risks to Inventory Management.
  • Ensure priority materials and operational requests are addressed according to established timelines.
  • Support efficient warehouse organization and material flow.
  • Escalate operational issues that may impact production, customer commitments, compliance, or safety.

Inventory Accuracy and Reconciliation

  • Support routine cycle counts and scheduled physical inventory activities.
  • Compare physical inventory against electronic inventory records and identify discrepancies.
  • Assist with root-cause investigations related to inventory variances.
  • Ensure identified discrepancies are properly documented and escalated.
  • Monitor adherence to inventory control procedures designed to prevent loss, misplacement, incorrect transactions, or documentation errors.
  • Support monthly and annual inventory reconciliation activities as requested by Inventory Management and Finance.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve inventory accuracy, workflow, material organization, documentation, and operational efficiency.
  • Support Lean, 5S, and other continuous improvement initiatives within the warehouse and inventory areas.
  • Participate in departmental and cross-functional improvement projects.
  • Encourage team members to identify and communicate operational improvement opportunities.
  • Assist management with implementing revised procedures, workflows, and inventory controls.

Safety and Warehouse Compliance

  • Promote a safe working environment and ensure employees follow applicable OSHA, EHS, and SBS safety requirements.
  • Ensure required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is used appropriately.
  • Report unsafe conditions, equipment concerns, incidents, or injuries in accordance with SBS procedures.
  • Support safe material handling and proper use of warehouse equipment.
  • Ensure aisles, storage areas, workstations, and inventory locations remain organized and free of avoidable hazards.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Shipping & Receiving, Production, and Quality Assurance to support timely and accurate material movement.
  • Coordinate with Inventory Management regarding staffing, priorities, inventory discrepancies, and operational concerns.
  • Support Finance during inventory reconciliation activities.
  • Collaborate with HR and Training to help ensure Inventory Associates remain current with required training and qualifications.
  • Maintain professional communication with internal departments regarding inventory requirements and operational priorities.



Other Duties as Assigned

  • Perform additional duties in alignment with evolving business priorities and departmental goals.

Physical and Environmental Requirements:
This position may involve physical and environmental demands as determined by its essential functions. These requirements are outlined in the attached Physical and Environmental Requirements document.
SriSai Biopharmaceutical Solutions, LLC (SBS) complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Inventory transactions and records are completed accurately and on time.
  • Inventory accuracy is consistently maintained at established departmental targets.
  • Materials are correctly identified, labeled, segregated, stored, and traceable.
  • cGMP/GDP documentation is accurate, complete, and audit-ready.
  • Cycle counts and inventory reconciliation activities are completed according to schedule.
  • Inventory discrepancies are identified, investigated, documented, and escalated promptly.
  • Materials are staged and available according to operational and production requirements.
  • Inventory Associates consistently follow SOPs, safety requirements, and documentation practices.
  • Warehouse and inventory areas remain organized, safe, and operationally efficient.
  • Strong communication and teamwork support timely operations across departments.
  • Team members demonstrate accountability, engagement, and continued professional development.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required:

  • Associate degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of 2–4 years of experience in inventory control, warehouse operations, materials management, logistics, or a related environment.
  • Previous experience providing work direction, team leadership, training, or supervision.
  • Working knowledge of inventory control practices, cycle counting, reconciliation, and material traceability.
  • Understanding of Good Documentation Practices (GDP).
  • Ability to work effectively within established SOPs and controlled procedures.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple operational requirements in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
  • Experience using an ERP, inventory management system, or Warehouse Management System (WMS).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional departments.

Minimum Education & Experience Requirements

Education

Associate degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

OR

An equivalent combination of education and relevant inventory or warehouse experience.

Experience

2–4 years of inventory, warehouse, logistics, or materials management experience.

Experience within a regulated, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or life sciences environment is preferred.

Previous experience leading, training, or providing daily direction to employees.

Demonstrated experience supporting inventory accuracy, cycle counts, and documentation activities.

Preferred:

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Experience working in a cGMP-regulated pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical environment.
  • Familiarity with FDA requirements and Good Documentation Practices.
  • Experience with ERP or WMS systems such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with barcode scanning and electronic inventory management systems.
  • Experience with temperature-controlled or cold-chain materials.
  • Knowledge of Lean, 5S, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Knowledge of OSHA and EHS requirements applicable to warehouse environments.

ABOUT SBS AND OUR VALUES

SriSai Biopharmaceutical Solutions (SBS) is a trusted pharmaceutical support and manufacturing partner delivering excellence in service and execution. Our RICE values guide us:

  • Respect – We treat others with dignity and professionalism.
  • Integrity – We act with transparency, honesty, and accountability.

title: RN - Detox - Nights
description:
JOB TITLE:

Registered Nurse


DEPARTMENT: Detox


SUPERVISED BY: Detox Program Manager


SUPERVISES: None


AVAILABILITY: Full-time. Alternating 3-night and 4-night shifts per week with 10-12 hours per shift and every other weekend, except when additional coverage is needed. Third Shift.


BENEFITS: Paid time off, health insurance (plus vision and dental), 401k plus 5% match, Aflac, Employee Assistance Program


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:



  • Conduct a full nursing assessment for each admission including, but not limited to, medical and social histories, obtain vital signs, Preliminary Breath Test (PBT); conducts blood glucose level (when indicated), Tuberculosis (Tb) and Urine Drug Screen (UDS) testing.

  • Perform an initial screening exam on new/walk-in clients to determine appropriateness for level of care

  • Enter and administer all client home medications. Assist with gathering pharmaceutical records when necessary.

  • Administer on-site medications, treatments and procedures according to standard nursing practices anD Standing Orders provided by ATS Medical Direction.

  • Responsible for the security, administration, and book-keeping/recording of controlled substances administered on site.

  • May need to perform or assist with wound care or minor soft tissue procedures.
  • A client-centered and engaged intake process. Assist with de-escalating clients, as necessary.
  • Assist Advanced Practice Provider and/or Medical Director with implementing orders.

  • Ensure quality documentation of all patient-related services are completed and maintained.
  • Assist in agency compliance and development by keeping current with online agency trainings.

  • Occasionally responsible for on-site visits to various agency satellite programs to conduct client scheduled nursing appointments, medication reconciliations, and/or general nursing duties as required/requested.

  • Maintains open lines of communication between nursing shifts, as well as other programs, supervisors, physicians and other healthcare providers as indicated.


EDUCATION:

Nursing degree from an accredited college or university is required. One year of related SUD or behavioral health experience and/or training is preferred.



REQUIREMENTS

CPR/First Aid

Current Licensed LPN or RN in the State of Michigan


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  1. Admit Medical patients for treatment of opiate and/or alcohol withdrawal
  2. Conduct and interpret urine drug screens and breathalyzer tests for clients
  3. Medicate residential clients as needed
  4. Effectively communicate all pertinent client information at the beginning and end of each shift
  5. Charting/progress note of all clients at least once per shift.
  6. Properly Discharge patients
  7. Count and Log Controlled Substances
  8. Work independently on-site, with an on-call medical provider

title: Installer
description:
At Sunrun, we’re on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we’re building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. To do it, we’re designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. It’s why we’ve become the #1 home solar and battery company in America. We’re unlike any other residential energy company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle – from sale through installation and beyond – so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.

Who We Are

We’re on a mission to make energy more reliable and affordable for more people. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs. Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses.


About Sunrun

Since 2007, Sunrun has grown into America's #1 home solar and battery company. We got here by putting our people’s safety and growth first. That’s why we created the Power+ program: to invest in your skills. We train you to work across different teams—from qualifying homes for solar, to installing, to inspecting the final work, and servicing existing systems. This versatility helps limit reduced hours and enhances job security in an industry affected by seasons. It also means you can solve customer problems in one visit, keeping you safely off the road and moving your career forward.

Overview

The Installer position is a critical member of a solar installation construction team and is responsible for working in partnership with the Foreperson and Lead Installer to complete residential solar installation projects. As Sunrun continues to help build a more sustainable future, this position is best suited for someone passionate about solar installation, field safety and working with others.

Responsibilities/The Impact

  • Ensure personal, crew and job site safety at all times and participates in training sessions on new products, installation methodology and safety

  • Review inventory at loading dock to ensure assigned crew truck is stocked adequately

Qualifications/How You Will Be Successful

  • Previous solar, construction or military experience preferred but not required

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work on rooftops with various angles and surfaces which requires frequent bending, twisting, squatting, climbing, kneeling, crawling, turning, standing, and balance

description:
MOSAIC operates on traditional and unceded Coast Salish Territories, the ancestral lands of the sḵwx̱wú7mesh, sel̓íl ̓witulh, xʷməθkʷəy̓əm, qiqéyt, sc̓əwaθən məsteyəx, kʷikʷəƛ̓əm, q̓ic̓əy̓, qʼʷa:n̓ƛʼən̓, SEMYOME, S'ólh Téméxw (Stó:lō), Stz'uminus, WSÁNEĆ and Matsqui nations where we are privileged to carry out our mission.


WHY YOU SHOULD WORK WITH US:

MOSAIC is one of Canada’s largest settlement non-profit organizations. Our newcomer services change the lives of immigrants, refugees, and individuals from diverse backgrounds in Greater Vancouver and throughout BC. Since 1976, MOSAIC has worked to strengthen communities by advocating for positive changes and supporting newcomers in building their new lives in Canada. As an employer, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where employees can trust that their skills and contributions are valued. We advocate for and promote equitable employment opportunities for women, Indigenous Peoples, people with disabilities, persons of diverse sexual orientation, gender identity or expression (2SLGBTQI+), and racialized individuals. We have been recognized in the 2019 List of Best Workplaces™ in Canada (100-999 employees), the 2020 list of Best Workplaces Managed by Women and 2021 List of Best Workplaces™ in Canada (100-999 employees) by the Great Place to Work® Institute. Our employees benefit from many diverse perspectives, taking part in training opportunities for career growth.


Today the organization engages and serves over 26,000 clients per year at 47 service and community locations in Greater Vancouver through a wide range of high-quality settlement and integration programs including services geared towards youth and family, interpretation and translation, language and workplace training, counselling, and employment. As a certified living wage employer and a CARF-accredited organization, MOSAIC is among the country’s largest immigrant-serving organizations and enjoys a superb reputation, a solid financial position, and a hugely compelling mission.

Employment Counsellor, Surrey Cloverdale Location. Not sure if you're 100% qualified? We encourage you to apply anyway! MOSAIC is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from all backgrounds, spaces, and abilities to apply.

As the Employment Counsellor, you will deliver comprehensive career development services for all clients seeking occupational, certification, career development, career planning, training, and academic upgrading assistance.     position

  • Providing excellent customer service and resolving issues both in person and in a virtual service delivery environment

Full-time (35 hours per week, Monday to Friday and occasional Saturdays on a rotating basis. Fixed term position until March 31, 2027. )

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.


Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).


RECENT RECOGNITION

  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

title: Specialist - Forecasting Oncology
description:
GCL - D2

Introduction to role:

Are you ready to turn complex Oncology data into clear, decision-shaping forecasts that guide strategy and improve patient outcomes? As a Specialist in Forecasting for US Oncology, you will partner with the US Oncology Forecast Leader and Commercial teams. Together, you will develop transparent, trusted forecasts to guide investment, access, and prioritisation for key product lines.

In this role, you'll own short-, mid-, and long-term forecast models. They integrate patient flow dynamics, market research insights, and supplementary information to compose a coherent outlook. You will set expectations for performance, surface pivotal risks and opportunities, and influence brand strategy by defending your methodologies with difficulty and clarity. How will you translate TRx/NBRx signals, claims data, and epidemiology into a compelling narrative leaders can act on!

Based in Manyata Tech Park, Bangalore, this position operates on a 2 PM – 11 PM IST shift in a hybrid model, enabling real-time collaboration with US collaborators while providing the space to deliver high-quality analytical work.

Accountabilities:

  • Forecast Development and Stewardship: Deliver robust, open demand forecasts for strategic brands and therapy areas, clearly documenting assumptions and confidence levels to inform high-stakes decisions.
  • Patient Flow Modeling: Build and maintain product-specific short-term and long-term models using patient-based and patient flow approaches to reflect real-world treatment dynamics.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Align forecast assumptions and analytical assessments with Marketing, Sales, Market Access and Pricing, Finance, and Sales Operations to drive shared understanding and accountability.
  • Executive Engagement: Present and defend forecast approaches, methodologies, assumptions, and outputs to senior leadership, guiding clear choices on risks, opportunities, and prioritisation.
  • Scenario Planning and Risk Management: Apply industry-leading modeling techniques and sensitivity analyses across key variables to quantify uncertainties and shape contingency plans.
  • Performance Analytics: Provide in-depth analysis of drivers behind brand performance; support quarterly business reviews, sales bridges, business planning, and ad hoc requests for Finance and leadership.
  • Market Intelligence: Supervise the competitive landscape, policy shifts, and broader Oncology trends to keep models current and assumptions grounded in market realities.
  • New Product Introduction: Develop short- and long-term volume forecasts for new launches to support strategic and operational planning through realistic, data-backed trajectories.

title: Technical Program Manager, AI Benchmarking
description:
Title: Technical Program Manager, AI Benchmarking

Location: New Delhi, India

Work Authorization: Current and ongoing work authorization in India

Position: Full-time

Application deadline: September 18, 2026, 6 pm IST (applications may be reviewed as they are submitted)


Role Overview:


PxD is looking for a Technical Program Manager to lead delivery of a national initiative benchmarking Indian AI models for agricultural advisory. Government advisory platforms are increasingly powered by large language models, and a growing set of Indian foundational models, fine-tuned variants, and voice-based systems have emerged as potential alternatives — but little rigorous evidence exists on how they perform inside live advisory workflows. You will run a multi-partner benchmarking program that produces decision-ready evidence for the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare on which models can be safely and effectively integrated into existing advisory systems.


PxD will co-design the benchmark framework and act as consortium facilitator and government coordination partner for this work, convening government agencies, academic technical evaluators, benchmark partners, and model providers. You will be the person who holds that consortium together day to day: setting the benchmarking architecture with government, contracting and managing academic and technical partners, overseeing the evidence pipeline from technical testing through farmer-facing user research, and turning the results into recommendations a ministry can act on. This position is based in New Delhi, with travel to partner institutions and project states.


About PxD:


PxD is a rapidly scaling global non-profit that harnesses the power of technology, data science, and behavioral economics to provide targeted information to farmers in low- and middle-income countries. Providing the right information to the right people, in the right way and at the right time, increases incomes, protects the environment, and improves well-being. We are evidence-based: we test our interventions with randomized controlled trials to prove our impact and cost-effectiveness, to simultaneously learn from and improve our service, and to demonstrate our value to funders and partners.


Responsibilities:


Government & Stakeholder Management


  • Serve as PxD's day-to-day point of contact for the benchmarking program, working through PxD's embedded PMU team to align the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare on priority use cases, target languages and geographies, candidate models, benchmarking baselines, and approval pathways.
  • Establish the governance framework for the consortium — partner roles, decision rights, steering cadence, and escalation routes — and keep it functioning as the program moves through its stages.
  • Negotiate system and data access, including access to government advisory environments for substitution testing, and maintain a permissions tracker across government, academic, and advisory data sources.
  • Facilitate workshops and consultations with government counterparts, model providers, and domain experts; manage the funder relationship and reporting.


Benchmarking Design & Technical Delivery


  • Own the benchmarking framework end to end: advisory use cases, benchmark tasks, datasets, human-rating rubrics, safety and language criteria, tool-use and source-grounding assessments, cost comparison templates, and decision thresholds.
  • Work with existing benchmark initiatives to adapt and localise established assets rather than building a parallel benchmark.
  • Coordinate technical benchmarking across three layers — standalone model evaluation, substitution testing within the live government advisory stack, and a neutral benchmarking harness where direct system access is unavailable — alongside assessment of speech recognition, translation, text-to-speech, and multilingual performance.
  • Manage latency, reliability, and total-cost-of-ownership analysis, and oversee the cloud compute, GPU, and API resources that represent the single largest cost line in the program.
  • Safeguard the independence and neutrality of the benchmarking by maintaining clear separation between benchmark development, model evaluation, and model development roles of partner organisations, with transparent disclosure of potential conflicts of interest.


Evidence Generation & Synthesis


  • Oversee pre-deployment user evidence generation with agronomists, extension personnel, and compensated farmer participant testers, assessing whether advisory outputs are comprehensible, actionable, trustworthy, and usable in local languages.
  • Manage IRB submission and third-party field vendor selection and oversight for user testing.
  • Consolidate findings across technical performance, user evidence, safety, operational readiness, and cost into a single decision framework, and translate them into recommendations a non-technical government audience can act on.
  • Author the final evidence synthesis and decision report identifying models ready for pilot deployment, models requiring further optimization, and key implementation risks.


Grants, Contracts & Partner Management


  • Contract and manage academic and technical partners, sandbox and compute hosts, domain-expert consultants, and field vendors, monitoring performance against agreed deliverables.
  • Ensure contractual and donor compliance throughout implementation, including data-processing agreements and dataset licenses.
  • Coordinate with finance and operations teams on budgets, procurement, and financial reporting against grant milestones.


Team & Knowledge Management


  • Work alongside research and field staff supporting the program, providing technical direction and day-to-day coordination.
  • Document benchmarking tools, protocols, and methodology so future evaluations across agricultural and other public-sector advisory systems can build on this work.
  • Contribute to PxD's institutional knowledge management and cross-country learning on AI advisory.


What You'll Bring:


Required


  • Master's degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Public Policy, Economics, Agriculture, Development Studies, Management, or another relevant field.
  • 5–8 years of progressively responsible experience managing complex technical programs or projects.
  • Working fluency with modern AI systems — LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, prompting, model evaluation, and the practical trade-offs between accuracy, latency, safety, and cost.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multi-stakeholder projects involving government agencies, academic institutions, and external technical partners.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to run parallel workstreams against fixed donor milestones.
  • Ability to translate technical evidence into clear, decision-oriented recommendations for non-technical senior audiences.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.
  • Excellent organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.


Preferred


  • Demonstrated experience with AI model evaluation (academic/ personal/ work projects).
  • Direct experience designing or running model evaluations, benchmarks, or structured A/B testing of AI systems.
  • Experience with Indian-language NLP, speech technology (ASR/TTS), or multilingual model performance.
  • Experience working with state or national government programs, or with digital public infrastructure.
  • Background in agriculture, climate, technology, or international development.
  • Familiarity with causal inference and experimental design.
  • Comfort operating with significant ambiguity and limited existing infrastructure, having built or launched a new program from scratch.
  • Proficiency in one or more Indian languages.

title: Packaging and Labeling Associate
description:
Job Description

Packaging and Labeling Associate

About the Role

At SriSai Biopharmaceutical Solutions (SBS), our Packaging and Labeling Associates play a key role in supporting manufacturing and distribution operations. This position ensures that products are accurately packaged, properly labeled, and fully documented in compliance with cGMP regulations, company procedures, and quality standards.

This is a detail-oriented role where precision and compliance are critical. You will work closely with Production and Quality teams in a fast-paced, regulated environment while contributing to a culture driven by our RICE values: Respect, Integrity, Customer-Centered, and Excellence.

What You’ll Do

  • Assemble packaging components and perform line clearance between batches
  • Operate packaging equipment (labelers, sealers, shrink-wrap machines) safely
  • Inspect finished products to ensure accuracy and compliance
  • Complete documentation including packaging records and label reconciliation forms
  • Follow Good Documentation Practices (GDP) at all times
  • Report deviations, discrepancies, or labeling errors promptly
  • Maintain cleanliness and organization of the packaging area (GMP standards)
  • Follow gowning, hygiene, and safety procedures (PPE)
  • Collaborate with Production, QA, and Warehouse teams to meet timelines

Who You Are

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • 1+ year of experience in packaging/labeling (pharma, biotech, or regulated environment preferred)
  • Previous aliquoting experience preferred
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to follow SOPs and documentation practices
  • Basic computer skills
  • Able to perform repetitive tasks with consistency
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills

What Success Looks Like

  • Packaging and labeling completed accurately and in compliance with cGMP
  • No labeling errors or documentation discrepancies
  • Complete and timely documentation
  • Clean, organized, and inspection-ready workspace
  • Effective collaboration across teams

Working Conditions

  • Ability to perform repetitive tasks and stand for extended periods
  • Work in controlled manufacturing or warehouse environments
  • Follow safety and compliance standards at all times

Why Join SBS?

At SBS, we are more than a growing biopharmaceutical company—we are a team where precision meets purpose. If you are committed to quality, compliance, and making an impact, we encourage you to apply.

Our Values (RICE)

  • Respect: We treat everyone with professionalism and dignity
  • Integrity: We act with honesty and accountability
  • Customer-Centered: We deliver reliable, responsive support
  • Excellence: We strive for the highest standards in everything we do

Equal Opportunity Employer

SriSai Biopharmaceutical Solutions (SBS) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

In this role, you will be an integral part of our engineering teams, responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of our infrastructure, sophisticated CI/CD workflows, and essential operational processes. Your expertise will span across both cloud-based (AWS) and on-premises environments, ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of our cutting-edge banking platform.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain robust automation tools, sophisticated deployment pipelines, and streamlined operational processes across both AWS and on-premises systems.
  • Provide comprehensive support for application deployments and infrastructure management across all environments, including development, staging, UAT, and production.
  • Develop and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines tailored for a diverse range of application technologies, ensuring efficient and reliable software delivery.
  • Implement and manage GitOps-based deployment workflows and advanced release strategies to enhance control and visibility.
  • Support and manage containerized workloads effectively on platforms such as OpenShift, Kubernetes, or equivalent technologies.
  • Establish and optimize monitoring, logging, alerting, and distributed tracing systems to significantly enhance system reliability and expedite troubleshooting efforts.
  • Actively support high availability, disaster recovery planning, rigorous load testing, and overall platform stability initiatives.
  • Collaborate closely with backend, frontend, data, and ML engineering teams to provide seamless support for both batch and real-time workloads.
  • Prepare detailed technical documentation, comprehensive operational runbooks, and clear troubleshooting guidelines to empower the team and ensure knowledge transfer.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • A minimum of 4+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering roles.
  • Demonstrated strong experience with AWS cloud infrastructure and managing production environments.
  • Proven hands-on experience in designing, implementing, and managing CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and effective release strategies.
  • Solid experience with container orchestration platforms such as OpenShift, Kubernetes, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with GitOps tools and deployment practices, including but not limited to ArgoCD, Helm Charts, or Kustomize.
  • Proficiency with automation or configuration-management tools like Terraform/CDK and Ansible.
  • Experience utilizing monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, or Splunk.
  • A good understanding of Linux operating systems, networking principles, load balancing, cloud security best practices, and general system troubleshooting.
  • The ability to work independently, take initiative, and collaborate effectively with multiple cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Proficient English communication skills, sufficient for engaging in technical discussions and producing clear documentation.


Additional Information

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with message brokers or queueing systems like Kafka, Redis, or IBM MQ.
  • Familiarity with load balancers such as NGINX, HAProxy, or AWS ELB.
  • Exposure to distributed tracing tools like OpenTelemetry or Zipkin.
  • Experience supporting MLOps platforms, ML deployment pipelines, or complex data workloads.
  • Proficiency with SQL, MySQL, NoSQL databases, Unix shell scripting, or PowerShell.
  • Previous experience working within the banking, fintech, or large-scale enterprise project environments.
  • Familiarity with specific banking technologies such as Temenos T24 / TAP, Weblogic, or IBM Cloud Paks.
  • Possession of an AWS certification or equivalent cloud certification.

Why Join Us:

  • Salary: Up to 50 million VND Gross - open to discuss if you're a strong fit
  • Opportunity to work on a large-scale enterprise platform facing complex infrastructure and integration challenges.
  • Collaborate closely with highly experienced engineering and architecture teams, fostering professional growth.
  • Take ownership of significant DevOps initiatives, directly impacting the quality and efficiency of our delivery processes.
  • We offer competitive compensation packages and flexible working arrangements for suitable candidates, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

title: Sr. Proposal Writer
description:
Senior Proposal Writer


Location: Houston, TX | Hybrid
Compensation: Based on experience and qualifications; please include your salary expectations with your application.


Build the Proposals That Help Drive Our Growth

CenTrio is looking for an experienced
Senior Proposal Writer to lead the development of high-quality, compelling proposals that support our growth and business development efforts nationwide.


This is more than a writing role. As our Senior Proposal Writer, you will own the proposal process from start to finish, from RFP/RFQ intake and pursuit strategy through final submission, post-award analysis, and continuous improvement. You'll work closely with teams across operations, engineering, finance, and business development to turn complex technical information into clear, persuasive, client-focused proposals that differentiate CenTrio in competitive pursuits.


The ideal candidate is an exceptional writer and editor who is equally comfortable managing deadlines, coordinating multiple stakeholders, creating structure, and driving a proposal from concept to submission.


What You'll Do

Lead the Proposal Lifecycle

  • Own the end-to-end development of proposals, including RFPs, RFQs, and other competitive solicitations.
  • Develop proposal strategies, schedules, compliance matrices, submission plans, and internal deadlines.
  • Review solicitation requirements and evaluation criteria to ensure responses are complete, compliant, and competitive.
  • Coordinate proposal development from initial intake through submission and post-award review.
  • Identify risks, gaps, and opportunities early and proactively drive them toward resolution.

Write & Develop Winning Content

  • Write and edit sophisticated technical and narrative proposal content that is clear, persuasive, and client-focused.
  • Translate complex engineering, operational, and financial information into compelling business narratives.
  • Develop and incorporate win themes, differentiators, and value propositions into proposals.
  • Ensure proposals consistently meet CenTrio's standards for quality, grammar, formatting, tone, and brand.
  • Lead final reviews and quality-control processes before submission.

Coordinate Cross-Functional Teams

  • Partner with operations, engineering, finance, business development, and other subject matter experts to gather and develop proposal content.
  • Facilitate proposal kickoff meetings, working sessions, reviews, and alignment meetings.
  • Provide structure and direction to contributors who may be balancing proposal work with other priorities.
  • Track deliverables and hold stakeholders accountable to established deadlines.
  • Manage multiple complex pursuits simultaneously in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Strengthen Our Proposal Process

  • Develop, standardize, and maintain proposal templates and content libraries.
  • Maintain repositories of case studies, boilerplate content, credentials, and other proposal collateral.
  • Establish best practices for content organization, version control, and document management.
  • Lead lessons-learned and post-submission reviews to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Track proposal outcomes and success metrics to help improve future pursuits.


What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field.
  • Significant experience developing and managing competitive proposals, including RFPs, RFQs, and tenders.
  • Demonstrated experience managing the
    full proposal lifecycle, from strategy and intake through submission and post-award analysis.
  • Strong understanding of proposal compliance, evaluation criteria, and submission requirements.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, proofreading, and quality-control skills.
  • Ability to translate complex technical and operational information into clear, compelling content.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet demanding deadlines.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and coordinate cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and SharePoint.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with proposal management platforms such as Loopio or QorusDocs.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite; InDesign experience is a plus.
  • Experience working in a technical, engineering, energy, infrastructure, utilities, or industrial environment.
  • Association of Proposal Management Professionals (APMP) certification.
  • Experience developing and maintaining content libraries and proposal knowledge management systems.


The Kind of Leader We're Looking For

This position does not have direct reports, but it requires someone who can lead through influence.


You'll be successful in this role if you are someone who:

  • Takes ownership and drives projects forward without needing constant direction.
  • Can confidently establish timelines, expectations, and priorities.
  • Isn't afraid to ask questions, identify gaps, or push for what is needed to meet a deadline.
  • Can bring structure to complex, multi-workstream projects.
  • Builds strong relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Remains calm and organized when deadlines are tight.
  • Knows how to balance speed with quality.
  • Can move comfortably between strategic thinking, project coordination, writing, and detailed editing.


Hybrid Work Environment

This position offers a
hybrid work structure, providing flexibility to work remotely or from the office based on business needs.


Because this role involves significant collaboration, in-person work is encouraged when working sessions, meetings, or other activities benefit from being onsite. Office attendance may vary from week to week and will typically range from 2–4 days per week, depending on business needs and project requirements.


Why CenTrio?

At CenTrio, our work goes beyond traditional energy services. We develop and operate district energy systems that help major institutions and communities operate more efficiently, reliably, and sustainably.


As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to work on complex, high-impact projects while collaborating with professionals across engineering, operations, finance, and business development.


The Senior Proposal Writer will play an important role in how we communicate our capabilities, differentiate ourselves in the marketplace, and ultimately win new business.


If you're an exceptional writer who also loves strategy, project management, collaboration, and winning, we'd love to hear from you.



Health, Safety & Environment

Safety is a shared responsibility at CenTrio. Every employee is expected to contribute to a proactive HSE culture by:

  • Maintaining a safe and healthy workplace for themselves and their colleagues.
  • Following applicable health, safety, environmental, and company requirements.
  • Identifying and promptly reporting workplace hazards and concerns.
  • Reporting work-related injuries and illnesses immediately.
  • Supporting solutions and practices that promote a safe, injury-free workplace.


Diversity & Inclusion

At CenTrio, we know our greatest strengths come from the people who make up our team. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities are valued and respected.

We believe that bringing together different perspectives makes us stronger and helps us better serve our employees, clients, and communities.


CenTrio is an equal opportunity employer.

Compensation for this position is based on experience and qualifications. Applicants are encouraged to include their salary expectations with their application.

title: Product & Investor Relations Associate – Fixed Income
description:
BlueOrchard is a leading global impact investment manager with a long-standing track record of delivering financial returns alongside measurable social and environmental outcomes. Established in 2001 as part of a United Nations initiative, the firm has been a pioneer in impact investing, with a particular focus on emerging and frontier markets.

With more than two decades of experience, global reach and deep local expertise, BlueOrchard offers a broad range of impact investment strategies designed to meet the needs of institutional, private, and public investors. These solutions provide access to high-growth markets while supporting job creation and sustainable economic development. The firm has invested billions of dollars across more than 100 countries, benefiting millions of underserved micro-, small- and mid-sized enterprises.

As part of Schroders, a global asset manager with a heritage spanning over 200 years, BlueOrchard combines specialist impact investing capabilities with institutional-grade infrastructure and governance. Become part of this unique success story and join our fast-growing company in Tbilisi, Georgia as


Product & Investor Relations Associate – Fixed Income


In this role, you will join the Product Specialists & Investor Relations team as a Product & Investor Relations Associate for Blue Orchard’s Fixed Income strategies. You will support the set-up and ongoing development of a dedicated product management & investor relations function that serves as a central point of entry for product-related investor/client requests. The role will primarily focus on content preparation, internal coordination and quality control across teams, with the intention to also interact with clients occasionally and over time. The role will place particular emphasis on portfolio, market and performance communication for liquid fixed income strategies.

Key tasks

  • Fixed Income product management: develop into a product specialist for BlueOrchard’s Fixed Income strategies, including fund structures, investment strategies, portfolio positioning, performance drivers, liquidity profiles, market exposure, benchmark position, impact proposition and investor requirements.
  • Investor requests and internal coordination: act as a central coordination point for product-related investor and client requests, including client inbounds and detailed operational or fund-specific information requests, supporting Business Development through timely triage, follow-up, internal alignment and quality control.
  • DDQ, RFP and due diligence management: write and coordinate responses to investor due diligence questionnaires, RFPs and ad-hoc requests, ensuring accurate, consistent and client-ready materials.
  • Product content and sales enablement: prepare, maintain and improve pitch decks, factsheets, product briefs, Q&A documents, case studies, track-record materials and customized client presentations and analyses to support Business Development, capital raising, and go-to-market activities
  • Reporting and data quality: support the review and quality control of regular investor reporting, factsheets and customized reports, with a focus on narrative consistency, data accuracy, market commentary, performance explanations, portfolio attribution, and timely delivery.
  • Knowledge management and AI enablement: maintain a structured knowledge base of approved responses and supporting materials, and use CRM data, response mapping and approved AI tools to improve workflow efficiency.
  • Product and market positioning: support analyses, research and materials for product development, mandate opportunities, competitor reviews, portfolio-level analysis, and internal decision-making forums.

Required skills

  • Master’s degree in finance, economics, business administration or a related field; CFA or similar professional qualification is a plus.
  • 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in asset management, investor relations, investment management, investment consulting, banking or a similar role; prior experience as a fund, portfolio, investor relations manager is highly desired.
  • Good understanding of fixed income and credit markets, including bonds, yield, duration, spreads, ratings, benchmarks and portfolio risk characteristics; experience with emerging markets, impact investing, or labeled bonds is a plus.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and project management skills, with the ability to translate complex investment, portfolio and impact information into clear investor-facing language.

  • Professional proficiency in English required.


Your personal profile

  • Collaborative team player with strong client-service orientation, sound judgment and the ability to work effectively across functions, geographies and seniority levels.
  • Curious and pragmatic problem-solver with a continuous-improvement mindset, openness to AI-enablement and passion for impact investing.

title: Network Engineer
description:
Who we are:

Altagrove delivers smart and innovative technology solutions that create competitive advantages for our customers and their missions. Our focus areas include Space, Connectivity, Cyber, Cloud, Analytics, and Solution Integration. As we continue to grow, Altagrove is actively recruiting for a Network Engineer to join our energetic and entrepreneurial team that is executing on a variety of projects that are technology oriented. A successful candidate will bring a core area of expertise and a passion for learning and implementing new ideas in a start-up environment.


Follow us at -


What you will do:

  • Design, configure, deploy, and sustain secure enterprise LAN, WAN, and wireless network environments.
  • Install and configure Cisco and Juniper routers, switches, wireless access points, controllers, and supporting network infrastructure.
  • Configure Layer 2/3 services including VLANs, trunks, STP, link aggregation, inter-VLAN routing, IPv4/IPv6, and resilient network paths.
  • Implement and troubleshoot OSPF, BGP, static routing, route redistribution, and gateway redundancy in enterprise networks.
  • Deploy and support enterprise wireless networks, including SSIDs, authentication, RF optimization, roaming, coverage validation, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Configure ACLs, NAT, VPN/IPsec, 802.1X, AAA, RADIUS, TACACS+, and network segmentation/security controls.
  • Troubleshoot connectivity and performance issues using CLI diagnostics, packet captures, SNMP, syslog, NetFlow, and network monitoring platforms.
  • Support network refreshes, migrations, software/firmware upgrades, configuration management, hardening, vulnerability remediation, and change control.
  • Develop network diagrams, IP address plans, configurations, implementation procedures, test plans, and as-built documentation.
  • Collaborate with systems, cloud, cyber, wireless, and customer teams to support deployments, integrations, testing, and mission execution.


What you will bring:

  • Hands-on enterprise networking experience at a CCNA/CCNP level configuring and troubleshooting production network environments.
  • Strong experience with Cisco routers and Catalyst switches, including IOS/IOS-XE configuration, operation, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with Cisco enterprise wireless products, including access points and wireless LAN controllers; Catalyst 9800 experience preferred.
  • Experience with Juniper Junos-based routing and switching platforms and Juniper Mist wireless products; EX/MX experience preferred.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, IPv4/IPv6, subnetting, VLANs, Ethernet, STP/RSTP, LACP, and inter-VLAN routing.
  • Working knowledge of OSPF, BGP, static routing, route redistribution, HSRP/VRRP, and high-availability network design.
  • Understanding of 802.11 wireless standards, RF fundamentals, channel planning, roaming, 802.1X, and wireless troubleshooting.
  • Knowledge of network security concepts including ACLs, segmentation, NAT, VPN/IPsec, AAA, RADIUS, TACACS+, and least-privilege access.
  • Experience using Wireshark, packet capture, SNMP, syslog, NetFlow, and network monitoring/management tools for troubleshooting and performance analysis.
  • Familiarity with QoS, multicast, SD-WAN, network automation, Python/Ansible, APIs, or infrastructure-as-code concepts is a plus.
  • Experience supporting DoD, government, or regulated enterprise networks and familiarity with STIGs, configuration baselines, and vulnerability remediation preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Network Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered. CCNA required or equivalent demonstrated experience; CCNP preferred.
  • Active security clearance preferred; ability to obtain and maintain a clearance required. Must be able to work onsite and travel as required.

title: Senior Aerodynamics Designer
description:
TGR Haas F1 Team has been a stalwart of the FIA Formula 1 World Championship over the past decade. With more than 200 grand prix starts to our name, we pride ourselves on being an ambitious challenger within Formula 1 - and we want you to be part of that journey.


The first American Formula 1 team to compete in the sport since 1986, TGR Haas F1 Team made an immediate impression with a memorable points-scoring debut at the 2016 Australian Grand Prix. Ten years later, the team is still building momentum, guided by clear objectives and technical partnerships, and fresh from securing its second biggest points haul in a Formula 1 season.


We’re a racing team – not a corporate machine. We have three HQs – Kannapolis in the US, Banbury in the UK and Maranello in Italy – each powered by passionate, loyal and hardworking team ambassadors. At TGR Haas F1 Team, you’ll gain exposure to many areas of the business, enjoy wider visibility, and clearly see your contributions.


Yes, you’ll learn from us, but we expect to learn from you too!



General Summary
This role reports to the Aerodynamics Designer Team Leader or their designee and is based in Maranello, Italy. The role supports the delivery and contribution of departmental and organisational objectives. Responsible for supporting day‑to‑day operations within their area of responsibility, working collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders to ensure high standards of service, compliance, and performance. Adherence to organisational policies and procedures, effective communication with line management, and a commitment to continuous improvement and inclusive ways of working is essential.



Role Principles
• Act with integrity, always upholding the highest professional and ethical standards.
• Drive innovation and change to continuously improve ways of working and outcomes.
• Pursue operational excellence, ensuring efficiency, quality, and continuous improvement.
• Collaborate inclusively, building strong partnerships to achieve shared goals.
• Maintain a customer‑focused approach, prioritising the needs of internal and external stakeholders.
• Champion sustainability by embedding responsible and environmentally conscious practices into everyday work.



Key Responsibilities

Role specific responsibilities:

• Central to the design process, working closely with aerodynamicists, model designers, and full-size car designers to produce high-quality, high-performance surfaces.
• Collaborate within the development teams to provide comprehensive support for the concept surfacing function.
• Ensure adherence to standard design practices for surface models issued by the aerodynamics department.
• Partner closely with aerodynamicists to grasp the definition and requirements of all new surfaces, including modelling and construction approaches.
• Coordinate with Aerodynamicists and Model Designers to ensure the smooth execution of aerodynamic projects.
• Supervise and mentor junior aero designer with their contribution to the team activities.
• Develop high-quality surface geometry for both CFD Wind Tunnel testing and full-size releases.
• Provide the design and development direction on all aspects of the company’s Wind Tunnel models.
• Actively contribute to the upkeep of relevant surfacing documentation.
• Support the aerodynamicist in the legality checks for the full-size releases.
• Direct or undertake CAD tools and macro Ensure all standards required for production.
• Clear communication of task status. Develop workflow automation tools.

Operational Delivery:
• Carry out day‑to‑day tasks efficiently and within agreed timescales.
• Ensure work meets expected service, quality, and compliance standards.
• Demonstrate accountability and professionalism in all activities.


Team & Stakeholder Collaboration:
• Build positive working relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.
• Participate in meetings, briefings, and forums as required.
• Respond to queries within scope, escalating more complex matters when necessary.


Compliance & Governance:
• Adhere to relevant legislation, organisational policies, and internal controls.
• Handle information responsibly, including confidential or sensitive data.
• Support audit, governance, and risk management activities as required.


Continuous Improvement:
• Contribute ideas and feedback to improve processes and ways of working.
• Participate in team initiatives, projects, or improvement activities.


Additional Responsibilities:
• Undertake any other reasonable duties consistent with the level and purpose of the role, as assigned by the line manager.



Person Specification
Essential Qualifications & Experience:
• GCSE, High School diploma or equivalent required.
• Further education, including a university Degree or equivalent in a relevant discipline desired.
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar role or motorsport environment (preferably Formula 1).
• Exceptional creativity and a deep understanding of surfacing and parametric modelling techniques.
• Experience in the management of complex CAD structures.
• Thorough understanding of and experience with CAD, with expertise in CATIA/3DX.
• Acknowledgment of surface quality, model layout and robustness.
• Understanding of the kinematics problems related to suspension movements.


Resilience & Composure:
• Maintains calm and focus in high-pressure, fast-paced environments.
• Able to handle setbacks and adapt quickly to changing circumstances.


Integrity & Discretion:
• Trusted to manage confidential information and sensitive team matters.
• Upholds the highest standards of professionalism and ethical conduct.


Team-Oriented:
• Collaborative mindset with a commitment to team cohesion and shared success.
• Willingness to mentor and develop talent within the organisation.


Adaptability & Flexibility:
• Comfortable with extensive travel and irregular working hours, including weekends and race days.
• Open to innovation and continuous improvement in processes and culture.



Equipment and Applications
• Excellent knowledge of CAD software with preference to CATIA/3DX.
• Excellent knowledge of MS-Office software package.

Physical Demands

Extended Hours & Flexibility:
• Many roles require working evenings, weekends, and public holidays, particularly during race season or critical development phases.


Travel Requirements:
• Roles supporting race operations, logistics, or communications may involve frequent international travel, including long-haul flights and time zone shifts.


Physical Activity (Varies by Role):
• Trackside roles may involve standing for long periods, walking across paddocks, and working in noisy, crowded environments.
• Factory roles may require manual handling of components, use of machinery, or working in temperature-controlled areas.
• Office-based roles typically involve prolonged computer use and occasional movement between departments.


Sensory Demands:
• Exposure to high noise levels (e.g., engines, pit lane activity), bright lighting, and fast-moving environments is common in race support roles.
• This role is based in a shared workplace environment where exposure to common allergens (including food products, fragrances and cleaning materials) may occur. While we will always consider reasonable adjustments, we are unable to guarantee a completely allergen‑free environment.


Health & Safety Compliance:
• All roles require adherence to strict safety protocols, especially in technical and trackside environments.
• Completion of all mandatory compliance training (including health and safety, data protection, and role‑specific regulatory training) is a condition of employment and must be maintained throughout tenure.

This job description may not detail some less major duties, nor cover duties of a similar nature, which may from time to time be reasonably required by the relevant manager.
