The Senator John Heinz History Center, the largest history museum in Pennsylvania dedicated to history and an affiliate of the Smithsonian Institution, is seeking a Full-time Security Officer.

Security Officers must be friendly yet firm and responsive to the needs of all customers. The Officer may be questioned by the public on a number of topics regarding the History Center – directions within, amenities, exhibit components, and facilities. The officer observes and operates security systems as well as assists with overall risk management – locating, correcting and/or reporting threats of all kinds to the organization. The position demands that the officer maintain a working knowledge of the History Center exhibits, programs, and emergency response protocols while providing extraordinary customer service /interactions. Since the Officer at times be the only person in the building, a high degree of attentiveness and pro-activity will be necessary.

This is a full-time, hourly position reporting to the Chief of Security.

  • Serve as the software and autonomy SME for the program, collaborating with government and industry partners.

Education:

  • Relevant experience and years of service may be considered in lieu of required education.

Required Experience:

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in software development and systems integration.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as C++, Python, and Java.
  • Hands-on experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), including requirements, design, test, and deployment.
  • Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, and DevSecOps methodologies.
  • Ability to work as a member of a team with the skills and personality to lead discussions that result in positive desired outcomes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen

  • Experience working with the Rapid Innovation Cell, PEO-SDA, SOF Common Core Architecture (SCCA), AFSOC Common Core Architecture (ACCA), and autonomy suites (e.g., FANTOM Core, Vigilant Spirit, Arbitrator, BMS Control Hub).
  • Experience working with autonomy, machine learning (ML), or artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms.

title: Dispatcher - Containers
description:
We’re looking for a sharp, switched-on and tech-savvy Dispatcher for our container division in our Christchurch operation.


This is a role for someone who thrives in a busy operational environment. Someone who can take in a lot of information, quickly work out what matters, make good decisions and keep things moving when the plan inevitably changes.


You’ll be at the centre of our container operation – coordinating drivers, customers, ports, depots, bookings and delivery requirements, while keeping a close eye on timeframes, priorities and what’s coming next.


Working closely with our transport team, drivers, customers and wider team you will:

  • Plan, schedule and dispatch container movements across our fleet
  • Coordinate imports and exports between ports, depots and customer sites
  • Keep track of multiple container movements, bookings, timeframes and priorities at once
  • Monitor the operation throughout the day and adjust plans in real time
  • Make smart decisions about driver and vehicle utilisation
  • Keep drivers informed, supported and clear on what they need to do
  • Provide customers with accurate, proactive updates
  • Troubleshoot delays, booking changes, access issues and scheduling conflicts
  • Use our dispatch and online systems to keep information accurate and up to date
  • Keep an eye on critical timeframes to help avoid unnecessary delays, storage and detention costs
  • Work alongside the wider team to deliver a safe, efficient and reliable container operation.


You’ll be someone who enjoys being in the middle of a busy operation, with plenty going on and lots of moving parts to keep track of. You can take in information quickly, work out what matters, think a few steps ahead and change direction when the day doesn’t quite go to plan.


Technology will come naturally to you. You’ll be comfortable working across different systems and screens, picking up new technology quickly and using good information to make good decisions.


You’ll also be someone who keeps their cool. Transport can change by the minute, so you’ll need to be able to juggle competing priorities, solve problems on the fly and keep communicating – without letting the pressure get the better of you.


Just as importantly, you’ll enjoy working with people. You’ll build great relationships with our drivers, work closely with the wider Mackleys team and genuinely care about giving our customers great service. You’ll be clear, practical and approachable – the kind of Dispatcher that people trust to get things sorted.


We're looking for someone who is:

  • Highly tech savvy and quick to learn new systems
  • Fast thinking and practical when solving problems
  • Exceptionally organised

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.


Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).


RECENT RECOGNITION

  • Barron’s 100 Most Sustainable Companies
  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global

title: Information System Security Officer II
description:
Information System Security Officer II


(Req: 26-J-1879)



The ISSO is responsible for ensuring the appropriate operational security posture is maintained for an information system and as such, works in close collaboration with the ISSM and ISO. The position shall have the detailed knowledge and expertise required to manage the security aspects of an information system and, in many organizations, is assigned responsibility for the day-to-day security operations of a system. This also will include physical and environmental protection, personnel security, incident handling, and security training and awareness. It will be required to work in close coordination with the ISSM and ISO in monitoring the information system(s) and its environment of operation to include developing and updating the authorization documentation, implementing configuration management across authorization boundaries. This will include assessing the security impact of those changes and making recommendation to the ISSM. The primary function is working within Special Access Programs (SAPs) supporting Department of Defense (DoD) agencies, such as HQ Air Force, Office of the Secretary of Defense (OSD) and Military Compartments efforts. The position will provide “day-to-day” support for Collateral, Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and Special Access Program (SAP) activities.


Performance shall include:

  • Develop physical or logical topologies for a system
  • Assist the ISSM in meeting their duties and responsibilities.
  • Prepare, review, and update authorization packages.
  • Ensure approved procedures are in place for clearing, sanitizing, and destroying various types of hardware and media.
  • Conduct periodic reviews of information systems to ensure compliance with the security authorization package.
  • Coordinate any changes or modifications to hardware, software, or firmware of a system with the ISSM and AO/DAO prior to the change.
  • Monitor system recovery processes to ensure security features and procedures are properly restored and functioning correctly.
  • Ensure all IS security-related documentation is current and accessible to properly authorized individuals.
  • Ensure audit records are collected, reviewed, and documented (to include any anomalies).
  • Attend required technical and security training (e.g., operating system, networking, security management) relative to assigned duties.
  • Execute the cyber security portion of the self-inspection, to include provide security coordination and review of all system assessment plans.
  • Identify cyber security vulnerabilities and assist with the implementation of the countermeasures for them
  • Prepare reports on the status of security safeguards applied to computer systems.
  • Perform ISSO duties in support of in-house and external customers.
  • Conduct security impact analysis activities and provide to the ISSM on all configuration management changes to the authorization boundaries.


EDUCATION:

· Bachelor’s degree or associate degree in a related area + 2 years’ experience OR equivalent experience (4 years)


CLEARANCE:

· TS/SCI

· Current clearance as defined in ATTACHMENT VI

· Eligibility for access to Special Access Program Information

· Willingness to submit to a Counterintelligence polygraph


EXPERIENCE MANDATORY:

2-5 years related experience, especially in developing RMF packages or bodies of evidence; Prior performance in roles such as System/Network Administrator or ISSO; SAP experience; TRAINING: DoD 8570.01-M IAM Level II (in lieu of IAT Level II).

Must meet position and certification requirements outlined in DoD Directive 8570.01-M for Information Assurance Technician Level II or Information Assurance Manager II within 6 months of the date of hire



Other Requirements:

· Must be able to regularly lift up to 50 lb


BENEFITS:

We offer a competitive compensation package including a generous PTO and Flexible holiday package, tax-free healthcare cost reimbursement, and an immediate vesting 401K with 4% matching.

The Role

We're looking for an Engineering Intern to help build AI-powered tools and automations that improve how teams across NymCard work. This role is focused on internal transformation — using software and AI to simplify workflows, connect systems, automate repetitive work, and give teams better access to information and insights.

You'll help turn real business and operational challenges into working solutions — from internal applications and dashboards to AI agents, knowledge systems and workflow automations. What You'll Do

- Design and build internal tools, applications, dashboards, AI agents and automations that solve real problems for teams across the business
- Connect systems and data sources to eliminate manual, repetitive work
- Prototype and experiment with new AI models, agent frameworks and LLM tooling, bringing what works into real use
- Build knowledge systems that make information easier to find and act on
- Work closely with the team to scope, ship and iterate on solutions quickly, this isn't a "spec it and wait" internship


What We're Looking For

- A student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
- Comfortable with modern web development, APIs, databases and Git
- A strong interest in LLMs, AI agents and automation; you keep up with what's new and like trying it yourself
- Personal projects, prototypes or independent builds that show you can ship things on your own; this matters more to us than formal work experience
- Curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out with minimal hand-holding


Why NymCard

description:
Company :

Hastings Deering (Australia) Ltd

Kickstart your career or take the next step with Hastings Deering – where our people build something BIGGER.

Ready for your next adventure?

We're seeking experienced and motivated Field Service Fitters to join our team in Weipa, providing expert maintenance and repair support at Skardon River. This is an exciting opportunity to enjoy the variety and autonomy of field service work while building your career with a trusted industry leader.

Working an 8/6 FIFO roster, you'll be responsible for diagnosing, maintaining, and repairing a range of mining and construction equipment, ensuring maximum reliability and performance for our customers.

What you’ll be doing
As a Field Service Fitter at Hastings Deering, you will:

  • Maintain and repair equipment – diagnose, service, and repair heavy mining and construction equipment to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
  • Prevent downtime – perform preventative maintenance and breakdown repairs in the field to maximise equipment availability and productivity.
  • Keep accurate records – complete detailed service and maintenance documentation to support compliance, reporting, and equipment history.
  • Support customers – deliver exceptional customer service and technical support, providing timely advice and effective solutions.
  • Work safely every day – maintain a strong commitment to safety standards, site requirements, and compliance procedures at all times.

Who are we and why work with us?

Hastings Deering is proud to be one of the top 5 Caterpillar dealerships globally. We sell, rent, and offer support and parts distribution services for Cat® products across a range of industries, including resources, general construction, civil transport and commercial construction, power systems, government, primary industries and marine.

We have more than 3,500 employees across 23 business service centres throughout Queensland, Northern Territory, Papua New Guinea, the Solomon Islands and New Caledonia, with our headquarters based in Brisbane, Australia.

When you join our team at Hastings Deering, you’ll benefit from:

  • Big Pay, Bigger Growth - Competitive hourly rates with competency-based pay rises PLUS regular scheduled increases under our current Enterprise Agreement.
  • Body, Mind & Wallet Support - Free health checks, Employee Assistance Program, income protection insurance, and discounts at major retailers.
  • World-Class Training - We’re one of only eight Caterpillar Centres of Excellence globally. Learn from the best in CAT and boost your skills.
  • Career Paths That Work for You - Grow into leadership, technical specialist, or support service roles. At Hastings Deering, we align with YOUR goals.
  • Get more time back in your life - Our work schedules are made to fit your life, giving you the flexibility to take care of what matters most outside of work.
  • Security you can count on - Enjoy the stability of a long-term career with Hastings Deering, backed by global strength.
  • Cutting Edge Tech - Get hands-on experience with the latest CAT technology as we shape the future of mining and heavy equipment solutions.
  • Family Comes First - Paid parental leave with 16 weeks for primary carers and 2 weeks for secondary carers.
  • Benefits plus – Field Service Allowance, Income protection insurance + more!

What you’ll need:

A successful teammate will have experience in:

  • Bring your trade expertise – hold a trade qualification as a Diesel Fitter or Heavy Vehicle Mechanic with a strong focus on quality workmanship.
  • Solve complex issues – apply strong diagnostic and fault-finding skills to identify problems and deliver effective repair solutions.
  • Leverage industry experience – experience working on mining or construction equipment will be highly regarded.
  • Work autonomously – demonstrate the ability to work independently and manage priorities in a remote field service environment.
  • Put safety and customers first – maintain a strong commitment to safety, quality, and delivering exceptional customer satisfaction.
  • Be FIFO ready – FIFO from Cairns is preferred, supporting site-based field service requirements.
  • Hold relevant licences – possess HRWL tickets including Forklift, Dogger, Rigger, and Working at Heights, along with a current Driver’s Licence.


Interested? Here’s What’s Next:

If you’re interested in growing your career with a large OEM, we’d love to hear from you!

📌 Apply Now – click the button below.
📞 Enquiries: 1300 071 618
👤 Contact: Taylor Collett – Talent Acquisition Partner

Hastings Deering follows a Pre-Employment Process for all successful applicants, which includes two employment references, a National Police Check and a medical assessment. These checks are essential to your application, and your Talent Acquisition Partner will support you through the process.

title: Director of Safety Services
description:
The Director of Safety Services provides leadership and oversight for Safety Services across all The Avenue Church campuses, ensuring safe, welcoming, and prepared environments for church services, events, staff, volunteers, and guests. This role oversees the Safety and Medical Teams, develops safety and emergency response plans, coordinates training and coverage, and serves as a key advisor to church leadership on security, medical readiness, risk management, and emergency preparedness.

The Director will lead Safety Services as a ministry, creating opportunities for team members to grow in their faith, build meaningful relationships, and experience camaraderie while serving something greater than themselves. This role partners closely with campus and central leadership to create consistent systems, strong communication, and a culture of hospitality, safety, teamwork, and excellence.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The essential functions include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Lead and Develop the Safety Team – Provide leadership, direction, scheduling, training, and oversight for Safety and Medical Team volunteers across all campuses. Recruit, vet, develop, and empower volunteers and team leaders while creating opportunities for spiritual and leadership growth.
  • Build Team Culture – Foster a healthy team environment marked by camaraderie, trust, encouragement, communication, and shared purpose. Help team members understand that Safety Services is a ministry and that their service contributes to something bigger than themselves.
  • Develop Safety and Emergency Plans – Create and continually improve safety, security, and emergency response plans addressing potential threats, natural disasters, fire, medical emergencies, severe weather, and other unforeseen events. Coordinate with local first responders to strengthen and validate response plans.
  • Ensure Excellent Coverage and Readiness – Coordinate safety coverage for all church services, programs, and special events. Oversee the hiring and scheduling of off-duty law enforcement personnel as needed, and ensure that teams, equipment, and resources are prepared and serviceable.
  • Train and Equip Staff and Volunteers – Develop and oversee onboarding and ongoing training for Safety and Medical Team volunteers. Communicate emergency plans, safety procedures, and expectations to church staff and ensure they are prepared to respond appropriately.
  • Maintain Consistent Systems and Communication – Develop and maintain clear weekly safety plans, policies, procedures, and communication processes across campuses. Maintain consistent communication with Campus Pastors and Executive Pastor regarding safety concerns, incidents, staffing, training, events, and recommended improvements.
  • Oversee Safety Operations and Incident Response – Manage safety technology, cameras, access points, equipment, logistics, incident reporting, and follow-up. Investigate suspicious or potentially criminal activity when necessary and communicate identified threats or concerns to appropriate leadership and team members.
  • Manage Resources and Risk – Oversee the Safety Services budget, purchasing, and resource allocation. Regularly assess vulnerabilities, identify risks, and implement practical improvements to strengthen safety and operational effectiveness.
  • Partner Across the Church – Work closely with Campus Pastors, ministry leaders, Guest Services, and central leadership to ensure safety practices support rather than hinder the guest experience and overall mission of The Avenue Church.


Oversight:

  • Safety Team volunteers across all campuses, Medical Team volunteers, off-duty law enforcement personnel as applicable, safety-related equipment and resources, and the Safety Services budget.


Core Competencies:

  • Leadership & Team Development: Ability to recruit, train, empower, and develop volunteers.
  • Ministry Mindset: Commitment to spiritual growth, servant leadership, and meaningful volunteer engagement.
  • Communication: Clear, consistent, and timely communication across teams, campuses, and leadership.
  • Operational Excellence: Strong organization, attention to detail, and commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Crisis Management: Calm, decisive leadership in high-pressure situations.
  • Risk Management: Ability to identify vulnerabilities and develop practical solutions.
  • Hospitality: Commitment to creating environments that are both safe and welcoming.
  • Collaboration: Ability to build strong relationships with staff, volunteers, church leadership, and public safety partners.


Qualifications:

  • 3–5 years of experience in safety, security, emergency management, operations, law enforcement, military, fire/EMS, team leadership, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience leading and developing staff and volunteers.
  • Experience developing safety, security, or emergency response plans preferred.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and make sound decisions in high-pressure situations.
  • Ability to build relationships and lead volunteers in a ministry environment.
  • Church or nonprofit experience preferred.
  • Alignment with The Avenue Church’s mission, values, and beliefs.
  • High school diploma required; bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred.


Spiritual Requirements:

  • Regular involvement in The Avenue Church activities and events.
  • Signed acknowledgement of The Avenue Church’s “Statement of Faith” and “Staff Lifestyle Agreement” forms.
  • Signed acknowledgment of policies and procedures as stated in The Avenue Church’s employee handbook.
  • Living out the spiritual principles outlined in the “Staff Lifestyle Agreement”; participation in a small group; tithing consistently; attending worship services; involvement in outreach; following Christ personally and passionately; and sexual purity.


Physical Requirements:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions. While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands or fingers, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, sit, and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus. The noise level in the work environment is usually low to moderate.

description:

Summary

To assist the credit union in achieving its mission statement: PFCU will deliver financial well-being with value, convenience and exceptional service. The member Experience Specialist will accept personal responsibility and accountability for every member contact and take personal ownership of all situations presented. Responsible for performing a broad variety of member service activities, including cash handling with a high degree of accuracy, within established policies and guidelines in a prompt, courteous, enthusiastic and professional manner. While actively seeking out opportunities to build member relationships through education opportunities. Support, model & adhere to PFCU’s Service Standards as outlined in My MARC.

Experience Specialist level information

Advancement from one level to another is not automatic; advancements will be made as needed within the credit union and determined by success of the Experience Specialist employee.

To qualify for a position level advancement, the employee must consistently meet requirements of the current level before consideration of advancement to the next level. The employee will successfully display the ability to accomplish the duties and responsibilities of each level when advancing from one level to the next.

Essential Functions, Duties, & Responsibilities

Essential duties and responsibilities listed within each category include; are not limited to the duties listed below. When moving from one level to the next, duties and responsibilities are inclusive of all previous levels.

***NOTE: Experience Specialist Level I is a grandfathered position for those employees that previously held the role of Teller at PFCU, hired prior to August 2024, and assigned to a location requiring the need for Level I.***

Experience Specialist Level I:

· Build relationships, be dependable, demonstrate initiative, responsibility, integrity, professionalism and take responsibility to see that all tasks are done correctly. Handle situations with confidence, knowledge and creativity; seek guidance from supervisor when necessary.

· Greet and welcome members to the credit union in a courteous, professional and timely manner, providing prompt, accurate and efficient member transactions.

· Run transactions using cash and checks; deposits, withdrawals, transfers funds, makes payments and disburses funds. Provide members with account status, including current balances. Understand and complete appropriate forms needed to assist member. Secure your assigned cash and checks, including bottom drawers. Maintain and balance a cash drawer/TCR. Able to find errors with minimal help beyond introductory period.

· Verify member ID; examine checks for endorsement and negotiability. Detect and resolve discrepancies promptly.

· Able and willing to help with daily duties; including but not limited to Check 21, scanning, processing of mail deposits, processing ATM, ITM, business deposits, Night Drop deposits, stocking supplies and serve as the 2nd cash verifier when balancing the vault; remembering that your primary purpose is to serve the member.

· Maintains transactions average, overs/shorts, voids/adjustments at a satisfactory or greater level.

· Maintain an up-to-date comprehensive knowledge of all credit union products and services.

· Maintains an up to date and comprehensive knowledge on all related policies, procedures, and rules & regulations, including security procedures for all locations.

· Cultivate personal relationships with the membership; assume responsibility for member education. Promote, explain and educate the member on credit union products and services of benefit, meeting the established cross education goal at least 8 out of 12 months each appraisal year.

· Process additional basic account maintenance on a personal account including but not limited to; adding/changing authorized account users, address changes, beneficiary updates, ACH origination, check reorders, renewing certificates of deposit and subsequent actions.

· After account establishment open additional sub-shares, opening certificate of deposit and services opened after established membership. Assist members with access to Safe Deposit Box.

· Proficient and fluently use all programs used by an Experience Specialist including, not limited to Synergy, Instant Issue, DocuSign, etc.

· Use necessary formats to effectively communicate with members and coworkers. Promptly respond to all forms of communication including incoming phone calls, emails, chat software and voicemail.

· Ensure that the Credit Union’s branch image is favorable, reflecting a sound and secure financial institution; practice sound housekeeping procedures, safety measures, and provide a pleasant atmosphere for members and co-workers.

· Ensure that OFAC, currency reporting, Red Flag and suspicious activity reports are done promptly and correctly.

· Maintain cleanliness and security of work area and equipment including protecting the confidentiality of member information.

· Seek training opportunities to develop or enhance knowledge through training, conference, reading and etcetera.

· Willingly participate in and attend educational functions and meetings as requested by management.

· Provide management with new or innovative ways for improvement of employees, service quality or products offered.

· Assist with training and support of team members.

· Assist members by witnessing document signing; follow up with the processors to ensure completion of consumer loan closing.

· Develop and cultivate community relationships.

· Perform all other duties as assigned.

Experience Specialist Level II:

· Open new in-person and online membership accounts.

· Have complete knowledge and ability to modify all aspects of Specialty Accounts and IRAs.

· Able to assist members via telephone and e-mail with financial transactions and inquiries. Positively verify members before completing transactions. Troubleshoot and answer members’ questions regarding their accounts and PFCU services and programs. Route inquires to appropriate department after exhausting troubleshooting techniques.

· Perform notary duties.

· Open, maintenance and close Safe Deposit Boxes.

· Maintain accounts and assist with file maintenance.

· Maintain knowledge of the loan policy, interest rates, available terms and loan alternatives. Referring any loan application inquiries to a loan originator.

Lead Experience Specialist- Level III:

· Maintain accounts and assist with complex file maintenance.

· Assist management in creating a positive work environment. Serve as point of contact in the absence of management, providing guidance and support to team.

· Assist management with the operations of the Branch. This may include, but is not limited to; scheduling, assist employees or members in solving routine to complex account problems or questions on products and services, policies and procedures, or rules and regulations.

· Lead by example. Encourage and motivate peers to achieve member education expectations and goals.

· Assist management with brainstorming, creating and preparing for team meetings on pertinent topics, which could include, My MARC service expectations, opportunities for improvement, product

knowledge, changes in procedure or policy, etc.

· Effectively communicate with employees to ensure a positive and clear understanding of branch team goals.

· Assist with the operations of the branch by answering questions, solving problems, helping with complex transactions and sensitive member concerns, explaining policies and procedures to members. Approve member exceptions and authorize service fee refunds to members when deemed necessary.

· Assist management with pulling reports needed to complete employee monthly performance sheets. Monitor office activity, including number of transactions, phone calls and cross sales to ensure highest level of quality service to members.

· Assist in the investigation of employee cash offages and errors, offering support for resolution.

Regulatory Compliance

Follows regulatory and policy compliance requirements which would include those efforts in compliance with Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), Office of Foreign Asset Control (OFAC), Red Flag and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Regulations, and other compliance related policies.

Confidentiality

This position requires maintaining confidentiality with regard to non-public information about our members, employees and the Credit Union. We must protect the confidentiality of member information. Financial transactions are confidential and private. With account access, employees are to handle member information responsibly and confidentially.

Security

To ensure the safety and security of all employees, employees must follow all security policies and procedures at all times. Security is the responsibility of all employees.

title: Senior Thermal Analyst
description:
Are you passionate about shaping the future of humanity's presence in space? Lunar Outpost, an industry leader in space robotics and planetary vehicles, invites you to join our team! Lunar Outpost is dedicated to creating a permanent presence in space, while also driving positive impacts here on Earth. We are currently seeking a Senior Thermal Analyst to contribute to our mission in a dynamic startup environment. As a Thermal Analyst you will be responsible for the component and sub-system level thermal analysis of spacecraft from ground operations, through launch, orbital transfer, transit, landing and Lunar surface environments using Thermal Desktop. Typical tasks include capturing system inputs, constructing and vetting analysis models, performing system level trade studies, generating temperature and heat transfer predictions, assisting with ambient pressure and vacuum thermal testing and documenting results.


Take the #NextLeap with Lunar Outpost and work on the Pegasus LTV, which will carry NASA astronauts farther than they've ever been before on the lunar surface!


Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform thermal analysis of spacecraft systems and components using Thermal Desktop for missions spanning LEO, cis-lunar space, and future deep-space architectures, including multi-phase transit, orbital, and surface operations
  • Develop and validate thermal models to support design, integration, and mission operations
  • Define thermal control system architectures for passive and active thermal management
  • Support environmental testing (e.g., thermal vacuum, thermal balance) and correlate test data with analytical models
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure compliance with customer and program thermal requirements and standards
  • Model correlation and uncertainty/margin assessment
  • Thermal requirements verification and closure
  • Generate technical documentation including analysis reports, test plans, and design reviews
  • Provide thermal support during spacecraft integration, launch, and on-orbit operations
  • Conduct trade studies to optimize thermal performance and system reliability


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or related discipline
  • 5+ years relevant Thermal Engineering/Analysis experience
  • Solid understanding of heat transfer, thermodynamics and fluid mechanics
  • Demonstrated thermal analysis skills
  • Demonstrated experience with modeling spacecraft thermal performance using Thermal Desktop/Sinda/Fluint
  • Understanding of spacecraft thermal control systems, including passive and active thermal management techniques
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret technical data and perform engineering calculations
  • Self-motivated, focused, and driven to meet critical deadlines
  • Excellent organization and time management skills
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • U.S. Person


Preferred Qualifications:

  • M.S. degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or related discipline, or qualifying degree with Thermal-Fluids focus
  • 8+ years of relevant Thermal Engineering/Analysis experience
  • Demonstrated experience with modeling spacecraft thermal-fluid performance using FloCAD or other Thermal-Fluid analysis software
  • Demonstrated testing experience using thermal testing hardware (e.g., heaters, lamps, temperature sensors, data acquisition units, optical property measurement devices)
  • Experience with thermal-fluid design and/or analysis (e.g., heat pipes, pumped fluid loop systems)
  • Proficiency with Solid Works and Space Claim for geometry preparation and thermal model development


Compensation & Benefits: Compensation level and base salary are competitively structured and thoughtfully determined based on factors such as relevant skills, experience, education, and the scope of the role.

  • Comprehensive health coverage: Medical, dental, and vision benefits, with 70% of premiums covered by the employer
  • Paid time off: Three (3) weeks per year of vacation
  • Retirement plan: Up to 4% employer match on 401(k) contributions
  • Paid holidays: 11 company-recognized holidays
  • Parental leave
  • Educational reimbursement opportunities to support company objectives, continued learning, and career development


Lunar Outpost Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Lunar Outpost Inc. does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All employees, including executives and human resources personnel, are expected to conduct themselves with professionalism and treat others with dignity and respect in accordance with this policy.

description:

Oletko tarkka ja tehokas työntekijä, joka viihtyy vaihtelevissa työtehtävissä?

Onko sinulla reipas työote ja hymy herkässä, vaikka työtahti olisi kiireinen?

Nyt on tarjolla huippupaikka – ja se voisi olla juuri sinulle!

Työtehtävät:

  • Koti- ja toimistosiivoukset Kuopion alueella
  • Tulet työskentelemään niin toimistoissa kuin kotisiivouksenkin parissa, jonka vuoksi on tärkeää, että ymmärrät asiakaspalvelun ja luotettavuuden merkityksen
  • Työtä tehdään parin kanssa

Tarjoamme:

  • Vakituisen työn kotisiivouksen parista
  • 20-40h/vko työsopimuksen
  • Päivätyön maanantaista perjantaihin
  • Kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen

Odotamme sinulta:

  • B-ajokorttia, omaa autoa ei tarvitse olla, mutta tehtävässä sinun tulee ajaa manuaalivaihteista autoa
  • Suomen kielen taitoa
  • Halukkuutta työskennellä 5 päivää viikossa
  • Omaat positiivisen asenteen ja hoidat työsi täsmällisesti ja huolellisesti aikatauluista kiinni pitäen
  • Työssä ollaan jaloillaan ja liikutaan kohteiden välillä, joten hyvä fyysinen kunto on ehdottomasti eduksi tässä tehtävässä

Työ alkaa sopivan henkilön löydyttyä ja työllistyt suoraan asiakkaan omille kirjoille. Työ on arkisin tapahtuvaa päivätyötä ja pääsääntöisesti työt alkaa klo 8. Tulet työskentelemään osa-aikaisesti, ja tekevälle tyypille kertyy tunteja arviolta 20-40h/vko. Sinulla tulee olla valmius työskennellä viitenä päivänä viikossa.

Kolahtiko?

Kuulostaa hyvältä, mutta miksi hakisin töitä juuri Amikon kautta?

Amiko tarjoaa kaiken tasoisille ammattilaisille laajan valikoiman töitä. Olemme sinulle reilu, luotettava ja joustava työelämän kumppani. Amikolla on hyvä maine työmarkkinoilla. Pyrimme aina etsimään parhaat mahdolliset ratkaisut työllistymisesi tueksi. Amikolaisena saat:

• Vähintään TES:in mukaisen palkkauksen-palkkausjärjestelmämme on kannustava, joskus jopa suurempi kuin työllistyessä suoraan yrityksen palkkalistoille.

• Laajasti erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia- meillä on kattavat verkostot ja laaja työpaikkavalikoimaniin osa-aikaisia, kokopäiväisiä kuin sesonkitöitä monelta eri alalta. Kun sopiva työ löytyy, monille tarjoutuu myös mahdollisuus siirtyä vakituiseksi työntekijäksi asiakasyritykseen.

• Oman yhteyshenkilön ja yksilöllistä työnhakua – Amikolta saat henkilökohtaista palvelua ja oman tutun yhteyshenkilön, johon voit olla suoraan yhteydessä.

• Kattavat työterveyspalvelut, normaalin eläkekertymän ja sairausajan palkan sairauden sattuessa – Vaikka teetkin työsi asiakasyrityksessämme, olet amikolainen ja kannamme sinusta vastuun ja huolehdimme eduistasi.

• … vai kenties jotain ihan uutta urallesi? Autamme myös alanvaihdossa. Räätälöidyt uravalmennukset auttavat päivittämään osaamistasi ja löytämään uuden suunnan urallasi.

Voisiko tässä olla sinulle uusi työpaikka?

Toimimme asiakkaallemme rekrytointikumppanina, käsittelemme saapuvat työhakemukset sekä vastaamme ensimmäisen vaiheen haastatteluista. Jätäthän hakemuksesi pikimmiten tai soita Amikon Isabellalle p. 050 378 0432 arkisin klo 13:00-14:00 välillä ja nappaa itsellesi uusi huippuduuni!

Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivien henkilön löydyttyä.

Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse vastaanotettuja hakemuksia vaan jätäthän hakemuksen nettisivujemme kautta tietosuojasyistä.

Please note that we do not process applications submitted by e-mail, so please submit your application via our website for privacy and data protection reasons.

description:

  • Able to walk, sit, stand, bend, kneel, crouch, crawl, stretch, squat and climb, often in restricted spaces and at great heights for extended periods on ladders and scaffolding.

title: Software Team Lead
description:
As we continue to grow at ScreenPoint Medical, we are looking for a hands-on Tech Lead to lead one of our engineering teams and help bring our AI solutions into clinical practice.


In this role, you will combine strong technical expertise with day-to-day team leadership. You will guide software engineers, data engineers, and QA Test Engineers in solving complex technical challenges, while remaining closely involved in the development of our software products and AI systems.


You will be responsible for technical progress within the team, including planning, prioritization, coaching, and collaboration with stakeholders across the organization.


Key responsibilities

  • Lead a multidisciplinary engineering team and drive technical progress through sprint planning, prioritization, and monitoring of progress.
  • Build and maintain software and services that bring our AI solutions into clinical practice.
  • Guide engineers in solving complex technical challenges and making sound technical decisions.
  • Provide technical and personal leadership through coaching, mentoring, and regular feedback.
  • Understand complex clinical workflows and translate these into practical technical solutions.
  • Communicate progress, technical decisions, risks, and results clearly to stakeholders within and outside the company.
  • Contribute hands-on to software development where needed, particularly in C++ and Python.
  • Support verification and validation activities in collaboration with the QA testing team.
  • Promote strong engineering practices, including continuous integration, test-driven development, version control, issue tracking, security, and quality.
  • Encourage effective and responsible use of AI tools within the team to improve engineering productivity, problem-solving, testing, documentation, and knowledge sharing.


Job requirements

  • A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or higher degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
  • Strong software development experience, preferably with C++ and Python.
  • Experience leading or technically guiding a team of engineers.
  • The ability to break down complex technical challenges and guide a team toward practical solutions.
  • Experience with continuous integration, testing practices, issue tracking, and version control systems.
  • Good understanding of network and security considerations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills in English and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A hands-on mindset and the ability to balance technical execution with team leadership.
  • Strong AI savviness; you actively use and evaluate AI-enabled development tools to improve the way you work, while applying your own technical judgement and critically validating their output.


Preferred qualifications

  • Experience developing medical device software or other regulated software products.
  • Experience working with AI or machine learning systems in production.
  • Experience with verification and validation of software products.
  • Experience working with complex clinical or healthcare workflows.
  • Previous experience coaching or mentoring engineers.
  • Experience working in a fast-growing or changing engineering environment.
  • Experience in healthcare or medical devices is a plus, not a requirement. We are looking for a technically strong leader who can combine hands-on engineering with coaching, ownership, and the ability to learn our clinical and regulatory environment quickly.


About us

ScreenPoint Medical is a leading company that develops and markets breast image analysis and cutting edge machine learning applications and services. Our product Transpara improves breast cancer survival rates by detecting cancers earlier so that treatment can be more effective and less invasive.


Do you want to help us build an innovative solution to improve health worldwide? And do you want to be part of an ambitious and fast-growing team who help you develop your career further? Please apply using the application button.


Providing a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) or background check is part of our application procedure. Questions about the contents of the vacancy or the recruitment process at ScreenPoint Medical? description:

title: Product Manager
description:
Senior Product Manager

Purpose of the role

To own the product management and delivery of our live platform. What it should do, why it should do it, and making sure it gets built and lands well with the clients who depend on it.


Why this role

Our live platform carries the business and every client on it.

  • You would own a real product, with real authority. The roadmap, the delivery board, and the call on whether work is actually finished.
  • It is a great opportunity to learn the healthcare domain. Clinical assessment, laboratory data, regulated reporting, and the accumulated decisions about how they fit together.
  • There is real scope to improve how we work. How requirements get written, how work gets prioritised, and how we check what shipped all have room to improve.
  • You can influence the way we work. We use AI tooling heavily and how we work with it is still new and changing quickly, so it can be influenced by how you think it should be done.


Product judgement matters more as building gets faster. The harder question is increasingly what is worth building rather than how to build it, and answering it well takes someone who understands the clinical domain and the people using the product.


Responsibilities

Product direction and roadmap

  • Own the roadmap for the platform, deciding what it takes on and what it does not
  • Balance planned platform work against committed client work, and keep those trade-offs visible to the rest of the business
  • Maintain a view of where the product needs to go, informed by clients, users and the wider market


Discovery and customer understanding

  • Meet clients and users to understand the problem behind a request, rather than taking the request at face value
  • Work with customer success and operations to understand how the product is actually used day to day
  • Test ideas early with quick prototypes, before committing them to a specification


Requirements and specification

  • Write clear requirements documents covering the problem, the goals, what is in and out of scope, permissions and rollout
  • Define what success looks like before work starts, so that the result can be judged afterwards
  • Own how we specify work. Our existing documents are a starting point rather than a template, and we would expect you to develop them


Delivery

  • Own the delivery board for a team of engineers
  • Sequence work, manage capacity, remove blockers and hold timelines
  • Confirm that what ships matches what was specified, decide whether any gaps matter now or later, and schedule them accordingly
  • Hold the line on building client work as reusable platform capability, rather than letting deadline pressure turn it into a one-off
  • Handle product-side triage when something breaks for a client, and decide what it displaces
  • Keep operations, customer success and clients informed about what is landing and when
  • Represent the platform in the internal meetings where its direction and delivery get discussed


Outcomes

  • Assess whether delivered work achieved what its specification set out to achieve, not only that it shipped
  • Feed that back into what the platform does next


Ways of working

  • Improve how product and delivery run here, including through the use of AI tooling
  • Look for the same opportunities in processes elsewhere in the business


What we are looking for

Essential

  • Experience of owning roadmap, requirements and delivery for a live software product
  • Confident daily use of AI development and reasoning tools such as Claude Code or Codex, with a clear view of where they help and where they mislead
  • Enough technical depth to take a full part in discussions about APIs, authentication, data models, migrations and performance, and to get to the bottom of how an unfamiliar system behaves
  • Comfortable forming a view and acting on it without a detailed brief, with the judgement to know when something should be raised instead
  • Genuine interest in users and their working day, and the instinct to bound a problem rather than accept it as stated
  • Able to work closely with commercial colleagues without losing product judgement


Desirable

  • Experience in healthcare, clinical software or another regulated setting
  • Experience of a product serving several distinct groups of users with different needs
  • Experience of contributing to client scoping or statements of work

title: Investment Analyst
description:
ICBL is Barbados’ largest general insurance provider, writing business in all areas of general insurance including, Property, Liability, Accident, Motor, Marine, Aviation and Transit Insurance. ICBL also offers insurance coverage for Group Life, Group Health and Individual and Group Pensions.

We are recruiting an Investment Analyst to support the effective management of the Company’s investment portfolios by providing high-quality, analytical, reporting and operational assistance. The ideal candidate will contribute to portfolio monitoring, performance measurement and investment analysis, to support informed decision-making and alignment with the Company’s investment strategy.


The position is at the level of Grade 3 (Assistant Manager) in the Company’s compensation structure and will report to the Investment Manager or designate.

Major Areas of Responsibility:

Portfolio Monitoring & Support:

  • Assists with monitoring investment portfolios, ensuring alignment with approved asset allocation guidelines and investment limits.
  • Supports the rebalancing process by preparing data and analysis on portfolio positions and exposures.
  • Maintains accurate records of portfolio holdings, transactions and valuations within investment systems.
  • Tracks portfolio exposures, duration and liquidity positions.

Performance Measurement & Reporting:

  • Assists in the preparation of portfolio performance reports, including returns relative to benchmarks.
  • Supports basic performance attribution analysis (e.g., contribution by asset class or security).
  • Compiles and updates investment dashboards and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Prepares periodic reports for Management and Committees.

Investment & Market Analysis:

  • Conducts preliminary analysis of securities and asset classes, including fixed income, equities and cash instruments.
  • Gathers and analyzes economic and market data to support investment decisions.
  • Monitors local, regional and international capital markets and summarize key developments.
  • Assists in the preparation of investment notes and recommendations for review by senior team members.

Liquidity & ALM Support:

  • Assists with cash flow tracking and liquidity forecasting.
  • Supports Asset-Liability Management (ALM) processes by compiling relevant data and reports.
  • Contributes to the preparation of regulatory and internal ALM reporting.

Risk & Compliance Support:

  • Ensures investment data and reports comply with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Assists in stress testing and scenario analysis under guidance from senior team members.
  • Supports implementation and reporting requirements under IFRS 9.

Operational & Administrative Support:

  • Maintains and updates investment databases, models and records.
  • Assists in the preparation of departmental and investment reports.
  • Coordinates materials for Board and Committee meetings, as required.

Stakeholder Engagement:

  • Develops and maintains effective working relationships with internal teams and external market participants.
  • Liaises with brokers, custodians and other service providers to obtain market data and investment information.

Other Responsibility:

  • Performs other related duties as assigned and necessary for the development of the Insurance Corporation of Barbados Limited.


Qualifications, Experience and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Banking or equivalent degree in a related discipline.
  • One to three years’ experience in investments, finance, or a related analytical role (internships included).

title: Senior Communications and Network Engineer
description:
Senior Communications and Network Engineer

Tampa/MacDill AFB, FL


Agile IT Synergy, LLC is a Subject Matter Expert (SME) based information technology company focused on innovative engineering and integration of relevant technologies combined with effective business practices to deliver complete solutions that meet customer mission needs. Our proven ability to deliver against mission priorities ranging from organizational process improvements to the execution of mission-critical technical solutions is why we are trusted by critical government agencies. We're in search of customer focused individuals with a passion for solving difficult problems and exceeding expectations.


Position Location: Tampa/MacDill AFB, FL
Position Type: Full-Time
Security Clearance: Active DoD Top Secret


Job Description and Responsibilities:
The Senior Communications and Network Engineer will provide critical support to Special Operations Forces (SOF) technology integration initiatives, with responsibility for architecting, testing, and evaluating complex communication platforms in contested environments. This role is pivotal in driving the development and validation of next-generation capabilities for mission-critical operations.

Duties include but not limited to:

  • Lead the planning and execution of test and evaluation activities for advanced communication and network systems.
  • Architect, configure, and manage airborne and ground networks for technology demonstrations and operational assessments.
  • Serve as the primary technical liaison for network integration with USSOCOM PEO and stakeholder organizations.
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of network performance, including throughput, latency, and reliability in contested RF environments.
  • Develop and present detailed test reports and technical briefings to program leadership and stakeholders to communicate findings and recommendations.
  • Provide subject matter expertise on tactical data links, SATCOM systems, and advanced networking protocols.
  • Manage the installation and integration of communications equipment on various platforms for test events.
  • Must be willing to work onsite daily at customer or corporate locations at MacDill AFB, FL as directed.



Education:

  • Bachelor of Science (B.S.) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field is required.
  • Relevant experience and years of service may be considered in lieu of required education.


Required Experience:

  • Minimum of 10 years of experience supporting DoD/SOF communication systems.
  • Demonstrated expertise in network architecture, systems integration, and tactical communications.
  • Proven ability to operate and configure network analysis tools (e.g., Wireshark, Keysight).
  • Experience with tactical data links (e.g., Link 16) and SATCOM systems across various orbital paths (e.g., Proliferated Low Earth Orbit (PLEO), Low Earth Orbit (LEO), Geosynchronous Orbit (GEO).
  • Familiarity with contested RF techniques and technologies.
  • Ability to work as a member of a team with the skills and personality to lead discussions that result in positive desired outcomes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communications skills.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Active DoD Top Secret security clearance.



Preferred Experience:

  • Experience with data pipeline concepts (Extract, Transform, Load - ETL) for processing sensor and network data.
  • Experience supporting USSOCOM PEO-FW (Program Executive Office for Fixed Wing).
  • Experience working with the Rapid Innovation Cell, PEO-SDA, SOF Common Core Architecture (SCCA), AFSOC Common Core Architecture (ACCA), and autonomy suites (e.g., FANTOM Core, Vigilant Spirit, Arbitrator, BMS Control Hub).
  • Knowledge of sUAS (small Unmanned Aerial Systems) payloads and integration.
  • Familiarity with digital engineering and model-based systems engineering (MBSE).
  • CompTIA Security+ or equivalent DoD 8570 certification is highly desired.


Travel: Up to 20% based on customer needs.


AIT Synergy has competitive benefits and compensation packages that include Medical/Dental coverage, 401(k), Paid Time Off, Holidays, and opportunities for tuition reimbursement and training compensation relevant to task duties.

We’re a privately owned company. We prefer it that way. It means we’re free to do what we feel is best for our clients and our people. Our work is all about our clients. As a Paraplanner, you will be providing comprehensive administrative and technical assistance. Your responsibilities will include preparing client meeting documentation, suitability reports, and application forms, ensuring that all advice is delivered and processed with the utmost accuracy and compliance. You will conduct detailed research to identify the most appropriate financial solutions from our Centralised Investment Proposition or other market alternatives, aligning them with each client's financial needs and objectives.

To excel in this role, you will continuously develop your product, technical, and regulatory knowledge, staying current with the latest financial regulations. Your attention to detail and commitment to compliance will be vital in ensuring the highest standards of service for our clients.

This role is a fixed-term contract for 12 months, and suitable for candidates nationally as we have offices located in Cheltenham, Cardiff, Fareham, Newbury, London, Liverpool, Darlington and Grangemouth.

You are a detail-oriented and analytical Paraplanner with a solid foundation in financial planning, backed by at least two years of experience in the field. title: Digital Product Owner II

  • Identify, communicate, and resolve delivery risks, scope changes, and blockers.

  • Champion LEAN delivery practices and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with IT, Marketing, Legal, CX, and other cross-functional partners to align product dependencies.
  • Proactively surface delivery blockers, risks, and upcoming dependencies.
  • Support release planning, delivery tracking, and overall product readiness.

  • Strong communication and analytical skills.

  • Intermediate-level Agile coaching and backlog management.
  • Strong technical communication skills; can work with developers and architects.

This job operates in a professional office environment. The role routinely uses standard office equipment such as a laptop, desktop, smartphone, and photocopiers. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Essential oils are worn and/or diffused in the work environment.

Greenwood Heating and Home Services, the largest independently owned home service company in the Puget Sound and we are looking for a proven leader to continue the growth of our Restoration department.
