title: Director, Account Management (INTERNAL APPLICANTS ONLY)
description:
***THIS IS FOR INTERNAL APPLICANTS ONLY***


About Minga

Minga means community. It’s the belief that we achieve more together than we ever could alone. At Minga, joining our team isn't just about a new role, it's about joining a collective that is deeply invested in your growth, your impact, and your connection to the people around you.


We’re building the Student Behavior Platform schools can’t live without, and we’re having fun doing it.

We are a tight-knit group of curious, low-ego humans who genuinely enjoy the "we" over the "me."

  • Supportive Growth: You aren’t on an island. You’ll have the autonomy to do your best work and a community that has your back every step of the way.
  • Shared Ownership: Whether at our Kelowna HQ or remote, you’re a vital part of a team that cares as much about the people as the product.
  • Real Impact: Everything we do supports the educators and students we serve, creating a ripple effect of connection in schools everywhere.


Ready to be part of the community?
Come help us make school life better for everyone. 💙


The Role

We’re not just hiring for a position, we’re adding a teammate


Reporting to the CRO the Director, Account Management owns Minga's post-sale commercial motion including retention, expansion, and customer health for the Account Management organization. The Director, Account Management will lead the x2 Managers, Account Management and are ultimately accountable for GRR, NRR, and the quality of every customer relationship in the book.


This is a leadership role that operates at two levels simultaneously: setting the strategic direction for how Minga retains and grows its customer base, and being close enough to the team to know when something needs to change before the data tells you. You are the bridge between the AM organization and the rest of the company, bringing the customer perspective to Product, partnering with Sales on the expansion motion, and reporting the commercial health of the book to the executive team.


What You’ll Do 🚀

Organizational Leadership

  • Lead and develop the x2 Managers, Account Management, setting the direction and performance standards for the function
  • Create a culture of ownership, proactivity, and commercial accountability across the Account Management team
  • As needed, support recruitment of talent into the management layer; build succession depth within the AM organization
  • Allocate resources across the AM team as the customer base and growth targets evolve

Revenue & Retention Strategy

  • Own the company's GRR and NRR targets; set the strategy for how the post-sale org delivers on them
  • Design and maintain the customer segmentation model — defining how accounts are tiered, resourced, and managed based on size, complexity, and strategic value
  • Build the early-warning and intervention system that catches churn risk before it becomes churn
  • Develop the upsell and expansion playbook in partnership with the Director of Sales — ensuring AM-identified opportunities convert through the AE motion

Customer Strategy & Advocacy

  • Lead the business review and QBR program; define the cadence and format by account tier
  • Own the advocacy and reference pipeline, building a network of champion districts that accelerate new sales
  • Represent the customer voice to the executive team and Product organization; translate retention patterns into actionable strategic input

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with the Director of Sales on the AE ↔ AM expansion deal model. Clear lanes, clean collaboration, and no revenue left on the table
  • Work with Marketing and Customer Experience on customer marketing programs, case studies, and co-selling motions
  • Coordinate with the Implementation function to ensure AM handoffs from go-live are complete and actionable
  • Report AM team performance including GRR, NRR, health trends, churn analysis to the executive team on a regular cadence



What Success Looks Like 🎯

In the first 30 days:

  • Complete picture of the current AM book; health by tier, renewal pipeline, and team capacity
  • Relationships established with the Director of Sales, Director of Customer Experience, Product, and leadership team.
  • Assessment of the current touch model process and playbook, with a view on highest-impact improvements

In the first 90 days:

  • Updated customer segmentation model and resource allocation strategy for the AM team
  • GRR/NRR forecast presented to the executive team with confidence
  • Individual development plans in place for each AM in partnership with the Manager, Account Management

Ongoing:

  • Gross Revenue Retention (GRR)
  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR
  • Renewal rate
  • Healthy, growing advocate and reference pipeline
  • AM team retention - building an environment people want to stay and grow in


What We Require ✅

  • 5-8+ years in customer success or account management in B2B SaaS, with at least 3 years leading managers or senior leaders
  • Proven ownership of GRR and NRR at a company level, not just a team level
  • Experience building and scaling account management organizations in a named-book, renewal-focused model
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to design customer segmentation models, retention programs, and expansion motions
  • Strong cross-functional leadership - you've partnered effectively with Sales, Product, and Marketing to improve commercial outcomes
  • Excellent executive communication - you present performance data clearly and drive decisions at the leadership level
  • HubSpot or equivalent CRM and CS tooling experience
  • K-12 EdTech or education sector experience is a strong asset


Who You Are 🌟

  • A strategic owner - you see GRR and NRR as the outcomes of a system, and you build that system deliberately
  • A people developer - your managers are better leaders because of how you coach them
  • Commercially sharp and analytically driven, you make decisions based on data, not instinct alone
  • A connector - you hold the AE/AM expansion motion together and keep that seam clean and productive
  • A clear and confident communicator at the executive level, you don't just report results, you explain what's driving them and what you're doing about it
  • Mission-aligned - you believe that customer retention and customer success are the same thing, and that Minga's impact on schools depends on getting it right


Role Compensation 💰


OTE: $165,000-$205,000 + Equity


Compensation Philosophy & Transparency 💰

At Minga, we believe compensation should reflect impact, fairness, and market alignment, supporting our mission to empower educators and students while building a high-performing, people-first culture. Our standard is to pay at or near the midpoint of the range unless there is a clear business rationale to vary. This approach allows for growth and provides room to learn and develop within the role. We also conduct annual compensation reviews in November, which take into account both market benchmarks and individual performance.


Check out our Benefits & Perk Page for a full review of the overall compensation package.


AI at Minga 🤖

At Minga, we believe AI should make your work faster, smarter, and less repetitive — not more complicated. AI is meant to augment how we work, not replace human thinking or judgment

  • Leverage AI, but stay you. We expect you to use the tools available to you, but remember that Minga is built on real people. Your resume and "Why Minga" answer will be read by a real life human, so give us a glimpse of the person behind the profile.
  • During your interview we value your unique voice over a perfect prompt. It's okay to not answer perfectly.


What You Can Expect From Us 💙

At Minga, you’re more than just an application, you’re a real person with a story we want to hear.

We believe in clear communication, mutual respect, and ensuring every candidate walks away feeling valued, whether we end up working together or not.


Ready to Apply? 👋

If this role feels like a fit or even a maybe, hit apply.

We’re genuinely excited to learn more about you. Let’s build something meaningful together.

title: Teaching Lab Assistant - Surgical Technology
description:
Are you someone who strives for excellence, values accountability, provides the best service, all while reflecting unwavering integrity? Our talented team members across the state follow the behaviors, beliefs and outcomes of these core values to ensure that our vision is met. If you're ready to join the TSTC family and make great memories please complete our application process.

Job Description

The Teaching Lab Assistant's primary function is to assist professional faculty with teaching duties in the classroom, laboratory, computer laboratory, or facility as directed. In limited circumstances, a Teaching Lab Assistant may be authorized as the instructor of record for courses which they are qualified to teach. Teaching Lab Assistants assigned as instructor of record will serve under direct supervision of a faculty member experienced in the teaching discipline. Teaching Lab Assistants will attend and complete regular faculty development, and planned and periodic evaluations.

Essential Functions

The employee will demonstrate TSTC’s Core Values of Excellence, Accountability, Service, and Integrity with internal and external stakeholders, customers, students, and community members.

Student Academic Support
Supports student learning by tutoring and reinforcing instructional content previously delivered by faculty, including facilitating reviews and guided practice activities.

Laboratory and Shop Guidance
Assists students during hands-on laboratory and shop activities by providing direction, answering procedural questions, and ensuring proper and safe use of equipment and materials.

Supervised Instructional Delivery
Under direct faculty supervision, may serve as instructor of record to present prepared materials, supervise structured lab or shop activities, maintain an orderly learning environment, document student progress, and ensure readiness of supplies and equipment.

Laboratory Preparation and Breakdown
Prepares instructional spaces for laboratory and shop sessions by setting up experiments and equipment, securing materials after use, and disassembling activities in accordance with safety and operational standards.

Assessment and Record Management
Supports instructional assessment by grading assignments, exercises, and tests using established objective criteria and maintaining accurate and confidential student records and files.

Equipment Testing and Maintenance
Ensures instructional equipment is functional and reliable by testing new laboratory equipment for accuracy and performing routine maintenance and minor repairs on laboratory and instructional aids.

Instructional Materials Development
Assists professional staff in the development and preparation of training aids and instructional materials to support effective delivery of course content.

Supplies and Requisition Support
Initiates requisitions for consumable supplies and equipment repairs and prepares consumable materials necessary for classroom, laboratory, and shop exercises.

Inventory and Asset Management
Maintains accurate inventories of instructional supplies and equipment, ensures security of assets, and assists with major repairs or modifications of laboratory or shop equipment as assigned.

Student Worker Supervision and Safety Monitoring
Supervises assigned student workers and monitors instructional areas to identify and address safety conditions in compliance with institutional and regulatory standards.

Operational Support and Transportation
Operates motor vehicles to conduct TSTC business in support of instructional and operational needs, in accordance with institutional policies and safety requirements.

Collaboration & Communication

Works closely with faculty, staff, and students to support instructional activities and learning outcomes. Communicates clearly and timely regarding classroom needs, equipment status, safety concerns, and student support requirements.

Project or Work Management

Plans, prioritizes, and completes assigned instructional support tasks within established timelines. Manages multiple responsibilities concurrently while maintaining accuracy, safety, and accountability.

Quality & Compliance

Ensures instructional environments, equipment, and materials meet institutional standards, safety requirements, and applicable policies. Follows established procedures related to grading, recordkeeping, equipment use, and laboratory safety.

Continuous Improvement

Identifies opportunities to improve instructional support processes, laboratory setup, equipment usage, or workflows and collaborates with faculty and staff to implement improvements within the role’s scope.

Education & Experience

Minimum Qualifications

For general education courses or associate degree courses designed for transfer, a bachelor’s degree in the teaching discipline is required. For associate degree courses not designed for transfer, a bachelor’s degree in the teaching discipline or an associate degree with demonstrated competencies in the teaching discipline is required.

Preferred Qualifications

One to three years of related instructional, laboratory, or technical support experience is preferred. Relevant experience may be considered in lieu of formal education where appropriate, consistent with TSTC’s equivalency philosophy.

Skills & Abilities

Demonstrated knowledge of and skill in performing laboratory and shop procedures. Proficiency with information systems and computer applications, with advanced knowledge preferred. Ability to follow oral and written instructions accurately and work effectively with faculty, staff, students, and student workers. Ability to maintain a safe, organized, and effective instructional environment. Valid Texas driver’s license and ability to be insured under the TSTC Auto Liability Insurance Plan.

Core Competencies

Communication
Demonstrates clear, timely, and professional communication with faculty, students, and staff to support instructional activities, clarify expectations, and promote understanding in academic and laboratory settings.

Job Knowledge
Applies working knowledge of instructional support practices, laboratory and shop procedures, equipment usage, and institutional policies to perform assigned responsibilities accurately and consistently.

Student Focus
Supports student learning by providing guidance, answering questions, and reinforcing instructional content under faculty direction while maintaining appropriate professional boundaries.

Safety and Compliance
Follows established safety protocols and compliance requirements by monitoring instructional environments, ensuring proper equipment use, and addressing safety concerns to maintain a safe learning environment.

Collaboration
Works effectively with faculty, staff, and student workers to support instructional delivery, coordinate tasks, and contribute to a positive and productive learning environment.

Extra Duties Statement

This job description outlines the general responsibilities and expectations of the role. It is not intended to include every task or responsibility. Additional duties may be assigned by leadership as needed.

This role requires a valid Texas driver’s license and the ability to be insured under the TSTC Auto Liability Insurance Plan.

Standard Non Exempt

This position is classified under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) as non-exempt and operates within Texas State Technical College (TSTC) in a professional and instructional environment that may include campus offices, classrooms, laboratories, or other college facilities. The position is subject to TSTC timekeeping requirements, including accurate reporting of hours worked and compliance with overtime policies in accordance with FLSA and TSTC guidelines.

Texas State Technical College will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of the position.

Texas State Technical College is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, religion, genetic information, or veteran status.

The role may require movement across campus locations, participation in meetings, and regular interaction with faculty, staff, students, and external partners in support of TSTC’s mission and institutional goals. Work is primarily performed in an academic or laboratory environment using standard technology, instructional equipment, and communication tools. These duties may be performed with or without reasonable accommodation to support the essential functions of the position.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Texas State Technical College (TSTC), as an equal opportunity employer, complies with all applicable federal and state laws regarding nondiscrimination. TSTC is committed to a policy of equal opportunity for all persons and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, age, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or veteran status in employment, educational programs and activities, and admissions.


Employment Eligibility Verification

If hired, you will be required to complete the federal Employment Eligibility Verification I-9 form. You will be required to present acceptable and original documents to prove your identity and authorization to work in the United States. Documents need to be presented no later than the third day of employment. Failure to do so will result in loss of employment at TSTC.


Background Checks

A criminal history background check will be required for the finalist(s) under consideration for this position.

title: Front-end Engineer
description:
The opportunity

Do you care as much about how a product feels to use as you do about the code behind it?

First Table is looking for a Front-end Engineer to build and improve the customer-facing experiences our diners use every day, from discovering somewhere new to making a booking.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working at pace, has a strong eye for UI and design, and takes pride in turning an idea or design into a polished experience for customers. You’ll work across our React and Next.js web platform, with the opportunity to contribute to our React Native mobile app as well.

You don’t need to arrive with experience across every part of our stack. We’re particularly interested in strong front-end engineers who bring great React fundamentals, customer and design thinking, and the ability to learn and adapt quickly.

We’re open to an experienced intermediate or Senior Front-end Engineer. For us, it’s less about title and more about your capability, ownership and the quality of what you ship.


About us

At First Table, our vision is simple: to be the first place diners go to book a table.

Proudly established in Queenstown, New Zealand - where our head office is based - we've been leading the charge in the hospitality tech industry for over a decade, with operations spanning New Zealand, Australia, and the UK.

First Table is a dining discovery platform that connects diners to restaurants through their love of food. Through our clever tech, we help restaurants get their night off to a great start and give diners a compelling reason to try somewhere new. It’s a win-win situation. From early bird offers to last table reservations, we make discovering and booking great dining experiences fast, easy, and rewarding.

At the heart of everything we do are our values: Win-Win-Win, Own It and Grow Together. These guide how we show up for each other, our restaurant partners, and our diners and they’re a big part of what makes First Table a great place to work.

Learn more about our story here:


About the role

As a Front-end Engineer, you’ll build and improve customer-facing experiences across the First Table product, working closely with Product, Design, Analytics and Engineering.

Our web platform is built with React, TypeScript and Next.js, alongside our React Native / Expo mobile application. While experience across both web and mobile would be great, it’s not essential. If you’re a strong web engineer who is excited about developing your skills across React Native, we’d still love to hear from you.

You’ll be joining a team that values pace, pragmatism and customer experience. We want someone who doesn’t just ask “does it work?”, but also cares about whether it looks right, feels intuitive and creates a great experience for the diner.


What you’ll be doing

  • Build and improve customer-facing features across the First Table diner and booking experience.
  • Develop responsive, performant and accessible experiences using React, TypeScript and Next.js.
  • Turn designs into polished experiences with a strong eye for UI quality and usability.
  • Work closely with Product and Design to contribute ideas, solve problems and ship improvements quickly.
  • Contribute across our React Native / Expo mobile app as your experience develops.
  • Build reusable components and work with APIs, GraphQL and our wider application architecture.
  • Use analytics, experimentation and AI tools to understand performance, iterate and improve how we build and ship.


What we’re looking for

You’re a front-end engineer who enjoys building products for real customers and takes pride in the quality of what ends up on screen.

  • Strong commercial experience with React and TypeScript. React Native / Expo experience is a bonus, along with exposure to GraphQL, analytics or design systems
  • Experience with modern front-end frameworks, ideally Next.js.
  • Experience building customer-facing digital products and a genuine interest in user experience.
  • Strong front-end fundamentals across responsive design, performance and accessibility.
  • A good eye for UI and the ability to translate designs into polished customer experiences.
  • Experience working with APIs and modern application architecture.
  • A proactive approach - you contribute, ask questions and help move work forward rather than waiting for everything to be perfectly defined.
  • Strong communication and collaboration across Engineering, Product and Design.
  • Experience in B2C, marketplace, ecommerce or fast-paced customer-facing environments would also be valuable.


Why you'll love working with us

A high trust and flexible working environment: Hybrid from Auckland or Queenstown, you’ll be enabled to work the way that best suits you, in a high-trust, independent working environment.

Build things customers actually use: Work on highly visible experiences used by diners every day, with a clear connection between what you build and the experience our customers have.

Make an impact quickly: Join a team that values pace, pragmatism and getting great work into customers’ hands rather than getting caught up in unnecessary process.

Interesting product challenges: Work across a high-volume, two-sided marketplace with challenges spanning discovery, bookings, customer behaviour, conversion and retention.

Work with an experienced team: Partner closely with our Product, Design and Engineering teams while having the space to contribute ideas, take ownership and make things happen.

Grow across web and mobile: Build on your existing front-end strengths with the opportunity to contribute across both our web and mobile products.

AI-enabled ways of working: Be part of a team actively exploring how AI can help us build, test and learn faster, while keeping strong engineering judgement at the centre of what we ship.

Shape the future: Have a genuine influence on the experiences First Table creates as we continue to grow across multiple international markets.

Beloved consumer brand: Contribute to a product that diners and restaurants already love, making a visible difference across NZ, AU, and the UK.

Perks: Free First Table bookings, regular team recognition and social events, and the chance to work with a purpose-led, award-winning brand.


What’s next?

For more insights into our culture, the role and what we are looking for, we encourage you to check out our candidate page.

Submit your application with your CV and a brief cover letter telling us why First Table and this opportunity appeal to you.

We’d particularly love to hear about a customer-facing feature or product you’ve personally helped take from an idea or design through to something customers could use.

We’ll be reviewing and progressing applications as they come in, so don’t wait to apply.

title: Grief and Loss Practice and Education Lead

What makes a difference for us?

What makes a difference for you?

The opportunity to be part of the second-largest Queensland employer who has been leading by example for more than 100 years. Joining our team, you’ll be welcomed as part of the UnitingCare family.   • Flexible work arrangements to support work-life balance

  • Career development opportunities to challenge yourself, grow and make a meaningful difference

Child safe, Child friendly

UnitingCare is committed to being a Child Safe, Child Friendly organisation and will:

Diversity & Inclusion

Our approach is simple – everybody is welcome here. At UnitingCare, diversity is at the core of our who we are, our mission and our values. We are committed to providing equal opportunities to all employees no matter their sex, race, culture, sexual orientation, disability or gender identity. Demonstrating our commitment to reconciliation and building long-term employment opportunities for First Nations peoples, UnitingCare strongly encourages Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander applicants for this position.

Safe workplace

We work hard to make our services welcoming and safe for every person. We are united in keeping children, young people and the elderly safe from harm, within our services, workplaces and the communities we support. We are committed to speaking up loudly for their safety.

Commitment to Safeguarding

We are committed in creating services and workplaces that are welcoming and safe for every person. We work together to protect children, young people, adults and the elderly from harm within our services and the communities we support. We speak up for their safety to ensure their voices are heard. title: Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Intern
description:

As a Security GRC Intern, you'll work alongside BCM One's global Information Security, Privacy, Compliance, and Business Continuity teams to support critical governance and risk management initiatives. BCM One is a leading provider of NextGen Communications and Managed Services, supporting more than 18,000 business customers and 5,000 channel partners through a portfolio of cloud communications, managed services, and connectivity solutions. title: Sterile Processing Specialist - 2nd shift
description:

Children’s Wisconsin is a nationally recognized health system dedicated solely to the health and well-being of children. We provide primary care, specialty care, urgent care, emergency care, community health services, foster and adoption services, child and family counseling, child advocacy services and family resource centers. Our reputation draws patients and families from around the country.

We offer a wide variety of rewarding career opportunities and are seeking individuals dedicated to helping us achieve our vision of the healthiest kids in the country. title: Flight Follower
description:
Kalitta Charters II specializes in scheduled and on-demand narrow-body freighter operations. In 2003, aviator and NHRA World Champion, Doug Kalitta, set out to provide a safe and reliable solution to a complex logistics problem. This problem entailed moving freight across the Americas for our customers… overnight!


Job Summary:

The Flight Follower’s primary responsibility is to the safety of flight. Flight Followers are delegated authority by the Director of Operations to exercise operational control jointly with the pilot in command IAW 14 CFR Part 121 Supplemental rules. Flight Followers prepare and distribute domestic and international flight releases, runway analysis, and weather data in accordance with existing policies and procedures.


Functions/Responsibilities

  • Monitor the status of planned and in progress flights from the point of origin to the final destination
  • Release flights in accordance with all Kalitta Charters II applicable policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements
  • Collect and disseminate weather and aeronautical information to the PIC by preparing flight plans
  • Ensure all ground handling, deicing, fuel, landing/departure slots, and landing/overfly permits are in order before releasing a flight
  • Identify, anticipate, and take corrective action to minimize actual/potential delays due to weather, scheduling, operations, crew legality, and maintenance issues
  • Advise appropriate personnel of potential/actual delays and conditions affecting the safety of the flight
  • Coordinate with Maintenance Control to ensure that MEL/CDL limitations or restrictions are evaluated and complied with
  • Determine airport suitability/risk assessment

title: Program Coordinator
description:
POSITION

Program Coordinator


DEPARTMENT

Master in Management Program


REPORT TO

Director, Master in Management


POSITION TYPE

Full-time


WORK HOURS

37.5 hours per week (10:00–18:30, Monday through Friday)

*Weekend/evening work to attend events; compensatory time off provided.


LOCATION

City Campus (Sangen-jaya station)

*Hybrid-remote flexibility after initial training period available.


VISA REQUIREMENT

Temple University, Japan Campus (TUJ) is able to sponsor a visa for this position.


SALARY & BENEFITS

Commensurate with experience.

Eleven (11) days paid vacation in the first year, increasing to 20 days after 6 years of employment, plus 5 paid “personal and sick days” each year. In addition, approximately two weeks company-wide break over Christmas/New Year. Japanese social insurance and pension, commuting/telework allowance, a welfare-discount program membership, and retirement payment system.


OVERVIEW OF POSITION:

The Program Coordinator supports the growth and ongoing development of the Master in Management (MiM) program, with primary responsibility for recruitment and admissions coordination, program communications and marketing, CRM management, and the development of recruiting and student success events.

Working closely with the Program Director, Program Assistant, Career Advisor, faculty, and relevant university offices, the Program Coordinator helps ensure consistent and engaging experience for prospective students from initial inquiry through admission and transition into the program, while also supporting the program's visibility and student community.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Recruitment & Admissions

  • Coordinate prospective student engagement from initial inquiry through the admissions process
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for prospective students, responding to questions and providing information about the program, admissions requirements, timelines, and next steps
  • Coordinate recruitment activities, including information sessions, sample classes, fairs, and other prospective student events
  • Conduct follow-up communication with prospective students and applicants to support progression through the admissions funnel
  • Monitor applicant progress and work with relevant university offices to identify and follow up on incomplete applications or outstanding requirements
  • Coordinate and conduct admissions interviews, working closely with the Program Director and Fox’s admissions team.
  • Support admitted students during the transition from admission to enrollment, coordinating handoffs with the Program Assistant as appropriate
  • Track recruitment and admissions activity and provide regular updates on the prospective student pipeline

Recruiting Events

  • Coordinate the planning of recruitment-focused events, including information sessions, sample classes, admitted student events, and recruitment fairs
  • Coordinate participation by students, alumni, faculty, and other stakeholders
  • Work closely with the Program Director to develop event agendas, presentations, communications, and other content needed to effectively represent the program
  • Work closely with the Program Assistant on event logistics, including room reservations, catering, setup, materials, and other operational requirements
  • Track participation and follow up with attendees after recruitment events

CRM & Data Management

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records for prospective students, applicants and admitted students within the program's CRM systems
  • Track prospective student engagement, application status, recruitment activities, and communications
  • Develop and maintain processes to ensure consistent CRM usage and data quality
  • Generate reports and analyze recruitment and admissions data to support program planning and decision-making
  • Maintain contact lists and audience segments for prospective students, students, and alumni

Marketing, Website & Communications

  • Draft and coordinate program marketing and recruitment content, including emails, newsletters, announcements, presentations, and promotional materials in Japanese and English
  • Coordinate updates to the MiM website in Japanese and English and ensure program information remains accurate, current, and aligned with university guidelines
  • Work with relevant university teams and external partners on marketing and promotional initiatives
  • Identify student, alumni, faculty, and program stories that can be used to strengthen recruitment and program visibility
  • Support the development and maintenance of a consistent MiM program voice and messaging across communications and social media channels
  • Collaborate with the Program Director and TUJ Communications and Marketing support team to develop ads, and keep brochures, marketing materials, YouTube, and social media content up to date

Student Success

  • Lead the development of MiM student success activities that strengthen student engagement and community, while managing the program’s events budget
  • Collaborate with the Program Director to develop event concepts and programming that reflect the international and intercultural nature of the MiM student body
  • Coordinate with students, faculty, alumni, and external partners to develop meaningful community-building activities
  • Work with the Program Assistant to coordinate the operational and logistical elements of events, and to develop and maintain clear pre-arrival and post-arrival resources to help students navigate administrative processes and life in Japan
  • Together with the Program Assistant, provide support for incoming international students, including guidance on mandatory post-arrival administrative procedures
  • Gather student feedback and evaluate participation to continuously improve program activities

Program Support & Collaboration

  • Support the Program Director with program development initiatives, special projects, and activities related to recruitment, program growth and student success
  • Collaborate closely with the Program Assistant to ensure effective handoffs between recruitment/admissions activities and student onboarding and enrollment processes
  • Work with the Career Advisor to identify opportunities to incorporate alumni and employer engagement into program communications and events
  • Liaise with university departments and the Main Campus as needed on recruitment, admissions, marketing, and communications matters
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of program processes, systems, and the overall prospective and current student experience, as well as alumni engagement


QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum of 3 years of professional work experience in Japan
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Japanese
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across teams while also taking ownership of projects and initiatives
  • Strong interpersonal skills to build relationships with diverse stakeholders including students, alumni, faculty, staff, and external parties
  • Strong technical skills (including proficiency with Microsoft Office, experience with CRM systems and databases) and ability to quickly learn new systems and software
  • Detail-oriented with the proven ability to manage multiple concurrent responsibilities while maintaining composure in a dynamic work environment
  • Student-centered mindset with a strong commitment to creating a supportive, responsive and inclusive student experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

  • MBA or master's degree in a business field
  • Experience in Higher Education or program management
  • Experience in leading or supporting student recruitment and admissions processes
  • Experience in integrated marketing communications, including email marketing, digital advertising, content development, and campaign coordination
  • Experience delivering engaging presentations in both English and Japanese


APPLICATION PROCESS

Review of applications will begin immediately and will open until filled. Desired start date is October 1, 2026 or shortly thereafter.


Required application materials to be submitted:

  1. A cover letter highlighting relevant experience and what appeals to you about the position,
  2. A resume or curriculum vitae,
  3. A list of two references with contact information.

Only those applicants who make it past the initial review will be contacted.

Temple University, Japan Campus is committed to equal employment, and to increase diversity and inclusivity in both its community and curricula. All qualified applicants shall have full and equal consideration for employment. The university does not discriminate against candidates and employees because of their disability, sex, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, veteran status, or any other protected status under the law. Candidates who can contribute to the institution's goals are strongly encouraged to apply.

title: DSV Nurmijärvi hakee varastotyöntekijöitä!
location: Uusimaa, Hyvinkää, Järvenpää, Kerava, Nurmijärvi, Tuusula, Vantaa
description:
Etsimme motivoituneita varastotyöntekijöitä! Nurmijärven DSV tiimiin. Työtehtäviin kuuluvat pääasiassa kerääminen, kontinpurku, hyllytys, tarroitus ja muut vastaavat tehtävät. Työt alkavat sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä ja jatkuvat marraskuun loppuun saakka, mutta mahdollisuus myös pidempiin sopimuksiin on mahdollinen. Tällä hetkellä etsitään erityisesti keräilytaitoisia työntekijöitä.

Nyt on tarjolla huippupaikka – ja se voisi olla juuri sinulle!

Työtehtävät:

• Osallistut monipuolisesti logistiikan ja kuljetusten päivittäisiin tehtäviin, kuten tavaroiden vastaanottoon, keräilyyn, pakkaamiseen, lähettämiseen ja kontin purkuun
• Käytät alan perustyökaluja ja -järjestelmiä, esimerkiksi keräilytrukkia ja varastonhallintaohjelmia
• Huolehdit omalta osaltasi toimitusten tarkkuudesta, aikatauluista, turvallisuudesta ja työympäristön siisteydestä

Tarjoamme:

• Pitkäaikaisen työn arvostetussa logistiikka- ja kuljetusalan yrityksessä
• Mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi kokeneiden ammattilaisten rinnalla
• Hyvän työilmapiirin, modernit työvälineet ja osaavan tiimin tuen

Odotamme sinulta:

• Alan koulutusta tai aiempaa kokemusta logistiikan, varastotyön tai kuljetusten parista
• Motivoitunutta, oma-aloitteista ja huolellista työotetta
• Hyviä tiimityöskentelytaitoja ja halua tehdä laadukasta ja vastuullista työtä
• Valmiutta työskennellä vuorotyössä tai vaihtelevissa aikatauluissa, myös lauantai vuoroja kiireisimpinä viikkoina

Työ alkaa sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Palkkaus 16,09 - 18,21 €/h ja määrittämisessä otetaan huomioon aikaisempi kokemus ja koulutuksesi.

Kolahtiko?

Kuulostaa hyvältä, mutta miksi hakisin töitä juuri Amikon kautta?

Amiko tarjoaa kaiken tasoisille ammattilaisille laajan valikoiman töitä. Olemme sinulle reilu, luotettava ja joustava työelämän kumppani. Amikolla on hyvä maine työmarkkinoilla. Pyrimme aina etsimään parhaat mahdolliset ratkaisut työllistymisesi tueksi. Amikolaisena saat:

• Vähintään TES:in mukaisen palkkauksen-palkkausjärjestelmämme on kannustava, joskus jopa suurempi kuin työllistyessä suoraan yrityksen palkkalistoille.

• Laajasti erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia- meillä on kattavat verkostot ja laaja työpaikkavalikoimaniin osa-aikaisia, kokopäiväisiä kuin sesonkitöitä monelta eri alalta. Kun sopiva työ löytyy, monille tarjoutuu myös mahdollisuus siirtyä vakituiseksi työntekijäksi asiakasyritykseen.

• Oman yhteyshenkilön ja yksilöllistä työnhakua – Amikolta saat henkilökohtaista palvelua ja oman tutun yhteyshenkilön, johon voit olla suoraan yhteydessä.

• Kattavat työterveyspalvelut, normaalin eläkekertymän ja sairausajan palkan sairauden sattuessa – Vaikka teetkin työsi asiakasyrityksessämme, olet amikolainen ja kannamme sinusta vastuun ja huolehdimme eduistasi.

• … vai kenties jotain ihan uutta urallesi? Autamme myös alanvaihdossa. Räätälöidyt uravalmennukset auttavat päivittämään osaamistasi ja löytämään uuden suunnan urallasi.

Voisiko tässä olla sinulle uusi työpaikka?

Toimimme asiakkaallemme rekrytointikumppanina, käsittelemme saapuvat työhakemukset sekä vastaamme ensimmäisen vaiheen haastatteluista. Jätäthän hakemuksesi pikimmiten ja nappaa itsellesi uusi huippuduuni!

Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivien henkilön löydyttyä.

Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse vastaanotettuja hakemuksia vaan jätäthän hakemuksen nettisivujemme kautta tietosuojasyistä.

Please note that we do not process applications submitted by e-mail, so please submit your application via our website for privacy and data protection reasons.

title: Board Members
description:

SOLOMON ISLANDS



Call for Board members



Lead. Inspire. Strengthen. Govern for Community Impact.

LLSI is a member of the Live & Learn Environmental Education Network, operating to improve locally-led climate resilience across the Asia and the Pacific, towards a sustainable, resilient and inclusive world.

Live & Learn’s works with communities to address climate change adaptation, environmental protection, disaster risk reduction and response, food security, water, sanitation and hygiene to eradicate poverty and create a fairer, more sustainable world. To achieve this, Live & Learn actively promotes gender equity, social inclusion, and the integration of Indigenous knowledge and local leadership in decision-making and program design.

You can find out more about Live & Learn at

We are now seeking an experienced, strategic and values‑driven Board members to guide the governance of Live & Learn Solomon Islands.

This is an exciting opportunity to join one of Solomon Islands leading charitable organisations. The LLSI Board has governance responsibilities, leads strategic decision-making, engagement with stakeholders and ensures compliance with relevant policies, legislation and standards to deliver high-quality, community‑driven development outcomes.

Commitment

Who We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate will have:

Applications close at 4:00 pm on 18th September 2026.

Interested applicants are invited to submit the following:

Please send your application or any enquiries regarding the role to: elmah.panisi@livelearn.org or call +23698.

When submitting your application, please use the subject line:

“Application – Board Member (LLSI)”

Child Safeguarding and Equal Opportunity

Live & Learn is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to the wellbeing and safety of all children. All board members, employees, volunteers are required to agree to and comply with our Child Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Good Practice Manual, and Code of Conduct.

title: Partnerships Coordinator
description:
PARTNERSHIPS COORDINATOR - JOB DESCRIPTION

Role: Partnerships

Contract Type: Consultancy

Division: Operations

Location: New Delhi, India

Reports to: Senior Manager, Austria

Date: August 2026



About CPI
Climate Policy Initiative (CPI) is an analysis and advisory organization with deep expertise in finance and policy. Our mission is to help governments, businesses, and financial institutions drive economic growth while addressing climate change.

With a team of experts across seven international offices, including a strong presence in emerging markets and developing economies, CPI is a leader in tracking sustainable investment trends, identifying innovative business models, and supporting the solutions that can drive the transition to a low-carbon, climate-resilient, inclusive economy. We are unique in our focus on finance, our ability to get the right people to the table, and our analytical rigor.

About the Role

This role has been created to manage the formal coordination with partners of CPI including, funders, contractors (communication, operational monitoring and reporting) for projects. While technical delivery on these projects, including drafting of proposals, budgets, and narrative and financial reports, may be led by the relevant delivering CPI office, all formal submissions to stakeholders (proposals, reports, invoices, amendments, and funder portal filings) are filed by the contracting entity.

The Partnership Coordinator acts as a critical link between CPI’s stakeholders and the project delivery teams .

This role sits within the Operations team and will work closely with program staff across CPI offices. The position is based in New Delhi, India, but is contracted, supervised, and managed by CPI Austria, reporting to the Austria Senior Manager.

Roles and Responsibilities

Partnership Coordination and Support

  • Serve as the designated CPI contact for receipt of finalized proposals, reports, budgets, invoices, and contract/grant amendments prepared by the delivering office.
  • Review incoming materials for high-level contractual and compliance alignment prior to filing.
  • Execute formal submission of proposals, reports, and contract documentation to partners via designated channels.
  • Confirm and share submission receipts and confirmations with the delivering office for their records.
  • Maintain records of all formal submissions and filings made .
  • Serve as a coordination point for partner communication, updates, presentations, meetings, reports and other communications, working with colleagues across CPI offices to gather required information.
  • Maintain calendars, trackers, and other tools necessary to monitor funder requirements, deliverables, and reporting deadlines, including U.S. federal and European government reporting requirements where applicable.

Relationship and Meeting Support

  • Support CPI’s engagement with partners by coordinating meetings, preparing materials, documenting next steps, and tracking follow-up.
  • Facilitate communication between CPI offices contributing to information or work relevant to the projects.

About You: Competencies and Experience

  • Post Graduate degree in any Finance/Economics and at least 7 - 8 years post qualification experience preferably within an international not for profit environment.
  • You are able to interact with high-level external stakeholders independently
  • You have exceptional attention to detail, organization, time management, and prioritization skills, and an ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines
  • Knowledge of the full project & contract lifecycle.

About You: Personal Attributes

  • You are a self-starter, and requires minimal supervision
  • You have an independent, analytical mind with a track record of applying sound strategic judgment to complex issues
  • You are proficient user of the MS Office suite, in particular Excel, word and power point and other software and tools
  • You have outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including fluency in English
  • You are willing to travel internationally/domestically

Position Details

CPI is hiring for a fixed term two-year contract consultant based in New Delhi, India.

To maintain a clear organizational and contracting structure, the Partnership’s Coordinator:

  • Performs services for and on behalf of the Austrian employing entity.
  • Acts as the designated focal point for CPI on projects delivered by other CPI offices, consistent with CPI's submission process. Will report to manager based out of Austria
  • May monitor or support work relevant to the obligations of CPI, including work being carried out by other CPI Offices.
  • May request, consolidate, track, and communicate information from other CPI office teams when required for partnership coordination.


To Apply
Visit this link to apply. With your application, enclose:

(1) CV no longer than 2 pages

(2) a compelling cover letter no longer than 1 page, setting out how you meet the requirements of the role and your motivations for wanting to work at CPI.

(3) Respond to the filter questions. We do not recommend the use of AI to complete your application.


Applications are accepted on a rolling basis, and open until filled. We encourage applicants to apply early or mention a deadline. Only short-listed applicants will be contacted.

Applicants must be eligible to work in the location they are applying for, CPI is unable to offer any visa sponsorship for this role.

Please be sure to add notifications@app.bamboohr.com to your contact list to ensure delivery of all correspondence from us.


Our Commitment

CPI’s mission is to create economic opportunity while protecting our environment. This worldview—grounding opportunity in something more fundamental that we all share and must protect—permeates our organization, and forms the foundation of our approach to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI).

CPI’s approach to DEI mirrors our mission: within a culture that values transparency and dialogue, we strive to improve equity within our organization as well as in the communities in which we work. Internally and externally, we seek to remove inequitable barriers regardless of their origin, whether it be class, race, religion, nationality, region, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation or physical ability. We are proactive in identifying and removing biases in our processes, seeking fairness in hiring, working conditions, and professional development.

If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of application. We will then work with you to identify the best way to assist you through the recruitment process.

title: Animal Care Specialist - SPCA Wake  (Full-Time)
description:
Animal Care Specialist
If you have a passion for working with animals and enjoy seeing goals met through daily scheduled activities, the Animal Care Specialist may be the most rewarding career journey of your life.


Job Type: Full-time
Pay: $21.00 per hour with scheduled salary increases at anniversary of hire date


Who We Are – Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals of Wake County (SPCA Wake)
Founded in 1967 in Raleigh, NC, SPCA Wake is a progressive and innovative private, non-profit animal welfare and sheltering organization. Our organizational core values are the foundation of a positive work culture that values employees just as much as our mission. We are committed to creating a better future for pets and people and we work hard to achieve our goals and offer a rewarding workplace. SPCA Wake provides competitive pay and excellent benefits (see below). Working at SPCA Wake is about more than just a paycheck, it’s about making a difference every day in the lives of pets and people.

With locations in Raleigh and Garner, SPCA Wake rescues, heals and adopts more than 4,000 pets annually and provides assistance to more than 30,000 families and individuals each year. We never place a time limit on how long cats, dogs and other pets stay at our shelter. Our vision is to create a humane community for pets and people. If you are looking to make an impact and to save lives, SPCA Wake is the perfect place for you.


Our Core Values:
1- Hell, Yeah!
2- Be Kind
3- Do What You Say
4- Forward Focused
5- Loose & Wiggly
6- Drop the Mic


Position Overview
As an Animal Care Specialist you (and your teammates) are responsible for the daily care and enrichment for shelter animals who are just entering our care or are waiting to be adopted. You will work with a dynamic assortment of volunteers and customers. The Animal Care Specialist improves the quality of life for homeless pets at SPCA Wake with training, feeding, exercise and socialization. The job is so much more than cleaning kennels, although there is a fair amount of that, to be honest. We practice fear-free animal handling at all times. Training is provided. While this is a front-line position, we don’t consider it an “entry level” position, as it takes some time to build the skills needed to excel for the betterment of the animals. One more thing -- you must be comfortable kneeling, crouching, reaching overhead and lifting, carrying, and pulling up to 50 lbs.


You might be a born Animal Care Specialist if:
• You’re equally comfortable talking to pets or people – you can communicate with either!
• You consider yourself to be a bit of a time management freak – you love nothing more than thinking about the most effective way to get your work done.
• You’re the first to notice when one of your, or your family’s, pets isn’t acting right and do something about it.
• You’ve never considered yourself only a “dog person” or a “cat person”; you’d snuggle up to any critter that would let you.


Required:

• Must love animals and care about people

• Previous professional animal handling experience

• Must be able to work a flexible schedule, including Saturdays and Sundays, some holidays

• Valid driver’s license (some animal transport van driving required)

• A high school diploma or equivalent

• Must be comfortable kneeling, crouching, reaching overhead and lifting, carrying, and pulling up to 50 lbs.

• Previous customer service experience

• Previous animal handling experience


Benefits:

  • Medical and Dental: Employer pays 90% of employee coverage (full-time)
  • Insurance includes wellness, dental, vision, life, mental health care, prescriptions, emergency & urgent care, chiropractic care, and physical therapy
  • Telemedicine options, 24/7 access to virtual health & wellness care and virtual behavioral health care

PAID TIME OFF –

  • All part-time and full-time staff receive paid time off.
  • Paid Holidays - 9 paid holidays per year (full-time)
  • Vacation Time - 10 paid vacation days per year (full-time) with scheduled increases at milestone anniversaries of hire date
  • Sick Time - 6.5 paid sick days per year (full-time)

FINANCIAL –

  • Healthcare: Flexible Spending Account
  • 401k Plan
  • Coastal Federal Credit Union Membership
  • 20% discount on pet adoptions and in SPCA Wake retail store

OTHER –

  • Bereavement time off
  • Federal & State Leave of Absence options

Only the most qualified candidates will be contacted for interviews. No phone calls or emails, please — we’ll have our people call your people!

title: 3D Modeller
description:
Mission Overview:


Keystone Solutions is seeking a talented 3D Modeller for a consultancy mission at a client site, where you will contribute to the development of XR simulators designed to train and prepare personnel for various scenarios. Your expertise in Blender and strong understanding of 3D modelling, texturing, and asset optimization will be crucial in creating high-quality, realistic XR training environments for critical organizations.


Responsibilities:


  • 3D Modelling: Create high-quality, detailed 3D models of characters, vehicles, props, weapons, and environments in Blender for use in XR training simulators.
  • Texturing & Materials: Develop realistic textures and materials using PBR workflows to enhance the visual fidelity and immersion of XR simulations.
  • Optimization: Optimize models, topology, and texture sizes (LODs, poly counts, UV layouts) to ensure smooth performance across different XR platforms.
  • Collaboration: Collaborate closely with end users, programmers, designers, and fellow artists to create assets that authentically simulate the situations and challenges they face.
  • Asset Integration: Prepare, export, and integrate Blender assets into Unity, ensuring correct scale, pivot points, materials, and naming conventions.
  • Environment Art: Build immersive environments, buildings, and props that accurately reflect real-world locations and scenarios encountered by special forces and the police.
  • Prototyping: Rapidly prototype and iterate on 3D assets and environments to refine the training experience.
  • Documentation: Maintain clear and up-to-date documentation of asset pipelines, naming conventions, and processes to facilitate knowledge sharing within the team and with partners.
  • Adaptation: Stay current with industry trends and emerging tools and techniques in 3D art and XR, and apply them to improve asset quality and pipeline efficiency.


Profile:


Knowledge and Experience (Required):


  • Bachelor's degree in 3D Art, Game Design, Animation, or a relevant field, or multiple years of proven experience in the industry. A comprehensive portfolio showcasing your work is required.


Advantages:


  • Previous experience with police services, defense, or other security services.
  • Experience with 3D scanning and digital reconstruction (LIDAR, photogrammetry).
  • Experience in operational training environments.


Competencies:


  • Strong proficiency in Blender, including modelling, sculpting, UV unwrapping, texturing, and material creation.
  • Demonstrated experience creating 3D assets and/or environments for games and/or XR simulators for training and simulation, showcased through a portfolio.
  • A solid understanding of PBR texturing workflows and tools such as Substance Painter or Substance Designer.
  • Experience optimizing assets (poly count, topology, LODs, texture resolution) for real-time rendering on XR platforms (VR, AR, MR).
  • Experience exporting and integrating assets into a game engine, preferably Unity.
  • Excellent eye for detail, proportion, and realism, with a passion for creating authentic XR training experiences for special forces and the police.
  • Proficiency in Dutch, French, and/or English.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work well with special forces and police partners and in cross-functional teams.
  • Experience with 3D scans and their optimization is a plus.


At Keystone Solutions, we pride ourselves on our consultancy nature, offering dynamic projects that provide turbo-charged learning opportunities and a commitment to skyrocketing ambition. Being a "K-Stone" means bringing our core values to every engagement. If you are ready to tackle technical and strategic challenges in a dynamic consultancy environment, apply today at Keystone Solutions Career Portal.


Duration: 15/09/2026 - 31/12/2026 4 months (full time)


Language requirements:

Dutch: Level Active knowledge
English: Level Active knowledge
French: Level Active knowledge

title: Rakennusaputyöntekijä
description:
Oletko kokenut rakennusalan osaaja tai vasta urasi alkuvaiheessa oleva tulevaisuuden tekijä? Viihdytkö tiimityössä ja arvostat vaihtelevia työtehtäviä? Jos vastasit kyllä, haluamme kuulla sinusta lisää!

Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme rakennusapulaisia työmaalle Kuopion alueelle. Rakennusapulaisen työtehtäviin kuuluu monipuolisesti erilaisia avustavia tehtäviä työmaalla. Työnkuvaan kuuluu perustöitä, kuten siivouksen ja järjestyksen ylläpitoa, haalausta ja purkutöitä. Lisäksi työnkuvaan kuuluu avustavat rakennustehtävät tulevia työvaihteita silmällä pitäen, kuten esimerkiksi muottien asettaminen valuja varten, tukirakentaiden asentaminen tai alustojen valmistelu.

Työt alkavat sopimuksen heti sopivien henkilöiden löytyessä ja projektin arvioitu kesto on pari viikkoa.

Sovit tähän työhön, jos sinulta löytyy:

  • Hyvä asenne ja oma-aloitteinen työote: olet ajoissa paikalla, teet sen minkä lupaat, uskallat kysyä apua ja olet valmis ottamaan vastaan ohjeita ja uusia oppeja

  • Voimassaoleva työturvakortti

  • Fyysistä kuntoa, sillä työtehtävät voivat olla fyysisesti kuormittavia.

  • Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa
  • B-luokan ajokorttia ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta

Hienoa (muttei välttämätöntä) on, jos sinulla on lisäksi:

  • Rakennusalan koulutus ja/tai aiempaa työkokemusta rakennusalan töistä

Me tarjoamme sinulle:

  • TESin mukaisen tai sitä paremman palkan, joka maksetaan aina ajallaan. Tässä työssä tuntipalkkasi asettuu 14-16 euron välille, ja se määritellään osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan.

  • Hyvät työvaatteet ja muut työssä tarvittavat varusteet

  • Mukavan ja rennon työporukan

  • Oman Workerin yhteyshenkilön, joka on helposti tavoitettavissa ja auttaa sinua henkilökohtaisesti kaikissa työsuhteeseesi liittyvissä asioissa

Miksi kannattaa hakea töitä juuri Workerin kautta:

”Workerilla voin luottaa siihen, että he näkevät potentiaalini, mihin pystyn ja mikä haastaa minua sopivasti”, kuvailee kauttamme työn löytänyt ammattilainen.

Me teemme sen, minkä lupaamme. Haluamme olla rekrytoijana ja työnantajana joustava, luotettava ja oikeudenmukainen. Käytännössä tämä tarkoittaa, että:

  • Meillä on reilu meininki. Saat aina työsopimuksen ja palkan ajallaan. Teemme sen minkä lupaamme, emmekä lupaa asioita, joita emme voi pitää.

  • Panostamme henkilökohtaiseen palveluun. Saat oman yhteyshenkilön, joka vastaa, kun soitat – niin pienissä kuin isommissakin työasioissa. Olet myös aina tervetullut piipahtamaan konttorillamme, tarjoamme kahvit! Toimipisteitä meillä on ympäri Suomen yhteensä 13.

  • Olemme puolellasi. Varmistamme, että saat asianmukaiset työvaatteet ja varusteet. Panostamme myös erityisen paljon työturvallisuuteen. Yhteyshenkilösi myös tukee sinua tarvittaessa työelämän kiemuroissa.

  • Tarjoamme paljon erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia. Oli tähtäimessäsi sitten alasi huippu, työelämässä rennosti surffailu tai kokonaan uusi ala, meiltä löytyy mahdollisuuksia ympäri Suomen. Voimme auttaa sinua myös löytämään urallesi uuden suunnan.

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi!

Jätä hakemuksesi klikkaamalla hakupainiketta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti, eli jätä hakemuksesi pian!

Hakemisen jälkeen kuulet meistä lyhyen ajan kuluessa. Jos etenet rekrytointiprosessissa, tapaat ensin Workerin työntekijän rennossa haastattelussa, jonka tavoitteena on tutustua tarkemmin sinuun ja osaamiseesi. Viimeisessä vaiheessa pääset tapaamaan myös asiakasyrityksen yhteyshenkilön.

Lisätietoja tästä työstä ja muista Workerin tarjoamista työmahdollisuuksista voit kysyä Ella Itkoselta, ella.itkonen@worker.fi tai 0505540401. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

title: Combustion Technician - White Tail Automation
description:
Combustion Technician - White Tail Automation


Put your combustion expertise to work. As a Combustion Technician, you’ll be the go-to expert in the field. Tuning burners, troubleshooting complex combustion issues, optimizing system performance, and helping customers operate safely and efficiently.

You’ll have the opportunity to work independently, tackle challenging technical problems, lead BMS installations and commissioning, and mentor less-experienced technicians.

If you enjoy hands-on technical work, problem-solving, and making a real impact for customers, this is an opportunity to take your career to the next level.

Who we are:

At the Crimson Group, we provide our clients with high-value automation, instrumentation, electrical design, and process operation solutions. With the capabilities of a large enterprise, and the agility and responsiveness of a small company, we are a customer-focused provider of automation and integrated solutions. Crimson Group provides total integration of design, project management, panel manufacturing, installation/commissioning, maintenance, and repair for North America and select international markets.



What we Offer:

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Comprehensive benefit package.
  • An environment of continuous learning with the opportunity to enhance your skills & experience and grow within the organization.
  • The opportunity to participate in charitable events through our charity, RedTail Community Foundation.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Independently tune ND burners to achieve safe, reliable, and optimal performance.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot complex burner and combustion issues.
  • Evaluate burner performance and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reliability, and operation.
  • Apply advanced knowledge of ND burner operation, combustion principles, and related components.
  • Demonstrate working knowledge of forced draft (FD) burners and associated controls.
  • Evaluate customer sites and equipment to identify combustion system requirements.
  • Work with customers and internal teams to define equipment and project requirements.
  • Lead standard BMS installation activities and coordinate installation work as required.
  • Assist with startup, commissioning, testing, and optimization of combustion systems.
  • Understand applicable emissions requirements within the technician's home region.
  • Perform required emissions testing and prepare accurate customer reports.
  • Maintain complete and accurate service, testing, and commissioning documentation.
  • Communicate technical findings and recommendations clearly to customers.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to less-experienced technicians.
  • Identify additional customer service, repair, and equipment opportunities.
  • Follow all company, customer, manufacturer, and regulatory safety requirements.
  • Maintain a professional customer-facing presence.
  • Travel to customer locations and respond to service requirements as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.



Your Skills and Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated competency as a Combustion Technician.
  • Advanced understanding of ND burner operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently tune ND burners.
  • Strong understanding of BMS operation and related components.
  • Working knowledge of FD burners and controls.
  • Ability to evaluate customer sites and determine basic combustion system requirements.
  • Knowledge of applicable regional emissions requirements.
  • Ability to complete accurate emissions testing and customer reporting.
  • Ability to lead BMS installation activities.
  • Strong troubleshooting, mechanical, and technical skills.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and make sound field decisions.
  • Ability to mentor and provide technical guidance to junior technicians.
  • Willingness to travel and work in varying field environments.
  • Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record, where required.


Working Schedule:

  • Monday–Friday schedule with 8 to 10 hour days and potential overtime and call outs.

**As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and professional work environment, the Crimson Group of Companies conducts comprehensive background checks and drug and alcohol testing on all prospective employees as part of the final offer process. These checks are intended to verify the accuracy of information provided by candidates and assess any potential risks to the company or its employees. All offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of these background checks.**

Please note: We do not accept phone calls regarding job opportunities. To ensure fairness and consistency in our hiring process, all candidates must follow the application instructions outlined in the posting. Thank you for your understanding.

title: Universal Banker I - James Island, SC
description:
The SouthState story is one of steady growth, deep community roots, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers move forward. Since our beginnings in the 1930s to becoming a trusted financial partner across the South and beyond - we are known for combining personal relationships with forward-thinking solutions.

We are committed to helping our team members find their success while maintaining the integrity of our values: building trust, fostering lasting relationships and pursuing excellence. At SouthState, individual contributions are recognized, potential is cultivated and team members are inspired to achieve their greater purpose. Your future begins here!

SUMMARY/OBJECTIVES

The Universal Banker serves as a full service, single point of contact in the branch for SouthState customers’ financial needs. The position operates in the dual capacity of a Teller and FSR providing exceptional customer service in both transactional and account management. The Universal Banker seeks to attract, expand, and retain customer relationships and is responsible for contributing to the financial growth of the bank.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Serves customers quickly, accurately, efficiently, and confidentially according to the South State Bank Service Standards.
  • Knows and understand the products and services offered by the Bank. These include facts and features, benefits and advantages, rules and regulations, price structure, and a simple definition of each service offered.
  • Able to identify customer needs and expectations by listening for clues. Seeks the opportunity to expand customer relationships by making referrals as outlined in the goals for this position.
  • Presents a neat and professional personal appearance, in accordance with bank policy.
  • Knows and ensures compliance to all banking regulations to include Regulation CC and Bank Secrecy Act.
  • Develop a strong understanding of customer facing technology with the ability to discuss with and enroll customers in self-service options.
  • Teller Duties:

    Processes transactions for savings, checking, and loan accounts.

    Maintains a neat and orderly work area.

    May assist in guiding and training new tellers.

    May allow customers access to safe deposit boxes.

    Cashes checks and processes savings withdrawals within assigned limits and in accordance with prescribed procedures.

    Sells certified checks.

    Balances transactions daily.

    May service/balance ATM.

    May utilize the branch capture system.

    Knows and follows policies and procedures in completing transactions, minimizing operational errors, and maintaining a proper workflow.

    Knows and follows the branch’s security and audit procedures and understands the function and operation of the security devices.

  • FSR Duties:
    • Opens new deposit accounts and understands the products and financial services offered by the bank. Also handles other services such as stop payments, wire transfers, and other maintenance functions within assigned limits.
    • Explains policies and procedures as necessary, keeping in mind most customers’ unfamiliarity with them.
    • Resolves customer problems and complaints with courtesy and discretion and direction and directs customers with difficult problems to other sources for assistance. Considers problems and complaints as opportunities to satisfy the customer and promote additional services.
    • Is knowledgeable of financial services offered by the bank.
    • Shows sincere appreciation for each customer’s time and business. Gives business card if not already given.
    • Knows and follows the branch’s security and audit procedures and understands the function and operation of the security devices.
    • Assures that branch records, reports and other correspondence resulting from customer development attempts are correct, timely and are properly distributed.

UNIVERSAL BANKER FUNCTIONS

  • One year of teller or cash handling experience and six months customer relationship building or sales experience
  • Demonstrated expertise in the Teller II and basic FSR job functions
  • Additional Responsibilities may include Vault Responsibilities or Back-Up Vault Responsibilities
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications, Education, and Certification Requirements

  • Education: High School diploma or equivalent
  • Experience: Cash handling, sales, customer service. Previous banking experience preferred.
  • Specific Knowledge: Good interpersonal skills, good computer skills, ability to read, write, speak, and understand English

TRAINING REQUIREMENTS/CLASSES

  • The SouthState Way New Team Member Orientation

title: Transfer Station Spotter
description:

For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.


Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
