title: Հաճախորդների մենեջեր,  «Հին Երևան» մասնաճյուղ
description:
«ԱյԴի Բանկ» ՓԲԸ-ն Հաճախոդների մենեջերի հաստիքը զբաղեցնելու համար փնտրում է մոտիվացված թեկնածուի, ով պատասխանատու է ստորև նշված պարտականությունները կատարելու համար։


ԱՇԽԱՏԱՆՔԱՅԻՆ
ՊԱՐՏԱԿԱՆՈՒԹՅՈՒՆՆԵՐ

  • Հաճախորդների սպասարկում, Բանկի կողմից մատուցվող ծառայությունների և պրոդուկտների վերաբերյալ համապատասխան խորհրդատվության տրամադրում,
  • Հաճախորդների կարիքների բացահայտում, նոր հաճախորդների ներգրավում,
  • Բանկի կողմից մատուցվող ծառայութունների վաճառքի/խաչաձև վաճառքի իրականացում,
  • Վարկերի տրամադրման, ավանդների ներգրավման, բանկային հաշիվների բացման և սպասարկման, վճարային քարտերի, պահատուփային /անհատական պահատեղեր/, հեռակառավարման համակարգերի գծով գործառույթների իրականացում,
  • Հաճախորդներին իրենց հաշիվների վերաբերյալ տեղեկանքների, քաղվածքների, վճարային փաստաթղթերի, դրանց կրկնօրինակների և Բանկի ներքին իրավական ակտերով սահմանված այլ փաստաթղթերի տրամադրում,



ՊԱՀԱՆՋՎՈՂ
ՈՐԱԿԱՎՈՐՈՒՄՆԵՐ

  • Բարձրագույն կրթություն,
  • Վարկավորման ոլորտում նվազագայունը 1 տարվա աշխատանքային փորձ,
  • Համակարգչային գիտելիքների լավ իմացություն (MS Office),
  • Հայերեն և ռուսերեն լեզուների իմացություն,
  • Հաղորդակցման և բանակցություններ վարելու հմտություն,
  • Վաճառքի հմտություններ,
  • Թիմային աշխատանքի պատրաստակամություն,
  • Տարբեր իրավիճակներում աշխատելու և արագ կողմնորոշվելու ունակություն:
  • Սթրեսակայունություն


Փորձաշրջանի բարեհաջող ավարտից հետո Բանկն իր աշխատակիցներին առաջարկում է արտոնությունների լայն փաթեթ, մասնավորապես, բժշկական ապահովագրություն, պարգևատրման ճկուն համակարգ, սպորտակումբների ծառայություններից օգտվելու կորպորատիվ փաթեթ, արտոնյալ պայմաններով բանկային ծառայություններ և այլն:


ԸՆԿԵՐՈՒԹՅԱՆ ՄԱՍԻՆ

«ԱյԴի Բանկ»-ը հիմնադրվել է 1990թ.-ին «Անելիք Բանկ» անվանումով, իսկ 2018թ․ Հունիսի 4-ից Բանկը ներկայանում է «ԱյԴի Բանկ» ՓԲԸ անվանումով։
«ԱյԴի Բանկ»-ի առաքելությունն է հաճախորդների համար լինել առաջին ընտրության լավագույն նորարար Բանկ՝ հաճախորդներին տրամադրելով անհատական մոտեցմամբ արդիական թվային լուծումներ։ Բանկի մասին հավելյալ տեղեկատվության համար կարող եք այցելել Բանկի պաշտոնական կայքէջ :

title: Quality Improvement Specialist, Bilingual Required
description:
Job Title:

Quality Improvement Specialist – Bilingual Required

Company Background:

Community Action is a non-profit organization that provides critical services to low-income families in the areas of housing, homeless services, economic empowerment, family development, and early childhood care and education. Community Action leads the way to eliminate conditions of poverty and create opportunities for people in the Washington County area. Be the change you want!

Job Position Description:

We are seeking a dedicated Bilingual Quality Improvement Specialist to join our team in Washington County. In this role, you'll be a mentor, a coach, and a strategist for early educators. You will play a pivotal role in increasing the quality of care for children and families by providing technical assistance, professional development, and hands-on support to family- and center-based child care programs.

Abbreviated Duties List:

  • Support educators in meeting licensing requirements and Spark standards while fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Provide one-on-one consultation and mentorship to early learning professionals, helping them navigate Spark standards and the Oregon Registry.
  • Develop and deliver high-quality trainings (aligned with the Oregon Registry) and conduct entry-point trainings like IRFCC Part 2.
  • Help small business child care owners strengthen their operations through technology, shared services, and grant applications.
  • Apply the Oregon Equity Lens and NAEYC Code of Ethical Conduct to all community interactions and program supports.
  • Maintain accurate records in partner databases (ORO, CCRISP, DHS Citrix, Find Child Care Oregon, etc.) and assist with state and local reporting.

Abbreviated Requirements:

  • Bilingual Requirement: Required to be fully bilingual (verbal and written) in English/Spanish.
  • Minimum of a Bachelor's Degree in Early Childhood Education or related field (Child Development, Human Development, Elementary Education, Human Ecology, Home Economics, Family and Consumer Studies, Child and Family Studies, Education and Special Education) or ability to achieve a Step 10 on the Oregon Registry within 12 months of hire date.
  • At least 2 years of experience in early childhood or youth development programs.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and experience managing databases (manipulating data/running reports).
  • Demonstrated understanding of systemic racism and inequity, with a commitment to addressing these issues in early learning.
  • Requires a valid Oregon driver's license, proof of auto insurance for a private vehicle, and access to reliable transportation.
  • Enrollment in the Oregon Central Background Registry (CBR) is required before hire.

What Will Make You Stand Out:

  • Experience owning and operating a family care business or child care center.
  • Familiarity with assessment tools: CLASS, ERS, ASQ/ASQ-SE, or Teaching Strategies Gold.
  • Orgon Registry Master Trainer Certification.
  • 2+ years of experience in technical assistance, home visits, or classroom observations.

*Pay is determined by education and/or Oregon Step Registry.

Top Benefits or Perks:

  • Comprehensive insurance benefits, including free dental and 90% of your medical premiums covered by the employer for single coverage plans
  • Bilingual Pay Program
  • 403(b) Retirement Plan with 3% employer match
  • Generous time off benefits with paid vacation, paid sick days, and 13 holidays!

How to Apply: Apply online directly at . The full job description and additional job details can be found there. Physical applications are also accepted at any of our Multi-Service Center locations.

title: Foreman, Highway Maintenance Operations
description:
LaPrairie Works Inc., a member of LaPrairie Group of Companies, is an ISO-9001-2015 certified company providing highway and bridge maintenance, civil infrastructure construction, slope stabilization, erosion and drainage control, and environmental remediation services across Western Canada. We are proud to be formally recognized with industry and ministerial awards for innovation and environmental stewardship, while managing long-term contracts within both provincial and federal jurisdictions.

We are in search of a Foreman, Highway Maintenance Operations to lead our highway maintenance operations our High Prairie, AB shop.

The Foreman, Highway Maintenance Operations, under the direction of the Superintendent, will oversee staff and the proper allocation of resources to ensure work is being performed according to contract. The Foreman, Highway Maintenance Operations, must possess proven knowledge of Provincial transportation specifications, experience in the highway maintenance industry and be prepared to reside within a 30-minute commute to the operational center they oversee.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Promote and monitor compliance with required legislation, including safe operation of equipment, National Safety Code, and Occupational Health and Safety regulations.
  • Promote company policies, procedures, and ethical standards and implement measures to ensure employee compliance.
  • Oversee operations to ensure that work is being performed according to established performance criteria.
  • Facilitate employee training, to meet LaPrairie program objectives and legislative requirements.
  • Monitor employee performance using practical targets that are consistent with company goals.
  • Coordinate activities effectively by allocating resources, scheduling work assignments, setting priorities, and delegating work accordingly.
  • Ensure procedures for equipment inspection and preventative maintenance of vehicles are followed.
  • Review road condition reports and track performance.
  • Assess team performance and identify areas for continuous improvement.
  • Ensure that safe work practices are being promoted and followed.
  • Perform other duties as required.

Required Skills:

  • Three years of experience in a management role and five years of experience in the Highway Maintenance industry.
  • Valid Class 1 or 3 Drivers License and clean record.
  • Proven experience with resource management.
  • Sound analytical thinking, planning, prioritization, and execution skills.
  • Ability to delegate, set expectations, and monitor progress of direct reports.
  • Strong verbal and written communication.

LaPrairie Works Inc. provides Industry-leading compensation and benefits, professional training, and development opportunities and all within a supportive, dynamic, and proactive work environment.

Interested candidates are invited to submit their application, including a resume and cover letter. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further steps in the selection process

title: Bridal Stylist
description:
Are you passionate about weddings, fashion, and helping others feel confident and celebrated? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, team-driven environment where every day brings the opportunity to make someone's dreams come true?


Luv Bridal is looking for an enthusiastic and customer-focused Bridal Stylist(s) to join our Denver showroom. This is a unique opportunity to be a part of one of the most memorable days in a bride’s life while growing your career in the bridal and fashion industry.


We’re looking for someone who is outgoing, emotionally intelligent, detail-oriented, and genuinely loves working with people. Bridal experience is a plus, but not required—we’re more interested in your attitude, energy, and ability to connect with our brides.


What You’ll Do

As a Bridal Stylist, you’ll create unforgettable, meaningful moments for every bride by:

  • Providing one-on-one appointments tailored to each bride’s vision, style, and personality
  • Creating an exceptional experience from the moment a bride walks through the door
  • Recommending gowns and accessories based on the bride’s style, budget, and timeline
  • Building strong relationships with brides, their guests, and fellow team members
  • Meeting and exceeding individual and team sales goals
  • Supporting daily showroom operations including cleaning, merchandising, and restocking gowns/accessories
  • Handling emotional situations with empathy and professionalism


What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in customer service or retail sales (bridal or fashion preferred)
  • Passion for weddings, styling, and creating special moments
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Confidence in sales and the ability to meet goals
  • Ability to work weekends (required)
  • Team-player mentality with a strong work ethic and positive attitude
  • Emotionally aware, calm under pressure, and solution-oriented


Ready to Join the Luv Team?

We’d love to hear from you! Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter telling us why you’d be the perfect fit to guide brides through their journey at Luv Bridal.


About Us

Luv Bridal was founded with a mission to redefine the bridal shopping experience. We believe every bride deserves to feel confident, celebrated, and supported — and we’ve created an environment and service model that reflects that mission. Our modern showrooms offer a stress-free, inclusive space where brides can try on beautiful gowns in sizes 2–28, shop exclusive international designers like Madi Lane, Evie Young, Serene Amé, Pronovias, and more — and complete their look with hand-selected bridal accessories.


With locations in Phoenix, Tempe, Los Angeles, Orange County, San Diego, Rancho Cucamonga, Denver, Houston, and Fort Lauderdale, Luv Bridal is proud to be a growing leader in the bridal industry.


At LUV Bridal, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where every team member feels valued no matter where they are located. We believe in celebrating each other’s successes and lifting one another up, fostering growth both individually and as a team. Our diverse and collaborative culture drives innovation and enables us to provide an exceptional experience for our clients and brides around the world. LUV Bridal is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Product Analyst - Service
description:
This role is for one of Weekday’s clients

Location: Hyderabad
JobType: full-time

We are seeking an experienced Product Analyst – Service to support customer-facing and internal product initiatives across CRM, digital experiences, and automotive service operations. This role will work closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Design, and Operations to translate complex business and customer needs into clear requirements, actionable plans, and successful product outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines strong Product Analysis and Salesforce CRM expertise with an understanding of service operations and customer journeys. You should enjoy solving ambiguity, connecting systems, and helping cross-functional teams deliver effective solutions quickly.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Product & Delivery Execution

  • Partner with Product Managers to translate product strategy into PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements.
  • Support backlog refinement, sprint planning, prioritization, and dependency management within an Agile environment.
  • Clarify scope, business requirements, constraints, and success metrics to enable efficient execution.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure requirements are clear, complete, and implementation-ready.

Customer Experience & Service Journeys

  • Map and analyze end-to-end customer journeys across digital sales, ownership, and automotive service experiences.
  • Support initiatives involving:
    • Service scheduling and appointment management
    • Repair order lifecycle and status tracking
    • Roadside assistance
    • Service communications
    • Customer notifications through calls, SMS, email, and digital channels
  • Identify customer and operational pain points using journey mapping, feedback, data, and service insights.
  • Translate service operations requirements into practical product and system improvements.

Salesforce CRM & Systems Enablement

  • Support initiatives across Salesforce CRM, including Sales, Service Cloud, Revenue Cloud/CPQ, and related platforms.
  • Analyze existing workflows, configurations, processes, and data models to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Work with engineers, Salesforce administrators, vendors, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions.
  • Coordinate integration requirements across CRM, digital platforms, ERP, inventory, contact center, and service systems.

Data, Testing & Insights

  • Define and monitor KPIs related to customer experience, service performance, and operational effectiveness.
  • Support UAT planning, test case development, execution, and issue tracking.
  • Validate solutions against real-world business and service requirements.
  • Develop dashboards, reports, and analytical artifacts to provide actionable insights to product and operations leadership.

Modern Product Practices

  • Use AI-powered tools to accelerate requirements analysis, discovery, prototyping, documentation, and iteration.
  • Create journey maps, process flows, diagrams, wireframes, and lightweight prototypes to align stakeholders.
  • Maintain a practical, outcome-focused approach that emphasizes speed, clarity, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

  • 7–9 years of experience as a Product Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar role supporting digital products, CRM platforms, or enterprise systems.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM.
  • Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud or similar service-management platforms is highly desirable.
  • Proven ability to develop clear and structured requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to translate complex business and technical concepts for diverse stakeholders.
  • Experience managing multiple initiatives and workstreams in a fast-paced Agile environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Direct experience with automotive Fixed Operations (Fixed Ops) or automotive service environments.
  • Understanding of service scheduling, repair orders, technician workflows, dealer/OEM operations, parts, warranty, and customer care systems.
  • Experience with customer-facing web applications or digital commerce products.
  • Familiarity with integrations across CRM, ERP, inventory, POS, and contact-center platforms.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Figma, Lucidchart, or similar tools.
  • Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, CPQ, or Revenue Cloud.
  • Strong visual thinking and experience with process mapping, journey mapping, and prototyping.

What Success Looks Like

  • Converting complex service workflows into clear, actionable product requirements.
  • Helping product and engineering teams deliver solutions efficiently without unnecessary process.
  • Balancing customer experience, operational requirements, and technical feasibility.
  • Building strong collaboration across Product, Engineering, Design, and Operations.
  • Using modern technologies and AI-enabled tools to accelerate discovery and product delivery.

title: HR Operations Lead
description:

About Tickmill.

Tickmill is an award-winning, multiregulated broker offering access to a broad range of asset classes, including CFDs on Forex, Stocks, Indices, Commodities, Cryptocurrencies, and Bonds, as well as Exchange Traded Derivatives like Futures & Options.


Founded in 2014, the Tickmill Group employs over 330 professionals across offices in London, Cyprus, Poland, Estonia, Seychelles and several other locations worldwide.

Our culture is built on trust, transparency, and high standards. We bring together ambitious professionals who are looking for an environment that supports them to dominate in their fields.

Our diverse, multilingual teams are focused on innovation, delivering bold excellence, and raising the bar wherever we can.

We offer competitive benefits packages, frequent team initiatives, and opportunities for professional growth. Join the Tigers!


What does the role look like?
The HR Operations Lead is a senior, builder responsible for standing up and scaling the HR operations function across the organization. The role directly owns HR operations for the Cyprus office , service delivery, benefits, HRIS data, and compliance , while providing international coordination and oversight across Dubai, Poland, Uk and other
locations. Core focus areas include service delivery, documentation and compliance, benefits administration, data integrity and reporting, and process improvement. The role reports to the Group Head of HR and serves as the single point of accountability for HR operations being consistent, well-governed, and reliable across the Group.

Ideal Candidate:
A builder personality , driven, results-oriented, and tech-savvy, with a genuine interest in modernizing how HR work gets done, including through AI and automation. Comfortable owning execution directly in Cyprus while coordinating and holding the line internationally. Someone who can take a function from good to great and own the operational backbone end-to-end.

Key Responsibilities:
HR Operations Leadership & Service Delivery

  • Establish clear service delivery standards, ownership, and escalation paths across the function.
  • Own HR operations directly for the Cyprus office, while coordinating with local HR contacts and providers internationally to ensure consistent execution and compliance with the Group's ways of working; own specific processes or entities directly where needed.
  • Escalate risks, resourcing gaps, and data quality issues and report on operational status across the Group to the Head of HR (Group) on a regular cadence.

Documentation & Compliance

Benefits Administration

  • Track benefits spend and coverage by entity; identify and flag gaps or inconsistencies.
  • Support the annual benefits audit and the transition toward a unified, Group-wide benefits approach.

Data Integrity & Reporting

  • Own high standards for employee data and document accuracy and completeness across the HRIS, including maintaining a single contract and document warehouse with complete, audit-ready employee files.
  • Support HR audits and compliance by maintaining precise, up-to-date records.
  • Develop and monitor operational metrics and dashboards to track HR operations performance.

Process Improvement & Collaboration

  • Drive process transformation through standardization and automation.
  • Identify and implement improvements to HR operations workflows, documentation, and employee self-service, applying technology and automation — while maintaining privacy, governance, and human oversight.
  • Prepare and validate people-related inputs for payroll (new hires, leavers, changes, leave) ahead of each payroll cycle, in coordination with HR Operations.
  • Partner with Payroll, Benefits, and Finance on payroll exceptions, compensation and benefits documentation, and special HR projects as required.


What do you need to succeed in this role?

  • 6+ years of progressive experience in HR Operations, HRIS, People Operations, or a related HR function, preferably in a global environment.
  • Strong HRIS experience.
  • Strong analytical, auditing, dashboard management, and reporting skills, including experience creating recurring and ad hoc reports.
  • Understanding employment laws, HR compliance requirements, data security practices, and policy administration.
  • Strong knowledge of Cypriot labor law.
  • Experience with process design, workflow optimization, documentation, and continuous improvement within HR Operations.
  • High-level proficiency with Microsoft Office, especially Excel reporting.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects in a fast-paced environment.

title: Shipping & Receiving Specialist — Keep Precision Work Moving
description:
Shipping & Receiving Specialist — Keep Precision Work Moving

$21–$27/hour, depending on experience | Englewood, Colorado | Full-time, day shift

A precision-machined part can take weeks to produce, pass dozens of inspections and be worth thousands of dollars. But if it is packaged incorrectly, shipped without the right documentation or sent to the wrong location, none of that matters.



That is why Shipping & Receiving is such an important part of Reata Engineering.



You will be one of the first people to handle the material and components entering our facility—and one of the last people to see our finished parts before they reach customers in aerospace, defense, medical, semiconductor and industrial markets.



This isn’t simply a warehouse job. It is a role for someone who takes pride in accuracy, organization and making sure every detail is right.



Your role in the story

When material arrives, you’ll verify that we received what we ordered, in the correct quantity, with the documentation and traceability our customers require. As jobs move through production and outside processing, you’ll help ensure the right materials, parts and paperwork stay together. When a job is ready to ship, you’ll confirm the quantity, documents, packaging, labeling and destination before it leaves our facility. You are helping protect weeks of work and ensuring Reata keeps its promise to the customer.|



Find your next level at Reata

We are interested in candidates with different levels of shipping, receiving, warehouse and manufacturing experience.

  • If you are developing your skills, you may begin with receiving, labeling, material movement, packaging and carrier transactions while learning our systems and quality requirements.
  • If you are more experienced, you can take greater ownership of shipment documentation, material traceability, outside-processing coordination, freight arrangements, inventory accuracy and workflow improvement.



As your capabilities grow, there may also be opportunities to develop skills in inventory control, purchasing, planning, quality, production support or Shipping & Receiving leadership.



What you’ll help us accomplish

Depending on your experience, you may:

  • Receive raw material, purchased components and customer-supplied parts
  • Match incoming shipments to purchase orders and packing slips
  • Verify quantities, part numbers, material certifications and other required documents
  • Identify and communicate shortages, damage or documentation discrepancies
  • Label, organize and route material to the correct location
  • Maintain material identity, lot information and traceability
  • Stage materials, parts and paperwork for production and outside processing
  • Package precision-machined parts to prevent damage, contamination or cosmetic issues
  • Verify quantities, packing slips, certifications and shipping instructions
  • Process shipments through UPS, FedEx, freight and courier systems
  • Record receipts, movements and shipments accurately in our ERP system
  • Help maintain accurate inventory and an organized, professional work area
  • Look for ways to make material flow more accurate and efficient



You will not be expected to know every Reata process on your first day. You will be expected to care about accuracy, learn from mistakes and ask questions when something does not look right.



What you should bring

  • At least one year of experience in shipping, receiving, warehousing, inventory or a related production environment
  • Experience using computers and entering information accurately
  • Strong attention to part numbers, quantities, documents and special instructions
  • The ability to organize competing priorities without losing track of details
  • Clear communication when something is missing, damaged or inconsistent
  • Reliability and a willingness to help the team
  • The judgment to stop and ask rather than guess



Experience in precision manufacturing, aerospace, medical devices or another regulated environment is helpful, but not required. Experience with ERP systems, UPS or FedEx software, inventory control, material certifications, freight coordination or forklift operation is also valuable.



Why join Reata?

Reata manufactures complex parts that other machine shops often will not quote. Our work supports customers whose products depend on precision, reliability and traceability.



We offer:

  • Competitive pay with overtime opportunities
  • Medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Company-paid life insurance and long-term disability coverage
  • 401(k) with company match, including traditional and Roth options
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Tuition reimbursement, training and professional development
  • Opportunities to learn other areas of manufacturing and operations
  • A technology-driven environment using modern manufacturing and ERP systems
  • A team-oriented workplace where people solve problems together



Let’s talk

If you are the person who notices when a quantity is off, a document is missing or a label does not match, we want to hear from you.
Apply and tell us about:

  • Your shipping, receiving, inventory or warehouse experience
  • The computer, ERP or carrier systems you have used
  • The types of products or materials you have handled
  • What you do when the paperwork and the physical shipment do not agree



At Reata, accuracy in Shipping & Receiving is not an administrative detail. It is part of how we deliver quality.



Reata Engineering & Machine Works is an equal opportunity employer. Employment is contingent upon applicable pre-employment screening. In compliance with Colorado law, the compensation range for this position is $21–$27 per hour. Final compensation will be based on qualifications, skills, education and experience.

title: Refining Engineer - Process Control Systems
description:
An exciting career awaits you


At MPC, we’re committed to being a great place to work – one that welcomes new ideas, encourages diverse perspectives, develops our people, and fosters a collaborative team environment.

POSITION SUMMARY:

Marathon Petroleum Company's Galveston Bay Refinery in Texas City, TX currently has a vacancy for a Process Control Engineer.

The Process Control Engineer will be providing operating unit support and ensuring optimal system performance of the site’s Controls Systems. Additional duties include Controls systems lifecycle management, systems improvement, and optimization. They will ensure reliability and function of process control systems and applications. This includes confirming that data and work processes are kept up to date and applications/hardware are running as intended.

The Process Control Engineer will collaborate with partners and customers to communicate, schedule, and execute updates. They also document, communicate, provide training, and work through issues, changes, notices, and impacts to customers.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Hardware and Software

  • Monitor System performance, evaluate and act on system alarms to correct problems.

  • Develop and maintain Preventative Maintenance (PM) procedures for equipment and maintain completed documentation.

  • Coordinate third party contractors and vendor work on equipment.

  • Lead for Management of Change (MOC) on system hardware and software changes.

  • Own system failure metrics (hardware and software), update problem reporting database.

  • Coordinate risk reduction efforts to improve system reliability and availability

  • Project support Lead for hardware refreshes and perform software version updates.

  • Develop multi-year plan for system migrations.

  • Troubleshoot and devise solutions for Controls system issues.

  • Create SAP requisitions for purchases.

Process Control Management

  • Maintain Process Control Key (security) database.

  • Update data historian.

  • Trained in site incident investigation management tool.

  • Lead hardware related incident investigations.

  • Participate in incident investigations for assigned units as requested.

Small and Large CAPEX Project Roles

  • Participate in project design, FAT, SAT, and implementation of new hardware/software.

  • Lead for design, testing and implementation of changes to existing or new hardware/software.

Application Support

  • Provide ongoing technical support for applications and software to Operations and Process Control.

  • Improve work practices to streamline data to the end user and minimize user error or systems customization.

  • Provide application training for Process Control and develop materials for Operator training.

  • Monitor and evaluate applications & system performance; recommend actions to bring performance to acceptable levels, including evaluating emerging technologies and 3rd party applications.

  • Coordinate with vendors and customers on application changes, including patching and upgrades.

  • Understand and communicate software version changes and impact to users, including vendor product alerts and notification.

  • Develop site specific standards for applications.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Chemical, Electrical, Mechanical, or Computer Engineering required ). (Education must be obtained/completed prior to start date)

  • Zero (0) years or more of experience in process control engineering within refining, petrochemical, or related industries required.

  • Self-motivated with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent communication skills (written & verbal), and strong collaboration skills.

  • Ability to work extended hours, on occasion, including nights and weekends in process operations environment and during periods of inclement weather.

  • Ability to access areas of the refinery requiring use of stairs and/or ladders to inspect equipment.

  • Ability to maintain on-call status and respond to emergencies as necessary during off-hours.

  • Ability to travel up to 10%.

  • A valid Driver’s License is required upon hire.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE/SKILLS:

  • Five (5) years or more working with an Industrial Control System on a process control, instrument/electrical, or an Operations Technology team within a refining/petrochemical plant or similar manufacturing environment.
  • Distributed Control Systems (DCS)
  • Honeywell: Experion & TPS/TDC,
  • Emerson: Ovation, DeltaV
  • GE: Mark VI
  • PLC Maintenance, Logic, Troubleshooting, Communications
  • Safety Instrumented System (SIS) Maintenance (Triconex), Troubleshooting, Communications
  • Controls systems asset management – ex. PAS Integrity/DOC4000
  • Historian Applications: Honeywell PHD / OSI Soft Pi System

title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow
location: UBC Vancouver Campus - Vancouver, BC, Canada
description:
Academic

Job Category

Faculty Non Bargaining

Job Title

Postdoctoral Research Fellow

Department

Quandt Laboratory | Department of Pathology and Laboratory Medicine | Faculty of Medicine (Jacqueline Quandt)

Posting End Date

September 25, 2026

Note: Applications will be accepted until 11:59 PM on the Posting End Date.



Job End Date

September 30, 2027

The expected salary range for this position is $55,000-$65,000 per annum.

At UBC, we believe that attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce is key to the successful pursuit of excellence in research, innovation, and learning for all faculty, staff and students. Our commitment to employment equity helps achieve inclusion and fairness, brings rich diversity to UBC as a workplace, and creates the necessary conditions for a rewarding career. ​​​​​​


The Quandt Laboratory at the University of British Columbia is seeking a highly motivated Postdoctoral Fellow to lead an independent research project investigating mechanisms of inflammation, tissue injury, and repair in multiple sclerosis (MS) and related neuroinflammatory conditions.

The Postdoctoral Fellow will be a key scientific leader within the Quandt Laboratory and will report directly to Dr. Jacqueline Quandt, Associate Professor, Department of Pathology & Laboratory Medicine, University of British Columbia.

The successful candidate will join a collaborative and translational research environment focused on understanding how innate immune cells contribute to disease progression and recovery within the central nervous system. A major goal of the position is to develop new mechanistic insights into pathways that regulate myelin damage and repair, with the potential to inform future therapeutic strategies for MS. The project will focus heavily on how a mutation in a cholesterol transporter—identified in families with severe, progressive Multiple Sclerosis (MS)—impacts inflammatory demyelination, tissue injury, and repair. Strong applicants should demonstrate a passion for neuroimmunology and CNS disease, a proven record of research productivity, strong scientific rigor and work ethic, and evidence of creativity, initiative, and scientific independence. The ideal candidate will be excited to develop and lead a research program while working collaboratively with trainees and team members across disciplines.

The Department of Pathology and Laboratory Medicine at UBC is a hybrid, academically intensive Department within the UBC Faculty of Medicine whose activities span a broad spectrum of teaching, research, and academic service, often performed in the milieu of clinical practice, and are ultimately devoted to improving the care, treatment, and well-being of patients. The Department offers academic degrees at the bachelor’s (Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Science (BMLSc)) and graduate (MSc, PhD) levels with the graduate program, one of the largest in the Faculty of Medicine, which has been recognized by UBC for its quality. The Department plays a major role in the MD undergraduate program and offers an accredited residency-training program. Faculty members participate across a spectrum of research from basic investigative to translational to clinical applied research and are recognized locally, nationally and internationally for their excellence.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Reporting to Dr. Quandt, the incumbent will be responsible for:

  • Leading an independent research project investigating mechanisms of neuroinflammation, myelin injury, and repair in experimental models of multiple sclerosis.
  • Designing, implementing, troubleshooting, and optimizing experimental approaches.
  • Developing and executing studies utilizing transgenic mouse models relevant to MS pathogenesis and recovery.
  • Performing and overseeing cellular and molecular studies involving macrophages, microglia, and other CNS-resident or infiltrating immune cells.
  • Conducting and interpreting experiments involving phagocytosis assays, immunohistochemistry, microscopy, flow cytometry, and molecular analyses as appropriate.
  • Analyzing, interpreting, and communicating complex datasets.
  • Preparing manuscripts for publication and contribute to grant applications and research reports.
  • Presenting research findings at laboratory meetings, departmental seminars, and national and international scientific conferences.
  • Mentoring graduate students, undergraduate trainees, research assistants, and summer students.
  • Contributing to the development of new research directions and collaborative initiatives within the laboratory.
  • Collaborating with academic, clinical, and industry partners as appropriate.

QUALIFICATIONS

Successful applicants will have:

  • PhD in neuroscience, immunology, pathology, cell biology, molecular biology, biomedical sciences, or a related field.
  • Strong record of peer-reviewed publications and research productivity relative to career stage.
  • Demonstrated expertise in neuroimmunology, immunology, neuroscience, or related biomedical disciplines.
  • Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable:
    • Mouse models of neuroinflammatory and demyelinating disease;
    • Macrophage and/or microglial biology;
    • Flow cytometry;
    • Immunohistochemistry and microscopy;
    • Cellular and molecular biology techniques;
    • Transcriptomic or systems biology approaches.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently design and execute research projects.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and work with minimal supervision.
  • Proven ability to work both independently and within a collaborative, interdisciplinary research environment.
  • Commitment to scientific rigor, reproducibility, and mentorship.
  • Willingness to respect diverse perspectives, including perspectives in conflict with one’s own.
  • Demonstrates a commitment to enhancing one’s own awareness, knowledge, and skills related to equity, diversity, and inclusion.

The expected salary for this position is $55,000-$65,000 per annum. The Faculty of Medicine is committed to offering equitable and competitive salaries, commensurate with the qualifications and experience of the candidate.

APPLICATION PROCEDURE

An application package should include:

  • A letter of application outlining the applicant’s research and teaching interests;
  • A detailed curriculum vitae outlining foundational and technical training and proficiency;
  • Contact information for 3 referees

Applications should be submitted to:

Jacqueline Quandt

Associate Professor

UBC Pathology & Laboratory Medicine

Subject: PDF in Neuroinflammation

Email: jquandt@pathology.ubc.ca


Should you have any queries around this position, please contact Jacqueline Quandt at jquandt@pathology.ubc.ca

Review of applications will begin immediately and continue until the position is filled. The anticipated start date for this position is October 2026 or upon a date to be mutually agreed.

title: Mountain Dispatch Specialist - Winter 2026/27
description:
Location: Bend, Oregon

Are you interested in delivering memorable experiences, enhancing people's lives and having fun while doing it? This shared mission of POWDR and Mt. Bachelor creates a fun and inspiring culture that we live every day. We look for employees who are passionate about sharing mountain culture, have a positive attitude, are problem solvers and care about winning as a team. Our vision drives us to deliver exceptional experiences and it's our employees who become the true moment makers here at Mt. Bachelor.


This role comes with amazing perks & benefits because we want our employees to Work Where You Play!


  • Free employee season pass and free or discounted dependent(s) season pass
  • Free and discounted friends & family day passes
  • Free transportation to & from Bend, Sunriver, and La Pine
  • Discounts across the resort (food & beverage, retail, rentals, lessons & more)
  • Winter season employee housing program & Summer season camping program
  • 401k with up to 5% company match & immediate vesting
  • Discounted daycare onsite at Mt. Bachelor
  • Local & national discounts (YETI, Burton, Dell, Subaru, Nokian, Sunriver Golf, Mammut, & more)
  • Free reciprocal access for employees to other POWDR resorts & 50% day passes at IKON pass resorts

The schedule for this position is 3 or 4 days per week, 6:30am to 4:30pm, no flexibility on hours, must be in office. Starting end of April, the hours are reduced to 6:30am - 2:00pm.

Position Summary

The Mountain Dispatch Specialist is an ideal job for anyone who wants to learn about ski area operations. The successful candidate will collect and communicate Mt. Bachelor operations data to internal teams and external guests. This entails documenting and following up on matters related to weather, lift operations, grooming, and snow reporting. An ideal candidate will be detail-oriented, well-organized, and reliable. Depending on shift assignments, work may begin as early as 6:00 a.m. and conclude as late as 4:30 p.m. About 10% of the job is outdoors in any weather conditions, with the remaining 90% being indoors. This is a seasonal position that will start in mid-November and conclude in late May.

Essential Functions/Major Responsibilities:

Communication of Operational Status and Snow Conditions – 40%

  • Document the ski area’s snowfall.

  • Gather information from on-mountain weather stations, online weather forecast sites, from grooming, ski patrol, lift operations and lift maintenance departments.

  • Distribute weather/snow condition and operational status updates via e-mails, websites, electronic signage boards and hard-copy prints – in a manner that is factual and honest.

  • Accurately assess weather/snow conditions.

Data Documentation – 20%

  • Maintain file of weather/snow observations, grooming reports, and terrain park logs.

  • Maintain file of lift openings, closings, and downtime.

  • Maintain file(s) of other items as requested.

Radio and Phone Dispatch – 40%

  • Act as the central communications and dispatch hub for the ski area by monitoring radio and phones, responding to requests, and executing action plans that follow established procedures.

  • Provide back-up support to Ski Patrol Dispatch during emergency situations.

Secondary Function

  • Occasionally assume Ski Patrol Dispatch duties as requested by the Communications & Community Relations Manager & Patrol Director during irregular or emergency situations when a Ski Patrol staff member is unavailable.

  • Assist the Communications & Community Relations Manager and/or Marketing department with various tasks.

Job Scope

This job operates within parameters established in the Essential Functions/Major Responsibilities description above. Position will not hold any decision-making authority beyond the daily decisions required by the position itself. Consequences for errors related to Essential Functions/Major Responsibilities will result in discipline as outlined in the company handbook.

Interpersonal Contacts

Internal interaction with office staff from multiple departments. The Communications & Community Relations Manager will be the direct report. The position will also interact with any/all staff members through radio/phone dispatch duties.

Specific Job Skills

  • License/Certifications: None

  • Technical: Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Outlook is essential; basic knowledge of document scanning, and experience in working on website platforms for updates is preferred.

  • Physical Capabilities: Able to lift 25lbs, walk through deep snow or slippery surfaces in extreme winter weather conditions.

  • Additional: Strong verbal and written communication skills, punctuality, enthusiasm towards working very early in the morning, stamina to work long days, familiarity with the layout of Mt. Bachelor, curiosity about weather and its impact on ski area operations, and passion for winter sports.

Education/Related Experience

  • Minimum education required: High School Diploma or equivalent.

  • Minimum time in related position: Some experience preferred in a communications-focused position, such as a dispatcher, call center representative, or other similar position is preferred.

Current Hiring Rate: $18/hr

Minimum Age Requirement: 18+

Bachelor is committed to creating a quality work environment which makes full use of the talents and contributions of all employees without regard to race, color, religion, national origin or citizenship status, sex, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, disability or military status.

title: Cloud Administrator | Administrateur·rice infonuagique
description:
Company Overview
Jesta I.S. is a leading supplier of ERP software for the apparel, footwear, and soft-goods industries. Our global client base includes many recognizable brands and continues to grow. We are seeking a Cloud Administrator to join our IT team in Montreal.


Position Summary

We are looking for a Cloud Administrator to join our IT team in Montreal. The role focuses primarily on AWS, with growing responsibilities in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

You will administer, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain cloud environments supporting internal and client operations. You will work across cloud infrastructure, networking, security, Infrastructure-as-Code, monitoring, containerized workloads, data services, and cloud-hosted applications.

This is a hands-on operational role focused on keeping cloud environments secure, reliable, scalable, cost-effective, and well documented, while collaborating closely with technical teams across the organization.


Responsibilities

    Cloud Administration & Operations

    • Administer, monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot AWS and OCI environments.
    • Support cloud compute, storage, networking, databases, security, and monitoring services.
    • Resolve operational, deployment, access, and performance issues.
    • Perform maintenance, upgrades, migrations, and deployments.

    Client Cloud Deployment & Support

    • Deploy and configure AWS and OCI environments for new clients following established standards.
    • Support client onboarding, validation, and environment handover.
    • Troubleshoot client environment issues and coordinate with technical teams.
    • Maintain accurate environment and configuration documentation.

    Infrastructure-as-Code & Automation

    • Maintain Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform and support automated deployments.
    • Automate cloud configuration and administrative tasks using Python, Bash, and/or PowerShell.
    • Support CI/CD processes and collaborate with DevOps and Development teams.

    Containers, Monitoring & Incident Support

    • Support Docker and containerized workloads and troubleshoot infrastructure-level issues.
    • Monitor cloud services, logs, performance, and availability using CloudWatch and OCI tools.
    • Investigate incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.

    Cloud Data Services & Networking

    • Support cloud data services such as S3, Lambda, DMS, Glue, Athena, and RDS.
    • Administer and troubleshoot VPCs, VCNs, subnets, routing, security groups, DNS, and VPN connectivity.
    • Collaborate with technical teams to resolve connectivity and data-service issues.

    Security & Continuous Improvement

    • Administer AWS and OCI IAM and access controls using least-privilege principles.
    • Support security, encryption, vulnerability remediation, and compliance requirements.
    • Maintain technical documentation and recommend improvements to reliability, security, automation, and cost efficiency.


    Qualifications

    Technical Experience

    • 3-5+ years of hands-on experience in cloud, infrastructure, or systems administration, including strong AWS administration experience.
    • Experience administering and troubleshooting AWS environments, including CloudWatch, IAM, VPC, S3, Lambda, DMS, Glue, Athena, RDS, and related services.
    • Experience or working knowledge of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), with the ability and willingness to further develop OCI expertise.
    • Practical experience with Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code.
    • Experience supporting Docker or containerized workloads.
    • Working knowledge of cloud networking, including VPCs, VCNs, subnets, routing, security groups, gateways, DNS, and VPN connectivity.
    • Ability to troubleshoot cloud services, deployments, access issues, networking, performance, logs, and operational incidents.
    • Scripting experience with Python, Bash, and/or PowerShell.
    • General understanding of CI/CD processes and cloud security practices, including IAM, least privilege, encryption, logging, and secrets management.
    • Experience supporting multiple cloud or client environments is an asset.

    Education & Certifications

    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent education and professional experience.
    • AWS and/or OCI certifications are considered an asset.

    Skills & Abilities

    • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
    • Clear communication and strong documentation skills.
    • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical teams.
    • Strong organization and ability to manage priorities across multiple environments.
    • Continuous improvement mindset with strong ownership and accountability.


    Additional Information

    • This is a hybrid role, 2 days working in the office in Montreal, QC is required.
    • We thank all applicants for their interest. However, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.


    --------------------

    Présentation de l’entreprise

    Jesta I.S. est un fournisseur de premier plan de logiciels ERP pour les industries de l’habillement, de la chaussure et des biens de consommation. Notre clientèle mondiale comprend de nombreuses marques reconnues et ne cesse de croître. Nous recherchons un·e administrateur·trice infonuagique pour joindre l’équipe TI à Montréal.


    Résumé du poste

    Nous sommes à la recherche d’un·e Administrateur·rice infonuagique pour se joindre à notre équipe TI à Montréal. Le rôle est principalement axé sur AWS, avec des responsabilités croissantes liées à Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

    Vous serez responsable d’administrer, de surveiller, de dépanner et de maintenir des environnements infonuagiques qui soutiennent nos opérations internes et celles de notre clientèle. Vous travaillerez notamment sur l’infrastructure infonuagique, les réseaux, la sécurité, l’Infrastructure-as-Code, la surveillance, les environnements conteneurisés, les services de données et les applications hébergées dans le cloud.

    Il s’agit d’un rôle opérationnel et pratique visant à assurer des environnements infonuagiques sécurisés, fiables, évolutifs, rentables et bien documentés, en collaboration avec différentes équipes techniques.


    Responsabilités

    Administration et opérations infonuagiques

    • Administrer, surveiller, maintenir et dépanner les environnements AWS et OCI.
    • Soutenir les services de calcul, stockage, réseaux, bases de données, sécurité et surveillance.
    • Résoudre les problèmes opérationnels, de déploiement, d’accès et de performance.
    • Effectuer les activités de maintenance, mise à niveau, migration et déploiement.

    Déploiement et soutien des environnements clients

    • Déployer et configurer les environnements AWS et OCI selon les normes établies.
    • Soutenir l’intégration, la validation et le transfert des environnements clients.
    • Diagnostiquer les problèmes et collaborer avec les équipes techniques concernées.
    • Maintenir une documentation à jour des environnements et configurations.

    Infrastructure-as-Code et automatisation

    • Maintenir l’Infrastructure-as-Code avec Terraform et soutenir les déploiements automatisés.
    • Automatiser les configurations et tâches administratives avec Python, Bash et/ou PowerShell.
    • Soutenir les processus CI/CD et collaborer avec les équipes DevOps et de développement.

    Conteneurs, surveillance et incidents

    • Soutenir les charges Docker et conteneurisées et résoudre les problèmes d’infrastructure.
    • Surveiller les services, journaux, performances et disponibilités avec CloudWatch et les outils OCI.
    • Diagnostiquer les incidents, effectuer les analyses de causes fondamentales et mettre en place des correctifs.

    Services de données et réseaux

    • Soutenir les services de données infonuagiques tels que S3, Lambda, DMS, Glue, Athena et RDS.
    • Administrer et dépanner les VPC, VCN, sous-réseaux, routage, groupes de sécurité, DNS et VPN.
    • Collaborer avec les équipes techniques pour résoudre les problèmes de connectivité et de services de données.

    Sécurité et amélioration continue

    • Administrer les accès IAM AWS et OCI selon le principe du moindre privilège.
    • Soutenir la sécurité, le chiffrement, la correction des vulnérabilités et les exigences de conformité.
    • Maintenir la documentation technique et recommander des améliorations en matière de fiabilité, sécurité, automatisation et coûts.


    Qualifications

    Expérience technique

    • 3-5+ ans d’expérience pratique en administration infonuagique, infrastructure ou systèmes, dont une solide expérience avec AWS.
    • Expérience en administration et dépannage d’environnements AWS, notamment CloudWatch, IAM, VPC, S3, Lambda, DMS, Glue, Athena, RDS et services connexes.
    • Expérience ou connaissances pratiques d’Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), avec la capacité et l’intérêt de développer davantage cette expertise.
    • Expérience pratique avec Terraform et l’Infrastructure-as-Code.
    • Expérience avec Docker ou les charges de travail conteneurisées.
    • Bonne connaissance des réseaux infonuagiques : VPC, VCN, sous-réseaux, routage, groupes de sécurité, passerelles, DNS et VPN.
    • Capacité à diagnostiquer des problèmes liés aux services cloud, aux déploiements, aux accès, aux réseaux, à la performance, aux journaux et aux incidents opérationnels.
    • Expérience en scripting avec Python, Bash et/ou PowerShell.
    • Bonne compréhension des processus CI/CD et des pratiques de sécurité infonuagique, notamment IAM, moindre privilège, chiffrement, journalisation et gestion des secrets.
    • Expérience avec plusieurs environnements infonuagiques ou environnements clients, un atout.

    Formation et certifications

    • Baccalauréat en informatique, technologies de l’information, génie ou domaine connexe, ou combinaison équivalente de formation et d’expérience professionnelle.
    • Certifications AWS et/ou OCI, un atout.

    Compétences et aptitudes

    • Excellentes capacités de dépannage, d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
    • Bonnes aptitudes en communication et en documentation.
    • Capacité à collaborer efficacement avec des équipes techniques et non techniques.
    • Bon sens de l’organisation et capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités et environnements.
    • Esprit d’amélioration continue, sens des responsabilités et grande autonomie.


        Informations supplémentaires

        • Ce poste est hybride : 2 jours par semaine au bureau à Montréal sont requis.
        • Nous remercions toutes les personnes candidateant pour leur intérêt; seules les personnes sélectionnées pour une entrevue seront contactées.

title: Editorial Content Lead/Writer
description:
The Azrieli Foundation is one of the largest public philanthropic foundations in Canada, supporting initiatives in education, science & healthcare, research and the arts across Canada and Israel. Through innovative and strategic philanthropy, we work to open doors, break new ground and nurture networks – helping people of all faiths, ages, backgrounds and abilities reach their full potential and drive positive change in their communities.

We are seeking an Editorial Content Lead/Writer to join our dynamic and collaborative Communications team.

Position Summary:

The Editorial Content Lead/Writer serves as the Foundation's lead writer and editorial strategist and storyteller, advancing the Foundation's charitable objectives and strategic priorities through impactful, audience-centered communications. The role translates complex issues, research, grant outcomes and organizational impact into compelling narratives that strengthen understanding of the Foundation's work, amplify key initiatives, support thought leadership and foster meaningful engagement with grantees, collaborators, beneficiaries and other key stakeholders.

Core Responsibilities:

Editorial Leadership & Storytelling

  • Serve as the Foundation's lead writer, editor and storytelling specialist.
  • Contribute to a strategic editorial calendar aligned with organizational priorities, initiatives and campaigns.
  • Build and maintain a cross-departmental Story Bank, identifying and capturing stories from grantees, beneficiaries, researchers, collaborators and internal stakeholders that demonstrate the Foundation’s mission, vision and wide-reaching impact.
  • Translate complex ideas, grant outcomes, research findings and impact data into engaging and accessible content for diverse audiences.

Writing & Content Development

  • Produce high-quality long- and short-form content across multiple channels and formats, including: impact stories, newsletter & website content, campaign materials, video scripts, internal communications, etc.
  • Draft speeches, presentations, key messages, talking points and correspondence for senior leaders.
  • Support the development of opinion editorials, commentary pieces and thought leadership articles.
  • Assist with media relations through the development of media materials, backgrounders, spokesperson briefs and key messages.

Editorial Standards & Quality Control

  • Maintain brand and editorial standards and content best practices.
  • Ensure consistency of voice, tone, language and messaging across all communications.
  • Act as the Foundation's primary editor and proofreader for major communications materials.
  • Review content for clarity, accuracy, accessibility and audience relevance.

Brand Narrative & Organizational Positioning

  • Help shape and evolve the Foundation's organizational narrative and messaging framework.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen the Foundation's profile through strategic storytelling and content development.
  • Ensure editorial content aligns with organizational priorities, mission and values.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Sr. Communications Specialist, Impact Storytelling and Recognition, to identify and develop grantee, program and impact stories.
  • Partner with the Digital Communications Specialist to optimize content for digital platforms and support digital content strategy.
  • Collaborate with program teams, Foundation leadership and external partners to gather content and develop stories.
  • Support communications activities related to major announcements, campaigns, events and strategic initiatives.

Multimedia & Event Support

  • Support video production development, including story development, scripting and spokesperson preparation.
  • Contribute editorial expertise to multimedia projects, including podcast, video, etc.
  • Support Foundation events, publications, special initiatives as required.

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in editorial content development, journalism, communications, publishing or related fields.
  • Passionate storyteller with exceptional writing and editing abilities; strong editorial judgment and attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated experience translating complex subject matter into engaging and accessible content, conducting interviews and developing human-centred impact stories.
  • Experience supporting executive communications and thought leadership initiatives
  • Familiarity with digital content strategies and multi-channel content distribution.
  • Experience in the nonprofit, philanthropic, research, education, healthcare or public sectors is an asset.
  • Proficiency in French and/or Hebrew is also considered an asset.

Required Skills:

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Trustworthy, reliable and can exercise discretion and tact in difficult or confidential situations.
  • A team player with strong interpersonal skills who can collaborate effectively with key stakeholders and leadership.
  • Calm under pressure and can adapt quickly to changing priorities and circumstances.
  • Outstanding people skills, with the ability to interact with diverse groups and individuals, both internally and externally.
  • A self-starter with a creative mindset and problem-solving capabilities, able to work independently and proactively.

Additional Information:

  • This role may require flexible hours to support events and initiatives.
  • Limited travel may also be required.
  • The Azrieli Foundation is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

Our Values

Inspired by Jewish values – including Tikkun Olam, the responsibility to repair the world - and the vision and resilience of our founder, David J. Azrieli z”l, the mission of Azrieli philanthropy is to improve the lives of present and future generations through Education, Research, Healthcare and the Arts both in Canada and Israel.

Our values are the bedrock of our culture. They shape how we work, how we collaborate and how we make decisions—every single day. Those who succeed at the Azrieli Foundation exemplify the core principles of:

  • Integrity & respect
  • Taking on big challenges
  • Excellence
  • Passion for making a difference
  • Results-oriented mindset
  • Sustainable impact

Inclusivity and Accessibility

Living our values means creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, supported and empowered to contribute. Our commitment to equity, diversity and inclusion is one way we put those values into practice.

We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and value diverse backgrounds, abilities and ways of thinking. Diversity and inclusion make our organization strong, productive and innovative. Applicants with lived experience who identify as neurodivergent are strongly encouraged to apply.

We are committed to creating inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection processes. If you require an accommodation during the application or recruitment process, please reach out to HR@azrielifoundation.org.
