title: Global Director of Ecommerce
description:
The Role

We are looking for an outstanding Global Director of Ecommerce to join Hårklinikken as we enter the next phase of our global growth journey.


As Global Director of Ecommerce, you will lead Hårklinikken’s global digital business, owning the ecommerce P&L, paid media spend and third-party e-tailers.


You will have commercial ownership of our digital ecosystem across markets – including six Shopify websites, paid media, affiliate marketing, CRM, loyalty and retention initiatives – and will be responsible for driving profitable growth across key ecommerce KPIs, including traffic, customer acquisition, conversion, AOV, retention, LTV, CAC and profitability.


The role has a global remit, with the US being a particularly important growth market, and requires a strong commercial profile who combines strategic thinking with a willingness to get into the details and make things happen. Speed and a strong bias towards action are important: we are looking for someone who can identify opportunities, make informed decisions and move quickly from strategy to execution without compromising on quality.


Hårklinikken is a true omnichannel business. Our clients get to know us through paid media, after which they may visit one of our clinics, either in person or virtually, to initiate their treatment. Throughout the treatment journey, our CRM and webshop serve as important drivers of retention and additional purchases. This only works when our clinics and digital business operate seamlessly together.


In this role, you will use an analytical and data-driven approach to inform decisions, optimise the customer journey and identify new growth opportunities. You will combine this analytical mindset with commercial creativity and an obsession with serving consumers better. We are looking for someone with a proven track record of scaling ecommerce businesses efficiently and profitably, while maintaining a strong focus on brand, customer experience and long-term value.


Primary Relationships

You will work closely with the CEO, Chief of Staff, CFO and other senior business and functional leads.


You will also collaborate closely with the wider Brand & Marketing team, including Creative, Content, PR and Social, to ensure our commercial and brand strategies work seamlessly together.


Externally, you will lead relationships with key digital partners, including website development, technology, CRM and paid media agencies.


Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, develop and mentor the ecommerce and digital team.
  • Lead by example, promoting professionalism, accountability, curiosity and a strong sense of ownership.
  • Foster a culture of testing, learning and continuous optimisation to keep Hårklinikken ahead of ecommerce trends and best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with business and functional leads to identify and execute initiatives that drive profitable growth across digital channels and markets.


Ecommerce, Trading & Digital Growth

  • Own the P&L for Hårklinikken’s global ecommerce business and drive profitable and sustainable growth across markets.
  • Own the commercial trading performance of six Shopify websites, continuously optimising acquisition, conversion, AOV, retention, LTV, CAC and profitability.
  • Lead the global performance marketing strategy across paid media, affiliate and other acquisition channels, with a strong focus on efficient new customer acquisition and profitable growth.
  • Develop and manage CRO roadmaps, continually identifying opportunities across the funnel, channels, markets and product portfolio.
  • Use data and customer insights to identify opportunities, set priorities and support commercial decision-making across the wider business.
  • Work closely with Brand & Marketing to ensure that performance marketing is both commercially effective and consistent with the Hårklinikken brand.
  • Lead and develop relationships with relevant global e-tailers and digital commercial partners.


CRM, Retention & Customer Lifetime Value

  • Own and continually evolve Hårklinikken’s global CRM and retention strategy.
  • Develop lifecycle journeys, segmentation, loyalty, subscription and retention initiatives that increase repeat purchase, engagement and customer lifetime value.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen the relationship with clients throughout the entire customer journey – from first interaction through conversion, retention and advocacy.
  • Ensure CRM insights are actively used to inform ecommerce, product, marketing and customer experience decisions.


Website, Technology & Development

  • Own Hårklinikken’s global digital product and development roadmap in partnership with third-party technology partners.
  • Determine development priorities across ecommerce, CRM/CX and digital marketing based on customer needs and commercial impact.
  • Lead the ongoing optimisation of website functionality, user experience and transactional performance.
  • Stay ahead of emerging technologies, tools and ecommerce capabilities that could improve performance, efficiency or customer experience.


Digital Customer Experience

  • Champion the Hårklinikken digital customer experience and ensure our online platforms reflect the premium, personalised experience of the brand.
  • Use customer care feedback, web analytics, CRM data, social insights, qualitative research and A/B testing to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Work closely with Creative, Design, Video and Copy teams to brief and implement high-performing, brand-right content across paid media and owned digital channels.
  • Ensure the digital customer journey is continually optimised from first touchpoint through conversion, retention and advocacy.


Third-Party & Agency Management

  • Act as the senior lead for key third-party digital partners and agencies.
  • Proactively identify new partners, technologies and capabilities that can strengthen Hårklinikken’s digital business.
  • Establish clear KPIs and accountability across external partners.
  • Facilitate regular strategic business reviews and maintain strong, productive relationships throughout the year.


What Success Looks Like

You will build and continuously improve a high-performing global digital engine that delivers profitable ecommerce growth while elevating the Hårklinikken customer experience.


You will create clear visibility into performance across markets and channels, strengthen both acquisition and retention, improve conversion and customer lifetime value, and ensure that our digital ecosystem delivers the same level of expertise, quality and premium experience that defines Hårklinikken.


You will be a key commercial and strategic partner to the leadership team, using data, customer insight and strong business judgement to help shape Hårklinikken’s next phase of global growth.


Core Competencies & Experience

This is a challenging role that requires the experience and insight to build the right strategies and tactics within digital commerce. At the same time, you must enjoy – and take pride in – turning those strategies into action, delivering at pace and with a high level of quality. A strong bias towards action is essential: you are comfortable making informed decisions, moving quickly and taking ownership of getting things done.


The role requires broad understanding and experience across areas such as CRM, ecommerce trading and customer journey optimisation, media agency management and third-party digital marketplaces.


You don’t need to tick every box to be the right fit. We would love to hear from you if you bring solid experience within ecommerce and paid media, combined with an ambitious mindset, high learning agility and a strong can-do attitude.


  • A demonstrated track record of successfully and efficiently scaling ecommerce businesses, ideally across multiple markets.
  • Strong commercial acumen and experience owning or significantly influencing an ecommerce P&L.
  • Broad experience across several of the following disciplines: ecommerce, testing/CRO, paid media, customer acquisition and CRM.
  • Experience with subscription-based and omnichannel revenue models is advantageous, but not a hard requirement.
  • Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to translate complex data into clear commercial priorities and actions.
  • Experience managing meaningful ecommerce and performance marketing budgets, with a strong understanding of CAC, LTV and profitability.
  • A customer-obsessed mindset, prioritising retention and customer experience alongside efficient acquisition.
  • Hands-on experience with Shopify, GA360/GA4, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads and Klaviyo.
  • A resilient, proactive and entrepreneurial mindset, with speed, ownership and a strong bias towards action, and the ability to move seamlessly between strategy and execution.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where priorities can evolve quickly.
  • Experience working with premium or luxury consumers, personalised services, beauty, wellness or adjacent categories is highly relevant.
  • International experience is strongly preferred, with specific experience in the US market considered a significant advantage.


Who Are We?

Founded in 1992 in Copenhagen, Hårklinikken’s award-winning treatment regimen is expert-formulated to help clients achieve optimal scalp health and long-lasting hair gain with product blends rich in potent botanicals.


We’ve masterminded a diagnostic approach to hair health known as The Hårklinikken Method. Beginning with a consultation – conducted virtually or in-person at one of our clinics in New York, Beverly Hills, Copenhagen, Aarhus, Dubai, or Reykjavik – our specialists create a regimen of Hårklinikken essentials, personalised to each client’s individual needs.

  • Aikaisemman kokemuksen rakennus- ja/ tai logistiikka-alalta.
  • Voimassa oleva työturvallisuuskortti
  • Suomen kielen taito

Eduksi katsomme:

  • Taakansidonnan pätevyyden

Työ alkaa sopivan henkilön löydyttyä ja työskentelet vuokratyösuhteessa asiakkaamme palveluksessa.

Palkkaus 12,24-13,00 €/h ja määrittämisessä otetaan huomioon aikaisempi kokemus ja koulutuksesi.

Kolahtiko?

Kuulostaa hyvältä, mutta miksi hakisin töitä juuri Amikon kautta?

Amiko tarjoaa kaiken tasoisille ammattilaisille laajan valikoiman töitä. Olemme sinulle reilu, luotettava ja joustava työelämän kumppani. Amikolla on hyvä maine työmarkkinoilla. Pyrimme aina etsimään parhaat mahdolliset ratkaisut työllistymisesi tueksi. Amikolaisena saat:

• Vähintään TES:in mukaisen palkkauksen-palkkausjärjestelmämme on kannustava, joskus jopa suurempi kuin työllistyessä suoraan yrityksen palkkalistoille.

• Laajasti erilaisia työmahdollisuuksia- meillä on kattavat verkostot ja laaja työpaikkavalikoimaniin osa-aikaisia, kokopäiväisiä kuin sesonkitöitä monelta eri alalta. Kun sopiva työ löytyy, monille tarjoutuu myös mahdollisuus siirtyä vakituiseksi työntekijäksi asiakasyritykseen.

• Oman yhteyshenkilön ja yksilöllistä työnhakua – Amikolta saat henkilökohtaista palvelua ja oman tutun yhteyshenkilön, johon voit olla suoraan yhteydessä.

• Kattavat työterveyspalvelut, normaalin eläkekertymän ja sairausajan palkan sairauden sattuessa – Vaikka teetkin työsi asiakasyrityksessämme, olet amikolainen ja kannamme sinusta vastuun ja huolehdimme eduistasi.

• … vai kenties jotain ihan uutta urallesi? Autamme myös alanvaihdossa. Räätälöidyt uravalmennukset auttavat päivittämään osaamistasi ja löytämään uuden suunnan urallasi.

Voisiko tässä olla sinulle uusi työpaikka?

Toimimme asiakkaallemme rekrytointikumppanina, käsittelemme saapuvat työhakemukset sekä vastaamme ensimmäisen vaiheen haastatteluista. Jätäthän hakemuksesi pikimmiten ja nappaa itsellesi uusi huippuduuni!

Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivien henkilön löydyttyä.

Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse vastaanotettuja hakemuksia vaan jätäthän hakemuksen nettisivujemme kautta tietosuojasyistä.

title: Product Manager (Mid)
description:
An exciting opportunity to join an industry-leading company in the nonprofit software market.


At Enthuse, we’re on a mission to transform digital fundraising by building the technology that empowers great causes. Our donations, event registration, and fundraising platform helps thousands of charities raise millions.


Launched in 2012, we’ve come a long way — we’ve grown the team to over 70 people and now serve thousands of charities. Enthuse is headquartered in London, with operations in Scotland, Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland. What's more, Enthuse is the official online fundraising partner for London Marathon Events and Great Run. Reporting to the Senior Product Manager, you’ll pioneer the development of innovative software solutions that align with our company's goals — and also help build and grow a company of smart and passionate people. And create a real impact.


As our Product Manager you’ll work across the full Enthuse stack; donations, event registration, fundraiser experience, charity admin and everything in between. No pigeon-holing: you’ll go where the biggest business problems are. You’ll take stakeholder requirements and turn them into sharp, business-led bets, pair closely with Engineering, Design and Data, and make fast, decisive calls about what we build, what we don’t, and why.


We’re looking for someone who is allergic to the feature factory. You don’t ship features because they were asked for; you ship them because they move Enthuse’s unique business KPIs. You’re commercially minded, great with people, and genuinely AI-native, you know its strengths for assistance and its weaknesses.


We believe productivity is no longer the bottleneck, clarity of vision is. We want a PM who can prototype an idea with AI before the meeting, not write a 12-page PRD after it.


How you’ll contribute


  • Own outcomes, not outputs. Frame every bet in terms of the metrics that move the business; tipping, Gift Aid uptake, churn, retention, conversion, and be ruthless about killing work that doesn’t.
  • Translate stakeholder requirements into business-led product decisions. Listen deeply to charities, partners and internal teams; filter aggressively; and come back with a clear point of view.
  • Prototype to think. Use Gen AI tools to mock up ideas, test flows, and bring something tangible to discussions rather than a deck.
  • Make decisions quickly and decisively and be willing to change your mind just as fast when the data or the user tells you to.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Design and Data across the full stack, working with teams building on a modern TypeScript, event-driven, edge-first platform.
  • Manage stakeholder relationships with warmth and directness, from charity partners to internal leaders, and be the person they want in the room.
  • Support the Senior Product Manager in shaping the strategy and roadmap, bringing your own ideas and evidence to the table rather than waiting to be told what to do.
  • Champion data-informed decision-making, working with our Analytics Engineer and Data Analyst to turn numbers into “so what, now what”.


About you


  • 2+ years of experience as a Product Manager (or equivalent e.g. Associate PM, Product Analyst stepping up) in a fast-paced, product-led environment.
  • Business-led instincts. You reach for the retention curve or the conversion funnel before the feature list. Domain experience in fintech, payments or nonprofit is a nice-to-have, not a must.
  • Genuinely AI-native. You can show real, concrete examples of how you use Gen AI to prototype ideas, stress-test decisions, compress discovery cycles, and bring ideas to life fast. This is non-negotiable.
  • Good with people. You build trust with stakeholders quickly, and people leave conversations with you feeling heard and clearer on what happens next.
  • Decisive. You’re comfortable making calls with incomplete information, explaining your reasoning, and owning the outcome and equally comfortable asking for help when you need it.
  • Strong communicator who can move fluently between a charity support conversation, an engineering whiteboard session, and an internal update.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and energised by a small team in a scale-up environment where you’ll have real autonomy and real impact.
  • Curious about the tech. You don’t need to code, but you want to understand how an event-driven, edge-deployed platform shapes what’s cheap, expensive, fast or slow to build.
  • Hungry to grow. You’re early in your product career and want to learn from a Senior PM and a cross-functional team that will push you.


What you’ll get


  • We celebrate together with an early Friday finish with optional team drinks, team incentives, and a variety of company socials
  • We believe work-life balance matters and have flexible hours, working from home, and support part-time work
  • We believe in giving back and give you one paid day to fundraise for a charity of your choice
  • We want you to travel well with the Cycle to Work scheme, season ticket loan, and a London-based office
  • We will support your journey through our learning and development program with an allowance for training each year and Personal Development Plans, as well as a mentor program that offers structured support from senior team members
  • Holiday allowance: 25 days holiday and bank holidays (33 in total). We increase holidays based on length of service, so for every year you’re with us, you’ll get an additional day’s holiday up to 28 days. We also offer an additional 5 days of unpaid holiday
  • Your birthday off!
  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years at Enthuse
  • Enthuse Wings! Work from abroad for up to 4 weeks of the year!
  • We offer a generous equity options scheme at a fast-growing, stable company backed by socially responsible investors. We give back to all our employees who get us closer to achieving our mission
  • Private health insurance coverage
  • Places for Races, as partners of London Marathon Events and Great Run, we get access to a number of participant places for major fundraising events. So if you're a keen runner, swimmer or cyclist - you could be in luck


Come as you are. Love what you do.

At Enthuse, we want to create a positive impact on a global scale. And to do that we know that the people at Enthuse have to reflect all global lives and identities.

We work flexible hours, we support remote working, and if that doesn’t quite work, we will definitely listen to what will. We’re striving to create a place where all feel valued and welcome — and would love to hear how we could do that for you.

title: Working Foreman
description:
Do you enjoy making a difference? Do you like keeping things clean and orderly? Do you believe in doing what is right, even when policy makes it challenging? Can you easily admit when you’re wrong? Do you have a great attitude, a solid work ethic and a willingness to learn?


If you answered yes to these questions, we want to hear from you! We’re currently looking for a full-time Working Foreman to grow the team on our multi-family, wood-frame project currently under construction in Peachland, BC. Enjoy going to work and expand your skills with a professional, supportive team.


WHY HIGHSTREET?


Highstreet is the largest developer, builder and operator of net-zero-ready homes in Canada and the only one offering double the standard warranty. We also manage our own growing portfolio of 1,400+ rental apartments with customer service scores that consistently rank among the best in the industry.


Our vision is that everyone in Highstreet’s community will want their friends to work with us, live with us and invest with us.


Help us achieve that vision.


CORE VALUES

Known as “Highstreeters” we demonstrate our core values in everything we do:

  • Humility grants us insight from others
  • Inquisitive & learning continuously
  • Guided by always doing what is right
  • Honest, open and timely communication
  • Responsible & accountable for our actions and decisions
  • Determined to persevere, get results and “win” together


RESPONSIBILITIES

Reporting to the Site Superintendent, the Working Foreman with Highstreet is responsible for the self-performed scope management including: (i) safety, (ii) material organization, (iii) quality, (iv) cleanliness, and (v) removal of roadblocks to facilitate project schedule. Scopes may include the full breadth of construction, spanning foundation through to finishing.


Day-to-day tasks would include, but are not limited to:


  • Work closely with Assistant Site Superintendent to provide daily direction to crew on self-performing scopes
  • Hands-on with self-performed scopes, leading by example on site. Balance hands-on site work (approx. 80%) with planning, coaching, and administrative duties (approx. 20%)
  • Perform quality checks with the Assistant Site Superintendent before beginning any self-performed tasks
  • Communicate material, tool, and equipment requirements prior to any job start
  • Complete material take-offs, place orders, and manage deliveries to align with project schedules
  • Manage roadblocks, team capacity, and scheduling to ensure self-performed tasks are completed on time
  • Direct, manage, and mentor Carpenters, and Site Dynamos (Labourers)
  • Attend daily foreman meetings and collaborate with site leadership to align on priorities

Qualifications / Requirements:

  • 5+ years leadership experience in multi-family construction
  • Journeyman Carpenter (or equivalent skill set) with ability to manage multiple scopes of work
  • Ability to read and interpret plans, drawings and specifications to ensure accuracy and compliance
  • Comfortable using standard computer programs (Excel, Outlook, Teams, Bluebeam)
  • Advanced First Aid an asset
  • Ticketed on skid steer, rough terrain forklift, boom lifts, and/or excavator an asset
  • Valid safety and equipment certifications (Fire stop installation, Hilti Rebar Installation, Fall Arrest, Hoisting & Rigging, etc.)
  • Have good physical conditioning and stamina
  • Valid Class 5 driver’s license and reliable transportation


Additional requirements:

  • Satisfactory credit and criminal record check.
  • Travel to Head Office in Kelowna required, up to 2 times a year.
  • Travel to Vancouver Island for one week is required for initial training. Transportation, accommodation and an allowance will be provided.


Compensation Package:

Annual Salary: $80,000-$105,000 dependent on experience

The posted salary range reflects our target base salary for this role. Most successful candidates are offered salaries near the midpoint of the range, based on their experience and qualifications.

Annual Bonus: Highstreet pays an annual bonus based on company performance. A typical bonus for a Working Foreman is approximately 14% of annual salary. Determined annually, the bonus may be higher or lower, depending on performance results.

Investment Opportunity: Highstreet encourages all employees to share in our success by offering the opportunity to invest in the projects we build and operate. To encourage employee investment, Highstreet matches contributions at 50%, up to 20% of annual salary (i.e. for every $1 invested by the employee, Highstreet invests $0.50 on the employee's behalf). The investments are TFSA and RRSP eligible.

Job Description:

Batory Foods is a national food ingredient distributor that has built a successful business and superior reputation by hiring and retaining the most talented people in the industry. We are looking to add an organized and highly motivated Quality Assurance Technician to our team Quality Team.


Key Responsibilities:

title: Quality Assurance Manager
description:
Role title

Quality Assurance Manager (QA Manager)

Department

Quality Assurance and Food Safety / Operations

Location

Field-based; regular work across farms, aggregation points, fulfilment centres, packhouses, warehouses and shipment locations

Grade

Manager level; final internal grade/band subject to the approved job-grading framework

Reports to

Chief Operations Officer

Direct reports

None initially; leads through quality standards, audit authority, corrective-action governance and shipment release decisions

PRIMARY MANDATE: Ensure at least 98% of released crop deliveries meet the agreed buyer specification and applicable food standards, while maintaining a non-negotiable control that 100% of shipments receive documented QA release before departure.

Detailed responsibilities

Quality-management system, SOPs and control architecture

  • Design, maintain and enforce the end-to-end quality-assurance framework for every crop and trade lane, covering farms, growers, agents, suppliers, aggregation points, fulfilment centres, packhouses, warehouses, transport, ports and delivery interfaces.
  • Convert applicable buyer, legal, certification and internal requirements into controlled SOPs, SLAs, work instructions, inspection checklists, acceptance criteria, sampling plans, forms and evidence standards.
  • Define critical-to-quality attributes, food-safety hazards, preventive controls, operational prerequisites and critical control points where applicable; ensure monitoring and escalation are practical for field execution.
  • Maintain a controlled document register, revision history and distribution process so teams use the current approved specification and procedure.
  • Establish the quality RACI for Agronomy, Field Operations, Crop Sourcing, Procurement, Production, Inventory, Logistics, Sales and Customer Success, with clear handoffs and escalation ownership.
  • Review the quality system after buyer complaints, audit findings, new crops, new markets, new suppliers, new locations, process changes or material changes in buyer requirements.

Trade-specific quality planning and buyer-specification control

  • Obtain the final approved buyer specification, contract quality terms, destination-market requirements, test methods, tolerances, packaging and labelling requirements before production or sourcing commitments are operationalized.
  • Prepare a quality plan for each material trade that identifies specification parameters, risks, inspection points, sampling frequency, required laboratories, records, release criteria and accountable process owners.
  • Run pre-trade quality-readiness reviews with Commercial, Agronomy, Crop Sourcing, Supply Chain, Production and Logistics and document gaps, owners and go/no-go conditions.
  • Control specification changes and ensure any buyer-approved concession or deviation is documented before release; prevent verbal or retrospective changes from being treated as approval.
  • Maintain a crop and buyer specification library that is searchable, version-controlled and linked to the relevant purchase, production, inventory and shipment records.

Production, grower and supplier quality assurance

  • Work with Agronomy to verify that production protocols, approved inputs, application records, pre-harvest intervals, harvest-maturity criteria and crop-specific food-safety controls are defined and evidenced.
  • Conduct risk-based farm, grower, cooperative, agent and supplier audits and verify corrective actions before high-risk supply is accepted.
  • Establish supplier and grower approval, probation, suspension and requalification criteria using quality history, audit performance, traceability, complaints and corrective-action responsiveness.
  • Verify harvest readiness against buyer specification, crop maturity, expected defects, residue or contamination risk, weather exposure, handling capacity and packaging readiness.
  • Coordinate representative field or pre-harvest sampling and approved laboratory testing where required; preserve sample identity, chain of custody and result integrity.
  • Train and coach growers, agents and operating teams on quality standards without taking over Agronomy's technical ownership or Operations' execution accountability.

Receiving, aggregation, inventory and processing controls

  • Ensure every incoming lot is uniquely identified, weighed, sampled, inspected and graded against the approved crop and trade criteria before acceptance into controlled inventory.
  • Verify crop-specific parameters such as variety, maturity, size, appearance, defects, foreign matter, moisture, temperature, Brix, pungency, aflatoxin, residue, microbiological or other attributes where relevant to the order.
  • Enforce segregation, status labelling and system blocking for released, quarantined, rejected, rework, returned and expired inventory; prevent commingling that destroys traceability or certification status.
  • Audit sanitation, hygiene, pest control, water quality, equipment condition, calibration, environmental conditions, cold chain, storage life and stock-rotation controls as applicable.
  • Verify that sorting, cleaning, processing, grading, packing, labelling and rework follow approved instructions and do not introduce contamination, substitution or specification drift.
  • Review yield, shrinkage, downgrade, waste and reconciliation data for anomalies that may indicate process failure, record error, theft, substitution or concealed nonconformance.

Final inspection, hold and shipment-release authority

  • Complete or oversee final lot and shipment inspection using the approved sampling plan, test method, calibrated equipment and acceptance criteria.
  • Verify packaging integrity, labelling, lot codes, quantity, palletization, container or vehicle hygiene, temperature controls, loading method, seals, documentation and destination requirements before release.
  • Compile and approve the shipment quality dossier, including the current buyer specification, inspection results, certificates of analysis where required, traceability, concessions, photographs and corrective-action evidence.
  • Issue a documented QA release only when all mandatory criteria are met; maintain an auditable link between the release, inventory lot, vehicle or container, dispatch and buyer order.
  • Place any crop, lot, facility process, vehicle or shipment on hold when safety, legality, certification, traceability, specification or evidence requirements are not met, and communicate the hold immediately to accountable leaders.
  • Authorize re-inspection after documented correction and recommend rework, downgrade, alternative compliant use, return or destruction; no disposition may compromise food safety, law, certification or an agreed buyer requirement.
  • Escalate any attempt to bypass, backdate, alter or pressure a quality decision and retain an unedited record of the original evidence and decision.

Nonconformity, complaints, CAPA and crisis readiness

  • Operate one nonconformity and corrective-action register covering field failures, rejected lots, audit findings, process deviations, buyer complaints, returns, claims and certification findings.
  • Ensure immediate containment of critical food-safety and specification risks, including lot isolation, shipment stop, notification, evidence preservation and risk assessment.
  • Lead or facilitate structured root-cause analysis using evidence and distinguish the occurrence cause, escape cause and system cause rather than blaming individual operators without proof.
  • Assign corrective and preventive actions with owners, deadlines and verification criteria; reject closure that documents activity without demonstrating effectiveness.
  • Coordinate quality investigations with Commercial and Customer Success, provide fact-based buyer responses and separate valid claims from commercial disputes or post-release changes.
  • Maintain withdrawal and recall procedures, current contact lists, decision thresholds, mock recall schedule and escalation protocols; participate in incident command when activated.
  • Trend defects, complaints, holds and repeat failures by crop, location, supplier, process, buyer and root cause and sponsor prevention priorities with the COO.

Certification, audit and regulatory readiness

  • Lead certification readiness, initial certification, surveillance, renewal and scope-extension efforts assigned to the function, coordinating evidence and implementation across accountable teams.
  • Maintain a live obligations register for applicable food-safety, agricultural production, export, buyer, certification and laboratory requirements across each trade lane.
  • Conduct internal audits and readiness reviews against current applicable requirements, record objective evidence and escalate critical or repeated gaps promptly.
  • Coordinate external certification bodies, laboratories, inspectors and customer auditors through approved channels and ensure records provided are authentic, controlled and complete.
  • Own the audit-action plan and verify sustainable closure; report overdue, disputed or recurring findings to the COO and relevant executive owner.
  • Monitor changes to applicable standards and buyer requirements and translate them into timely updates to SOPs, training, systems, supplier controls and investment plans.

Real-time field quality visibility and digital controls

  • Build a risk-based coverage model that prioritizes high-risk crops, suppliers, locations, processes and shipments while maintaining routine assurance across the wider network.
  • Implement digital inspection, sampling, hold, release and CAPA workflows with mandatory timestamps, user identity, lot reference and supporting evidence; use geolocation or photo evidence where proportionate and authorized.
  • Define when remote verification is acceptable and when physical attendance, independent sampling or laboratory confirmation is mandatory.
  • Maintain live visibility of inspections due, lots on hold, pending test results, release readiness, expiring certificates, unresolved complaints and overdue corrective actions.
  • Establish contingency procedures for low-connectivity locations, including offline forms, controlled synchronization, record reconciliation and prevention of duplicate or backdated decisions.
  • Validate data quality and investigate anomalies such as impossible timestamps, repeated images, unusual pass rates, missing samples, altered results or repeated overrides.

Quality capability, reporting and continuous improvement

  • Define role-based quality competencies for Agronomy, Field Operations, Production, Warehouse, Inventory, Procurement and Logistics personnel and verify effectiveness after training.
  • Coach process owners to conduct first-line quality checks correctly while preserving QA's independent verification role.
  • Publish a weekly quality operations report and monthly management dashboard showing conformance, holds, release status, inspection coverage, complaints, CAPA, audit status, traceability, supplier performance and cost of poor quality.
  • Present material risks, trend analysis, root causes, decisions required and recovery plans in S&OP, D2D, operations and executive cadences.
  • Partner with Product, Data and Engineering to digitize quality controls, integrate records with trade and inventory workflows, and remove manual gaps without weakening segregation of duties.
  • Use Pareto analysis, control charts or other appropriate methods to prioritize prevention, validate improvement and reduce variation by crop, supplier, site and process.
  • Model integrity and impartiality: report inconvenient quality evidence early, avoid conflicts of interest and protect employees or partners who raise genuine food-safety or quality concerns.

Required experience, qualifications and technical capabilities

Required experience and non-negotiables

  • At least five years of progressive quality assurance, quality control or food-safety experience in food, fresh produce, agricultural commodities, agribusiness, export supply chains or a closely related environment.
  • Demonstrated responsibility for quality across multiple field, supplier, aggregation, warehouse, packhouse, production or logistics locations rather than experience limited to a single laboratory or office.
  • Proven experience leading certification implementation, audit readiness, certification renewal or scope expansion and closing findings through cross-functional owners.
  • Hands-on experience translating buyer specifications into sampling, inspection, grading, testing, acceptance, hold, release and traceability controls.
  • Evidence of reducing buyer rejection, complaints, rework, quality loss or recurring defects through structured root-cause analysis and verified corrective action.
  • Experience with perishable and/or export-bound agricultural products, including time-sensitive release decisions and quality control under field and commercial pressure.
  • Demonstrated courage and integrity to stop or hold a shipment, challenge unreliable evidence and report a material risk despite delivery or revenue pressure.
  • Ability and willingness to travel extensively and work in farms, rural communities, aggregation sites, warehouses, packhouses, ports and other operating environments with variable infrastructure and connectivity.

Qualifications and professional requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Food Science or Technology, Agriculture, Agronomy, Crop Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, Quality Management, Biological Sciences or a closely related discipline.
  • Recognized training or certification in HACCP and food-safety management is required; lead-auditor or internal-auditor qualification for an applicable food-safety or quality standard is strongly preferred.
  • Practical working knowledge of current applicable Codex good hygiene and HACCP principles, ISO 22000 or an equivalent food-safety management system, GLOBALG.A.P. Integrated Farm Assurance or other company-required certification schemes, as relevant to the crop and market.
  • Knowledge of applicable national food, plant-health, export, laboratory and importing-market requirements and the ability to determine when specialist regulatory or laboratory advice is needed.
  • Strong written and spoken English; French and relevant local language capability are advantageous for multi-country field operations.
  • Valid driving eligibility and safe field-travel capability where required by the operating model.

title: Occupational Health Physiotherapist - Trident
description:
Job Purpose

The Occupational Health Physiotherapist is responsible for providing high-quality physiotherapy, occupational rehabilitation, injury prevention, and functional restoration services to employees.

The role focuses on the assessment, diagnosis, treatment, rehabilitation, and prevention of musculoskeletal and functional impairments/ disability arising from occupational and non-occupational conditions. The incumbent will support evidence-based return -to-work pathways through Functional Capacity Assessments (FCAs), individualized rehabilitation plans, workplace conditioning & hardening programs, ergonomic interventions, and injury & disease prevention initiatives.

The Occupational Health Physiotherapist will work closely with the Primary care Physiotherapist & offsite OHPT and work rehab team to ensure continuity of physiotherapy and rehabilitation care across the employee population. While the Occupational Health Physiotherapists maintain responsibility for occupational rehabilitation, functional work capacity assessments, work conditioning, and return-to-work outcomes, the Primary Care Physiotherapist may provide specialized physiotherapy interventions, advanced rehabilitation equipment access, and treatment services not available onsite. All roles shall operate within a coordinated rehabilitation framework to optimize employee recovery and work participation outcomes.

Working collaboratively with Occupational Health Doctors, the FQM Fitness & Rehabilitation Coordinator, Specialist Work rehabilitation support and Specialist Fitness, Gym & Wellness, offsite OHPT and Primary care Physiotherapist, the Occupational Health Physiotherapist plays a key role in promoting workforce health, reducing disability, improving work readiness, and optimizing rehabilitation & fitness outcomes.

Key Role Accountabilities

Clinical Physiotherapy Services

  • Manage and coordinate physiotherapy services for employees to a standard of professional excellence.
  • Assess, diagnose, treat, and rehabilitate employees presenting with musculoskeletal, neurological, orthopaedic, occupational, and functional conditions.
  • Develop and implement evidence-based physiotherapy treatment plans.
  • Deliver physiotherapy interventions including Manual therapy, Exercise therapy, Electrotherapy, Soft tissue mobilization & therapeutic massage, Ultrasound therapy, Hydrotherapy, Functional rehabilitation.

Occupational Rehabilitation and Return-to-Work Services

  • Coordinate rehabilitation activities and progress reviews with the Primary Physiotherapist for employees receiving offsite or specialized physiotherapy services.
  • Integrate specialist physiotherapy recommendations into occupational rehabilitation and return-to-work planning.
  • Maintain oversight of occupational rehabilitation outcomes and work-readiness progression for employees receiving treatment through MBHS physiotherapy services.
  • Ensure continuity of care during employee transitions between onsite occupational health rehabilitation services and offsite physiotherapy treatment pathways.
  • Collaborate with the FQM Fitness & Rehabilitation Coordinator & Specialist Work Rehabilitation Support to develop and implement effective occupational rehabilitation programs.
  • Conduct Functional Capacity Evaluations (FCEs) and Functional job Assessments (FJA).
  • Prepare objective and evidence-based reports for Occupational Health Doctors.
  • Assist in determining fitness for duty, physical work capabilities, and work restrictions.
  • Support graduated return-to-work and work conditioning & hardening programs.
  • Participate in employee rehabilitation reviews and multidisciplinary case management discussions.
  • Monitor rehabilitation progress and recommend adjustments to rehabilitation plans as required.

Injury Prevention and Employee Wellness

  • In collaboration with FQM Fitness & rehabilitation Coordinator & Specialist Work rehabilitation Support, develop and implement musculoskeletal injury prevention programs.
  • Support design and implementation of employee fitness, conditioning & hardening programs.
  • Conduct workplace ergonomic assessments and provide recommendations to reduce injury risk.
  • Deliver educational sessions on, injury prevention, safe manual handling, stretching programs, workplace ergonomics, physical fitness and musculoskeletal health.

Service Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with the Primary care Physiotherapist & offsite OH PT to ensure seamless coordination of physiotherapy and rehabilitation services for employees.
  • Facilitate referrals to the Primary Physiotherapist for specialized interventions, electrotherapy modalities, advanced rehabilitation equipment, and treatment services not available onsite.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary rehabilitation case conferences involving Occupational Health Physicians, Physiotherapy personnel, and the FQM Fitness & Rehabilitation Coordinator.
  • Ensure timely communication regarding treatment progress, functional outcomes, rehabilitation goals, and return-to-work recommendations.
  • Escalate complex rehabilitation cases requiring multidisciplinary intervention to the Occupational Health Physician and FQM Fitness & Rehabilitation Coordinator.
  • Ensure continuity of care and implementation of specialist treatment recommendations.
  • Maintain strong communication with Occupational Health Doctors and other healthcare professionals.
  • Attend clinical meetings, rehabilitation reviews, and workplace health initiatives.
  • Identify service gaps and recommend improvement opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

The Occupational Health Physiotherapist shall collaborate closely with the Primary care Physiotherapist, Offsite Occupational Health Physiotherapist and Physiotherapy Technologists, Occupational Health Doctors and the FQM Fitness & Rehabilitation Coordinator to provide an integrated rehabilitation service model that supports employee recovery, functional restoration, fitness for work, and safe return-to-work outcomes.

Clinical Practice

  • Conduct comprehensive physical and functional assessments.
  • Evaluate patients' movement, mobility, strength, endurance, and ability to perform occupational tasks.
  • Design individualized treatment and rehabilitation programs.
  • Provide patient education regarding exercise programs and injury management.
  • Monitor patient progress and maintain treatment effectiveness.
  • Maintain accurate patient records and treatment documentation.

Functional Capacity Assessment

  • Conduct standardized Functional Capacity Assessments.
  • Assess physical work capabilities including; lifting, carrying, pushing and pulling, mobility, balance, endurance, dexterity and positional tolerances.
  • Provide detailed reports to Occupational Health Doctors and the FQM Fitness & Rehabilitation Coordinator.

Rehabilitation Program Development

  • Design workplace-focused rehabilitation programs.
  • Support work hardening and work conditioning interventions.
  • Participate in return-to-work planning and reviews.

Supervision

  • Supervise and support the Work Rehabilitation Physiotherapy Technologist.
  • Guide junior rehabilitation personnel in clinical and occupational rehabilitation practices.
  • Support continuous professional development within the physiotherapy team.

Equipment and Facility Management

  • Conduct daily startup and shutdown procedures for physiotherapy equipment.
  • Ensure regular inspection, maintenance, and calibration of equipment.
  • Maintain treatment rooms and rehabilitation facilities to required standards.
  • Coordinate procurement of physiotherapy equipment, consumables, and supplies.
  • Monitor stock levels and ensure FIFO inventory management practices.

Quality, Safety and Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with FQM & MBHS policies, procedures, and service standards.
  • Always maintain patient confidentiality.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and audits.
  • Conduct risk assessments of clinical environments and work practices.
  • Adhere to infection prevention and control standards.
  • Ensure compliance with all legal, professional, and regulatory requirements.
  • Utilize PPE appropriately and ensure safe clinical practice.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Science (BSc) Degree in Physiotherapy.
  • Current registration with the Health Professions Council of Zambia (HPCZ).
  • Valid Practicing License.
  • Current registration with Zambia Society of Physiotherapy.

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum two (2) years post-qualification physiotherapy experience.
  • Experience in occupational health, mining or heavy industry will be an advantage.
  • Employee wellness and fitness program implementation experience.
  • Return-to-Work program management exposure.

Competencies

Technical Competencies

  • Occupational Rehabilitation
  • Functional Capacity Evaluation
  • Musculoskeletal Assessment

title: SENIOR MEDIA COORDINATOR - UEFA
description:
Whisper is a leading global production company, specialising in sports, unscripted and branded entertainment.

Our diverse team of over 285 international employees produce top-level sports such as Formula One, UEFA and the Paralympics, as well as branded content, prime-time documentaries, and entertainment quiz shows for a raft of broadcasters.

Whisper’s creativity and storytelling are BAFTA-winning and Emmy International-nominated.


It is also a Sunday Times Best Places to Work.


We are looking for an experienced Senior Media Coordinator to join our busy UEFA department, taking a key role in managing media workflows, supporting post-production delivery, supporting the UEFA Media Manager and helping guide junior team members.

The role will be integral to the smooth delivery of UEFA magazine programming, with responsibility for helping to oversee the ingest, organisation, preparation, export and archive of media for content relating to the UEFA Champions League, UEFA Europa League and UEFA Conference League.

The Senior Media Coordinator will also support content relating to the UEFA European Qualifiers and UEFA Nations League, ensuring media is delivered accurately, efficiently and in line with UEFA and Whisper technical requirements.

We are looking for someone with strong experience using Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe Media Encoder, a confident understanding of post-production workflows, excellent technical judgement and a meticulous approach to file management, quality control and delivery.

You will be comfortable working as part of a fast-paced production team, acting as a key point of contact for Producers, Assistant Producers, Editors and Technical colleagues, whilst deputising for the Media Manager as required and supporting junior members of the media team.

A strong knowledge of, and passion for, domestic and international football is vital, alongside the ability to stay calm, organised and solutions-focused during busy delivery periods.

Whisper is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, communities and lived experiences, and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels supported, valued and empowered to do their best work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assisting in the day-to-day running of the media coordination team, including training new staff and helping to review and update workflows in conjunction with your line manager to increase productivity and improve processes.
  • Working on the day-to-day organisation, labelling, storage and processing of UEFA media, ensuring all content is handled accurately and consistently.
  • Syncing, compiling, preparing and exporting rushes in line with UEFA and Whisper technical specifications, including the creation of UCMs (ungraded split track masters).
  • Creating, maintaining and troubleshooting edit projects, ensuring Editors and APs have the correct media, sequences and supporting materials.
  • Acting as the main point of contact for Producers, APs, Editors and technical colleagues regarding media workflow, technical queries and delivery issues.
  • Monitoring and managing media workspaces, storage and project organisation, keeping systems clear, efficient, production-ready and at a sensible level.
  • Maintaining accurate records of media movement, exports, archives and deliverables, and updating and maintaining UEFA/Whisper documentation.
  • Supporting and guiding the existing team of Media Coordinators, helping to uphold team standards and consistent working practices.
  • Identifying workflow improvements and flagging risks, delays or technical issues promptly to the relevant production and post-production teams.

Please note that responsibilities may be amended, added to, or removed to reflect the changing needs of the production or organisation

Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • Strong working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe Media Encoder
  • Confident understanding of post-production workflows, media ingest, transcoding, exports, archiving and delivery processes
  • Good knowledge of broadcast file formats, codecs, frame rates and technical specifications
  • Proven ability to support busy edit teams and manage multiple projects, deadlines and priorities at once
  • Excellent attention to detail, with a calm, methodical and solutions-focused approach to problem solving
  • Excellent organisational, communication and time management skills
  • Experience supporting, training or overseeing junior team members
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workloads, priorities and new systems
  • Ability to work effectively with others and manage relationships across a large, busy and diverse production team
  • Strong knowledge of domestic and international football, with an understanding of UEFA competitions desirable

Location:

This role will be based in Kew, London.

Working hours:

This role will require flexibility and some weekend working. Lieu days will be given for any days worked over a five-day week.
The role will require the successful applicant to be in the office 5 days a week.

Whisper operates a 4:1 working from home policy, which the successful applicant will be offered once they pass their probationary period and are comfortable performing and completing all daily tasks.

Start:

October 2026 to 30th June 2027


Salary:

Based on experience

Application Closing:

Friday 4th September 2026

How to apply:

Please upload your CV and tell us, in your own way why you are the right candidate for this role.

title: Senior Policy Analyst – Artificial Intelligence (AI) / Analyste principal(e) des politiques – Intelligence artificielle (IA)
description:
Position Overview

The Senior Policy Analyst takes directions from and reports to the Director, Languages and Learning. The incumbent will conduct research, analyze, develop, coordinate and deliver policy briefings, reports and other written material related to artificial intelligence (AI) and its implications for First Nations, including AI governance, First Nations data sovereignty and related policy issues. The position is responsible for the achievement of defined work plans and objectives aimed at supporting and advancing AFN’s national advocacy positions, interests and strategies in First Nations Language & Learning related issues and priorities. At times, this position is required to travel.

Reporting to the Director, Language and Learning, the Senior Policy Analyst – AI will have the following,


Key Responsibilities:

  • Gathers and analyzes statistical information, reviews and assesses existing research, and prepares reports and briefings on findings related to AI and First Nations priorities with high complexity requiring expertise knowledge.
  • Makes recommendations to inform the development of AI-related policies through research and engagement with First Nations and AI stakeholders.
  • Makes recommendations related to First Nations AI policies, governance, data sovereignty and program development, processes and procedures within a broad scope (strategic) and impact on First Nations.
  • Assist with the preparation of AFN resolutions and policy papers related to AI.
  • Make recommendations in the development of policies by collecting and analyzing statistical data.
  • Works with other Sector staff to share information, recommend approaches, discuss challenges and potential solutions, etc.
  • Assists with the preparation, coordination, processing, editing and completion of Sector materials such as briefing notes, speaking notes, PowerPoint presentations, annual reports, reports, quarterly reports, updates, letters, memos, brochures, postcards, e-bulletins, email, articles, papers, and record of decisions (minutes), invitations, workplans etc. To be done with specified timelines. All final approved documents to be filed in the record keeping system – Laserfiche.
  • Attends and take notes at Chiefs-in-Assembly (Annual General Assembly and Special Chiefs Assembly) meetings held twice annually in July in different locations and December in the Ottawa area.
  • Assists with the planning and coordination of the Sector’s Chiefs Committees, Technical Committees, and/or Working Groups, as required.
  • Monitors and/or attend Parliamentary standing committees as required.
  • Assist Director with reporting requirements of funding agreements.
  • Submits vacation, sick and special requests through the leave system to the Director.
  • Conducts other duties as assigned by the Director.


Working Conditions

  • Primarily office-based, with frequent travel required for meetings, community engagements, and events.
  • Availability to work irregular hours, including evenings and weekends, as necessary to meet organizational needs.
  • Ability to handle high-pressure situations and adapt to changing circumstances.


Physical and Mental Demands

  • Prolonged periods of sitting and computer use.
  • Capacity to manage complex and sensitive issues with professionalism, discretion, and cultural sensitivity.
  • Emotional resilience and the ability to navigate politically sensitive and challenging environments in a professional and effective manner.


Who can apply


  • Post secondary degree in political science or social science, computer science, information technology or a related field of study and 5 to 7 years of directly relevant senior experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • A minimum of 5+years of positive experience with First Nations and First Nations programs and policies
  • Advanced knowledge and expertise of AI with demonstrated understanding of its impact on First Nations communities
  • Advanced experience of analyzing large sets of complex and changing policy issues and data, and communicating it concisely, ensuring clarity to different audiences, including senior leadership.
  • Familiarity of manipulating and analyzing data on management information systems/databases and Excel
  • Excellent knowledge and ability to apply effective research techniques to issues related to AI
  • Demonstrated experience working with First Nations partners, federal, provincial, territorial, northern, urban and international governments and officials
  • Demonstrated interpersonal skills, teamwork and judgement
  • Diplomacy, tact and decision-making ability (decisions are strategic, complex and may have a far-reaching consequence and impact)
  • Planning & organization skills, must be able to multi-task effectively while working under pressure with competing deadlines
  • English is the working language however the ability to work in both official languages (English/French) is an asset. Fluency in a First Nations language is also an asset.

Diversity Statement

Qualified persons of First Nations Ancestry will be given preference in accordance with s.16(1) of the Canadian Human Rights Act.


Why Work with AFN?

At the Assembly of First Nations (AFN), we value our employees and are committed to fostering a supportive, engaging, and rewarding workplace. When you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Employer-Paid Health Benefit Premiums – Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, with premiums fully paid by AFN.
  • Generous Pension Matching – A competitive pension plan with significant employer contributions to help you build your future.
  • Ample Vacation, Sick, and Personal Days – Generous vacation entitlements, paid sick leave, and personal days, plus additional non-legislative time off throughout the year.
  • Professional Development Support – Coverage for courses, certifications, and training to help you grow your skills and advance your career.
  • Wellness Funds – Annual funds you can use towards fitness, mental health supports, or other wellness-related expenses.
  • Modern, Central Location – Our bright, collaborative office is located in the Sun Life Building in downtown Ottawa, with Parliament LRT Station right in the building for an easy commute.
  • Convenient Amenities – Steps away from cafes, restaurants, and shops.
  • Meaningful Work – Be part of a national organization advocating for First Nations, making a positive difference for communities across Canada.
  • Collaborative & Inclusive Culture – Work alongside passionate, dedicated colleagues in a supportive and dynamic environment.


Accommodation Statement

The Assembly of First Nations (AFN) is dedicated to an inclusive selection process and work environment. If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please advise the Human Resources representative when you are invited to meet regarding this employment opportunity.

While we appreciate all applications, only those candidates short-listed for an interview will be contacted.

AFN may cancel, postpone, or revise employment opportunities at any time.

Aperçu du poste

L’analyste principal(e) des politiques relève du(de la) directeur(trice) des Langues et de l’Apprentissage. Le(la) titulaire du poste mènera des recherches, effectuera des analyses et élaborera, coordonnera et présentera des notes d’orientation, des rapports et d’autres documents écrits portant sur l’intelligence artificielle (IA) et ses conséquences pour les Premières Nations, notamment la gouvernance de l’IA, la souveraineté des Premières Nations en matière de données et les enjeux politiques connexes. Le(la) titulaire de ce poste est chargé(e) de mener à bien des plans de travail et des objectifs définis dans le but de soutenir et de promouvoir les positions, les intérêts et les stratégies nationales de plaidoyer de l’APN concernant les enjeux et les priorités liés aux langues et à l’apprentissage des Premières Nations. Ce poste peut occasionnellement nécessiter des déplacements.

Relevant du(de la) directeur(trice) des Langues et de l’Apprentissage, l’analyste principal(e) des politiques – IA aura les responsabilités suivantes :


Principales responsabilités

  • Recueillir et analyser des informations statistiques, examiner et évaluer les recherches existantes et rédiger des rapports et des notes d’information sur les conclusions relatives à l’IA et aux priorités des Premières Nations, dans le cadre de tâches complexes nécessitant une expertise pointue.
  • Formuler des recommandations pour orienter l’élaboration de politiques liées à l’IA, en s’appuyant sur la recherche et la collaboration avec les Premières Nations et les parties prenantes du secteur de l’IA.
  • Formuler des recommandations concernant les politiques des Premières Nations en matière d’IA, la gouvernance, la souveraineté des données ainsi que l’élaboration des programmes, des processus et des procédures dans une perspective globale (stratégique) et en tenant compte de leur incidence sur les Premières Nations.
  • Contribuer à la préparation des résolutions et des documents d’orientation de l’APN relatifs à l’IA.
  • Formuler des recommandations pour l’élaboration des politiques en recueillant et en analysant des données statistiques.
  • Collaborer avec les autres membres du personnel du secteur pour diffuser de l’information, proposer des stratégies, discuter des défis et des solutions possibles, etc.
  • Participer à la préparation, à la coordination, au traitement, à la révision et à la finalisation des documents du Secteur, tels que les notes d’information, les notes d’allocution, les présentations PowerPoint, les rapports annuels, les rapports trimestriels, les mises à jour, les lettres, les notes de service, les brochures, les dépliants, les bulletins électroniques, les courriels, les articles, les documents et les comptes rendus de décisions (procès-verbaux), les invitations, les plans de travail, etc. Ces tâches doivent être réalisées dans les délais impartis. Tous les documents finaux approuvés doivent être classés dans le système d’archivage – Laserfiche.
  • Assister aux réunions des Chefs-en-assemblée (Assemblée générale annuelle et Assemblée extraordinaire des Chefs) et prendre des notes lors de celles-ci; ces réunions ont lieu deux fois par an, en juillet, dans diverses villes, et en décembre, dans la région d’Ottawa.
  • Aider à la planification et à la coordination des comités des Chefs, des comités techniques et/ou des groupes de travail du Secteur, le cas échéant.
  • Assurer le suivi et/ou assister aux réunions des commissions parlementaires permanentes, le cas échéant.
  • Aider le(la) directeur(trice) à remplir ses obligations en matière de production de rapports dans le cadre des ententes de financement.
  • Soumettre au(à la) directeur(trice) les demandes de congés annuels, de congés maladie et autres congés spéciaux via le système de gestion des congés.
  • Accomplir toute autre tâche confiée par le(la) directeur(trice).


Conditions de travail

  • Poste principalement basé au bureau, avec des déplacements fréquents pour assister à des réunions ou des événements.
  • Capacité à travailler de longues heures, y compris le soir et la fin de semaine, en fonction des besoins de l’organisation.
  • Capacité de gérer des situations délicates et de s’adapter à des circonstances changeantes.


Exigences physiques et mentales

  • Travailler en position assise pendant des périodes prolongées et en utilisant un ordinateur.
  • Capacité à gérer des enjeux complexes et sensibles avec professionnalisme, discrétion et sensibilité culturelle.
  • Résilience émotionnelle et capacité à évoluer dans des environnements politiquement sensibles et difficiles de manière professionnelle et efficace.


Qui peut postuler?

  • Diplôme d’études supérieures en sciences politiques ou en sciences sociales, en informatique, en technologies de l’information ou dans un domaine d’études connexe, et 5 à 7 ans d’expérience à un poste de responsabilité pertinent, ou une combinaison équivalente de formation et d’expérience.
  • Un minimum de 5 ans d’expérience positive auprès des Premières Nations et dans le cadre de programmes et de politiques les concernant.
  • Connaissances et expertise avancées en matière d’IA, avec une compréhension avérée de son incidence sur les communautés des Premières Nations.
  • Expérience approfondie de l’analyse de vastes ensembles d’enjeux stratégiques et de données complexes en constante évolution, et capacité à les communiquer de manière concise, en veillant à la clarté pour différents publics, y compris les hauts dirigeants.
  • Maîtrise du traitement et de l’analyse des données sur des systèmes d’information ou des bases de données de gestion et Excel.
  • Excellentes connaissances et capacité à appliquer des techniques de recherche efficaces aux enjeux liés à l’IA.
  • Expérience avérée de collaboration avec des partenaires des Premières Nations, ainsi qu’avec les gouvernements et responsables fédéraux, provinciaux, territoriaux, internationaux, du Nord et des municipalités.
  • Compétences interpersonnelles, esprit d’équipe et jugement avérés.
  • Diplomatie, tact et capacité à prendre des décisions (les décisions sont stratégiques, complexes et peuvent avoir des conséquences et une incidence de grande portée).
  • Compétences en matière de planification et d’organisation; capacité à mener efficacement plusieurs tâches de front tout en travaillant sous pression avec des échéances concurrentes.
  • L’anglais est la langue de travail, mais la capacité à travailler dans les deux langues officielles (anglais/français) constitue un atout. La maîtrise d’une langue des Premières Nations constitue également un atout.


Énoncé relatif à la diversité

Les personnes qualifiées d’ascendance autochtone se verront accorder la préférence conformément à l’article 16(1) de la Loi canadienne sur les droits de la personne.


Pourquoi travailler pour l’APN?

À l’Assemblée des Premières Nations (APN), nous sommes conscients de l’importance de nos employés et nous sommes déterminés à maintenir un milieu de travail favorable, stimulant et gratifiant. En vous joignant à notre équipe, vous bénéficierez des avantages suivants :

  • Primes d’assurance maladie payées par l’employeur – Une couverture complète des soins de santé, des soins dentaires et des soins de la vue pour vous et votre famille, dont les primes sont entièrement payées par l’APN.
  • Un régime complémentaire de retraite généreux – Un régime de retraite compétitif avec des cotisations importantes de l’employeur pour vous aider à bâtir votre avenir.
  • De nombreux jours de congé annuel, congé de maladie et congé personnel – Un congé annuel, un congé de maladie payé et un congé personnel généreux, ainsi que des jours de congé supplémentaires non prévus par la loi tout au long de l’année.
  • Soutien au perfectionnement professionnel – Prise en charge de cours, de certifications et de formations pour vous aider à développer vos compétences et à progresser dans votre carrière.
  • Fonds de mieux-être – Des fonds annuels que vous pouvez utiliser pour le conditionnement physique, un soutien en santé mentale ou d’autres dépenses liées au mieux-être.
  • Emplacement central et moderne – Nos bureaux lumineux et collaboratifs sont situés dans l’édifice Sun Life, au centre-ville d’Ottawa. La station de train léger sur rail (TLR) Parlement est située dans l’édifice, ce qui facilite les trajets quotidiens.
  • Commodité – À quelques pas des cafés, restaurants et magasins du centre-ville.
  • Un travail enrichissant – Faites partie d’une organisation nationale qui défend les intérêts des Premières Nations et qui améliore le quotidien des communautés partout au Canada.
  • Culture axée sur la collaboration et l’inclusion – Travaillez aux côtés de collègues passionnés et dévoués dans un environnement dynamique et solidaire.

Énoncé relatif à l’accommodement

L’Assemblée des Premières Nations (APN) s’engage à maintenir un processus de sélection et un milieu de travail inclusifs. Si vous avez besoin de mesures d’adaptation durant le processus de recrutement, veuillez en informer l’agent(e) des ressources humaines au moment où un entretien vous sera proposé.

Nous remercions tous les candidats de leur intérêt, mais nous ne communiquerons qu’avec les personnes présélectionnées en vue d’une entrevue.

title: Data Engineer
location: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
description:
Introduction:

DataProphet is a global leader in Artificial Intelligence (AI) for manufacturing. Our award winning technology embeds unique adaptations and advancements of deep learning, enabling AI to have a significant, practical, impact on the factory floor. DataProphet’s solutions are built to be adapted and integrated into existing environments, making it possible for our digital transformation team to take your operations from zero to AI. We understand manufacturing and that real impact is achieved with pre-emptive actions because real-time is often too late. For more information, visit Why join DataProphet?

You'll work on technically challenging problems where AI moves beyond experimentation and creates measurable real-world impact.

You'll have meaningful ownership, work alongside highly capable colleagues across Data Science and Engineering, and have the opportunity to apply your skills across new problems, use cases and domains.

Curiosity, continuous learning and collaboration are central to how we work. Our team works together from our DeWaterkant, Cape Town office in a professional, supportive environment designed to help people do their best work.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a
Data Engineer to design, build and maintain the data infrastructure and pipelines that enable DataProphet's AI solutions.

You will work with complex and varied data sources and be responsible for making data reliable, accessible and usable by Data Scientists, machine learning systems and other downstream consumers.


Roles and responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

  • Design, build, test and maintain scalable production data pipelines & infrastructure..
  • Own data pipelines end-to-end across ingestion, transformation, storage and delivery.
  • Integrate data from varied source systems into DataProphet's data environment.
  • Build reliable, clean and usable datasets for Data Scientists, machine learning systems and other stakeholders.
  • Design and maintain appropriate data models and data warehouse / lakehouse structures.
  • Implement data quality validation, monitoring and alerting.
  • Diagnose and resolve pipeline failures and data-quality issues.
  • Build prototypes and proof-of-concept solutions where required.
  • Evaluate hardware, software and cloud solutions for building and integrating systems & data warehouses.
  • Contribute to data & system architecture and design.
  • Integrate new data management technologies and software engineering tools into existing structures and create custom software components and analytics applications.
  • Install and update disaster recovery procedures.


Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor's / Honours / Master’s / PhD Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of experience building and maintaining production data infrastructure.
  • Track record of owning features end-to-end: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and post-release support
  • Demonstrated experience owning data pipelines from ingestion through transformation, storage and downstream delivery.
  • Experience working with data quality, monitoring and incident response.
  • Relevant technical or cloud certifications are advantageous.


Core skills

  • Strong SQL and Python skills, with the ability to write production-grade, maintainable and testable code.
  • Strong understanding of data modelling, data warehousing and modern data architecture.
  • Experience building and orchestrating production data pipelines using tools such as Airflow, Dagster, Apache Spark or Prefect.
  • Experience with version control tools such as Git and collaborative development
  • Familiarity with modern data platforms like Databricks, ClickHouse, Snowflake, or DuckDB .
  • Experience with data transformation frameworks.
  • Experience working with at least one major cloud platform — AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Understanding of data quality, testing, monitoring and observability.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices for data pipelines as well as production concerns (logging, monitoring, performance, security).
  • Ability to translate loosely defined data requirements into effective data engineering solutions.
  • Exposure to distributed processing technologies such as Apache Spark, streaming technologies such as Kafka or Kinesis, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.
  • Familiarity with networking performance, design and tradeoffs.
  • Comfort reading and adapting to unfamiliar codebases.
  • Solid grasp of system design at a component level (can design a service or module, not just a function).
  • Can break down a loosely defined problems into a technical plans.

title: U02 - Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Backend Engineer to design and build high‑performance, scalable, and resilient backend services using Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and Microservices architecture. The ideal candidate has strong engineering fundamentals, deep understanding of distributed systems, and hands-on experience delivering enterprise applications in fast‑paced, highly regulated environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Java 11/17, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and modern JVM patterns.
  • Build microservices following clean architecture, domain-driven design (DDD), and asynchronous design principles.
  • Implement RESTful APIs, event-driven components, and backend modules that meet business and technical requirements.
  • Optimize backend systems for performance, scalability, fault tolerance, and low latency.
  • Design and implement event-driven flows using Kafka (producers, consumers, partitions, schema management).
  • Ensure message integrity, idempotency, retries, dead-letter queue strategies, and exactly-once/at-least-once processing where applicable.
  • Build streaming and asynchronous integrations to support real-time and near real-time use cases.
  • Work with relational and NoSQL data stores (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, Redis).
  • Design data models, queries, and schemas optimized for performance and maintainability.
  • Integrate backend services with internal/external systems using REST, events, or batch interfaces.
  • Implement robust automated tests (unit, integration, contract, performance) using JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers, etc.
  • Ensure observability through logging, metrics, and distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Conduct code reviews, improve code quality, and enforce engineering best practices.
  • Work closely with DevOps to build CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps).
  • Deploy and troubleshoot services on container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes/OpenShift).
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code and automation initiatives.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to knowledge-sharing and technical excellence across the team.
  • Collaborate with Product, QA, Architecture, and other engineering teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Participate in solution design discussions, architecture reviews, and technical decision-making.

Qualifications

  • 6–10 years of backend engineering experience, preferably in large-scale enterprise systems.
  • Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

Strong proficiency in:

  • Java 11/17, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud
  • Kafka (event-driven systems, streaming patterns)
  • Microservices architecture, API design, distributed systems
  • RDBMS (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL)
  • NoSQL stores (MongoDB, Redis)
  • Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift
  • CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native delivery
  • Nice to Have
  • Experience in banking/payments or other mission-critical environments.
  • Familiarity with performance tuning (JVM, GC, load testing tools such as JMeter/Gatling).
  • Exposure to messaging systems (RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ) or additional streaming platforms.
  • Knowledge of security best practices (OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, secrets management).
