title: Health and Safety Coordinator
description:
At ProSlide, we are committed to fostering a culture where health, safety, and wellbeing are integrated into everything we do. Reporting to the Manager of Talent & Culture, the Health and Safety Coordinator will serve as the organization's health and safety subject matter expert, supporting both our Ottawa head office and international construction and commissioning projects. The successful candidate will be passionate about promoting a safety-first culture, developing effective health and safety programs, and influencing safe work practices across office, field, and project teams globally.

Number of vacancies for this role: 1

YOUR CHALLENGE:


  • Champion a safety-first culture across the organization with a focus on compliance and continuous improvement.
  • Develop, maintain, and communicate HSE policies, procedures, standards, and best-practice guidance in alignment with applicable legislation and industry practices.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement, emerging risks, training needs, and opportunities to strengthen safety performance across the organization.
  • Lead the Joint Health and Safety Committee. Coordinate meetings, agendas, minutes, inspections, recommendations, and follow-up actions.
  • Oversee and investigate incidents and support modified work programs as required.
  • Oversee day-to-day H&S requirements for ProSlide’s Head Office and Pro Lab facilities
  • Conduct regular office and Pro Lab health and safety inspections and coordinate corrective actions.
  • Support the development, maintenance, and testing of workplace emergency and evacuation plans.
  • Participate in pre-deployment meetings for team members throughout the project cycle.
  • Ensure employees travelling to international projects to receive appropriate safety information and training before deployment.
  • Partners with the Global Field Services and RV Commissioning teams to support the safe deployment of our team members across the world.
  • Support the Project Management team with the development of health and safety documentation specific to their projects, providing advice and support for all HSE items for a safe and successful project.
  • Maintain accurate H&S training and competency records, certifications, and renewals.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE ROLE:


  • Post-secondary education of a degree or diploma in Occupational Health & Safety and Environment or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in an HSE-related role, ideally within the construction industry.
  • A strong understanding of provincial regulations and programs, knowledge of international legislation is considered an asset.
  • Certified Canadian Registered Safety Professional (CRSP) or Certified Health and Safety Consultant (CHSC) considered a desired asset.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interact with employees at all levels in various locations.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:


  • Expected salary range: $60,000-$80,000
  • 3 weeks paid vacation
  • Company-paid extended health and dental benefits
  • Annual Wellness Wallet
  • Bonus eligibility
  • RRSP matching (after 1 year of service)
  • Free outdoor parking

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:


Human-led Hiring

title: Junior Consultant
description:
Job Description


Are you someone passionate about reshaping the mining industry through social and environmental practices into Life of Mine plans?


If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you. We’re growing in the North American region and are on the lookout for an ambitious Junior Consultant (Engineer or Scientist) to join our dynamic team. Come be a part of a visionary journey that is all about making a positive impact. This role is open to our Calgary office.


At Okane, we believe that integrated mine closure planning is just the starting point to ‘Help Create a Better Tomorrow’. We work with mining companies to return land responsibly and safely, enabling what comes next to serve both people and the planet. Our work challenges the status quo - we advocate for meaningful partnerships with communities, including Indigenous rightsholders, and design solutions that create lasting financial, environmental, and social value. From early-stage planning through to relinquishment, we’re helping reshape the future of mining, and we’re looking for people who want to be part of that transformation.


Responsibilities:

In this role, you will work closely with our interdisciplinary technical teams on projects that span diverse sites with unique challenges to support the development of practical solutions.


Your work will include:

  • Collaborate design work and project scopes with multidisciplinary teams (ie: geoscience, geotechnical, hydrological and geochemical) to ensure optimized feasible mine closure plan and to gain consensus among stakeholders and collaborate towards shared goals.
  • Prepare proficient technical documentation and reporting in area of technical discipline. Prepare or review detailed work scopes for proposals relating to technical discipline.
  • Complete simulations of mine closure and risk assessment conditions for a given model domain development through robust conceptual analysis.
  • Complete background reviews in support of conceptual model development.
  • Foster and maintain client relationships.
  • Plan and complete field investigations such as material sampling programs and construction QA/QC projects.
  • Empathize with stakeholders and communities affected by mining operations and work to address their concerns with sensitivity and understanding.
  • Take ownership of tasks, seek out opportunities for improvement and contribute positively to team efforts.
  • Actively participate in development of workshops, including development of materials.
  • Ensure the highest commitment to ethical behavior, integrity, and transparency in all interactions, particularly when dealing with stakeholders and sensitive environmental issues.
  • Willingness to continuously learn and expand knowledge in technical discipline, regulatory requirements, and stakeholder engagement practices.
  • Ability to analyze environmental data, including soil and water quality data, to inform reclamation plans and closure strategies.
  • Junior-level project management skills to assist in planning, organizing, and executing reclamation and closure projects.


Qualifications:


  • Educational background in environmental, civil, geotechnical or mining engineering, earth sciences, environmental science or geology is an asset.
  • Experience working in professional services or within the mining industry is an asset.
  • Knowledge of environmental principles, regulations, and best practices related to mine reclamation and closure.
  • Genuine interest in environmental sustainability and a commitment to mitigating the environmental impacts of mining activities.
  • Experience in engaging with local communities, stakeholders, and regulators to gather input, address concerns, and build relationships is an asset.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills to convey technical information clearly and effectively to diverse audiences.
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify issues, evaluate options, and develop practical solutions in reclamation and closure planning.
  • Understanding the environmental regulations and permitting requirements relevant to mine reclamation and closure activities could be considered an asset.
  • Experience in facilitating workshops or meetings to develop closure visions with input from various stakeholders considered an asset.
  • Ability to remain resilient and composed under pressure, while maintaining professionalism and focus on achieving project objectives.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities, project requirements, and stakeholder expectations in a dynamic work environment.
  • Meticulous attention to detail to ensure accuracy and precision in data analysis, reporting, and project documentation.


Why Join Okane?

At Okane, we're committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, where every individual is valued for their unique contributions. Our dedicated teams span across the globe, connecting people from diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

Our workplace culture is defined by the everyday behaviors of our team and driven by our Core Values: Passionate, Thoughtful & Caring, Smart & Clever, Positive and Humble. We believe in flexibility, work-life balance, and an open-door approach to communication.

We believe in personal and professional development, offering opportunities for continuous learning and growth. At Okane, we foster the opportunity for everyone to grow and develop their skills that align with their career path. As we continue to expand our global presence, we're looking for individuals who share our values and are dedicated to making a positive impact in the world.


How to Apply:

If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact in the mining industry and contribute to sustainable land stewardship, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your experience and why you’re a great fit for this role by September 15th, 2026. Please note that only those candidates who are selected will be contacted.

If you require an adjustment during the recruitment/interview process, please let the HR team know, and we will work with you to meet your needs. For more information about Inclusion, Diversity & Equity at Okane, please click here: Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion • Okane Consultants.

title: Host
description:
The Restaurant Host/Cashier is the first point of contact for guests, creating a positive and welcoming first impression. They are responsible for greeting and seating guests, managing reservations, processing payments, and ensuring a smooth and efficient dining experience.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Guest Reception and Seating:
    • Greet guests warmly and professionally upon arrival.
    • Manage the waitlist and seat guests in a timely and efficient manner.
    • Escort guests to their tables, providing menus and any necessary information.
  • Cashier Duties:
    • Process guest payments accurately and efficiently, using the restaurant's point-of-sale (POS) system.

  • Order Input & Menu Knowledge

    • Possess thorough knowledge of the menu, including ingredients, preparation methods and potential allergens to effectively answer guest inquiries
  • Front of House Organization:

  • Physical Requirements: Ability to stand for extended periods of time, walk, and occasionally lift and carry up to 20 pounds.

title: IT Specialist - DSP
description:
Aspire Software is looking for an IT Specialist to join our team in Lebanon.

Here is a little window into our company: Aspire Software operates and manages wholly owned software companies, providing mission-critical solutions across multiple verticals. By implementing industry best practices, Aspire delivers a time sensitive integration process, and the operation of a decentralized model has allowed it to become a hub for creating rapid growth by reinvesting in its portfolio.

POSITION DESCRIPTION:

This role owns the full employee technology lifecycle — from provisioning laptops and accounts for new hires, to day-to-day helpdesk support, to securely decommissioning devices and access when employees leave. The person in this role will work closely with onboarding and offboarding, will serve as the primary point of contact for all end-user IT needs across the company, and will play a key role in helping maintain SOC 2 certification.

Key Responsibilities

Onboarding & Offboarding (HR Systems Support)

  • Partner with HR/People Operations on every new hire, transfer, and termination to ensure IT tasks are completed on schedule.
  • Create, configure, and deactivate user accounts across company systems (e.g., Microsoft 365, Slack, Teams, HRIS-linked tools) as part of onboarding and offboarding.
  • For systems managed internally by Dispatch employees, notify the designated internal system owner when an employee is being onboarded or offboarded so access can be added or removed on schedule, and track that each notification is acted on.
  • Maintain an accurate, up-to-date record of who has access to which systems, and audit that terminated employees' access has been fully removed from all systems.
  • Coordinate first-day-ready setup for new hires: hardware, accounts, credentials, and a welcome/orientation walkthrough of company systems.

Device & Hardware Lifecycle Management

  • Provision laptops and equipment for new hires and as replacement/upgrade needs arise for existing employees.
  • Research, recommend, and assist HR/Finance with purchasing laptops and other hardware, including vendor comparisons and quotes.
  • Maintain an inventory of company-owned devices, including assignment history, warranty status, and lifecycle/refresh planning.
  • Image, configure, and enroll new devices in company device management/MDM tools prior to distribution.
  • Manage return, wipe, and redeployment of devices from departing employees.

Helpdesk & End-User Support

  • Serve as the first point of contact for employee IT tickets and requests (e.g., WiFi connectivity issues, password resets, account lockouts, hardware/software troubleshooting).
  • Triage, track, and resolve tickets in a timely manner, escalating to specialized vendors or Dispatch's engineering team when needed.
  • Provide basic training/guidance to employees on company systems and IT best practices.

Security, Patch & Compliance Monitoring

  • Monitor company devices for outstanding software/OS updates and push patch notifications to keep all endpoints current.
  • Monitor endpoint/device management tools to detect when a company-owned device appears to have become a personal device (e.g., ownership or enrollment status change) and take steps to bring it back into compliance or remove it from company systems.
  • Monitor security alerts and triage findings; provide initial incident response support and escalate critical threats to the engineering team as needed.
  • Send remote lock or wipe commands to company devices as needed for terminations, lost/stolen equipment, or security incidents.
  • Support company security tools already in place (e.g., endpoint protection, password management) and respond to related alerts.

Systems Administration & Vendor Coordination

  • Administer and support 20+ business-critical applications, including day-to-day administration, access provisioning, and user support.
  • Serve as the point of contact for third-party vendors that support specific systems, ensuring smooth vendor coordination and issue escalation.
  • Maintain documentation of system configurations, access procedures, and IT processes.

SOC 2 Compliance Support

  • Support Dispatch's SOC 2 certification effort by helping implement and document the technical controls auditors expect (access controls, onboarding/offboarding evidence, device encryption and patch status, password/MFA policies, backup and monitoring configurations).
  • Own ongoing evidence collection for IT-related controls — access reviews, termination checklists, patch/vulnerability reports, device inventory, and security monitoring logs — and keep it organized for audit periods.
  • Partner with leadership, HR, and any outside compliance/audit consultants to close gaps identified during SOC 2 readiness assessments and respond to auditor requests.
  • Help maintain IT security policies and procedures (access control, acceptable use, incident response, asset management) required for SOC 2, and keep them current as systems change.
  • Conduct periodic access reviews across company systems to confirm permissions match current employment status and role, flagging and remediating discrepancies.
  • Support the annual (or ongoing) SOC 2 audit cycle once certified, including recurring evidence requests and control testing.

Requirements

  • Experience in an IT support, systems administration, or helpdesk role, ideally supporting a company of similar size.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 administration and endpoint/MDM tools.
  • Experience with onboarding/offboarding processes and coordinating access changes across multiple systems and stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with password management tools, security awareness platforms, and endpoint protection tools.
  • Experience supporting SOC 2 (or similar compliance framework, e.g., ISO 27001) readiness or audits, including evidence collection and control documentation — direct SOC 2 audit experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with non-technical employees and HR/People Operations.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and tickets independently with minimal supervision.
  • Preferred: Experience with GDC or other global shared service centers managing end-user IT support across distributed teams.

title: SERVICE TECHNICIAN
description:

MASTER APPLIANCE SERVICE TECHNICIAN: $31.07 PER HOUR $64,625.60 YEARLY


JOB SUMMARY: This position will learn from on-the-job training, computer based training and classroom instruction in the processes maintaining the Okaloosa Gas Districts’ natural gas systems. Learns the fundamentals of Meter Maintenance Procedures (Reading, Removals, Cut Offs, Pull meters, and Cut and Caps), Emergency Procedures (Gas leaks, Carbon Monoxide Investigations and Structure fires), and After the Meter Procedures (Turn On, Relight, Meter set, Heat & Gas Inspections).


APPRENTICESHIPS (May be offered to eligible candidates without the minimum experience for the Technician I and above):

An Apprenticeship is an entry-level training position. Certain training milestones must be met before being qualified for a higher position. This position will learn from on-the-job training, computer-based training and classroom instruction in the processes maintaining the Okaloosa Gas Districts’ natural gas systems. Learns the fundamentals of Meter Maintenance Procedures (Reading, Removals, Cut Offs, Pull meters, and Cut and Caps), Emergency Procedures (Gas leaks, Carbon Monoxide Investigations and Structure fires), and After the Meter Procedures (Turn On, Relight, Meter set, Heat & Gas Inspections).

Apprentices have up to 12 months to accomplish training milestones required of this position to include all Operator Qualification requirements. Failure to do so could affect employment.


Incumbents in this position will be held to the District’s Gold Standard for Customer Service.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Maintains the District’s natural gas systems from the riser to the private owner’s house piping. This would include regulators, meter bars, meters, piping and fittings.
  2. Meter Maintenance Procedures: Maintains and repairs meter sets. Completes meter reads, removals, pulls meters and assists with Cut and Caps.
  3. After the Meter Procedures: Turns gas service on to new and existing customers. Sets Meters on new and existing homes and businesses. Performs Heat & Gas Inspections for our Senior Citizens and other natural gas customers.
  4. Conducts pressure checks to ensure structure piping is free of leaks and set to the correct operating service pressure.
  5. Conducts routine checks of all gas appliances before leaving premises to ensure all appliances and piping are operational and safe.
  6. Emergency Response Calls: Aides our first responder to inside natural gas leak and carbon monoxide calls. Isolates and/or repairs gas leaks. Inspects carbon monoxide calls and identifies any defective natural gas appliances in the home or structure.

***Ensuring our customers safety is our top priority***

  1. Assists in the Servicing and repair of natural gas tank water heaters, to include estimates for replacement.
  2. Maintains natural gas tankless water heaters through de-scaling (de-lime) procedures.
  3. Trains on natural gas appliance services when time and work load allows in preparation for Service Technician career advancement and further natural gas knowledge.
  4. Completes required automated forms to document materials used and completion of work orders.
  5. Documents condition tags, door knockers, parts requests, and other misc. forms used in the course of daily duties.
  6. Safely and responsibly operates the District’s automotive vehicles. Maintains vehicles used through appropriate operator maintenance and keeps vehicles clean and neat at all times.
  7. Maintains control of inventory items obtained from stock or carried on truck.
  8. Maintains tools and equipment in a clean and workable condition.
  9. Provides assistance to other Okaloosa Gas District Departments as directed by the Service Supervisor.
  10. Other duties as assigned.


The preceding is intended to describe the general content of and requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements. The principal duties and responsibilities enumerated are all essential job functions.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

High School plus one to three years of experience.


ESSENTIAL COMPETENCIES:

  1. Oral and written communication skills; capability to listen and understand instructions and/or details to resolve customer trouble calls.
  2. Displayed skills to work effectively and cooperatively with a diverse team of coworkers, and internal/external customers within a team environment.
  3. Ability to safely operate company supplied vehicles and equipment.
  4. Knowledge of and performance of relevant safety procedures associated with natural gas and natural gas appliances.
  5. Interpersonal skills to deal with various personality types in less than ideal circumstances.
  6. Ability to schedule leave time wisely and efficiently. Uses the leave calendar for scheduled doctor’s appointments and other requested leave including annual and personal leave.
  7. This position requires knowledge and task evaluation as determined by Pipeline and Hazardous Material Safety Administration rule CFR 49, Part 192; Subpart N: Operator Qualifications (OQ).


TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIRED:

  1. Ability to use a computer, smart phone and skills to process computer data.
  2. Capacity to develop mechanical, plumbing, electrical and pipefitting skills to complete assigned tasks relative to equipment and systems in a safe and efficient manner.
  3. Basic mechanical and piping skills required to maintain natural gas piping systems.
  4. Knowledge of District O&M procedures, local building codes, Southern Building Code, FHA and VA requirements.
  5. Ability to read and understand blueprints and maps.
  6. Capacity to perform multiple tasks with limited supervision in often confining, cramped spaces.


OTHER FACTORS:

  1. Must possess and maintain valid Florida driver’s license and a driving record satisfactory to the District and its insurers.
  2. Must be appropriately dressed in a clean and neat District authorized uniform during work hours.
  3. Regular attendance is essential. May be required to work other than normal work schedule. May be required to work overtime or extended hours with little to no notice.
  4. Physical Effort: Requires bending, stooping, crawling, climbing and moderate lifting. Must be capable of working from ladders and elevated areas.
  5. Working Conditions and Hazards: Works inside and outside. Exposed to rain and seasonal weather extremes. Exposed to fires, toxic fumes, electrical shocks from high voltage, and dog bites. Must be able to work with power tools and other hazardous equipment. Confined spaces including attics and crawl spaces.
  6. DRUG TESTING FOR ILLEGAL DRUGS: Employees in this classification will be subject to undergo testing for illegal drugs in accordance with DOT Pipeline Safety Regulations, Code of Federal Regulation, Title 40 (49 CFR), Part 199.

title: CAD & Computational Geometry Expert (Python / 3D Modeling)
description:

Gramian Consultancy is a boutique consultancy specializing in IT professional services and engineering talent solutions. With a strong background in software engineering and leadership, we help companies build high-performing teams by matching them with professionals who truly fit their needs.

We are looking for experienced technical professionals who can interpret dimensioned engineering drawings and reproduce them as precise 3D solid models. The work may involve complex curved geometry, programmatic CAD generation, STEP export, and detailed validation against geometric and physical requirements.

This is not a general hardware-support or electronics role. Strong CAD, spatial reasoning, geometry, and technical problem-solving skills are essential.

  • Use Python to generate or automate CAD models.

  • Validate dimensions, topology, volume, surface area, and inertia properties.

Requirements

  • Strong 3D spatial reasoning and understanding of geometric relationships.

title: State Capacity Lead, India
description:
State Capacity (Senior) Manager, India

Location: Delhi, India


The Opportunity

Building the capacity of the Indian state is one of the most consequential problems in global development. Governments at every level are making decisions that affect hundreds of millions of people. The quality of those decisions depends on whether the right data, evidence, and institutional capabilities are in place.

As State Capacity Lead, you will develop and hold relationships with senior leaders at influential government institutions and use them to drive reforms that actually stick. You will advise on governance reforms, improving public financial management, developing economic growth strategies, and above all, enabling governments to benefit from cutting-edge digital and AI innovations.

This role sits at the intersection of several things we think matter: governance reform, economic growth, and the use of AI in government, a space that is moving fast and where good judgment is crucial. You would be working with institutions like the Capacity Building Commission as well as planning and other departments across several key states, alongside a team that takes the analytical side of this work seriously.

This is a senior role with autonomy and agency. You would be shaping what we work on, and then driving a high-performing, motivated team towards delivering success.



About IDinsight

IDinsight is a global advisory, data analytics, and research organisation. We work with governments, foundations, and nonprofits across Asia and Africa, helping decision-makers use data and evidence to design better programmes and allocate resources more effectively. Our team of roughly 240 - including economists, data scientists, statisticians, and policy specialists - operates across nearly two dozen countries.

More at.



About our goverance portfolio in India

We have been working with state and central Indian government organizations for about 13 years. Here are a few examples of what we are currently doing:

  • Mission Karmayogi: We are the M&E partner for the civil service reform programme, working with the Capacity Building Commission and Karmayogi Bharat on how to measure and improve public sector capability.
  • Uttar Pradesh Planning Department: We are helping the department build the tools to track economic activity in real time, alongside efforts to strengthen the department's own analytical capacity.
  • Madhya Pradesh New and Renewable Energy Department: We are helping the department identify optimal locations for solar parks within the state by using data science to find contiguous patches of land which do not have water bodies, human settlements, agricultural land, and unfavourable elevation.

We have also worked with governments in Punjab, Telangana, Bihar, Odisha, Delhi, and Meghalaya, and with NITI Aayog on the Aspirational Districts Programme and the National Data and Analytics Platform. Our work in this space is funded by leading funders such as the Gates Foundation, MSDF, Co-Impact, and the Veddis Foundation.


What the job actually involves

The core of it is senior government relationships - being someone that senior government decision-makers want to call when they are thinking through a hard problem. That takes time to build and requires showing up consistently, understanding the institutional context, and being honest about what the evidence does and does not support.


Beyond that:

Advisory work across several domains. Our state capacity engagements touch governance reform, PFM, economic growth strategy, and increasingly AI in government. You would need to be credible and informed across these areas. Not necessarily a technical expert in all of them, but someone who can engage seriously and bring in the right people when needed.

AI and government. There is a lot of noise here, which can drown out the signal. Part of the role is helping government partners think carefully about where AI can genuinely improve how they work - in service delivery, financial management, planning - and where the institutional groundwork is not yet there.

Practice development, You would work with IDinsight India leadership on shaping what the portfolio looks like over time - which governments we engage with, what kinds of problems we take on, where we should be building deeper expertise.

Team leadership. You would manage a team of Associate Directors, Managers and Associates and be responsible for their professional development. The team does serious analytical work, and part of your job is creating the conditions for that to happen well.

Project management. This involves owning and managing timelines, budgets, and funder reporting across several projects.


Who we are looking for

Someone with 12-15 years of experience, a meaningful portion of which has been spent working with or inside the government. You do not need to have done every type of engagement we do, but you should have a genuine feel for how government institutions work - where decisions actually get made, what makes a reform stick, why good ideas often do not survive contact with implementation.


Beyond that - strong analytical instincts, comfort with data and evidence, and the kind of presence that earns trust with senior officials. You should be someone who can hold a room with a senior secretary and also give a junior team member clear, honest feedback on their work.


A Master's in public policy, economics, or public administration is preferred, but what matters more is the quality of your experience.



A note on culture

IDinsight is not a large bureaucracy. Things move, priorities shift, and you'll sometimes be asked to figure things out without a clear playbook. People who do well here tend to be intellectually curious, be comfortable with ambiguity, have a sense of humour, and be genuinely motivated by the mission.

We invest seriously in professional development - mentorship, real-time feedback, and enough autonomy that growth is possible if you want it.



Nuts and Bolts

Location: Delhi, with regular travel across India


Start date: As soon as possible


Compensation: Competitive within the global development sector, and commensurate with experience



How to apply

Please click the "Apply for this job online" button at the top right. The application asks various questions in order for us to get to know you and requires a CV. Please note that we will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis.

Please ensure that your CV includes relevant professional and personal experience as well as details on academic qualifications. CVs can range from one to two pages. Please note that headshot photographs, parental details, birth dates, marital status, and other personal information not relevant to the application do not need to be included in your CV.

If you’ve previously applied to an IDinsight role, we encourage you to reapply only if you’ve gained additional relevant experience to strengthen your application since your previous application.



IDinsight’s commitment to reducing power asymmetries

IDinsight is committed to reducing power asymmetries in the social sector. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion reflects our understanding of the need for the sector to abandon unhealthy practices of the past. We wish to be part of a new generation of international NGOs who are honest about this history and transparent about our role in the present. Our commitment is also aligned with the impact of our work.

We seek a diverse workforce that inherently embodies our commitment to fostering inclusivity. This also helps us refine and improve our methods and relationships and strengthen the services we provide our clients and their communities or constituencies. The following commitments represent our vision for the IDinsight team:

  1. IDinsight will have greater representation from the populations with whom we work and the clients we serve.
  2. IDinsight will have greater representation from the countries in which we work.
  3. Across all countries in which we recruit, we will seek greater representation from historically excluded communities.
  4. IDinsight will foster an inclusive work culture that empowers a diverse team to do their best work.

IDinsight is committed to non-discrimination in our recruitment, employment practices, and organizational culture, regardless of people’s age, disability, gender identity, national origin, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law.

title: Full-Time Permanent Chiropodist

The Humber River Family Health Team (HRFHT) is a non-profit organization providing interdisciplinary, patient-centred primary care to optimize individual and family health within the community.

  • B.Sc. and licensing/registration by the College of Chiropodists of Ontario.

Please forward your resume to hiring@hrfht.com, quoting “HRFHT Full-Time Chiropodist” in the subject line. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Senior Estimator - Industrial Construction
description:
The Weitz Company is seeking a Senior Estimator to join our Industrial team in Des Moines, IA! The ideal candidate will have extensive industrial experience. Power, Manufacturing, and Heavy Industrial experience preferred.

​The Senior Estimator is responsible for all preconstruction cost control functions for construction projects including complete estimates, cost analysis, comparisons, assisting with feasibility studies, and historical cost reports. This individual is capable of performing cost control functions on multiple projects of varying complexity simultaneously. Additionally, this role may take the lead role in preconstruction efforts. Typically, the Senior Estimator reports to the Chief Estimator and may have estimators reporting directly to him/her on assigned project(s).

We believe our employees to be our most valuable asset, and we are committed to growing a diverse and inclusive culture that inspires, motivates, and continuously improves.

What You’ll Do:

  • Review all estimates for accuracy, detail, and expectations
  • Review project plans, requirements, and specifications to develop a comprehensive understanding of the project and develop the scope of work, labor, and equipment costs
  • Prepare quantity takeoffs and pricing of scope either through self-perform production-based estimates or unit price estimating
  • Contact local building trades, subcontractors, suppliers, government offices, etc., to understand and verify local market conditions, trade practices, and costs
  • Analyze manpower and equipment requirements for specific self-perform operations
  • Visit project sites to evaluate existing conditions, identify and capture scope not included in design documents
  • Prepare quantity surveys and unit pricing sheets for subcontractors’ completion and submission of unit price data
  • Prepare bid analysis scope sheets and review subcontractor cost proposals to ensure bid proposals are complete
  • Prepare and enter estimate data in WinEst, including estimate breakdowns and alternates
  • Prepare trade partner bid proposal forms and bid recording sheets for assigned trades, evaluate trade partner input for scope inclusion, identify scope gaps and overlaps, and coordinate with other staff managing trades
  • Understand the impact of general conditions and contract language; review with the project team
  • Coordinate building systems and schedules with Operations to plan and budget for safety on each project
  • Utilize conceptual estimating skills and identify items required for complete systems, even if not outlined on construction documents
  • Make decisions in a timely manner; understand when to involve upper management in decisions; assess the level of risk and consequences associated
  • Understand the clients’ needs to manage the process efficiently, ensure timely completion, understand local logistics/subcontractor and supplier market, and how BIM/LEED/LEAN can be best utilized
  • Prioritize safety and communicate safety requirements to the team
  • Assist with certain post-bid buyouts
  • Initiate and participate in meet-and-greet presentations with subcontractors and suppliers

  • Education:
    • Bachelor's Degree from an accredited degree program in Engineering, Construction Management, Building Construction, or similar
  • Experience:
    • Ten years of estimating responsibility is required for this position. Experience with formal presentations and supervising staff is helpful

    • This position requires excellent conceptual estimating skills and the ability to identify items required for complete systems, even if not delineated on construction documents
    • The ability to mentally schedule and construct a building from drawings is essential
    • Excellent computer skills are important, as is the ability to quickly learn, articulate, and apply new applications as the industry grows and changes
    • Must have the ability to communicate in a professional and courteous manner with clients, architects, subcontractors, suppliers, and project teams
    • Organization, quick creative thinking, and the ability to balance and prioritize projects with impending deadlines are essential
    • The ideal candidate will be a great communicator with a strong track record of providing accurate estimating services
    • A qualified candidate will be able to compare and analyze various systems and related cost impacts, as well as possess solid leadership skills and the ability to coach direct reports
    • Ability to read, understand, and interpret contract documents, drawings, specifications, scopes of work, and project schedules
    • Extensive knowledge of estimating documents and the ability to provide accurate qualitative and quantitative analysis of documents
    • Conceptual ability, able to work with minimal information and quickly develop an understanding of owner/architect requirements
    • Project management of competing demands and meeting established deadlines
  • Technology:
    • Proficient in basic computer software including Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Outlook
    • Knowledge of On-Screen Takeoff, Bluebeam, or similar quantity takeoff software is a plus
    • Ability to learn specific job-related software upon hire

What We Offer:

  • Rewarding Bonus Program
  • Comprehensive Benefits Package with Tax-Advantaged HSA and FSA offerings
  • Employer-Paid Short- and Long-Term Disability Programs
  • Employer-Paid Life Insurance

  • Tuition Reimbursement

  • Voluntary Products Including: Critical Illness Insurance and Accident Insurance
  • Corporate Wellness Program with Wellness Time Off and Rewards

title: Interim Global Director of Ecommerce
description:
The Role

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Interim Global Director of Ecommerce to join Hårklinikken during an important period of growth and development.


The immediate focus of the role is to ensure strong execution, commercial performance and momentum across our global ecommerce business. You will step into an existing digital setup and take responsibility for driving key initiatives forward across ecommerce, performance marketing, CRM and retention, digital customer experience and our external digital partners.


You will work across our six Shopify websites and global markets, with the US being a particularly important focus, and help ensure that our key ecommerce KPIs – including customer acquisition, conversion, AOV, retention, LTV, CAC and profitability – remain closely managed and continuously improved.


This is a role for someone who can quickly get under the skin of the business, create structure and clear priorities, and move seamlessly between performance analysis, project management and hands-on execution.


Speed is important in this role. We are looking for someone with a strong bias towards action, who is comfortable making informed decisions, moving quickly from insight to execution and maintaining a high level of quality along the way.


Primary Relationships

You will work closely with the wider Brand & Marketing team as well as senior stakeholders across the business.

You will also manage key external partners, including website development, technology, CRM and paid media agencies, ensuring strong coordination, clear priorities and timely delivery.


Key Responsibilities

Ecommerce, Trading & Digital Growth

  • Manage the commercial performance of Hårklinikken’s global ecommerce business across six Shopify websites.
  • Monitor and optimise key ecommerce KPIs including revenue, acquisition, conversion, AOV, retention, LTV, CAC and profitability.
  • Oversee performance marketing across paid media, affiliate and other acquisition channels in close collaboration with external partners.
  • Manage and prioritise CRO initiatives across the funnel, markets and product portfolio.
  • Use data and customer insights to support commercial decision-making and prioritisation.
  • Work closely with Brand & Marketing to ensure ecommerce and performance activity is both commercially effective and consistent with the Hårklinikken brand.
  • Support and manage relationships with relevant e-tailers and digital commercial partners.



CRM, Retention & Customer Lifetime Value

  • Oversee Hårklinikken’s CRM and retention activities across markets.
  • Ensure lifecycle journeys, segmentation, loyalty, subscription and retention initiatives are being executed and optimised effectively.
  • Ensure CRM insights are actively used to inform ecommerce, marketing and customer experience initiatives.



Website, CRO & Development

  • Manage and prioritise the ecommerce development roadmap together with our third-party technology partners.
  • Ensure development projects are clearly scoped, prioritised and delivered on time.
  • Drive ongoing optimisation of website functionality, user experience and transactional performance.
  • Support implementation of new tools, functionality and integrations where relevant.



Project Management & Execution

  • Drive key ecommerce and digital projects from brief through implementation.
  • Create clear visibility across ongoing initiatives, timelines, responsibilities and deliverables.
  • Coordinate internal teams and external partners to ensure projects stay on track.
  • Provide clear and regular performance and project updates to relevant stakeholders.



Digital Customer Experience

  • Help ensure Hårklinikken’s digital customer experience reflects the premium and personalised nature of the brand.
  • Use customer feedback, web analytics, CRM data, social insights and A/B testing to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Work closely with Creative, Design, Video and Copy teams to brief and implement relevant content across paid and owned digital channels.



Agency & Partner Management

  • Act as the senior day-to-day contact for key ecommerce, development and performance marketing agencies.
  • Ensure agencies and partners have clear briefs, KPIs, priorities and deadlines.
  • Hold external partners accountable for agreed deliverables and performance.



What Success Looks Like

You quickly establish a clear overview of the ecommerce business and bring structure, momentum and strong execution across key digital initiatives.


Commercial performance is closely monitored, opportunities are identified and acted upon, and key projects move forward with clear ownership and timelines.


Internal teams and external partners are aligned around the right priorities, and you help ensure that the ecommerce business continues to perform and develop throughout the interim period.


Core Competencies & Experience

This is a challenging and exciting role that requires the experience and insight to build the right strategies and tactics within digital commerce. At the same time, you must enjoy – and take pride in – turning those strategies into action, delivering at pace and with a high level of quality.


The role requires broad experience across areas such as CRM, ecommerce trading and customer journey optimisation, media agency management, and third-party digital marketplaces.


You don’t need to tick every box to be the right fit. We’d love to hear from you if you bring solid experience within ecommerce and paid media, combined with an ambitious mindset, high learning agility and a strong can-do attitude.


  • A strong track record within ecommerce, ideally across multiple international markets.
  • Strong commercial acumen and experience managing or significantly influencing ecommerce performance and P&L.
  • Broad experience across several of the following disciplines: ecommerce, testing/CRO, paid media, customer acquisition and CRM.
  • Experience with subscription-based and omnichannel revenue models is advantageous, but not essential.
  • Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to translate data into clear priorities and actions.
  • Good understanding of key ecommerce metrics including conversion, AOV, CAC, LTV, retention and profitability.
  • Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • Comfortable managing agencies, developers and external partners.
  • Hands-on knowledge of platforms such as Shopify, GA360/GA4, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads and Klaviyo.
  • A resilient, proactive and entrepreneurial mindset with a strong bias towards action.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment where priorities can evolve quickly.
  • Experience working with premium or luxury consumers, personalised services, beauty, wellness or adjacent categories is highly relevant.
  • International experience is preferred, with specific experience in the US market considered a significant advantage.


Timing & Application

We are looking to have this interim role in place quickly, so if this sounds like you, we encourage you to reach out sooner rather than later. We will be meeting candidates on a rolling basis and will close the process as soon as we find the right person. The ability to start quickly is therefore important.


Who Are We?

Founded in 1992 in Copenhagen, Hårklinikken’s award-winning treatment regimen is expert-formulated to help clients achieve optimal scalp health and long-lasting hair gain with product blends rich in potent botanicals.


We’ve masterminded a diagnostic approach to hair health known as The Hårklinikken Method. Beginning with a consultation – conducted virtually or in-person at one of our clinics in New York, Beverly Hills, Copenhagen, Aarhus, Dubai, or Reykjavik – our specialists create a regimen of Hårklinikken essentials, personalised to each client’s individual needs.


We’re on a mission to help as many people as possible achieve fuller, stronger, healthier hair with restorative products that optimise conditions for hair growth.


Our work environment includes:

  • Modern clinics with maximum focus on quality and aesthetics
  • Safe work environment
  • International workforce
  • Growth opportunities
  • A flexible hybrid working policy
  • Pension contributions
  • Holiday allowance
  • Discounts and allowances on products and treatments


Equal Employment Opportunities
We offer equal employment opportunity to qualified individuals without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We strongly believe that cultivating a diverse workplace gives a company strength. The combination of unique skills, abilities, experiences, and backgrounds creates an environment that produces extraordinary results.

Working collaboratively with the Centre Leadership Team and educators, you will provide curriculum leadership and support the delivery of high-quality education and care programs that respond to the individual needs, interests and development of each child.


South Coast Baptist College is an independent, co-educational school and childcare serving families in Perth's southern metropolitan region and beyond. The College provides inspired, innovative, and exemplary Christian care and education, empowering students to reach their purpose.

title: Outpatient Program Manager
description:
Application Timeline: This position will be posted beginning March 9, 2026 and will remain open until March 30, 2026. Applications will be reviewed after the closing date, and interviews will be scheduled shortly thereafter.




MISSION STATEMENT:

We say yes to people seeking help with addiction and mental health. We create pathways to recovery and purpose. We provide the right service at the right time, delivered by people with lived experience. We transform behavioral health systems through innovation, creativity and collaboration.

Job Description:

The Outpatient Program Manager provides clinical and operational oversight of outpatient behavioral health services, supervising counselors and case managers to ensure high-quality, compliant care. This role facilitates clinical meetings, conducts assessments and outpatient assessment reviews, and provides individual, group, and collateral interventions using evidence-based practices. The Program Manager supports treatment planning, crisis intervention, and coordination of care while ensuring adherence to state regulations, ethical standards,

and organizational policies. Responsibilities include monitoring documentation and billing in OPUS, reviewing client progress using diagnostic and rating tools, coordinating referrals and community resources, and supporting staff competency through supervision and training. The position requires collaboration across interdisciplinary teams to maintain effective program operations and ensure that services are responsive to client needs related to mental health and substance use disorders.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provides oversight of the duties and responsibilities of counselors and case managers
  • Provides supervision to clinicians for competency and compliance in their roles
  • Provides supervision to case managers
  • Facilitate clinical meetings in collaboration with lead counselor
  • Conducts clinical interviews and assessments; gathers information for diagnostic and treatment planning purposes, as needed.
  • Conducts outpatient assessment reviews.
  • Provides interventions using evidence-based techniques and methodologies approved by the department.
  • Provides individual, group therapy and collateral interventions; provides an atmosphere of trust and safety.
  • Provides crisis intervention to clients who are in apparent emotional distress.
  • Provides referrals to community agencies and providers for support or additional services.
  • Assures compliance with State Regulations, legal requirements and established Borough policies and procedures related to behavioral health services.
  • Assist patients in locating resources by contacting appropriate agencies over the phone and in person; coordinate with other agencies concerning referrals of mental health cases; arrange for hospitalization for mental patients requiring inpatient care.
  • Uses a variety of diagnostic and rating tools to evaluate client progress, effectiveness of intervention and/or to assist treatment planning.
  • Participates in the development of treatment plans for clients to alleviate current areas of impairment; assures that treatment plans have problem solving objectives. Serves as service coordinator as assigned.
  • Documents daily interventions provided for clients; efficiently documents all billable interactions into OPUS, utilizing DAP note formatting.
  • Participates in weekly clinical supervision and follows training guidelines and instructions as provided by the clinical supervisor.
  • Attends and participates in team meetings where current cases are reviewed; reviews cases with social and community agencies as appropriate; adheres to applicable confidentiality laws and regulations.
  • Maintain case records including agency forms, documentation sheets, timecards and related forms concerning cases.
  • Performs related duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

  • Master’s degree in social work, counseling, psychology or related field preferred, with the ability to complete, preferred.
  • Combination of education, experience and licensure accepted.
  • Active license preferred; must be eligible for a license (supervision complete) and obtain license within one year upon hire.
  • Must have a CDC II/ CDC S; or must obtain within 3 years of hire.
  • Experience in substance abuse or mental health field including:
  • Delivering direct individual and group services.
  • Conduct assessments utilizing the DSM-5 and ASAM criteria.
  • Create individualized treatment plans addressing mental health and substance use issues.
  • Treatment team participation.
  • Crisis intervention skills.
  • Case management.
  • Adhere to ethical guidelines of related profession.
  • Maintain CEUs needed for licensure and continued professionalism.
  • Establish and maintain therapeutic boundaries.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Basic computer skills and fluid use of electronic communication tools.
  • Administer UAs and breathalyzers as needed.
  • Participate as part of an interdisciplinary team to address clinical concerns relating to the clients.
  • Receive direct supervision from eligible supervisors as qualified by State standards of the profession.

PREFERRED SKILLS



  • Principles and practices of modern clinical psychology, individual, group and family therapy techniques.
  • Basic understanding of mental health disorders as defined in DSM 5 codes.
  • Basic understanding of substance abuse level of care as defined by ASAM.
  • Crisis intervention principles.
  • Knowledge of patient’s rights and behavioral health regulations.
  • Research methods and report writing techniques.
  • Laws, rules and regulations related to assigned activities.
  • Oral and written communication skills.
  • Correct English usage, grammar, spelling, punctuation and vocabulary.
  • Policies and objectives of assigned program and activities.
  • Health and safety regulations.
  • Substance abuse and addiction.
  • Utilize Interpersonal skills using tact, patience and courtesy.
  • Provide individual, group and family therapy sessions.
  • Diagnose and treat mental disorders and establish treatment plans.
  • Establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with others.
  • Compile and verify data and prepare reports.
  • Prioritize and schedule work.
  • Maintain current knowledge of program rules, regulations, policies and procedures.
  • Analyze situations accurately and adopt an effective course of action.
  • Plan and organize.
  • Clinicians may be exposed to abusive and potentially dangerous behavior from unstable individuals.



COMPETENCIES

  • Assessing Strengths and Needs
  • Planning Services
  • Providing Services
  • Linking to Resources
  • Advocating
  • Individualizing Care
  • Documenting

When working outdoors or at a job site the employee may be exposed to construction equipment or other moving objects/equipment; reference job site specifics. The employee is occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 50 lbs. Employee is frequently required to sit, stand, walk, talk/hear, see, read, and personally interact with others.

title: Business Fulfillment Coordinator (Internal Only)
description:

title: Financial Data Analyst
description:
Tech Soft 3D is the leading provider of engineering software development toolkits and enterprise applications for CAD/CAE data conversion, visualization and data publishing.

We’re looking for a Financial Data Analyst to lead the automation and optimisation of key reconciliation and reporting processes at Tech Soft 3D. With a primary focus on US Health Benefits, finance accounting, and NetSuite-based workflows.

The individual in this role brings a balance of finance acumen and technical expertise, partnering closely with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver scalable, audit-ready solutions in a dynamic, collaborative hybrid environment.

We are looking for candidates located, in or close to Lyon since the role is either hybrid or in-office

What You’ll Do:

  • US Health Benefit reconciliation automation: Design, build, and maintain automated reconciliation processes for US Health Benefits at both the employee and health carrier level, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
  • Finance & accounting reconciliation automation: Identify manual reconciliation activities across finance and accounting workflows and implement scalable, automated solutions to improve efficiency and reduce risk of error.
  • Financial reporting & variance analysis: Support the update of the monthly financial reporting package and perform analysis of main variances.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with HR, Accounting, and FP&A stakeholders to gather requirements, validate data quality, and continuously improve financial processes.
  • Documentation & controls: Document automated processes, maintain reconciliation logs, and support internal control and audit requirements.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 5 years of professional experience in finance, accounting, or financial data analysis, including at least 1 year directly relevant to this role (finance automation, reconciliation, NetSuite, or financial reporting).
  • Strong Excel skills — advanced formulas, pivot tables, Power Query — and experience leveraging AI tools such as Claude to improve productivity and automate repetitive tasks.
  • Hands-on NetSuite experience including saved searches, workflows, and NetSuite automation.
  • Solid understanding of accounting principles, reconciliation methodologies, and financial close processes.
  • Strong analytical mindset with high attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Familiarity with US Health Benefits administration or health carrier billing processes.
  • Experience with Power BI or other data visualisation tools.
  • Curiosity for process automation, finance transformation, and continuous improvement.
  • Prior exposure to multi-entity consolidation in NetSuite, including FX translation and intercompany eliminations.
  • Experience working in an international company.
  • Fluency in both French and English.

Reasons to Not Apply:
We believe in matching great talent with the right roles. You might want to pass on this opportunity if:

  • You prefer a slow-paced environment that resists change
  • You expect rigid job boundaries and minimal cross-team collaboration
  • You’re uncomfortable working across global time zones or adapting to evolving priorities
  • You prefer highly structured oversight over autonomous, results-driven work

Benefits and Other Cool Stuff:
Our employees enjoy a complete benefit package, health coverage, bonus potential, exceptional paid time off and holidays, and generous parental leave. Not to mention, the cool perks you get as a “Techsoftian”… fun culture, a relaxed and inclusive environment, outstanding leadership, continuous learning and growth opportunities, flexible daily schedules, a charitable donation matching program, home office reimbursement, monthly internet allowance, and an amazing employee recognition program (winners get an all-expense trip anywhere in the world!).

The salary for this role is based on experience, education, and skills.

As our Co-Founder, Ron Fritz, says: “You almost can’t walk down the street and see a man-made thing that somehow hasn’t been touched by Tech Soft 3D technology. That makes me feel great.”

title: Laboratory Assistant - Seasonal
description:

title: Cellar Door Host
description:
Join the newly awarded Michelin star team at Amisfield, an enchanting world where vineyard and restaurant unite in taste and terrior. Nestled amidst the breath-taking landscapes of Central Otago, New Zealand, Amisfield is not just a place – it's an experience. As pioneers in sustainable winemaking, our commitment to organic practices and preserving the land runs deep in every vine and dish we craft. Our focus is on embodying the flavours of Central Otago in an innovative and modern way.


Embark on an adventure of the senses with us as we uncork the spirit of Amisfield, one sip and bite at a time.


About the Role


We’re looking for a passionate, engaging Cellar Door Host to join our dynamic team.


This is a hands-on, guest-facing role where you’ll bring our wines to life — guiding visitors through tastings, sharing our story, and turning every guest into an Amisfield ambassador.


You’ll receive wine and sales training, and work with the rest of the team to achieve cellar door targets. You’ll also gain insight into our winemaking, viticulture, and restaurant operations — an incredible opportunity to grow your knowledge and career in the wine industry.


About Amisfield

We are a Central Otago icon — a 92-hectare, single-vineyard estate producing world-class Pinot Noir and aromatic whites with remarkable characteristics. And we’re proud to be recognised as:

  • Michelin Star — awarded to our restaurant
  • Riedel Vineyard of the Year – Aotearoa Organic Wine Awards 2024
  • Sustainable Vineyard of the Year – NZ Organic Wine Awards 2023
  • Winery of the Year in both 2022 and 2020


Key Responsibilities

  • Welcome and host guests, delivering exceptional and engaging wine tasting experiences.
  • Lead the Amisfield Cellar Door Experience, Masterclasses and Private Bespoke Tastings.
  • Share your passion and knowledge of Amisfield wines, our story and Central Otago with customers.
  • Drive wine sales, grow Wine Club membership and build strong, lasting customer relationships.
  • Manage bookings, customer enquiries and follow-up communications to create a seamless guest experience.
  • Support direct-to-consumer wine sales, including order processing, customer follow-up and dispatch.
  • Maintain a beautifully presented Cellar Door while overseeing stock, daily sales and operational requirements.

About You

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has a genuine love of wine and a thirst to learn more.
  • Enjoys engaging with people from all over the world and creating memorable experiences.
  • Is confident and compelling when it comes to selling our wine.
  • Is a proactive and positive team player with strong communication and organisational skills.
  • Passionate about and committed to the hospitality industry.
  • (Bonus!) Have a WSET qualification, Duty Manager’s Certificate, or CRM experience.


What We Offer


  • The opportunity to work within one of New Zealand's leading restaurant and wine businesses.
  • A professional and supportive environment with a strong focus on quality and development.
  • Successful candidates will be offered competitive remuneration + the opportunity to earn commission, great working hours and the opportunity to progress in their career. The role is full-time permanent, with a minimum of 30 hours guaranteed per week, with flexibility to work rostered shifts, including weekends and public holidays.


And there’s a barrel of additional benefits to working as part of this team – you won’t be fighting the traffic, there’s free parking on-site, healthcare cover, staff discounts on our products and services, wellbeing support, and free staff meals.


This position is available for an immediate start.

If you’re ready to share your passion for wine, connect with guests from around the world, and be part of an exceptional team — we’d love to hear from you. Apply HERE

title: Associate Director/Director, GMP QA & Compliance
description:
Associate Director/Director, GMP QA & Compliance

About Climb:

Climb Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing therapeutics for patients with immune-mediated diseases. Our product candidates include, budoprutug, an anti-CD19 monoclonal antibody that presents us with an exciting opportunity given its broad potential applicability across a number of B-cell mediated diseases, including primary membranous nephropathy, systemic lupus erythematosus, and immune thrombocytopenia and CLYM116, an anti-APRIL monoclonal antibody in development for IgA nephropathy.

At Climb Bio, our team has a knack for seeing what no one else sees—and a drive to achieve results no one expects. We believe that our combined strength conquers any summit, and our core values – Build Trust, Decide & Commit, Accelerate Impact, and Mark the Moment – guide how we work, collaborate, and innovate. They reflect our commitment to patients, each other, and the pursuit of transformative science.

We are seeking a highly motivated Associate Director/Director, GMP Quality and Compliance. Reporting to the VP, Head of Quality. This is a critical, high-visibility position accountable for the quality and compliance of our investigational products from manufacturing through regulatory submission, and for designing a GMP quality and compliance program that scales to multi-region Phase 3 supply and, ultimately, commercial launch. As a leader within the Quality organization, the successful candidate will build, lead and develop Climb Bio’s internal GMP QA team, direct consulting resources, and establish the trusted relationships.

Key Responsibilities:



GMP Quality Operations:

  • Serve as the GMP Quality leader for the Climb Bio portfolio, overseeing quality operations across drug substance (DS), drug product (DP), and investigational product (IP) activities, and building, leading and developing GMP QA capability – both internal staff and consulting resources.
  • Partner with CMC on technology transfer, process validation, and scale-up activities, working as an embedded, solutions-oriented partner from campaign planning through execution.
  • Function as the Quality subject matter expert (SME) and trusted advisor to the CMC organization providing guidance on GMP requirements, risk assessments, and quality decision-making, and earning the credibility to influence outcomes and shape decisions both internally and with external partners.
  • Own DS, DP, and IP labelling review and disposition for global clinical supply, ensuring accuracy and compliance with approved labelling requirements and applicable regulations across multiple regions and countries, including EU and ex-US requirements.
  • Build and maintain an effective working relationship with the external Qualified Person (QP), coordinating EU and ex-US certification and release and ensuring supply chain, documentation and disposition requirements are met for global clinical distribution.
  • Ensure combination product quality activities are completed in compliance with 21 CFR 820 including design document review and device vendor audits, utilizing consulting resources as needed.
  • Contributes to and review CMC content and quality sections of regulatory submissions (e.g., IND/BB/IMPD), partnering with Regulatory Affairs and CMC teams to support data integrity and submission readiness.
  • Own GMP inspection readiness – including document and data readiness, storyboards, subject matter expert preparation, and mock inspections – and host GMP regulatory agency and partner inspections.
  • Design and continuously improve the GMP QA program for Phase 3 and commercial readiness, including phase-appropriate procedures, quality risk management input, and the build-out of GMP QA resourcing.
  • Develop and deliver GMP training; author and approve GMP SOPs, specifications and quality agreements in partnership with the Quality Management Systems function.

Quality Compliance

  • Act as the GMP Quality representative to the Climb Bio organization – on cross-functional program teams, and governance forums– providing risk-based input on quality strategy and compliance matters and translating regulatory expectation into practical guidance the business can act on.
  • Own the vendor quality management program, ensuring all vendors are qualified, quality agreements are in place, auditing/requalification programs are in place, and supplier performance is monitored – while cultivating collaborative, performance-focused relationships with CMOs, contract laboratories and other partners so that issues surface early and are resolved jointly rather than escalated late.
  • Select, qualify and manage third-party and partnering audit firms that execute audits, maintaining a pre-qualified panel of audit partners and ensuring on-time audit delivery, timely response to observations and closure of resulting CAPA.
  • Generate and report quality and vendor performance metrics to Quality Management Review (QMR), escalating compliance risks and adverse trends to the VP, Head of Quality.
  • Lead quality escalations, negotiations and issue resolution with external partners – including quality agreement negotiation, joint quality councils and periodic business reviews – representing Climb Bio’s position with clarity, diplomacy and a firm compliance line.
  • Serve as a member of the Quality leadership team, contributing to functional strategy, resourcing, budget and hiring decisions, and partnering with peers in Quality Control, Quality Management Systems and Clinical Quality to present one consistent Quality voice to the business.
  • Champion a positive, phase-appropriate quality culture across Climb Bio and its partners – modelling the Company’s values, encouraging open escalation of issues without blame, and helping colleagues understand the intent behind GxP requirements rather than only the rule.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a scientific, engineering, or related discipline.
  • 8–14+ years of progressive GMP quality assurance experience in biotech or pharma, including clinical-stage DS/DP manufacturing and investigational product management; Phase 3 and/or commercial experience strongly preferred. Level commensurate with demonstrated experience.
  • Working knowledge of FDA and international GMP regulations, including IND (and/or BLA) submission support.
  • Demonstrated people leadership – hiring, coaching, developing and retaining quality staff and directing consultants and external service providers – with proven ability to lead independently in a lean organization, owning broad scope and building the structure and resourcing to support it as the company grows.
  • A credible communicator and strong problem solver who makes complex compliance matters clear to senior leadership, cross-functional partners and inspectors — and aligns them behind a course of action.
  • Track record of building trust-based relationships with CMOs, contract laboratories, Qualified Persons and audit firms, and influencing their behavior and performance.
  • Ability to make and defend difficult quality decisions under inspection, supply and timeline pressure, balancing compliance rigor with pragmatic, collaborative resolution.
  • Experience leading GMP inspection readiness and hosting regulatory agency inspections.
  • Experience supporting global clinical supply – multi-region IP labelling, import/export and distribution – and working with an external Qualified Person for EU/ex-US certification and release.
  • Working knowledge of 21 CFR 820 / ISO 13485 and combination product requirements preferred.
  • Ability to travel approximately 20 - 30%

This role is a hybrid role based out of our office in Wellesley, MA.

Base salary offered may vary depending on individual’s skills, experience, and competitive market value.

  • Salary Range:
    • Associate Director: $158,000-$200,000
    • Director: $187,000-$230,000

Additional total rewards include discretionary annual bonus, comprehensive benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, short-term and long-term disability, company paid basic life insurance, 401k company match, generous paid time off and paid holiday, and stock options.

Climb is a publicly traded company. For more information, please visit climbbio.com.

Climb is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, place of origin, religion, family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and disability or any other federal, state, provincial or local protected ground.

title: Automotive Tech - Entry Level
description:

That’s Nice, But What’s the Job?

  • Wellness Program. Health is wealth! This program includes self-guided coaching and journeys, cash incentives and discounts on your medical premiums through engaging in fun activities!

  • No Weekends, No Problems. Take it easy on the weekends (the only exception is during our peak season when business is booming).
  • Paid Time Off. Not just lip service: we work hard, to play hard! Paid time off includes (for all full-time roles) wellness days, holidays, and good ole' fashioned YOU time! For our Part-timers, don't fear you get some time too...vacation time is available - the more you work, the more you earn!

Anything Else? Absolutely.

DriveTime Family of Brands is Great Place to Work Certified! And get this: 90% of our rockstar employees say they feel right at home here. We could spend a lot of time having you read about ALL our awards, but we’ll save time (and practice some humility) just naming a few others; Comparably Awards: Best Company for Diversity, Best Company Culture and Best Company Leadership, oh and don’t forget Phoenix Business Journal Healthiest Employers (okay, we’ll stop there)!

And when it comes to hiring, we don't just look for the right person for the job, we seek out the right person for DriveTime. Buckle up for plenty of opportunities to grow in a professional, fun, and high-energy environment!

title: SUE Technician III
description:
Founded in 1995, JBPro is one of the leading site development design and consulting firms in North Florida. Approaching our fourth decade of service, we remain dedicated to our passion for client advocacy and community development. We prioritize quality work and client advocacy, ensuring we make a positive impact on the communities we serve.

At JBPro, we believe that our greatest strength lies in our people. We are committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment where every employee feels valued and motivated to excel. Our team members are more than just colleagues; they are family.

Join the JBPro family, where your efforts are valued, your development is supported, and your work truly makes a difference.

Position Overview:

The SUE Technician III is responsible for complex utility investigations, safe and efficient field execution, and the quality of information returned to JBPro's project teams. This role assists in selecting appropriate investigation methods, performs field quality control, and serves as a primary field contact on assigned projects.

What You’ll Do:

  • Supports complex multi-utility investigations using electromagnetic methods, GPR, sondes, sewer cameras, vacuum excavation, test-hole equipment, and complementary investigative techniques.
  • Direct and participate in Quality Level B designation and Quality Level A physical exposure work; support records research and surveyed surface-feature collection needed for a complete investigation.
  • Interpret conflicting or incomplete records and field evidence; troubleshoot difficult locates, identify uncertainty, and recommend additional investigation or escalation.
  • Assist in coordinating daily crew activities, conducting job briefings, monitoring productivity, and verifying compliance with safety, traffic-control, and equipment procedures.
  • Review field notes, sketches, photographs, measurements, test-hole logs, electronic files, and markings for completeness and accuracy before submittal.
  • Mentor Level I and II technicians in locating theory, safe excavation, equipment care, field judgment, documentation, and customer communication.
  • Occasionally serves as the field point of contact for clients, contractors, utility owners, survey crews, and JBPro project managers; communicate schedule changes, conflicts, hazards, and scope impacts promptly.
  • Protect, inspect, troubleshoot, and coordinate maintenance for assigned vehicles, vacuum systems, geophysical equipment, and safety gear.

Requirements

  • Five or more years of progressive SUE or advanced private utility locating experience, including demonstrated responsibility for complex investigations and field crew coordination; equivalent utility, survey, or construction experience may be considered when paired with advanced locating proficiency.
  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Working knowledge of underground utility systems, utility records, engineering plans, and standard utility color codes.
  • Hands-on skill with electromagnetic, GPR, and vacuum excavation equipment is required.
  • Ability to prepare complete, legible field notes, sketches, photographs, measurements, and electronic records.
  • Valid driver's license and an acceptable driving record.
  • Demonstrated ability to train others, make safe stop-work decisions, and deliver accurate work with limited supervision.
  • Strong applied knowledge of ASCE 38 quality levels, utility investigation limitations, field quality control, and documentation practices.
  • CDL, DOT medical card, OSHA 30, advanced Maintenance of Traffic/Temporary Traffic Control, First Aid/CPR, confined-space, competent-person, or vacuum-excavation qualifications are preferred as applicable to JBPro's equipment and contracts.
  • OSHA 10, Maintenance of Traffic/Temporary Traffic Control, First Aid/CPR, confined-space, competent-person, or vacuum-excavation training is preferred; ability to obtain assigned certifications after hire is required.

Benefits

  • Competitive Pay!
  • Opportunity for Career Advancement
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401K with a 3% match, plus profit sharing
  • PTO up to 4 weeks depending on years of experience
  • 9 Paid Company Holidays
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Employee Referral Program

title: Customer Experience Associate
description:
